articleTitle: Fibered laser system for atom interferometers based on telecom technology at 1560 nm and frequency doubling
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a compact and reliable laser system for onboard atom interferometers using rubidium. Our system is based on the frequency doubling of a telecom fiber bench at 1560 nm.

articleTitle: All fiber wavelength tunable bandpass filter for optical inter-connections
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose an all-fiber wavelength tunable bandpass filter with multi-mode to single-mode converting property via serially concatenated structure of a helicoidal long-period fiber grating (HLPFG), a hollow optical fiber (HOF), and a multimode fiber (MMF).

articleTitle: Raman microspectroscopy of melanosomes in RPE cells: The effect of light irradiation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Raman microspectroscopy is used for the first time to study chemical and structural transformations in RPE cells exposed to cw and short-pulsed high-intensity light irradiation.

articleTitle: Tensorial inhomogeneities in the nonlinear responses of an array of gold nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We use nonlinear microscopy to measure second- and third-harmonic generation from gold nanodots in an array. The polarization-dependent responses exhibit strong variations between individual dots, providing evidence of tensorial inhomogeneities in the nonlinearity.

articleTitle: High-order harmonics from targets containing an abundance of metal nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generate high-order harmonics from ablation plasma containing an abundance of nanoparticles. Results show that the use of nanoparticles targets enhances the harmonic intensity, and also shifts the harmonic spectrum in wavelength.

articleTitle: Dual-concentric-core microstructured optical fiber with selective filling of hole for chromatic dispersion compensation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose three designs of microstructured optical fibers for chromatic dispersion compensation. Dispersion of -3500, -25000, and -135000 ps/nm/km were obtained with FWHM of ~30 nm, ~6 nm, and ~2 nm, respectively.

articleTitle: Vacuum-free hard x-rays driven by high-field pulses from a femtosecond fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A compact vacuum-free hard x-ray source based on high-field pulses from a femtosecond fiber laser interacting with nickel in gently flowing helium is demonstrated. K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</inf> x-ray conversion efficiency is 1.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup>.

articleTitle: Passively synchronized two-color polarization additive pulse mode-locked fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Passive synchronization and polarization additive pulse mode-locking techniques are combined to generate simultaneously the 1.03 mum and 1.53 mum ultrashort pulses at the same pulse repetition rates from synchronized Yb-fiber and Er-fiber mode-locked lasers.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional photonic crystal microcavity sensor for single particle detection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally demonstrate a compact silicon photonic crystal microcavity sensor capable of detecting in vivo a single particle of size comparable to a virus.

articleTitle: Nearly-octave broadband, high-powered optical parametric amplification toward monocycle regime
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated the generation of 34-μJ, 14-fs optical pulses with an ultrabroad bandwidth (540 – 1000 nm) by the use of one angularly-dispersed non-collinear optical parametric amplifier.

articleTitle: Polymer photonic crystal band edge lasers for evanescent wave sensing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Two different effects of opto fluidic tuning of polymer photonic crystal band edge lasers are demonstrated. A device symmetry different from that of the photonic crystal is imposed by the global shape of the device. This causes the device to emit in fewer directions, and the relative intensities of these signals depend on cladding refractive index. The wavelength of the emission in any direction depends on cladding refractive index with a sensitivity of 1 nm per 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> refractive index units.

articleTitle: Angular dimensionality of two-photon entanglement
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We pass twin-photons through rotatable angular phase plates, and detect entanglement that has a continuously variable angular dimensionality D. Experimentally, D was varied from 2 to 6 and values up to 50 are practically feasible.

articleTitle: The physics of high-order harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This tutorial will describe the field of high-order harmonics in gases, including attosecond pulse generation.

Author Keywords: (020.2649) Atomic and molecular physics : Strong field laser physics

articleTitle: Fabrication of high aspect ratio microfluidic devices using direct fs ablation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a single stage direct fs ablation results which show that it is possible to make high quality and high aspect ratio devices in a single stage process using a CAD optimised approach.

articleTitle: Enhancement of laser-induced gratings diffraction efficiency by forcing molecular rotation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: For the first time to our knowledge, thermal laser-induced gratings (LIGs) are generated via two-photon stimulated Raman excitation of pure rotational transitions in molecules employing a single broadband pump laser.

articleTitle: Nonlinear femtosecond pulse reshaping in waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe nonlinear pulse reshaping of femtosecond pulses propagating in a waveguide array. The reshaping is due to non-linear coupling between waveguides. The output temporal width shows power-dependent pulse shortening.

articleTitle: Enhanced slow-light effect by combining broadband SBS system and off-resonance FBG
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a technique for improving the pulse-delay performance of stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) based slow-light system by combining it with a fiber Bragg grating (FBG) under distortion and system resource constraints.

articleTitle: Manipulating nonlinear optical response from electron spins in a 2D electron gas via exciton injection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using a two-color, three-pulse differential transmission technique, we manipulate nonlinear optical processes of electron spins in a modulation-doped CdTe quantum well through exciton injection. The spin manipulation takes place without optical spin rotation.

articleTitle: Micro-concentrator for vanadium nanorods by efficient light-induced convective flow
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Avalanche concentration, a rapid long-range accumulation of particles around a laser spot in a liquid sample, is demonstrated and characterized for VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanorods. The effect is found to be driven by a convective flow in the sample, caused by efficient heating of VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>] nanorods that transition from insulator to metal within the laser spot.

articleTitle: Quantum Coherent Effects with Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We review the results of the work done on coherent effects in hollow-core photonic crystal fibers. These include generation of electromagnetically induced transparency and saturable absorption spectroscopy in molecular gases and atomic vapours.

articleTitle: InGaN-GaNAs type-II ’W’ quantum well lasers for emission at 450-nm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Type-II InGaN-GaNAs quantum well gain media is analyzed for lasers emitting at 450-nm. Optical gain analysis, using 6-band k.p formalism, show 3-times improvement and 40% reduction in threshold current.

articleTitle: High-precision characterization of dynamic acoustic grating induced by stimulated Brillouin scattering in a high-birefringence optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel experimental method is demonstrated to precisely characterize optical-frequency deviation within plusmn4 MHz between orthogonal axes in a high-birefringence fiber arising from the SBS-induced dynamic acoustic-grating. This precision means a birefringence accuracy of 3times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup>.

articleTitle: Lateral dynamics of lattice solitons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We derive an analytic formula for the lateral dynamics of solitons in a general inhomogeneous nonlinear media and demonstrate numerically that it can be valid for tens of diffraction lengths.

articleTitle: Ultrafast spin dynamics in colloidal ZnO quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We perform time-resolved Faraday rotation measurements on colloidal ZnO quantum dots. A biexponential decay of the dephasing time T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> of the electron spins governed by competing recombination processes is observed.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Second-harmonic generation in periodically poled lithium tantalate crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The fabrication of periodic poled Lithium Tantalate single crystal fibers by the laser heated pedestal growth method were achieved with in-situ monitoring of transient poling current. The whole cross section of the fiber is poled through as seen from the confocal measurement.

articleTitle: Short wavelength extension of CW-pumped supercontinuum at 1 micron
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a CW supercontinuum pumped at 1 mum which extends short of the pump wavelength to 0.6 mum. Four-wave mixing is believed to be a major process for the short wavelength generation.

articleTitle: Single quantum dot spectroscopy in a cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A photonic crystal slab nanocavity with a single InAs quantum dot in a field antinode is a promising system for cavity QED because of the cavitypsilas small volume and the dotpsilas stationary position.

articleTitle: Asynchronous optical probing of coherent magnetic excitations from picoseconds to nanoseconds
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Thermoreflectance and coherent spin dynamics in Fe films are measured using asynchronous optical sampling at kilohertz rates. We observe ultrafast laser-induced time dependence of spin precession frequencies that is attributed to thermal relaxation.

articleTitle: Seed pulse optimization for saturated fiber-amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The optimum seed pulse-profile for a desired output pulse-profile in saturated ns-pulsed fiber-amplifiers is determined with an analytical solution for the amplification process. It can be regarded as an inverse Frantz-Nodvik-equation for the seed photon-density.

articleTitle: Multi-slot silicon optical waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe, fabricate and demonstrate multi-slotted silicon nanophotonic waveguides, comprised of four low index slots etched longitudinally along the waveguide. The computed modal profiles are well described by supermode theory. We have measured the group index of refraction of the waveguide in the TE and TM polarizations.

articleTitle: High quality telecom-band polarization-entangled photon-pairs from a stable, pulse-pumped, short PPLN waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-stable, pulse-pumped source of telecom-band polarization-entangled photon-pairs using 1-mm-long PPLN waveguide placed in a polarization-diversity fiber-loop without temperature control. Full tomographic characterization confirms a purity higher than 0.94 and fidelity exceeding 0.96.

articleTitle: Dy3+ and Pr3+ doped crystals for mid-IR lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Here is presented a review of rare-earth doped crystals wherein mid-IR oscillation is demonstrated. Advantages and disadvantages of low phonon matrixes are examined.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Nonlinear hofstadter butterfly and its optical realization
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the extended modes of a nonlinear quasi-periodic system and show that the nonlinear spectra are deformed versions of the Hofstadter butterfly. An optical realization of the Hofstadter butterfly is proposed.

articleTitle: Nanofabrication of sub-wavelength grating using ultra-fine nano-machining process
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the nanofabrication of sub-wavelength grating using ultra-fine nano-machining process. We successfully demonstrate the nano-machining fabrication of 20 nm grating pitch for nano-structured photonic devices, which is also used for thermal nano-imprint mold.

articleTitle: The effect (or lack of it) of an ultrashort pulse’s spatial profile on the single-shot measurement of its temporal profile
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A non-uniform spatial profile could distort single-shot pulse measurements. But, surprisingly, we show that these effects are significantly reduced by several fortuitous aspects of the GRENOUILLE technique and so usually have little effect in practice.

articleTitle: Efficient conversion of light from sparse laser arrays into single-lobed far-fields using phase structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a new optical technique that converts light from a sparse array of mutually coherent sources into a single-lobed far-field with a theoretical efficiency approaching 100%. Initial experimental results show conversion efficiencies of 82%.

articleTitle: Interface quality control of monolithic photonic crystals by hydrogen annealing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that the optical characteristics of silicon photonic crystals can be modified by hydrogen annealing. Hydrogen annealed PCs show reduced surface roughness and improved structural uniformity, leading to increased reflectivity and sharper resonance peaks.

articleTitle: Influence of class-B to class-A transition on relative intensity noise in semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The transitional regime from class-B to class-A dynamics in semiconductor lasers presents a non-resonant second order filtering behaviour. Compared to the transitional regime, class-A operation provides a very effective noise filtering especially at low frequencies.

articleTitle: Properties of hard x-rays generated by femtosecond laser interaction with Cu in a laminar helium flow in ambient air
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Hard x-rays are generated in laminar helium flow in atmosphere by tightly focused 35fs-3mJ laser pulses interacting with Cu. Spectrum, efficiency and source size are compared with those measured in vacuum and in static helium.

articleTitle: In-line holography for the 3D reconstruction of laser pulse filamentation in transparent media
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In-line holographic microscopy is used to retrieve the 3D distribution of the refractive index perturbation, resulting from the nonlinear propagation of 35fs IR pulses in transparent media, including the Kerr effect and plasma strings.

articleTitle: Extending the tunability and spectral narrowing of Ti:Sapphire oscillator via Volume Bragg Grating based feedback
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A Ti:sapphire oscillator tunable over 138 nm and maintaining a spectral linewidth less than 15 pm with no spectral jitter is presented. Outputs in the 200 mW regime with an excellent beam quality were achieved.

articleTitle: High-Q cavity design in photonic crystal heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We introduce a simple procedure for high-Q cavity design in photonic crystal heterostructures. The key parameter in the optimization process is the relative position of the resonant frequency within the mode-gap.

articleTitle: Critical slowing down in InGaAsP-InP nonlinear photonics crystal resonator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Critical slowing down (CSD) phenomenon was observed experimentally in InGaAsP-InP nonlinear photonics crystal resonator. The hallmark of CSD is the occurrence of the output transmission in the unstable state for a long time before switching.

articleTitle: Resonant properties of terahertz metamaterials of sub-skin-depth thicknesses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optically thin terahertz metamaterials made from Pb split-ring resonators are investigated. The LC resonance emerges at a critical metal thickness near 0.15 skin depth and exhibits a characteristic evolution with increasing thicknesses at sub-skin-depth level.

articleTitle: Frequency dependence of the fixed point in a fluctuating frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Modulating the pump power of a mode-locked laser causes the frequency comb to expand and contract about a fixed point in frequency. We report the first measurement of this fixed point in a tunable laser.

articleTitle: Demonstration of spontaneously generated conical waves during ultrashort laser pulse filamentation in air
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Measurements and simulations show that X-waves are spontaneously generated during filamentation in air. This explains the sub-diffractive propagation of filaments beyond the end of the plasma channel generated by multiphoton ionization.

articleTitle: Fiber length stabilization system for long-baseline phased-array radio telescopes (ALMA)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We’ve developed local oscillator dissemination system for ALMA. The high-purity 120GHz local oscillator was delivered as a heterodyne beat signal over 25 km through length corrected optical fibers with phase fluctuation of 10-2 radian.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion by terahertz electro-optic modulation in asymmetric coupled quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Wavelength conversion in coupled quantum wells driven by terahertz fields has been studied using a model that includes the effects of band structure, excitons and intersubband transitions. Good agreement is achieved with published experimental data.

articleTitle: Coherent phonon excitation and manipulation in bismuth using temporally shaped ultrafast pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This presentation discusses generations of coherent phonons during ultrafast laser interaction with bismuth. Ultrafast pulse shaping is used to produce THz pulse trains to enhance the phonon generation. The effect of coherent phonon generation on materials removal is discussed.

articleTitle: InGaN light emitters: A comparison of quantum dot and quantum well based devices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In this paper, we have studied the band structure of InGaN based quantum dot devices. The valence force field model and k middot p method have been applied to study the band structures in InGaN quantum dot devices including the piezoelectric polarization effects. A comparison with InGaN quantum wells shows that InGaN quantum dots can provide better e-h overlap and reduce the radiative lifetime. The dot size and the relation to the effective bandgap have been studied in this paper. The results suggest that InGaN quantum dots would have superior performance in white light emitters.

articleTitle: Chirp of color-free injection-locked reflective semiconductor optical amplifier transmitter in 200GHz AWG based WDM-PON after 25km metropolitan transmission
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Chirp analysis of color-less RSOA transmitter with 2–3 ASE injection-locked modes for 1.25Gb/s metropolitan WDM-PON network reaching BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> under receiving power below −29.5dBm and power penalty of ≪0.1dB after 25km transmission is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fabrication of tailored photonic crystals using multiphoton lithography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Multiphoton lithography methods have been used to fabricate tailored photonic crystal structures with controllable stop bands that are effective templates for the formation of high contrast photonic crystals by post-fabrication processing. Metallization of such structures produces photonic crystals with a high reflectance in the infrared spectrum.

articleTitle: Direct determination of exciton homogeneous and inhomogeneous linewidths in semiconductor quantum wells with two-dimensional fourier transform spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Homogeneous and inhomogeneous broadening of heavy- and light-hole excitons in semiconductor quantum wells are measured along with the excitation dependence of both broadenings. Isolation of disorder-induced broadening is possible with spectra in different coherent pathways.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband femtosecond continuum generation in crystals of bismuth triborate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultrabroadband generation of white-light continuum in the near-IR (~135 THz, 1.15-2.4 mum) is demonstrated in BiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>, pumped by 45 fs long pulses at 800 nm, achieving an energy of 15 muJ at 1 kHz.

articleTitle: Floating micro-structured force probe for 3D imaging and force microscopy on the nanometre scale
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A nanometre scale, picoNewton force probe based on advanced optical tweezers control of transparent microstructures will be presented. The probe will be applied to dynamic bio-molecular interactions in solution

articleTitle: Continuous tuning of an extented-cavity diode laser with a translated varied line-space grating as an external coupler
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An extended-cavity diode laser is tuned without mode hop by simply translating a varied line-space grating. This original technique has produced a continuous wavelength tuning range as wide as 12 nm at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Effects of the foreign phases on the crystallization and growth of magnetooptic garnets films
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The low temperature crystallization of magnetooptic iron garnets CeY<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> (Ce-YIG) in thin films has been investigated. The parasitic phases were shown to have a negative impact on the crystalline structure.

articleTitle: Phase-matched THz-wave generation in a planar GaAs waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using near-degenerate optical parametric oscillator operating at ~2 microns as a dual-wavelength pump source, we generated tunable THz radiation near 2 THz, at a microwatt power level, with TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> propagation mode of a planar GaAs waveguide.

articleTitle: Wave propagation in a sub-wavelength waveguide array: Superluminal lattice solitons and bands’ cutoff
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the formulation of wave propagation in arrays of subwavelength waveguides with sharp index contrasts. We demonstrate the collapse of the bands into evanescent modes, and propagation of lattice solitons with superluminal phase velocity.

articleTitle: Multiple reference Fourier Transform holography using coherent high-harmonic soft-x-rays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate multiple reference Fourier transform holography with coherent soft X-rays from a tabletop high harmonic source for the first time. Simple reconstruction using a two dimensional Fourier transform shows a 90 nm resolution.

articleTitle: Tandem fiber laser: Injected laser versus double pass amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We coupled two laser fibers to provide two 6.7 ns, coherent, synchronized, adjustable, diffraction limited, Q-switched laser pulses with up to 120 kW peak power at repetition rates between 10 and 100 kHz.

articleTitle: Substrate study of tungsten nano-gratings deposited by a single femtosecond laser beam
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Sub-wavelength tungsten nano-gratings were grown using a single femtosecond laser beam on many substrates. Quantitative study of substrate reveals that substrates play a significant role in controlling the growth conditions and physical attributes of tungsten-nano-gratings.

articleTitle: Stable gain-switched 845 nm pulse generation by a weak 1550 nm seed laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate what we believe to be the first demonstration of stable gain-switched 845-nm pulse generation by a weak modulated 1550-nm seed laser from an Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped fluoride fiber pumped by a CW 974 nm LD.

articleTitle: Real-time THz-TDS line scanner for moving object
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a real-time, line-field THz-TDS imaging system based on electro-optical time-to-space conversion and line focusing of a THz beam. The proposed system functions as a color scanner in the terahertz spectral region with fast line-scanning and has been successfully used to image moving objects.

articleTitle: Highly efficient cross-polarized wave generation in the UV region
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally the generation of cross-polarized wave in BaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> crystal in the UV. The efficiency in the UV below XPW saturation is about 30 times higher then in visible for the same input intensity.

articleTitle: Analysis of spectroscopy and amplification at 1.3 Analysis of spectroscopy and amplification at 1.3 μm in Nd/Tm/Yb doped tellurite glass fibres
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Emission branching ratio at 1.3 mum and 1.06 mum has been studied in Nd/Tm/Yb doped tellurite glass fiber. 1.3 mum fluorescence intensity has been increased significantly. 3-4 dB signal gain has been observed in fiber.

articleTitle: Squeezing and entanglement of optical fields transmitted through a thick atomic medium
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Propagation of a quantized optical field through a thick sample of two-level atoms, considering the complete Zeeman sublevel structure, is theoretically investigated. Squeezing and entanglement between orthogonal polarization components is predicted for the transmitted field.

articleTitle: Cavity opto-mechanics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Two device geometries that enable structural coexistence are micro-mechanical and optical resonators. In one geometry, a micro-cantilever mechanical resonator also functions as a mirror in a high-finesse optical cavity. In a second, opto-mechanical coexistence takes the form of a micron-scale silica toroid that exhibits both high-Q radio-frequency mechanical resonances and optical resonances.

articleTitle: Single photon emission from spatially controlled periodic arrays of II-VI quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed a means of spatially organizing II-VI colloidal quantum dots into periodically patterned templates with high accuracy. Individual quantum dots are readily accessible by photoexcitation and show single photon emission with antibunching characteristics.

articleTitle: Depletion dynamics for stimulated emission depletion (STED) microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present preliminary experimental data revealing depletion dynamics for stimulated emission depletion (STED) microscopy as a function of excitation intensity, depletion intensity, time delay, and fluorophore damage. FluoSpheres 350/440 (Invitrogen) is used.

articleTitle: Cavity QED with single atomic and photonic qubits
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Recent experiments towards deterministic quantum information processing with single atoms and single photons in a high-finesse optical cavity are discussed, including a single-photon server and an atom-photon interface.

articleTitle: 1.3 W quantum cascade lasers with optimized design for continuous-wave operation at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Continuous wave optical power of 1.32 W and wallplug efficiency over 7.1 % were demonstrated at 300 K for MOCVD-grown quantum cascade lasers emitting at 4.6 mum.

articleTitle: Extrinsic orbital angular momentum carried by photon-pairs in spontaneous parametric down-conversion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show in theory that the down-converted photon-pairs carry extrinsic orbital angular momentum in the degrees of freedom of relative movement of one photon with respect to its twin in type-II spontaneous parametric down-conversion.

articleTitle: Self-consistent optical gain analysis and epitaxy of strain-compensated InGaN-AlGaN quantum wells for laser applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Self-consistent optical gain analysis of strain-compensated InGaN-AlGaN quantum wells (QWs) using 6-band k⋅p formalism shows 28% improvement, which is suitable for laser active regions. MOCVD-grown strain-compensated InGaN QW exhibited 62.7% improvement in integrated luminescence intensity.

articleTitle: Control of the third-order nonlinearities in a GaAs/AlGaAs superlattice by ion implantation quantum well intermixing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Self-phase modulation was observed in GaAs/AlGaAs superlattice-core waveguides that were quantum well intermixed by ion implantation. The band gap was blue-shifted by 68 nm and the Kerr effect was suppressed by 67% after intermixing.

articleTitle: A 648-pixel, two-dimension spatial light modulator with an over-two-octave bandwidth from ultraviolet to near-infrared
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We developed a 648-pixel, two-dimension spatial light modulator operating from 260 to 1100 nm, which is useful for ultrabroadband chirp compensation.

articleTitle: Quantum mechanical description of the dynamics of a laser with two-pulse/cavity round-trip
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The density matrix of a two-level system interacting with a near resonant field, corresponds to the circulating intensities (diagonal elements) and the beat signal of the interfering outputs (off-diagonal element) of a ring laser.

articleTitle: The ordered nanopore array diode laser: Comparing analysis with experiment
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An analytical model describing the density of states and gain spectrum of the ordered nanopore array diode laser is presented. The theoretically predicted gain spectrum shows excellent agreement with experimental results.

articleTitle: Optical birefringence effects of pure spin currents in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We predict that a pure spin current in a semiconductor, even without net magnetization, presents the Voigt and Faraday birefringence, which may be exploited for a direct, non-demolition measurement of the pure spin current.

articleTitle: Optical guiding of atoms through a hollow-core photonic band-gap fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have demonstrated guiding of rubidium atom through a hollow core photonic bandgap fiber. Rb atoms from a thermal oven travel down 6 cm fiber with an efficiency that is greater than 70%.

articleTitle: 142 mW tunable blue light generation at 488 nm by single-pass SHG of an external cavity enhanced broad-area laser diode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: 142 mW visible light with a tuning range of 5 nm were generated by frequency doubling of an external cavity broad-area laser diode using a PPLN waveguide crystal. A wall-plug efficiency of 5.9% was obtained.

articleTitle: The fine structure of a laser-plasma filament in air
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We probed the electron density variations of a controlled femtosecond plasma-filament. It exhibits rapid variations and a meter-long self-guided stage despite the fact that plasma alone cannot efficiently saturate nonlinear self-focusing.

articleTitle: Raman amplification of low divergent radiation in barium nitrate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The efficient Raman amplification (amplification was up to 1600) of low divergent first Stokes radiation was demonstrated. The amplified pulse energy was up to 63 mJ at pump energy of 208 mJ.

articleTitle: Crystalline cavities for quantum and nonlinear optics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present crystalline whispering gallery mode resonators (WGMR) operating as the efficient Raman lasers. Fundamental limitations on optical quality (Q) factor are discussed. A new resonant scattering phenomenon is observed.

articleTitle: Spectroscopy of individual V-shaped silver nanoantennas
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Following the theoretical suggestion of Stockman et al., we have fabricated individual V-shaped silver nanoantennas with 20-nm minimum feature size. Measured attenuated total internal reflection spectra are compared with numerical solutions of the vector Maxwell equations.

articleTitle: Recent progress in plasmonics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Plasmonics is an exploding new field of science and technology in which the flow of light can be molded at the nanoscale using metallic nanostructures. This newly found ability is rapidly impacting every facet of optics and photonics and is enabling a myriad of exciting new technologies. After providing an introduction to plasmonics, I will describe a number of interesting recent developments in the field, including chipscale interconnection, solar cells, nanoscale optical spectroscopy, metamaterials, nanoscale thermal engineering, non-linear optics, and quantum optics. Plasmonics is currently moving in many new directions and I will provide my personal assessment of the limitations and most exciting future opportunities for the field.

articleTitle: Limiting nature of continuum generation in silicon
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The generation of spectral continuum in silicon is studied experimentally and theoretically. The dynamics of the free carriers generated through two photon absorption (TPA) is found to limit the extent of the generated continuum.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of single-walled carbon nanotube saturable absorbers for solid-state laser mode-locking near 1 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultrafast single-walled carbon nanotube saturable absorbers were fabricated and optimized for mode-locking solid-state lasers near 1 mum. Their typical modulation depth and recovery time were measured to be Gt 0.3% and ~ 750 fs, respectively.

articleTitle: Low loss Si-SiO2-Si 8nm slot waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Quasi-TM-mode propagation loss of 1.83 dB/cm at lambda = 1.565 mum is achieved in horizontal Si(amorphous)-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-Si(crystalline) slot waveguides with 8.3 nm slots fabricated on silicon-on-insulator. Waveguide loss is measured using a ring resonator with Q ~ 3x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>.

articleTitle: Ultra-high-power optical vortex output from a side-pumped Nd:GdVO4 bounce laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We produced directly an ultra-high-power 1.06 mum vortex mode from a diode-pumped Nd:GdVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> bounce amplifier. A maximum vortex output of 17.8 W was achieved at a pump power of 55 W.

articleTitle: Complex networks of interacting solitons: Noise-enhanced memory and self-synchronization
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose complex networks constructed from interacting vector solitons. Within soliton-based networks, we demonstrate memory effects that are greatly enhanced by noise, as well as spontaneous entire network self-synchronization effects.

articleTitle: Ultrafast carrier-envelope-offset phase control of optical rectification in resonantly excited semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultrashort pulse light-matter interactions in a semiconductor are theoretically investigated within the regime of resonant optical rectification. Using 5 fs pulse envelope areas of around 1.5-3 π, a single-shot dependence on carrier-envelope-offset phase.

articleTitle: Fiber laser array passively phase locked in a ring cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the passive phase-locking of an array of four fiber amplifiers in a ring cavity. The feedback loop is a single mode fiber that performs an intracavity filtering of the far field pattern.

articleTitle: Terahertz-field-induced carrier-wave Rabi oscillations in n-type GaAs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Carrier-wave Rabi oscillations between bound impurity levels in n-type GaAs are demonstrated by ultrafast THz propagation experiments for driving fields up to 5 kV/cm. For stronger fields the two-level approach breaks down.

articleTitle: The (critical) clamped intensity of a plasma filament induced by a femtosecond laser pulse in helium
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The clamped intensity of a plasma-filament induced by a femtosecond laser pulse in one-atmospheric-pressure helium was measured. The measured electron density of ~7times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> corresponds to a clamped intensity of about 7.8times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup>W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Determination of fluorescence lifetimes of Yb3+ in different Borate and vanadate hosts using the pinhole method
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The fluorescence lifetimes of the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5/2</inf> level of Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> in LaSc<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>(BO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, Li<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Y(BO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, Ca<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>YO(BO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, Ca<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>GdO(BO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, and YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> were determined for various doping concentrations applying the pinhole method.

articleTitle: The use of Circular Dammann Gratings (CDG) in angle measurement
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe a robust method of inclined angle measurement based on the projection of the CDG image. An accuracy of 5% can easily be achieved and this application can be employed in many different areas.

articleTitle: Dynamics of harmonic generation in highly nonlinear silica nanowires
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We numerically investigate non phasematched third harmonic generation induced by few cycle pulses in highly nonlinear fused silica nanowires. We study in particular the spectral amplitude dependence on pump pulse parameters and carrier envelope phase.

articleTitle: Interference of light emitted by a slit and a groove coupled by surface plasmons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a method to generate an interference pattern from a slit-groove structure. Although we have not used a double-slit, a Young like interference pattern is observed due to the effect of surface plasmons.

articleTitle: Inherently directional lasing from a thermal-induced-deformation high-Q microcavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally report a novel asymmetrical spherical microcavity with thermal-induced deformation, in which whispering gallery modes possess not only ultra-high quality factors (Q) but also remarkably directional escape emission from the microsphere boundary.

articleTitle: Optimization of SiNx planar microdisk high Q resonators for chipscale visible integrated photonics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultra-high Q (>5 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>) microdisk resonators are demonstrated in a SiNx platform at 650 nm with integrated in-plane coupling waveguides on a Si substrate. Critical coupling to first-order radial-mode is demonstrated using pedestal layer to control coupling.

articleTitle: Solvent-casting deposition of chalcogenide glass for photonic applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A solvent casting method of depositing amorphous chalcogenide materials has been developed. Films are characterized and applied to the tuning of mid-infrared photonic structures and waveguide fabrication through a combination of soft-lithography and microfluidics.

articleTitle: Sellmeier and thermo-optic dispersion formulas for RbTiOPO4
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Thermo-optic constants for RbTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> were measured from 20 to 120degC in the 0.532-1.571 mum range. The Sellmeier and thermo-optic dispersion formulas that reproduce well the phase-matching conditions for normal and periodically poled crystals are presented.

articleTitle: Coherent coupling of multiple transverse modes in a quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate phase coherence of multi-transverse modes in quantum cascade lasers through both near- and far-field mode measurements. We explain the observed phase locking by four-wave mixing of longitudinal modes belonging to different transverse modes.

articleTitle: Higher order mode photonic bandgap fibers for dispersion control
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the dispersion properties of solid core and hollow core photonic bandgap fibers and propose a novel, partial reflector layer around the core for dispersion control of femtosecond optical pulses.

articleTitle: Implementation of high resolution planar wavelength demultiplexers using strong dispersion in photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Wavelength demultiplexing is one of the major applications of unique dispersive properties of photonic crystals (PCs). Possibility of integration and compactness are two main advantages of PC-based demultiplexers compared to other demultiplexing techniques for applications including compact spectrometers (for integrated sensing applications), spectral analysis modules (for optical information processing systems), and WDM multiplexers and demultiplexers. The current demands in these applications require improvement of the resolution of these demultiplexing devices from the values demonstrated to date, and we propose utilizing strong dispersion in higher photonic bands of the planar PC to achieve this goal. Here, we discuss the important factors to be considered in implementing an efficient superprism-based PC wavelength demultiplexer in their strong dispersion regime. The predicted performance of this device is experimentally verified, and steps to further improve their performance are discussed.

articleTitle: Characterization of Raman-assisted Fiber optical parametric amplifiers gain
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We reported theoretical modeling of the gain of Raman-assisted fiber optical parametric amplifiers. The model can be used to design and optimize the amplifier gain.

articleTitle: 5-D spectroscopic microscopy for intelligent femtosecond laser writing of optical waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A dual purpose femtosecond laser processing and 5D spectroscopic (xyz, time, wavelength) microscopy system provides intelligent in-situ analysis and on-the-fly control of optical waveguides during laser writing. Definitive evidence of heat accumulation effects is reported.

articleTitle: Ultrafast pump-probe reflectance study of multiferroic Eu0.75Y0.25MnO3
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measured the pump-probe reflectance relaxation time in multiferroic Eu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.75</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.25</sub>MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. The relaxation time can be tuned by magnetic field and follows the temperature dependence of the low-energy spectral weight that includes phonons and electro-active magnons.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Electronically switchable extraordinary terahertz transmission through metallic hole arrays fabricated on a semiconductor substrate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated electronically switchable extraordinary terahertz transmission through sub-wavelength metallic hole arrays fabricated on doped semiconductor substrates. A reverse voltage bias results in a controllable depletion thus tuning the substrate loss and switching the transmission.

articleTitle: Group velocity dispersion in chalcogenide As2S3 glass nanofibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Group velocity dispersions of air and borosilicate cladding chalcogenide As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanofibers are calculated and compared. Zero flattened dispersion can be tailored around telecommunication wavelength, 1.5 μm, by proper cladding material and the nanofiber core diameter.

articleTitle: Photon gun using a finite-size photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Modified spontaneous emission from a single-quantum-dot embedded in a small finite-size, photonic-crystal slab waveguide are investigated.We subsequently demonstrate very large Purcell factors that can be exploited to emit efficient single photons “on-chip”.

articleTitle: Integration of site-controlled pyramidal quantum dots and photonic crystal membrane cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Deterministic integration of site-controlled InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots (QDs) with photonic crystal cavities is demonstrated. Fine adjustment of QD position (within ~10 nm) and emission energy (few meV) allows construction of coupled QD systems.

articleTitle: Ultrafast carrier dynamics in PbS quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report studies of multi-carrier dynamics in PbS quantum dots. Nanosecond recombination times are observed for the 1S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">el</sub>-1S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3/2</sub> transition and evidence of direct radiative recombination from 1P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">el</sub>-1P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3/2</sub> is observed on picoseconds time scales.

articleTitle: Observation of fidelity saturation in a δ-kicked rotor potential
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally investigate the effect of atomic δ-kicked rotor potentials on themutual coherence between wavepackets in an atom interferometer, and demonstrate fidelity saturation in phase-space displacement echoes at quantum resonance.

articleTitle: Room temperature terahertz detection based on electron plasma resonance in an antenna-coupled GaAs MESFET
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Plasma resonance of electrons was observed in an Antenna-Coupled GaAs Metal-Semiconductor-Field-Effect-Transistor (MESFET) by sweeping bias voltages. This resonant absorption was used to realize a room temperature terahertz detector.

articleTitle: Switch of absorption in coherently driven media
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A system usually characterized by electromagnetically induced absorption was investigated with a probe and a coupling laser. Properly tuning the laser polarizations and intensities, inversions in the lasers absorption were measured for the first time.

articleTitle: Slow and fast light in liquid crystal light valves
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that fast and slow light occurs in a liquid crystal light valve when two-wave mixing occurs in the Raman-Nath diffraction regime. Light pulses are slowed at group velocities as low as 0.2 mm/s.

articleTitle: Deep-subwavelength coaxial waveguides with a hollow core
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We analyze propagating plasmonic modes in deep-subwavelength coaxial metallic waveguides with a hollow core. Such modes couple to plane waves and exhibit much larger cut-off wavelengths than the TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>-mode in a conventional coaxial waveguide.

articleTitle: Fiber taper coupling to chalcogenide microsphere modes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the manufacturing and optical characterization of microsphere in chalcogenide. We show that high-Q modes of a 9.2 mumm diameter chalcogenide glass can be efficiently excited using a silica tapered fiber.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Channel and Wedge Plasmon Polarition Devices by Combined UV and Nanoimprint Lithography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a large-scale compatible fabrication method for channel and wedge plasmon polariton waveguides. Optical characterization of fabricated devices using SNOM shows sub-wavelength confinement and propagation lengths in the hundreds of microns.

articleTitle: Generation of beams with spiral phase shift using a divided half waveplate in a laser cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Beams with spiral phase shift are generated using a duodecimally divided half waveplate in a Ti:sapphire laser cavity. Either Laguerre-Gaussian or radially polarized laser beam with orbital angular momentum is obtained from the cavity.

articleTitle: Decoupling and asymmetric coupling in a triple-core photonic crystal fiber (PCFs)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We simulate and measure decoupling in triple-core PCFs. We obtain the three supermodes and calculate the coupling parameters. The measured parameters agree well with the calculated ones. The inter-core coupling is found to be asymmetric.

articleTitle: Characterization of bending-induced density change inside an optical fiber by use of four-wave mixing microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Microscopic density characterization of transparent material with depth resolution is achieved with four-wave mixing microscopy. The density change inside a bent optical fiber with a curvature radius of 3.4 mm is successfully detected.

articleTitle: Electrokinetic control of single molecules in fused silica fluidic nanochannels
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We discuss single-molecule detection of fluorescently-labeled proteins in solution within a nanochannel fabricated in fused silica. Confocal fluorescence microscopy and fluorescence correlation spectroscopy are employed to monitor the motion of single molecules under electrokinetic control.

articleTitle: Tight focusing of light in aberration-compensated photonic crystal negative refractive lens
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a composite photonic crystal for compensating an aberration in negative refractive lens. We experimentally observed that the focused spot size was clearly narrowed, compared with the case of single photonic crystal.

articleTitle: Bistable mode-locking in a semiconductor disk laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first demonstration of hysteresis in a semiconductor disk laser mode-locked with semiconductor saturable absorber. It is shown that the size of the hysteresis loop can be controlled by varying the unsaturated gain.

articleTitle: Controlling the quenching of single-molecule fluorescence through a plasmonic slab
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The fluorescence quenching of a single molecule can be controlled using a plasmonic device made of a metallic or negative-index slab and a metallic nanoparticle. The concept of dark near-field fluorescence imaging is introduced.

articleTitle: Electro-optic sensor from high-Q resonance between optical D-fiber and slab waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An electric-field sensor is specially fabricated with an optical D-fiber that utilizes weak evanescent coupling with a lithium niobate slab waveguide. Resonant modes with a Q-factor of ~13,000 yield high sensitivity for detecting electric fields.

articleTitle: Generation of squeezed vacuum light pulse at non-soliton wavelength of 800 nm with a Sagnac loop fiber interferometer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Production of squeezed vacuum laser pulses at 800 nm is studied with a Sagnac fiber interferometer using a Ti:sapphire femtosecond laser. Excessive noise can be suppressed with shorter fiber lengths even with sub-picosecond laser pulses.

articleTitle: Biased liquid crystal photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We simulate the director structure of all capillaries in a biased photonic crystal fiber infiltrated with liquid crystals. Various mode simulations for different capillaries show the necessity to consider the entire structure.

articleTitle: Standoff chemical detection using SUPER CARS
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a new method for standoff chemical detection based on single ultrafast pulse excitation for remote coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy. Mode-selective and background-free excitations were achieved through optimal binary phase pulse shaping.

articleTitle: Time-multiplexed optical waveform generation for high-resolution imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed a time-multiplexed technique for controlling the amplitude and phase of the individual frequency components of a mode-locked laser to generate a precisely linear chirped waveform. We have demonstrated a 20-GHz, 1-mus chirp.

articleTitle: A 4W tunable Tm3+:Ho3+ silica fibre laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A multiwatt Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:Ho<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> co-doped silica fibre laser pumped at 0.79 mum is demonstrated with an extended tuning range from 1920-2120 nm, compared with 1880-2040 nm obtained using a Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> only doped fibre.

articleTitle: Magnifying metamaterial lens design by coordinate transformation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We use the coordinate transformation technique to design metamaterial lenses that can magnify a two-dimensional planar image beyond the diffraction limit.

articleTitle: Nonlinear compression towards few-cycle pulses in two-photon semiconductor amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultra broadband nonlinear two-photon gain is proposed for pulse compression down to few optical cycles. Recent experimental report on two photon gain in semiconductor is exploited for analysis of pulse compression under realistic semiconductor parameters.

articleTitle: Coherent optical spectroscopy of a strongly coupled semiconductor microcavity-quantum dot system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A fiber taper waveguide is used to perform coherent optical spectroscopy of a GaAs microdisk strongly coupled to an InAs quantum dot. Vacuum Rabi splitting under weak driving and saturation under strong driving are observed.

articleTitle: High-power widely-tunable thulium-doped fiber master-oscillator power-amplifier around 2 mm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a high power, widely-tuneable Tm-doped fiber master-oscillator power-amplifier system generating over 100 W of linearly-polarized output with a >190 nm tuning range. The output power is limited only by the available pump power.

articleTitle: Adaptive detection of Doppler frequency shift using ac non-steady-state photo-EMF effect
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Adaptive velocimeter based on the AC non-steady state photo-EMF effect induced by oscillating interference pattern has been investigated. The possibility to detect very low velocities (micrometer per second) using photoconductive polymer based detector was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Sub-watt threshold CW Raman fiber-gas-laser based on H2-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A single pass CW Raman laser based on a hollow-core PCF filled with hydrogen exhibits 50% conversion quantum efficiency even at atmospheric pressure. The addition of fiber-Bragg-gratings reduces the Raman threshold power below 600 mW.

articleTitle: Coherent control using the carrier-envelope phase
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Octave-spanning laser pulses enable a new coherent control scheme based on the carrier-envelope phase (CEP). Multiphoton ionization of Xe atoms demonstrates CEP control over the phases of photoelectron quantum states and therefore the photoelectron direction.

articleTitle: An organic laser in the monomolecular regime
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated laser action in the regime of linear recombination of singlet excitons in para-sexiphenyl crystalline films in the form of nanofibers under optical excitation with femto- and nanosecond pulses.

articleTitle: Spontaneous coherence, interaction and kinetics of macroscopically ordered exciton state
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The macroscopically ordered exciton state (MOES) appears in the external exciton rings in GaAs/(Al,Ga)As coupled quantum wells below a few Kelvin. Here, we report on the experimental study of coherence, interaction and kinetics of MOES.

articleTitle: Triplet energy confinement effect in blue phosphorescent organic light emitting devices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The effects of triplet energy confinement and charge balance by hole and electron transport layers are investigated on blue phosphorescent organic light emitting devices (PHOLEDs).

articleTitle: Detection of process-dependent changes in the Hf(in1−x)SixO2/Si (100) barrier heights by second harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measure barrier heights of silicon/high-k dielectric structures, and their changes with processing, by identifying a photon-energy-dependent threshold for internal hole photoemission using spectroscopic time-dependent second-harmonic generation.

articleTitle: Wavelength polarization switching and bistability in a 1550nm-VCSEL subject to orthogonal optical injection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the first experimental observation of different forms of wavelength polarization switching and bistability with a 1550-nm VCSEL operated just above threshold and subject to orthogonally-polarised optical injection.

articleTitle: Spectral phase shaping for high resolution CARS spectroscopy around 3000 cm−1
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate high resolution (1 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) spectroscopy around 3000 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> by combining a broadband shaped pulse (pump and probe) with a narrow Stokes pulse. We introduce new phase shaping strategies for the removal of the non-resonant background.

articleTitle: Probing excited state dynamics of retinal isomerization in bacteriorhodopsin
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the effects of excitation pulse intensity, chirp and bandwidth on the ultrafast dynamics of retinal isomerization in bacteriorhodopsin. Variation of these parameters alters the decay times of the I and J conformations.

articleTitle: Electronic characterization of silicon doped beyond the solubility limit via femtosecond laser irradiation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have performed temperature-dependent resistivity measurements of silicon after doping with sulfur via femtosecond laser irradiation. Results are consistent with a theoretically predicted binding energy for sulfur donors of 100 meV below the conduction-band edge.

articleTitle: Diffraction property of cholesteric liquid crystal grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Diffraction property of cholesteric liquid crystal (CLC) grating has been theoretically and experimentally investigated. The experimental result is in good agreement with the Raman-Nath theoretical diffraction probed by a polarized beam in various polarization states. The dependence on the wavelength and the polarization creates a possibility for externally modulating the CLC device.

articleTitle: Efficiency and beam quality analysis of a semiconductor disk laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The slope efficiency of semiconductor disk lasers is seen to be reduced at high output coupling. Careful adjustment of the cavity and pump mode sizes is also necessary for high efficiency and good beam quality.

articleTitle: STIRAP in waveguides: Linear and nonlinear effects in an adiabatic three-core system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate an adiabatic passage between uncoupled waveguides, in analogy with the quantum effects of STIRAP. In the nonlinear regime the associated adiabatic light passage is found to critically depend on the excitation power levels.

articleTitle: High power broadband THz generation in a GaP waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Broadband THz generation is demonstrated using optical rectification in 6 mm GaP waveguides pumped by a high power, high repetition rate, ultrafast Yb-doped fiber amplifier. 150 μW THz radiation is obtained from 10 W pump power.

articleTitle: Dynamic response of quantum dot lasers — Influence of nonlinear electron-electron scattering
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
