abstract: The dynamic response of semiconductor quantum dot lasers can be quantitatively understood by including the strong nonlinearity of electron-electron scattering processes.We combine microscopically calculated Coulomb scattering rates with a rate equation model.

articleTitle: Terahertz field mapping of poynting vectors through a one-dimensional grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally study Poynting vector flows when terahertz waves transmit through a multiple slit arrays. Our methods provide a new way of visualizing energy flows and determining different diffraction orders in the near-field.

articleTitle: A three-dimensional lefthanded metamaterial operating at THz frequencies
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a bulk metamaterial operating in the THz frequency range. The implemented structure consists of pairs of metallic crosses for which the resulting composite medium exhibits a lefthanded transmission band at about 1.1 THz.

articleTitle: Simulations of a compact integrated plasmonic attenuator operating at telecom wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present finite-element simulations of a 1-mm long variable optical attenuator based on a long-range surface plasmon polariton waveguide, exhibiting <1 dB insertion loss, 20 dB extinction ratio, low power consumption and response times around 1 ms.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical properties of conjugated polymer charge transfer composites
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Processing methods for optical-quality conjugated polymer charge-transfer composite films have been investigated. These materials exhibited strong energy-suppression characteristics in the near infrared regime for nanosecond pulses and show potential as efficient optical limiters for sensor protection.

articleTitle: Complete spectral phase retrieval by modified interferometric field autocorrelation traces
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose analytic retrieval of complete spectral phase profile by measuring two modified interferometric field autocorrelation traces using thick nonlinear crystals with slightly different central phase-matching wavelengths.

articleTitle: Low wavelength emissions with Nd doped lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the first demonstration of true three level laser emission in diode-pumped Nd doped vanadate and YAG crystals. Wavelengths ranging from 900 to 869 nm open new doors to deeper blue emissions by SHG.

articleTitle: Nanoplasmonics: Subwavelength waveguides, resonators and antennas
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Subwavelength waveguides, resonators and antennas utilizing surface plasmon polariton modes are considered, reviewing recent experimental investigations and demonstrating first examples of ultracompact plasmonic components.

articleTitle: Light localization in silicon nanophotonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the first observation of Anderson light localization in compact silicon nanophotonic slow-light waveguides consisting of long sequences of coupled resonators fabricated on a silicon-on-insulator (SOI) chip.

articleTitle: Reducing mode-transition loss in silicon-on-insulator strip waveguide bends
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Mode-transition loss in silicon-on-insulator strip waveguides is reduced from 0.019 dB/transition to 0.0046 dB/transition for a bending radius of 4.5 micrometer, by adding a gradual-transition curved waveguide to connect the bend section and straight section.

articleTitle: Semiconductor waveguide optical isolators incorporating ferromagnetic epitaxial MnX (X=As or Sb)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: TM-mode waveguide optical isolators consisting of semiconductor waveguides with ferromagnetic MnX (X = As, Sb) layers were developed. The device with a MnSb layer had an isolation ratio of 12 dB/mm in the wavelength range 1530-1555 nm.

articleTitle: Coherent phonon oscillations excited by the E11 ttransition in micelle-suspended single-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the observation of coherent phonon oscillations of RBMS excited by the E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> transition in isolated SWNTs. We observe stronger intensity for the (n-m)mod3 = +1 family than for the (n-m)mod3 = −1 family.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated laser Bragg Q-switch and wavelength converter in a PPLN crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a PPLN crystal with a built-in electro-optic Bragg grating for both temperature-insensitive laser Q-switching and temperature-tuned wavelength conversion with 35% parametric efficiency from 1064 nm to mid-infrared wavelengths between 1440 and 2750 nm.

articleTitle: Densely folded silicon photonic wire biosensors in ring resonator and Mach-Zehnder configurations
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate silicon photonic wire evanescent field sensors formed by folding long photonic wire waveguides into dense spiral paths that occupy spot sizes less than 150 mum in diameter, and are hence suitable for biochip array formats. These sensors are incorporated into both ring resonator and Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) interrogation circuits, and tested by monitoring streptavidin protein adsorption. The level of detection is less than 1% of a monolayer in either configuration. Using a balanced MZI design, we show that the sensors can be insensitive to temperature and wavelength, while retaining a very high sensitivity to molecular adsorption.

articleTitle: Demonstration of L-band lasing in an integrated microsphere plus coupler device
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We explore thermal effects in a rare-earth doped glass microsphere resonator arising from internal heating of the cavity via pump intensity. This has facilitated the fabrication of an integrated coupler plus source for L-band lasing.

articleTitle: Correlation between the subband electronic temperatures and the internal quantum efficiency of THz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have measured the electronic temperature of the upper laser level (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">E</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">u</sup>) during continuous-wave operation in THz quantum-cascade lasers and found an experimental correlation with the occurrence of stimulated emission and the internal quantum efficiency.

articleTitle: Quantum enhancement of optical beam position accuracy by self-focusing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The standard and Heisenberg quantum limits on the position accuracy of an optical beam are rigorously derived. A simple scheme of beating the standard quantum limit by self-focusing is proposed.

articleTitle: Enhanced transmission through subwavelength aperture arrays with short range order
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measure the THz transmission properties of subwavelength aperture arrays that possess short-range order (SRO), but lack long-range order (LRO). We demonstrate that transmission enhancement still occur through these structures despite the absence of LRO.

articleTitle: Observation of frequency division and chaos behavior in a laser diode driven by a resonant tunneling diode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report optical experimental frequency division and chaos results in a resonant tunneling diode laser diode driver configuration that forms a self-oscillating circuit. Circuit behavior and laser output results are well predicted using Lienardpsilas equation.

articleTitle: Development and Frequency-doubling of a 5-W 756-nm injection-locked Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed a cw 5-W 756-nm injection-locked Ti:sapphire laser and generated 1.1-W 378-nm radiation by its frequency-doubling in an external enhancement cavity, which is useful for the selective optical pumping of thalium isotopes.

articleTitle: High-power, high-repetition-rate femtosecond pulses tunable in the ultraviolet
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Efficient femtosecond pulse generation across 250-355 nm in the ultraviolet is reported by internal doubling of a visible optical parametric oscillator. An average power of 225 mW in 132-fs pulses at 76 MHz is demonstrated.

articleTitle: In-vitro SHG/THG imaging of porcine cornea
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: THG and SHG signals can be detected on the corneapsilas whole thickness in forward or backward directions, allowing the observation of epithelium, stroma and endothelium by topographic and high resolution imaging.

articleTitle: Time-resolved spectroscopy of the charge-transfer gap in Sr2CuO2Cl2
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present energy- and time-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy near the charge-transfer gap in the undoped copper oxide Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>CuO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Cl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The photoinduced response relates simply to the thermal response, indicating a common boson-mediated origin.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: High power 29 W CW supercontinuum source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The authors report a 29 W CW supercontinuum spanning 1.06-1.67 mum with a spectral power density of 50 mW/nm up to 1.4 mum generated in a double-zero PCF. The dynamics of formation are analyzed.

articleTitle: Passive phase locking of fiber laser array based on a common ring cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the passive phase locking of three fiber lasers based on a common ring cavity. The cavity provides the common resonating modes of the array through mutual injection locking.

articleTitle: Dark pulse diode laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A dark pulse train is generated by an external cavity quantum dot diode laser, which is passively controlled by a saturable Bragg reflector. The 92 ps dark pulses have a 400 MHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Manipulation of quantum emitters on photonic crystal cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the manipulation of nanoscopic particles, which contain few or single quantum emitters, on photonic crystal cavities using scanning probe techniques, thereby aiming at the precise control of light-matter coupling in these cavities.

articleTitle: Terahertz detectors and emitters based on plasma wave oscillations in nanometer gate length transistors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The channel of high electron mobility transistor can act as a resonator for the plasma waves propagating in 2D electron gas. The plasma frequency increases with reduction of the channel length and can reach the Terahertz range for nanometre size transistors. This work presents an overview of the experimental results on THz detection and emission by nanometre size transistors and multi-grating structures with nanometre size gates.

articleTitle: Mid-IR photoacoustic spectroscopy by use of an entangled-cavity doubly resonant OPO
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An entangled cavity optical parametric oscillator is applied for photoacoustic spectroscopy in the wavelength range of 3.8-4.3 mum. High resolution spectra of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O are reported around 3.8 and 4 mum.

articleTitle: Resonant Raman scattering of coherent picosecond pulses by one and two longitudinal-optical phonons in GaN film grown on silicon (111) substrate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have observed resonance-enhanced Stokes and anti-Stokes Raman scattering of coherent picosecond pulses by one as well as two longitudinal-optical phonons in GaN film grown on Si (111) substrate.

articleTitle: A molecular spectroscopic view of surface plasmon enhanced resonance Raman Scattering (SERRS)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Surface plasmon enhancement of molecular resonance Raman scattering is developed by treating the molecule-metal interaction as transition dipole coupling between the electronic transitions of the molecule and the metal nanoparticle via a density matrix treatment.

articleTitle: Frequency comb referenced diode laser system for coherent molecular spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a low-noise diode laser system for coherent precision spectroscopy of individual ro-vibrational molecular states. A 10 fold reduction of frequency-noise of our diode laser with respect to grating stabilized diode lasers is presented.

articleTitle: Polarization effect of self-assembled guanosine crystal on the transport properties of metal-semiconductor-metal structure
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Guanosine molecules have strong dipole moment and can self-assemble in confined space to ribbon-like structure with polarization along its axis. Single molecule current-voltage and photocurrent measurements show that the polarization depends on the ribbon length and affect electric characterization of the MSM structure.

articleTitle: Terahertz emission from nonpolar gallium nitride
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe polarized terahertz emission from nonpolar gallium nitride due to an inplane polarization terminated by stacking faults. A measured flip of the THz waveform polarity agrees with carrier transport in an in-plane electric field.

articleTitle: Terahertz radiation from biased femtosecond laser filament in air
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Terahertz radiations of laser filament biased by an AC terahertz field or a DC electric field are studied. Similar physical properties of the two THz radiations are observed. Efficiency of both methods is compared.

articleTitle: Self-pulsation clock sources based on two-section DFB lasers with built-in shift layer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a novel model for estimating the self-sustained pulsation frequency (s.p.f), the model considers all the important factors in multi-sections DFB laser architecture, and the measured s.p.f. is matched the estimated s.p.f.

articleTitle: Highly-directed terahertz photonic transmitter by using the design of planar antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By adopting a novel CPW-fed rampart slot array antenna, we demonstrate a compact highly-directed THz photonic transmitter with a single photodetector source. 3dB radiation beam widths in both E- and H-planes are significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Improved band anticrossing using many impurity Anderson model and study of N induced scattering in the GaInNAs material system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using self energy calculations we present an improved band-anti crossing model with regards to the perturbed extended and localized states, based on the many impurity Anderson model. We also derive the perturbed density of states.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of femtosecond laser direct written volume diffractive optical elements in fused silica
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have demonstrated femtosecond laser direct written volume diffractive optical elements in a fused silica. The fabrication of a built-in coupler consisting of a direct written waveguide and a Fresnel lens has been described.

articleTitle: Silicon-chip-based single-shot ultrafast optical oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a single-shot ultrafast optical oscilloscope using a four-wave-mixing-based parametric temporal lens integrated on a CMOS-compatible silicon photonic chip. Experimentally, we demonstrate waveform measurement with a 100-ps record length and sub-picosecond resolution.

articleTitle: Compensation of focus blurring of Ag slab superlens with intrinsic loss of absorption
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using non-impedance matching condition, we improved image quality of Ag slab superlens with ~69% enhanced visibility and ~138% increased depth of field of contrast 0.5 through our FDTD calculation.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped sub 60-fs Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb-doped sesquioxide combined ceramic laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Diode-pumped Kerr-lens mode-locked laser operation of Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:Sc<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> combined ceramics has been achieved. Sub-60 fs pulses with the average power of 380 mW were obtained at the center wavelength of 1042 nm.

articleTitle: Efficient coupling of light to a single molecule, observation of its fluorescence Mollow triplet, and more
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Efficient coupling of laser to single quantum emitters is achieved via near- and far-field techniques. Direct detection of 11.5% extinction and the first direct measurement of the Mollow triplet in solid state system are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental implementation of 1310-nm differential phase shift QKD system with up-conversion detectors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have experimentally implemented a differential phase shift quantum-key distribution system with up-conversion detectors operating at a 2.5 Gbps clock rate. A Michelson interferometer with Faraday mirrors is used to increase the system stability.

articleTitle: Few-cycle pulse interactions in dispersion-managed quadratic photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose new type of photonic crystals with managed dispersion for few-cycle pulse nonlinear optics. Dispersive effects can be reduced in layered medium with alternating nonlinear and dispersion coefficients. Soliton propagation dynamics was also studied.

articleTitle: Ideal cylindrical cloak and influence of tiny perturbation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The invisibility of cylindrical cloaks produced by arbitrary radially coordinate transformations is confirmed. The influence of a tiny geometrical perturbation at the inner boundary of the cloak is investigated. It is shown that a tiny perturbation would induce a noticeable field scattering, due to the slow convergence of the zero<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order scattering coefficients. However, by choosing appropriate coordinate transformation functions, the noticeable scattering can be reduced. More interestingly, the slow convergence can be overcome drastically by putting a PEC (PMC) layer at the interior boundary of the cloak shell for TM (TE) mode.

articleTitle: Strong interaction between light and a single trapped atom without a cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measured the extinction of a focused light beam by a single <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb atom localized in an optical dipole trap and found a value of 7.2% for a focused Gaussian beam resonantly interacting with an atomic two-level system. Various models describing interaction of an atom with a focused light field are compared to explain our experimental result. Our experiment suggests that a strong coupling may be achieved without cavity assistance. This opens new perspectives for a development of an efficient atom-photon interface for Quantum Information processing.

articleTitle: High-power emission of Nd-vanadate thin-disk lasers in-band pumped at 0.88 μm directly into the emitting level
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In-band pumping at 0.88 mum was used to realize Nd-vanadate thin-disk lasers with maximum continuous-wave output power of 14.9 W at 1.06 mum, and to generate 9.1 W output power of green light at 0.53 mum. Results on deep-blue generation are discussed.

articleTitle: Cladding modes in all-solid photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first characterization of cladding modes of a low-index contrast all-solid photonic bandgap fiber using an acousto-optic long-period grating. Near field modal measurements and theoretical calculations reveal unique cladding mode properties.

articleTitle: Incorporable DFB dye lasers for micro-flow-channels on a polymeric chip
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Integration techniques of tunable film dye lasers on a plastic optical application chip were studied. We fabricated microflowcytometry chip integrated with DFB film lasers as a first example. Preliminary LIF experiment was also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Long-Range trapping and rotation of single nanorods using plasmonic tweezers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present plasmonic tweezers that makes use of localized surface plasmons from a close-packed Au nanoparticle (NP) array. This device is able to realize long-range trapping and orientation control of single nanorods with a very low optical intensity requirement.

articleTitle: Enhancing efficiency of electroluminescence using individual metal nanoparticles and ordered nanoparticle arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We apply the ldquoeffective mode volumerdquo theory to evaluate the enhancement of the efficiency of electroluminescence of the semiconductor placed in the vicinity of isolated metal nanoparticles and their arrays and show that using random assembly of isolated particles holds an advantage over the ordered arrays.

articleTitle: Novel photonic crystal fiber sensors using splitting of a degenerate plasmonic doublet
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The concept of honeycomb photonic crystal fiber-based plasmonic sensor, having a sensing mechanism based on the detection of breaking of an degeneracy between the two near-IR plasmonic excitations with the resolution of 7.2 ldr 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> RIU, is developed.

articleTitle: High-speed quantum random number generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a quantum random number generator based on randomness in photon emission and detection. Using a single-photon counter and FPGA-based data processing allows for a convenient implementation that outputs data at 40 Mbit/s.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Raman microspectroscopy for structural and chemical analysis of biological solutions in microfluidic devices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate here for the first time potential applicability of coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy (CARS) for protein folding and crystallization in microchannels.

articleTitle: Impedance matched hyperlens
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We develop an imaging system capable of magnification, subwavelength-resolution and impedance matching, which minimizes reflection losses. We propose a practical design of the system based on available materials and existing fabrication technologies.

articleTitle: A simple and practical 157nm and 193 nm coherent light source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a fully-coherent ultrafast UV light source at 193 and 157 nm using a cascaded four wave mixing technique in a hollow dielectric waveguide. We have obtained 200 nJ and 20 nJ per pulse energy at 193 nm and 157 nm respectively using pulses of 200uJ pulse energy and 50 fs pulse width from a Ti:sapphire regenerative amplifier at 5 kHz. Our technique can easily be scaled to 100 kHz repetition rate for use in defect inspection for lithography development and many ultrafast spectroscopy experiments.

articleTitle: Strong signal suppression due to the combined effect of Raman and parametric gain in a fiber parametric amplifier.
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The combined action of parametric gain and Raman scattering can lead to the complete suppression of an input optical signal. Experimentally we are able to demonstrate over 95% (13 dB) suppression.

articleTitle: Multicanonical Monte Carlo study of noisy signal evolution in 2R all-optical regenerators with normal and anomalous average dispersions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that evolutions of optical noise on the background of a strongly nonlinear signal pulse are similar in Mamyshev-type regenerators employing maps with either normal or anomalous average dispersion.

articleTitle: Single laser system for onboard atomic interferometry
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a compact and robust laser system for onboard rubidium atomic interferometry usefull for atomic inertial sensors. Our system is based on the second harmonic generation of a telecom fiber bench at 1560 nm.

articleTitle: Two-/three-photon pumped ultraviolet nanorod lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: With femtosecond-pulse excitation, two- and three-photon absorption induced ultraviolet lasing with spectral linewidth 0.2-1 nm have been realized under very low excitation threshold from ZnO nanorod arrays at both room and liquid nitrogen temperatures.

articleTitle: Tapered microstructure fibers for fiber optical parametric oscillators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a systematic study of microstructure fibers reduced in size in order to tailor the group-velocity dispersion (GVD). The analysis includes taper recipes, GVD measurements, SEM images, and subsequent fiber optical parametric oscillator performance.

Author Keywords: (060.4005) Fiber optics and optical communications: Microstructured fibers
(190.4970) Nonlinear optics: Parametric oscillators and amplifiers

articleTitle: Terahertz emission from a tilted-front laser pulse: Phase-matching vs Cherenkov radiation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We developed a theory to explain record experimental efficiencies of terahertz emission from tilted-front femtosecond laser pulses propagating through electro-optic crystals. This theory predicts optimal pulse parameters and crystal size maximizing the terahertz yield.

articleTitle: Cesium spin-exchange-relaxation-free magnetometer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have built and tested a Cs atomic magnetometer operating in the spin-exchange-relaxation-free (SERF) regime at much lower temperature than a more conventional potassium SERF magnetometer developed at Princeton University.

articleTitle: Highly efficient, charge balanced blue phosphorescent OLEDs employing wide band gap host with p-i-n architecture
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In this study we report the use of a wide band gap host host p-bis (triphenylsilyly) benzene (UGH2) for Iridium (III) bis [(4, 6-difluorophenyl)-pyridinato-N, C2'] picolinate (FIrpic) based devices. The wide band gap host serves to confine the charge carriers in the emitting layer. Also the high triplet energy of the host efficiently confines all the excitons on the dopant molecules. A systematic effort is made to enhance the performance of blue phosphorescent organic light emitting diodes using the UGH2 host. The device performance of the intrinsic device was further enhanced by incorporation of a p-i-n architecture to tune the charge balance in the device.

articleTitle: Manipulation of molecular rotational wave-packet
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We both experimentally and theoretically demonstrated that molecular rotational populations can be actively controlled in a coherent rotational wave packet by using two strong, properly delayed femtosecond laser pulses.

articleTitle: Measuring very complex ultrashort pulses using Frequency-Resolved Optical Gating (FROG)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: For very complex pulses (TBP ∼ 100), the XFROG, PG FROG, and SHG FROG pulse-retrieval algorithms converged for 100%, 99%, and 80%, respectively, of the pulses tried in our simulations, which included noise.

articleTitle: Flexible optical probe for planar lightwave circuits testing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A flexible optical probe that accomplishes wafer-level directional coupling of light into optical waveguides is investigated optically and mechanically. Unoptimized directional coupling efficiency of 4% was achieved into an S-shaped polymer test waveguide.

articleTitle: Detuning characteristics of the linewidth enhancement factor of a mid-infrared quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The linewidth enhancement factor of a 5.2-mum distributed-feedback quantum cascade laser above the threshold current caused by detuning from the gain peak was investigated. We clearly observed different values for the linewidth enhancement factor.

articleTitle: Chromatic two photon imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a chromatic two-photon imaging technique which can effectively realize z-scanning by using a Fresnel lens to focus excitation pulses at different wavelengths to different depth positions. Preliminary imaging result will be presented.

articleTitle: Electron emission from atomic clusters irradiated with few cycle laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first study of atomic clusters irradiated by ultra-short pulses. A weak prepulse has been shown to allow energetic coupling with the clusters enhancing the electron yield.

articleTitle: Material properties in Si-Ge/Ge quantum wells for silicon-integrated electro-absorption devices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The quantum-confined Stark effect demonstrated in Si-Ge/Ge quantum wells promises integration of optics with silicon ICs. Using photocurrent, tunneling resonance and nonparabolicity, we propose more accurate values of key parameters for device design.

articleTitle: Stored light in optical fibers via stimulated Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a new method for storing and retrieving sequences of optical data pulses via induced acoustic excitations in an optical fiber through the process of stimulated Brillouin scattering.

articleTitle: Nanoelectromechanical proximity perturbation switching for transparent wavelength switching of resonant filters
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report an experimental demonstration of nanoelectromechanical proximity perturbation switching for transparent wavelength switching of resonator filters. Proximity perturbation enables ~ 5 dB switching action with ~8 mus switching speeds from bar to cross state.

articleTitle: Tunable SrTiO3/DyScO3 heterostructures for applications in the terahertz range
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The terahertz dielectric properties of several heterostructures based on epitaxial SrTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and DyScO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> thin films were characterized without and under applied static or low-frequency electric field. We demonstrate up to 65% variation of the permittivity of SrTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> films and up to 35 % modulation of the power transmission of terahertz waves at 500 GHz and 112 V (75 kV/cm) bias.

articleTitle: A circuit model for terahertz metafilms and effective medium implications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A lumped-element circuit model is shown to accurately describe the behavior of terahertz metafilms, or planar metamaterials. The model provides insight into the proper application of effective medium approximations in determining metafilm constitutive parameters.

articleTitle: Surface nonlinear light generation in the whispering gallery modes of spherical microresonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measured second harmonic generation in the whispering gallery modes of a microspherical cavity from a monolayer of nonlinear molecules on the sphere surface. Such monolayer is placed with the appropriate configuration for phase matching.

articleTitle: Secure signal transfer by optical near-field interactions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We theoretically demonstrate secure signal transfer by optical excitations involving optical near-field interactions. The energy dissipation processes, occurred locally in the nanometer-scale associated with exciton-phonon interactions, guarantees higher tamper resistance than conventional wired devices.

articleTitle: Influence of metal permittivity on transmission properties of terahertz metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the effect of metal permittivity on transmission properties of double split-ring terahertz metamaterials. The measured LC resonance is enhanced with increasing imaginary permittivity of the constituent metals, showing consistence with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Passively Q-Switched Nd:YLF Laser in a D-rod configuration
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed a compact, efficient, passively Q-switched, solid-state-laser, producing 7-mJ, < 10 ns pulses, and a near TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> beam. The cross section of the laser crystal was D-shaped and it was side pumped.

articleTitle: Polarization manipulation devices based on silicon photonic wire waveguides and their practical application
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A compact polarization splitter and rotator based on silicon photonic wire waveguide have been developed. The splitter is based on simple directional couplers. In the fabricated splitter, the polarization extinction ratio is 23 dB and excess loss is less than 0.5 dB. The rotator consists of a silicon waveguide and an off-axis silicon oxinitride waveguide. In the fabricated rotator, efficient polarization rotation was observed, and the excess loss is about 1 dB. Using these devices, a polarization diversity system for ring-resonator wavelength filters has also been developed. The polarization dependent loss of the filter with diversity is about 1 dB.

articleTitle: Controlled coupling of terahertz lasing modes in microdisk photonic molecules
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the observation of optical coupling in terahertz microdisk molecules based on quantum-cascade lasers and its tunability by the applied electric field. The spectral behaviour is in good accordance with performed finite-difference time-domaine simulations.

articleTitle: Enhanced radiative energy transfer in single glycerol/water microdroplets on a superhydrophobic surface
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Up to 10 times enhancement in the energy transfer rate from donor to acceptor molecules is demonstrated at wavelengths resonant with a whispering gallery mode of a glycerol/water microdroplet standing on a superhydrophobic surface.

articleTitle: Integrated waveguide optical isolators : Principle and history
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Several approaches to realize the isolator integratable with active devices are described. The surface activated direct bonding technique is addressed as a key technology for integrating a magneto-optic material in III-V semiconductor based photonic circuits.

articleTitle: Ultrafast transport in dye sensitized ZnO nanotips investigated by terahertz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Transient far-infrared conductivity of as-grown and dye-sensitized ZnO nanotips is measured using time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy. We reveal that the sensitization procedure dramatically affects the transport properties of ZnO nanotips.

articleTitle: Novel filtering function using an embedded ring resonator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel resonator based on embedded rings may find important applications as novel ultra-small filter, modulator and delay element. It exhibits 10 times higher delay and potential for high-speed modulation.

articleTitle: Time-domain measurements of group-velocity dispersion in quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Time-resolved mid-infrared upconversion based on sum-frequency generation was applied to measure the group-velocity dispersion in quantum cascade lasers; material, waveguide, and gain contributions were distinguished, and used to model the temporal pulse broadening.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength measurements of the near-field of a metal aperture
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present results on THz near-field measurements of sub-wavelength apertures in metal films. Our results allow us to test, with unprecedented detail, the near-field predictions made by the well-known Bethe-Bouwkamp model.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of oxygen sensitive transducer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Photoluminescence emission power and lifetime temperature dependence for an oxygen sensitive ruthenium complex is investigated in sparged water and gas surroundings. From near freezing to 40degC studies show a negative linear response to temperature.

articleTitle: Inhomogeneous anisotropic subwavelength structures for the excitation of single hollow waveguide modes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a general approach for coupling a free space uniformly polarized beam to a desired hollow waveguide mode, thus enabling a single mode operation. Required polarization manipulations are achieved by inhomogeneous anisotropic subwavelength structures.

articleTitle: Difference frequency generation at 2.5–2.9μm in GaAs microdisks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a triply-resonant GaAs microdisk for difference-frequency generation in the 2.5-2.9 mum band. Its performances are first numerically studied, in terms of phase-matching condition, conversion efficiency and tolerances. Preliminary devices are then fabricated and characterized.

articleTitle: Imaging multiple focal planes simultaneously: Multifocal, photon counting, multiphoton microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Multiple image planes in a multiphoton microscope are acquired simultaneously through novel photon counting electronics and previous scaling limitations are overcome by a new Yb:KGW femtosecond oscillator laser design.

articleTitle: Time resolved photoemission of Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Time resolved photoemission is employed to study Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>CaCu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8+delta</sub>. The photoexicted electrons dissipate their energy on two distinct timescales (110 fs and 2 ps). This is attributed to the generation and subsequent decay of non-equilibrium phonons, respectively.

articleTitle: Measurement of the Gouy phase shift for surface plasmon polaritons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measure the Gouy phase-shift of converging surface-plasmons as they evolve through the focus using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy. We perform numerical simulations to determine the surface field distribution and associate it with the Gouy phase-shift.

articleTitle: Quasi-static fiber strain sensing with FM spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a highly sensitive detection system for quasi-static strain, employing FM spectroscopy with a gas cell as absolute frequency reference, demonstrating a few tens of pepsiv/radicHz sensitivity between 1-6 Hz.

articleTitle: Fractional decay of quantum dots in photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We define a practical measure for the degree of fractional decay and establish conditions for the effect to be observable for quantum dots in photonic crystals exhibiting absorptive losses.

articleTitle: Whispering Gallery Modes in quantum dot micropillar cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: High Q-factor (~60,000) whispering gallery modes are observed from GaAs based micropillar cavities with embedded InAs quantum dots. Low threshold lasing is observed in WGMs near to the peak of the QD ensemble.

articleTitle: Cathodoluminescence readout of high-density nanoparticle phase change memory
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: For the first time we demonstrate that information can be written in the structural phase of gallium nanoparticles within an array by a focused electron beam and read-out via measurements of cathodoluminescent emission.

articleTitle: Towards a scalable dipole-trapping scheme for neutral atoms
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a new scheme for trapping single atoms in separate dipole-traps and manipulating them individually. It relies on a spatial light-modulator to create the traps and will find applications in cavity-QED.

articleTitle: Forerunners and turbulent propagation in plasmonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Abrupt near IR optical pulses launched over metal-dielectric interface are exhibiting wavefronts moving almost at the speed of light in vacuum (much faster than plasmonic wavepackets) and comprised of much lower frequencies (tens of THz).

articleTitle: Observation of enhanced THz emission from InGaN/GaN multiple quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Broadband THz pulses have been generated from InGaN/GaN multiple quantum wells pumped by a frequency-doubled sub-picosecond laser amplifier at 395 nm. Enhanced THz emissions are strongly correlated with reduced photoluminescence intensities.

articleTitle: Comparative study of index of refraction: The strongly driven and the degenerate two-level systems
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This study compares the experimental results of absorption and refractive index of a probe laser measured in a strongly driven two-level atom with the results measured in a degenerate two-level system using pump-probe spectroscopy. This work demonstrates the possibility of realization an anomalous dispersive transparent medium using the strongly driven 4s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> - 4s4p <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> Ca transition. Absorption and phase shift profiles are measured as function of the driving field intensity using a Ca atomic beam. With increasing driving field intensities absorption and phase shift decrease, but the absorption decreases stronger than the dispersion. Results show that the resonant absorption and the anomalous dispersion are reduced with respect to the non-driving case by a factor 490 and 47, respectively. This means that a ~ 10-fold enhancement of the amount of dispersion provided per amount of absorption is attained.

articleTitle: Fabrication of microstructures containing the conjugated polymer MEH-PPV
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We use two-photon polymerization to fabricate microstructures containing the conjugated polymer MEH-PPV. The microstructures preserve the characteristic emission of MEH-PPV, exhibiting waveguiding of such emission when fabricated on top of porous silica substrate.

articleTitle: Deep sub-wavelength confinement in Metal-dielectric multilayers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present linear and nonlinear deep sub-wavelength confinement in metal-dielectric periodic nano-structures. The strong anisotropy supports the propagation of modes with very large transverse momentum, enabling confinement size limited only by the structure periodicity.

articleTitle: Compression of ultra-wideband microwave arbitrary waveforms via optical pulse shaping
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report matched filtering of ultra-wideband microwave waveforms via programmable optical phase filters implemented in a hyperfine resolution pulse shaper. As an example we demonstrate compression of an 800-ps electrical chirp waveform to 42 ps.

articleTitle: Inscription of cylindrical and planar waveguides with ultrafast bessel beams
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We fabricated planar and cylindrical waveguides in transparent dielectrics by using ultrafast Bessel beams instead of commonly used Gaussian beams. Excellent quality waveguides with low losses were produced by focusing millijoule femtosecond pulses with axicons.

articleTitle: All-optical streak camera
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a novel, ultrafast measurement technique based on optical beam deflection in a planar waveguide through the activation of an array of transient prisms for high-dynamic-range, single-shot recording with 2.5 ps resolution.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse generation at 1530nm using a GaInNAsSb SESAM
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe the operation of a femtosecond Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG laser that has been mode locked using a novel GaInNAsSb SESAM. 230fs pulses were generated at an average output power of 280mW.

articleTitle: Control of surface modes in low loss hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report low-loss hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers free from surface modes. They have low attenuation over the full spectral width of the bandgap, and approximately halved dispersion and dispersion slope compared to previous fibers.

articleTitle: Deterministic cavity QED with single atoms
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Individual laser-cooled atoms are delivered on-demand from a single atom magneto-optic trap to a high-finesse optical cavity using an optical conveyor. Strong coupling of the atom with the cavity field allows simultaneous cooling and detection of individual atoms for time scales exceeding 15 s. We demonstrate the ability to manipulate the position of a single atom relative to the cavity mode with excellent control and reproducibility.

articleTitle: Weak-pulse implementation of SARG04 quantum cryptography protocol in free space
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a weak-pulse implementation of SARG04 quantum cryptography protocol in free-space. The shifted key generation rate of 22 k bit per second and quantum bit error rate of 4% have been demonstrated. We have also studied the long-distance capability of the QKD system by adding optical losses to the quantum channel.

articleTitle: Square-lattice large-pitch hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Large pitch square-lattice hollow core photonic crystal fibers have been fabricated. Measurements show that the fiber exhibits similar optical linear properties to the Kagome fiber.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth volume Bragg grating stabilized Thulium fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A spectrometer resolution limited 300 pm linewidth is achieved in a volume Bragg grating stabilized Thulium fiber laser. Slope efficiency and output power are comparable to a similar resonator formed by a broadband high reflectivity mirror.

articleTitle: Designs of optical cloak with nonlinear transformations
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Two novel designs for optical cloaking based on nonlinear transformations for TM and TE polarizations are presented. This critical development builds upon our previous work on nonmagnetic cloak designs and high-order transformations.

articleTitle: Generation of long plasma channels in air by using axicon-generated Bessel beams
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By focusing ultrashort laser pulses in air with axicon, long and continuous plasma channels can be formed. The channel length is significantly longer than that obtained by filamentation with lens of same effective focal distance.

articleTitle: Coherent optical spectroscopy of a strongly driven quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the demonstration of the Autler-Townes splitting and Mollow absorption spectrum by means of coherent optical spectroscopy of a strongly driven quantum dot.

articleTitle: Actively Q-switched Tm3+-doped and Tm3+, Ho3+-codoped silica fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the Q-switched operation of Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped and Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>, Ho<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-co-doped silica fiber lasers. Short pulses at high repetition rates and high average power could be achieved with the Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped silica fiber.

articleTitle: All-fibre, high power, cladding-pumped 1565nm MOPA pumped by high brightness 1535nm pump sources
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have demonstrated for the first time a cladding pumped C-band amplifier using high brightness in-band pump source at 1535 nm. Output power >10 W was obtained at 1565 nm with better than 40 dB OSNR.

articleTitle: Experimental phase detection at the quantum limit with coherent state interferometry
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate phase sensitivity at the standard quantum limit independent of phase using Bayesian phase estimation. This technique is unbiased and saturates the Cramer-Rao lower bound representing the optimum technique using coherent states.

articleTitle: A linear optical method for measuring the carrier envelope offset phase
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A linear optical method is demonstrated for extracting the carrier-envelope offset phase via the fringe visibility in a combined two-path multi-path interferometer. This method is applicable to a wider class of lasers than f-to-2f interferometry.

articleTitle: One-way waveguides in photonic crystals and back-scattering suppression
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A broadband one-way waveguide is numerically demonstrated at the surface of a 2D magneto-optical photonic crystal containing Yttrium-Iron-Garnet. The strong time-reversal breaking results in the absence of backward-propagating modes and scattering-immune transmission across strong scatters.

articleTitle: Non-reciprocal optical phase modulation for integrated NRZ/DPSK data re-modulation in optical access networks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that the non-reciprocity of traveling-wave electrodes can efficiently impress phase modulation onto the reflected upstream signals only. Monolithically integrated transceivers may thus remodulate downstream signals for upstream data transmission without needing optical circulators.

articleTitle: Kinetics of excitons in an optically induced exciton trap
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the kinetics of a low-temperature gas of indirect excitons in an optically-induced exciton trap. The loading time of excitons to the trap center is ~40 ns.

articleTitle: High performance wavelet-based phase reconstruction of ultrashort laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a wavelet-based strategy for precise and rapid phase retrieval in SPIDER and spectral interferometry. Our method outperforms traditional Takeda phase tracking, both in terms of speed and precision.

articleTitle: Noncollinear mirrorless optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The first demonstration of self-established noncollinear operation in the idler-counter-propagating mirrorless optical parametric oscillator is presented using periodically poled KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> having 800 nm period. The noncollinear geometry is employed for enhanced output wavelength tuning.

articleTitle: Watt-level fluoride fiber laser at 1480 nm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report an advance in the power scaling of fluoride fiber lasers using FBGs. Watt-level output power at 1480 nm is demonstrated, which is four-fold greater than the best result obtained with external bulk mirrors.

articleTitle: Polarization bistability in 1550 nm wavelength single-mode vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers subject to orthogonal optical injection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Pure frequency-induced polarization testability of a 1550 nm single-mode VCSEL subject to orthogonal optical injection has been observed. The hysteresis width becomes constant when the injection power is greater than a value P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nu</sub>. Power-induced polarization bistability is also found near P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nu</sub>.

articleTitle: High-power, femtosecond, thermal-lens-shaped Yb:KGW Laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Thermal lens shaping for astigmatism compensation is extended to a 65 MHz, diode-pumped Yb:KGW oscillator mode-locked with the aid of a saturable Bragg reflector to yield 250fs (347fs) pulses at an output power of 3.5 W (5W).

articleTitle: Monomorph large aperture adaptive optics for high peak-power femtosecond lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Novel architecture of deformable mirror is presented. The monomorph mirror presents the advantage of avoiding high-spatial frequency on the residual wavefront enabling propagation without energy modulation. The residual wavefront at rest is 3.4 nm rms.

articleTitle: High-speed SiGe p-i-n W-structure photodetectors at telecommunication wavelengths grown directly on Si
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on Si-rich Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> p-i-n W-structure single-mode waveguide detectors of varying lengths, and found to have a responsivity of upto 489 muAW<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. The shortest tested devices exhibit a 1.74 GHz bandwidth, and 173.5 muA/W responsitivty at 1.3 mum.

articleTitle: Improvement of thermal properties of ultra-high Q silicon microdisk resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Silicon-on-insulator ultra-high Q resonators with improved thermal properties are reported. A thin Si pedestal layer between microdisk and oxide increases the thermal conductivity dramatically, while Q is preserved, enabling higher field intensities in nonlinear-optical applications.

articleTitle: 5W mid-IR optically-pumped semiconductor disk laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report multi-watt, TEM00 emission from a 2μm Sb-based optically-pumped semiconductor disk laser utilising an intra-cavity diamond heatspreader for thermal management. An output power of 5W and a wide tunability of over 160nm are achieved.

articleTitle: Adiabatic Transfer of Light in Optical Waveguide Arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the experimental demonstration of efficient adiabatic light transfer between the outer waveguides in a finite array of evanescently-coupled optical waveguides with negligible excitation of all the intermediate waveguides.

articleTitle: Electro-optic polymer waveguide modulators with refractive index tapers leading to low coupling loss and a high confinement factor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A new design of a hybrid electro-optic polymer waveguide modulator is demonstrated that uses grayscale lithography to create refractive index tapers by photobleaching. It leads to a device with a half-wave voltage of 1.9 V, modulation efficiency of 15 dB and a fiber to lens insertion loss of 11.6 dB using 20 wt. % AJLS102.

articleTitle: Efficient broadband Terahertz microstrip waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a novel subwavelength microstrip architecture for efficient broadband THz waveguiding that utilizes dipole antennas at the input-face for enhanced THz coupling. Experiments as well as simulation results demonstrate efficient broadband waveguiding capability.

articleTitle: Temperature dependences of quantum-dot laser thresholds under simultaneously three-state or two-state lasing operations
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Three-state lasing in quantum-dot lasers is demonstrated for the first time in this work. The individual threshold currents corresponding to different states are measured as a function of temperature, respectively. Their correlations will be discussed.

articleTitle: A high power, coherently enhanced THz source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a compact Smith-Purcell device can potentially generate hundreds of Watts of THz radiation, based on a train of short electron bunches from an rf photoemission gun at an energy of a few MeV.

articleTitle: Instability induced all-optical switching in planar semiconductor microcavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using a microscopic theory, we predict all-optical switching in planar semiconductor micro-cavities where a weak beam switches a stronger signal. The scheme is similar to that recently demonstrated in atomic vapors.

articleTitle: Trapped ion quantum networks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe the use of a photonic coupling between remote trapped ions for applications in quantum communication and quantum computing.

articleTitle: Excited state absorption cross-sections of an asymmetric pentaazadentate porphyrin-like manganese (II) complex
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Absorption cross-sections of the first excited singlet and triplet states of an asymmetric pentaazadentate porphyrin-like manganese complex have been measured using Z-scans employing both 7.1-ns and 30-ps pulse widths, each at multiple pulse energies.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of spectral phase for ultrafast laser pulses based on multi-photon intrapulse interference
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a direct measurement method of the spectral phase of ultrafast laser pulses. The second-derivative of the unknown spectral phase can be directly envisioned and extracted from the experimental 2D-contour plot without mathematical manipulation.

articleTitle: 1.5-μm-radius high-Q silicon microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show cascaded silicon microring resonators with 1.5-mum radius critically coupled to a narrower waveguide. A coupled Q of 9,000 is achieved. Devices are fabricated with the widely-available SEM-based lithography system using a stitching-free design.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband, high-gain, polarization-independent optical parametric amplification in type-II quasi-phase-matched AlGaAs waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We discuss a dispersion-managed non-birefringent type-II quasi-phase-matched (QPM) aluminum-gallium-arsenide (AlGaAs) waveguide, achieving 22.4 dB gain with plusmn0.5 dB uniformity across 334 nm-band centered at 1550 nm with 17 mW pump power.

articleTitle: Refracting Surface Plasmons with Nanoparticle Arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Variously shaped structures formed with a 100-nm-period square lattice of gold nanoparticles placed on a gold film are shown to possess an effective refractive index of about 1.08 for SPPs propagating through them.

articleTitle: Time lens for ultrafast signal measurements based on four-wave mixing in silicon
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a novel time lens based on four-wave mixing in a silicon nanowaveguide. The lens is used for 20times temporal magnification of a signal with 3-ps features, which permits measurement by a 20-GHz detector.

articleTitle: Preservation of entanglement in a slow light medium
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the preservation of entanglement of an energy-time entangled biphoton through a slow light medium. After delay of one photon by ~1.3 correlation lengths, the 1.3 THz biphoton still violates a Bell inequality.

articleTitle: Polarization controlled diffraction and near-field hot-spots in a quasiperiodic nanohole array in a gold film
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Quasicrystal arrays show a rotationally symmetric diffraction pattern that can be oriented with the polarization. A comprehensive electromagnetic theory agrees with the observed transmission spectrum and diffraction, and it shows near-field hot-spots.

articleTitle: Nanostructured optical fiber obtained by the sol-gel process in the SiO2-ZrO2 system doped with erbium ions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present experimental results concerning the first silica-zirconia nanostructured optical fiber doped with erbium ions obtained by the sol-gel process. The microstructure and the optical properties of the fiber are characterized.

articleTitle: Two-photon imaging and photothermal therapy of cancer cells using biofunctional gold nanorods
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Transferrin-conjugated gold nanorods were used for targeting, two-photon imaging and photothermal therapy of cancer cells. The presence of nanorods significantly reduced the laser power effective for therapy.

articleTitle: New nonlinear signatures in spectroscopy and imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultrafast laser pulse shaping makes it possible to observe nonlinear signatures, such as self phase modulation and sum frequency absorption, at safe laser powers for tissue. Neuronal activation and melanoma diagnosis are two early targets.

articleTitle: Intersubband nonlinear optical processes in GaN/AlN quantum-well waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast self- and cross-absorption saturation and self-phase modulation based on near-infrared intersubband transitions in GaN/AlN quantum-well waveguides designed to minimize the nonlinear switching energy.

articleTitle: Enhanced second-harmonic generation in an array of gold nanocones
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a centimeter-scale array of gold nanocones realized by nanoimprint lithography and e-beam evaporation. Field concentration at the tip of the cones is shown to enhance second-harmonic generation from the array significantly.

articleTitle: Probing a quantum dot in the weak coupling regime
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An InAs quantum dot inside a photonic crystal cavity in the regime of weak coupling modulates the intensity of a resonant beam by 50%, and is nonlinear at powers of one photon per lifetime.

articleTitle: Optical pulse compression of a pulse trapped in an optical microcavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that optical pulse compression can be realized by tuning the quality factor of an optical microcavity from a high value to a low value, with tuning time shorter than the photon lifetime.

articleTitle: Materials optimization for ytterbium-doped high power fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In this paper we will present paths to reduce the extent of photodarkening in ytterbium doped fiber lasers based on the aluminosilicate glass matrix. This will enable higher powers and longer operating lifetimes.

articleTitle: Observation of wavelength- and loss-splitting of supermodes in coupled photonic-crystal microcavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
