abstract: Splitting of mode wavelength and loss are observed in coupled photonic-crystal cavities. The characteristics of loss splitting are shown to have important impact on the optical energy transfer between such coupled resonators.

articleTitle: Anisotropy light extraction with high polarization ratio from photonic crystal light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The azimuthal anisotropy of GaN photonic crystal light-emitting diode is investigated using an annular structure. The extracted light distribution has P/S ratio of 5.5 for light propagating in ΓX direction and 2.1 for ΓM direction.

articleTitle: 5-fs multi-mJ CEP-locked OPCPA system at 1 kHz
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report an optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification (OPCPA) system with the pulse duration of 5.5 fs at a 1-kHz repetition rate, pumped by a 450-nm pulse from a frequency-doubled Ti:sapphire laser.

articleTitle: Selective excitation of vibrational mode and Fourier-transform four-wave-mixing spectroscopy using an ultra-broadband laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that the selective excitation of vibrational mode is achieved by a single broadband pulse to focus its bandwidth into a narrow spectral region. The spectral focusing is performed by controlling the spectral phase.

articleTitle: Disorder-induced resonance shifts in photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An optical scattering theory is introduced that predicts significant disorder-induced resonance shifts in photonic-crystal nanocavities. Even for nm-scale imperfections, we calculate blue shifts of several meV, two orders of magnitude larger than the cavity linewidth.

articleTitle: In-situ frog retina imaging using common-path OCT with a gold-coated bare fiber probe
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have demonstrated in-situ imaging of a frog retina and the surrounding tissue using common-path optical coherence tomography with a gold-coated bare fiber probe which shows no image degradation when operating in vitreous humor/saline solution.

articleTitle: Compression of picosecond optical pulses in tapered hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate nonlinear compression of 2.5 ps and 1.2 ps laser pulses at 800 nm wavelength using a 35 m tapered hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber with continuously-decreasing dispersion.

articleTitle: Theory and experiment of inhomogeneous inter-particle spacing in a dual-beam optical trap
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A dynamic theory, using Maxwellpsilas stress tensor analysis and the generalized multipole technique, is proposed to analyze inter-particle spacing in the dual-beam trap. The theory agrees well with our experiments.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation using axially symmetric, polarized beams with spatial variation of ellipticity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Transverse mode conversion by second harmonic generation is demonstrated using focused axially symmetric, polarized beams with spatial variation of ellipticity. Superposition of higher order transverse modes of Hermite-Gaussian or Laguerre-Gaussian beams forms peculiar intensity patterns.

articleTitle: Heralded generation of two-photon NOON states for precision quantum metrology
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a heralded source of high-purity two-photon NOON states derived from heralded single-photon sources.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband optical parametric generation in periodically poled lithium niobate and stoichiometric lithium tantalate crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report ultra-broad optical parametric gain spectra centered at near infrared in periodically poled congruent LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and stoichiometric LiTaO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> crystals, using group-velocity matching near the degeneracy point. They can be useful for ultra-fast pulse applications.

articleTitle: Quartz-enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy of HCN from 6433 to 6613 cm−1
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The HCN absorption spectrum from 6433 to 6613 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> was acquired at room temperature by means of a tunable external cavity diode laser based quartz-enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy (QEPAS) technique.

articleTitle: Complete performance analysis of a 3.5 ps pulse source consisting of a gain-switched laser diode followed by a non-linearly chirped grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The authors demonstrate the performance of an optimized gain-switched pulse source that generates 3.5ps pulses. The transform limited pulses perform excellently when employed in an 80Gb/s OTDM set-up and a 10Gb/s 40km transmission experiment.

articleTitle: Random lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Random lasing is a unique tool to investigate the longest-lived light modes in a disordered material. The behavior of very strongly scattering random lasers in our experiments is well understood in terms of these modes.

articleTitle: The normal incidence Goos-Hänchen shift
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We predict a lateral shift of the reflected beam when an electromagnetic beam is normally incident on an antiferromagnet in the presence of an external field. This shift is confirmed using simulations for Gaussian beams.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence enhancement from colloidal quantum dots in a flexible microcavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report enhanced photoluminescence from InGaP/ZnS core/shell quantum dots embedded in a one dimensional flexible microcavity realized via spin coating alternating layers of polymers. Tunability of emission wavelength by bending the microcavity is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Random laser with ultra-high concentration of dye
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have studied stimulated emission in rhodamine 6G - TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> random laser. The minimal threshold has been found at ultra-high concentrations of both dye and TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Intersubband electroluminescence from a ZnCdSe/ZnCdMgSe quantum cascade structure
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show electrically-pumped transverse magnetic polarized intersubband emission from a ZnCdSe/ZnCdMgSe quantum cascade structure grown lattice-matched on InP. Electroluminescence centered near 4.8 μm was observed, in good agreement with calculations.

articleTitle: Enhanced electro-optic effect in InAs/GaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The electro-optic properties of InAs/GaAs quantum dots are studied in an external Mach-Zehnder Interferometer setup. The InAs/GaAs quantum dots are found to increase modulation relative to bulk GaAs and exhibit an electro-optic coefficient of 26pm/V.

articleTitle: Delocalization of localized modes in nonlinear disordered waveguide lattices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present direct experimental measurements of localized eigenmodes in disordered one-dimensional waveguide arrays. In the nonlinear regime we observe delocalization of localized states, exhibiting different features in the limits of weak and strong disorder.

articleTitle: Electro-optic microwave-lightwave converter using antenna-coupled electrodes and polarization-reversed structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel electro-optic microwave-lightwave converter using antenna-coupled modulation electrodes and polarization-reversed structures is proposed. It can convert several wireless signals coming from different directions to different optical signals respectively. Basic operations at 15GHz were presented.

abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members.

abstract: Presents an index of the authors whose papers are published in the conference.

articleTitle: Group delay measurement for balancing dispersion in complex stretcher-compressor systems
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The phase-shift technique for measuring group-delay has novel applications for aligning and commissioning grating compressors and balancing dispersion in large, high-energy petawatt and other complex, chirped-pulse amplifier systems.

articleTitle: High precision optical characterization of semiconductor saturable absorber mirrors (SESAMs)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Precise semiconductor saturable absorber mirrors (SESAM) design has enabled modelocked lasers with >100 GHz pulse repetition rate or >10 muJ pulse energy. We discuss a new method for wide dynamic range nonlinear reflection measurements of SESAMs with <0.05% accuracy.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband doublet generation from NRZ-DPSK signals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present optical ultrawideband doublet generation from NRZ-DPSK signals based on a length of SMF. The generated ultrawideband spectra using 25 km SMF and 15 km SMF are analyzed contrastively.

articleTitle: What is a filament and why is it so interesting?
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The full evolution of a filament is explored experimentally and numerically and a standardized definition is proposed. This is followed by discussing challenges in filamentation nonlinear optics and remote sensing of chem-bio agents.

articleTitle: High-fidelity photon-number-resolution using multi-element superconducting nanowire single photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Achieving photon-number-resolution using superconducting nanowire single photon detectors (SNSPDs) can enable high-speed source characterization and high-rate conditional state preparation. We report improved fidelity photon-number-resolution using high system-detection-efficiency four-element SNSPDs.

articleTitle: In-situ active region temperature measurement for THz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The active region temperature of THz quantum cascade lasers during continuous-wave operation was measured using interband photoluminescence technique. The active region was found to be ~40 K above heat sink temperature at maximum THz power output.

articleTitle: Generation of high-contrast, high-intense laser pulses by use of nonlinear pre-amplifier in Ti:sapphire laser system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the first high-contrast, high-intense Ti:sapphire chirped-pulse amplification laser system incorporating a nonlinear pre-amplifier based on an optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification for use in experiments where relativistic effects dominate the physics.

articleTitle: Ultralow-threshold room-temperature continuous-wave double-clad Cr4+:YAG crystal fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the lasing characteristics of a room-temperature continuous-wave double-clad Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG crystal fiber laser with a record-low threshold of 0.7 mW, more than 500 times lower than any previously reported Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG lasers.

articleTitle: Dynamic photocurrent analysis of in-situ p-i-n PD based injection-locking monitor for Fabry-Perot laser diode transmitter
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An on-line monitoring and auto-restorable scheme for injection-locking of FPLD by using an integrated monitoring photodiode to achieve auto locking restoration in 50 seconds with Q factor ≫7 and SMSR ≫35 dB at 2.5 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Poor man’s channel waveguide laser: KY(WO4)2:Yb
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using low-cost fabrication methods, liquid phase epitaxy and strip-loading a short fiber piece with a fluid, channel waveguide lasing is demonstrated in KY(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>:Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>. Threshold is 82 mW, slope efficiency 30%, and output power 14 mW.

articleTitle: Large-scale 3D microporous structures by two-photon laser machining
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We fabricate large-scale 3D microporous structures fabricated with two-photon polymerization in broad-area SU-8 photoresist. This approach enables the fabrication of microporous structures simulating complex 3D microfluidic systems.

articleTitle: Polarization dependence of superconducting single photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have measured the polarization dependence of the detection efficiency of NbN superconducting single photon detectors. This behavior is explained by the calculated absorption efficiency of a parallel set of metal lines.

articleTitle: High-order harmonic generation with a 1.5 μm self-phase-stabilized parametric source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generated high-order harmonics with self-phase-stabilized near-IR pulses produced by a parametric source. We observed a significant cutoff extension whit respect to 800-nm driving pulses at comparable peak intensity. This result represents a step forward the generation of single attosecond pulses with photon energies exceeding 100 eV.

articleTitle: Nonlinear refractive index of BiB3O6
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The nonlinear refractive index of the monoclinic biaxial nonlinear crystal BiB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> was measured at 1064 nm and strong anisotropy was observed with about two times larger value for E//Z-axis in comparison to E//X-axis.

articleTitle: Dispersion relation of light in metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We derive the dispersion relation of light in metamaterials and define an effective index. Emphasis is on propagation directions deviating from the principal crystallographic axis. This index is compared with results from a finite slab.

articleTitle: Self-induced transparency in nano-dispersions: Formation and instabilities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that light scattering from a cloud of nano-particles dispersed in a host medium can lead to the formation of self-induced transparent waveguides. The stability properties of these nonlinear propagation channels are examined.

articleTitle: Digital resonance tuning of high-Q/Vm silicon photonic crystal nanocavities by atomic layer deposition
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the digital resonance tuning of high-Q/V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> silicon photonic crystal nanocavities using self-limiting atomic layer deposition. Control of resonances of 122 ± 18 pm per hafnium oxide atomic layer is achieved.

articleTitle: Visible split beam VCSEL for compact sensor applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a visible VCSEL with integrated beam splitter. By focusing one beam onto a moving target and monitoring the power variation in the second beam, these devices can be used as Doppler-based velocity sensors.

articleTitle: Broadband wide-angle polarization converter
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel polarization converter using reflective metallic gratings and broadband polarization beam splitter is developed. This device converts an unpolarized light to linear polarization with over 85% efficiency.

articleTitle: Generation of ultrashort pulses in the visible using cascaded intracavity processes in periodically poled MgO:LiNbO3
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on synchronously pumped OPOs with intracavity SHG or SFG in the same MgO:PPLN crystal. At e.g. 590 nm an output power of 190 mW was obtained with 140 fs pulses at a repetition rate of 81 MHz.

articleTitle: Catch and release of optical pulses by dynamic Q control of a photonic crystal nanocavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate catching and releasing of optical pulses by dynamic Q factor control of a photonic crystal nanocavity. Optical pulses are caught and released on demand within the photon lifetime.

articleTitle: High resolution spectral characterization of Betatron X-ray radiation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first detailed spectral measurement of 1-3 keV Betatron X-ray radiation with two high resolution crystal spectrometers. Electron trajectories in the laser produced plasma can be determined with this measurement.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of continuous variable entanglement distillation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate distillation of continuous variable entanglement through an attenuating quantum channel. Through a simple protocol based entirely on linear optics and homodyne detection we probabilistically filter out a highly entangled state from a less non-entangled mixed state.

articleTitle: Strain analysis on the interface of double-clad Cr4+:YAG crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The interface analysis of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG crystal fibers(DCF) was done using HRTEM. While it was pumped at 1064 nm and yields 3-dB bandwidth of over 240 nm with a maximum output power up to mW order

articleTitle: 40MHz pulse train based on a temporally demultiplexed 2.56GHz SCOWA low noise mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An alternative to the sub-100 MHz repetition rate laser source is explored. A low noise SCOWA-based harmonically mode-locked laser is developed and temporally demultiplexed to twice the cavity fundamental resulting in a 40 MHz pulse train.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of quantum oblivious transfer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present an experimental demonstration of an unconditionally secure, cheat-sensitive oblivious transfer protocol relying on entanglement-free quantum communication. Our experiment is based on a down-conversion-based heralded photon source, commercial fiber components, and silicon single-photon detectors.

articleTitle: Excitation of silicon-based random photonic crystal nanocavities with PbSe colloidal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Coupling of quantum dot photoluminescence from lead selenide colloidal nanocrystals into high-Q nanocavities supported by disordered photonic crystal waveguides in free-standing silicon membranes is observed.

articleTitle: Long phase coherence times in the microcavity polariton condensate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe high coherence times of polariton condensates up to 200 ps and build up of second order coherence. Interactions between the condensate and the thermal reservoir of polaritons determine the coherence properties.

articleTitle: History of high-intensity interactions: Physics of the power scaling of the 2.9 Angstrom Xe(L) X-ray amplifier to the multi-petawatt level
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The article presents experimental results demonstrating Xe(L) spectral hole-burning and corresponding saturated amplification on the X<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e31+</sup> transition array. Xe(L) single-pulse spontaneous emission spectrum was recorded with a CCD equipped von Hamos mica spectrograph. A spectral comparison of the amplified spectrum with the spontaneous emission profile is also presented.

articleTitle: Compact, rapid cell deformability measurements using diode laser bar optical trapping in microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a simple, compact, microfluidic system that easily facilitates diode laser bar optical trapping for cell stretching measurements and particle sorting within flowing microfluidic systems for the first time.

articleTitle: Polarization- and spin-dependent ultrafast optical nonlinearities of Bragg-spaced quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Spin- and polarization-dependent ultrafast blue shifts, transient gain and self-wave-mixing are observed in Bragg-spaced InGaAs/GaAs quantum wells. The data are in agreement with a microscopic theory.

articleTitle: Longitudinal mode structure of degenerate OPO with volume Bragg grating output coupler
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optical parametric oscillators using volume Bragg gratings as cavity mirrors provide narrow bandwidth signals. The longitudinal mode spectrum of a 1.06 mum pumped degenerate OPO is measured with Fabry-Perot etalon and compared to simulations.

articleTitle: Recent advances in Cr2+ and Fe2+ doped mid-IR laser materials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Recent advances in Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> and Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> doped mid-IR polycrystalline, hot-pressed ceramic, and quantum dot laser materials fabrication and lasing under optical excitation are presented. First steps towards achieving a direct electrical excitation are demonstrated.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Measuring relative atom number fluctuations in a coherently split Bose Einstein condensate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report direct measurements of number fluctuations between two BECs. A single BEC is dynamically and coherently split in two. Fluctuations in the relative atom number in repeated trials are evaluated against binomial random fluctuations.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics of magnetic nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Nonlinear magneto-optical properties of magnetic core(shell) gamma-Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>(Au) and Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> (magnetite) nanoparticles are studied. Nonlinear magneto-optical Kerr effect in hyper-Rayleigh scattering at the second harmonic wavelength is about 10-20% for both types of nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Diffraction coupling of tapered laser diodes in an external Talbot cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the in-phase coherent coupling of a tapered laser diode array in an external Talbot cavity. The divergence of the central peak is 0.27deg FWHM at 3.1 A with an output power of 931 mW CW.

articleTitle: High-index-contrast AlGaAs waveguide scattering loss reduction via oxidation smoothing of sidewall roughness
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The propagation loss of single mode high index contrast AlGaAs ridge waveguides is reduced nearly three orders of magnitude (at 1 cm guide length) through application of a nonselective wet oxidation sidewall roughness smoothing technique.

articleTitle: Room temperature operated 3.1-μm type-I GaSb-based diode lasers with 80mW continuous wave output power
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: High-power diode lasers with heavily-strained In(Al)GaAsSb type-I quantum-well active region emitting at 3.1 mum at room temperature are reported. Devices operate in continuous-wave regime with output power above 200 mW and 80 mW at 250 K and 285 K, correspondingly.

articleTitle: Developments toward a reliable diode-pumped hydrocarbon-free 795-nm rubidium laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a 795-nm diode-pumpable Rb laser using a buffer gas of pure <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>He. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>He gas enhances mixing of the Rb fine-structure levels. This enables efficient lasing at reduced He pressures and improved thermal management.

articleTitle: Trapping across PCFs: A numerical study
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We numerically examine the trapping efficiency of an optical beam transmitted transversely through a hollow-core, water filled photonic crystal fiber. The trapping beam retains its structure and trapping efficiency despite the fiber microstructure.

articleTitle: Photoconductivity of ambipolar long-channel carbon-nanotube field-effect transistors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The photocurrents of carbon-nanotube field-effect transistors are small due to the small exciton ionization rate and large exciton nonradiative-decay rate, and the photocurrent gain is small for the long-channel devices.

articleTitle: Microstructured chalcogenide glasses using femtosecond laser irradiation or photolithography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the microstructuring of bulk and film chalcogenide glasses using IR femtosecond laser exposure and photolithography for molecular sensing.

articleTitle: Robust decoy-state quantum key distribution with heralded single photon source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated a decoy-state quantum key distribution scheme (QKD) with a heralded single-photon source based on parametric down-conversion. What we used is a one-way BB84 protocol with a four-state and one-detector phase-coding scheme.

articleTitle: Detection of explosives and CO2 dissolved in water with an evanescent field sensor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A fiber optic approach for the determination of the carbon dioxide concentration in the gas or fluid phase during sequestration as well as for the sensing of the explosive TNT will be presented. The sensor consists of a quartz glass multimode fiber with core diameter of 200 mum and is based on the evanescent field principle. Cladding and jacket of the fiber are removed in the sensing portion, therefore interaction between light within the fiber and the surrounding medium is possible. A single-mode distributed feedback (DFB) laser diode with an emission wavelength around lambda= 1.57 mum and a frequency doubled passively Q-switched Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YAG microchip laser (lambda= 1064 nm) are used as light sources. The experimental setup and the sensitivity of the evanescent-field-sensor are characterized.

articleTitle: Transient electromagnetically induced transparency in InGaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) based on exciton spin transitions is observed in InGaAs quantum dots. Inhomogeneous broadening of the quantum dot ensemble, detrimental for EIT, is effectively reduced by using spectrally narrow pulses.

articleTitle: Analysis of one-dimensional photonic band gap structure to design tunable electro-optic filters for DWDM
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A DWDM tunable electro-optic filter using photonic bandgaps was designed. The tuning range and minimum channel spacing was controlled by an electro-optic defect, Pb (Mg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/3</inf>Nb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/3</inf>)O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-PbTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, or by including the EO material within the reflecting stacks.

articleTitle: Cryogenically-cooled laser based on resonantly-pumped Er3+:Y2O3 ceramic
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Laser performance of Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ceramic is reported for the first time. Resonantly-pumped, eyesafe, 1.6-mum Er:Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> cryo-laser slope efficiency of ~48% and output power ~7 W have been achieved in this first experiment.

articleTitle: Correlations in two-mode cavity QED
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The vertical and horizontal polarization modes of a cavity QED system become correlated through a single atom. Their auto-correlation and cross-correlations show an avenue for the study of the steady state entanglement in this system.

articleTitle: Nonlinear effects in PPLN waveguide resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Resonator bistability in Ti:PPLN waveguide was tested experimentally. Spectrum changes were measured at different input powers and compared with theory. Parameters necessary for bistable operation are accessible via temperature and wavelength tuning.

articleTitle: Observations of cavity dipole solitons and vortex soliton clusters in VCSELs with a surface photonic crystal structure
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report experimental observation of nonlinear transverse optical pattern distributions in a photonic crystal surface-structured VCSEL by using near-field scanning optical microscope. Rotating cavity dipole solitons and vortex soliton clusters are demonstrated.

articleTitle: “backward Heisenberg picture” approach for spontaneous parametric down-conversion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We develop a fully quantum-mechanical approach for describing spontaneous parametric down-conversion, which allows us to write an expression for the quantum state easily, even when multiple photon pairs are generated in the process.

articleTitle: Concentration-dependent laser performance of Yb:YAG ceramics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Laser performance of Yb:YAG ceramics and single-crystals doped with different Yb concentrations was investigated using two-pass pumping miniature laser configuration. Better laser performance was observed for heavy-doped Yb:YAG ceramic than single-crystal (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Yb</inf> = 20 at.%).

Author Keywords: 140.5680 (Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers)

articleTitle: Eyesafe optical parametric oscillators employing MgO-doped PPSLT and monolithic KTP
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We compare the oscillation thresholds and slope efficiencies in 10 ns pulsed eyesafe OPOs based on MgO-doped PPSLT and monolithic KTP. The optimal combination of low threshold and high slope efficiency is achieved with PPSLT.

articleTitle: Acceleration of slow-light in a Brillouin fiber laser: Pump power dependence of cavity modes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Acceleration of slow-light in a Brillouin fiber laser is reported. The resonant modes of the fiber cavity, due to nonuniform group index, shift to higher frequencies as the pump power is increased.

articleTitle: Development of SPR sensor array based on optoelectronic platform for high throughput system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A SPR biosensor array based on optoelectronic platform has been developed. Using integrated photodetector, the SPR signal has been directly converted into electrical signal and the device has the potential of high throughput measurement capabilities.

articleTitle: Cascaded exciton relaxation resonantly enhanced by LO phonons in vertically-stacked InAs quantum dots on InP
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have evidenced the relaxation of excitons cascading down from the highest energy state to the ground level in vertically-stacked InAs quantum dots grown on an InP substrate, which is resonantly enhanced by LO phonons.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Spatial phase shaping in nonlinear microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The contrast in nonlinear coherent microscopy is improved by using spatial phase shaping of the incident laser beams. This approach exhibits promising applications for biomedical imaging studies.

articleTitle: Coherent exciton — surface plasmon polariton interactions in hybrid metal semiconductor nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the coherent coupling between surface plasmon polaritons and quantum well excitons in a hybrid metal-semiconductor nanostructure. The coupling is probed by angle-resolved low temperature spectroscopy and analyzed within a coupled oscillator model.

articleTitle: Ultra high-rate optical key distribution
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe a novel scheme for encryption in the physical layer, that allows key establishment at rates that are compatible with the rates used in modern optical systems and thereby ultimate security can be achieved using the one-time pad protocol.

articleTitle: Regimes of operations of semiconductor ring lasers under optical injection and applications to optical signal processing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a detailed characterization of the semiconductor ring-laser operating regimes with special emphasis on the response to optical injection. Applications to an optical set/reset bistable memory and four-wave-mixing tunable THz signals generation are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Wavefront measurements with large dynamic range on high-power diode lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Wavefront measurements with large dynamic range on high-power diode lasers are demonstrated. The wavefront sensor exhibited a large dynamic range of π/2 to -π/2 and high accuracy of the wavefront slope angle of 0.05 degree. The result of this study may provide an accuracy method for measuring the wavefront distributions of the diode lasers and the light sources with large divergence angles, such as a 980-nm high-power diode laser.

articleTitle: Efficient Visible Laser Emission of GaN Laser Diode Pumped Pr-doped Fluoride Crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The authors report on the spectroscopy and laser results of diode pumped Pr-doped fluorides. We obtained efficient laser emission in the visible range with LiYF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, LiLuF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and LiGdF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystals.

articleTitle: Mass-fabrication of air-core microstructured polymer optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An air-core, 252 holes cladding, 51% air-occupied fraction PMMA-based MPOF as successfully fabricated by drawing an extruded 253 holes preform. With the extrusion technique, air-core MPOF preform could be produced on a large scale.

articleTitle: All-optical analogue to electromagnetically induced transparency with silicon photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe experimentally all-optical analogue to electromagnetically induced transparency with silicon photonic crystal nanocavities having high intrinsic quality factor and small modal volume. This phenomenon is analyzed through coupled-mode formalism and three-dimensional finite-difference time-domain method.

articleTitle: An interferometric method for dynamic extinction ratio measurement
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We introduce a novel interferometric method for dynamic extinction ratio measurement of temporally demultiplexed pulses by using a high extinction modulator. The resulting extinction ratio is 44 dB. Our method has a dynamic range of ~60 dB.

articleTitle: Filamentation with ultraviolet pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Filamentation in air with ultraviolet pulses is reviewed. Channels of considerably more energy than in the visible/near IR can be generated.

articleTitle: Investigation of local photon detection efficiency distributions in nanowire superconducting single—photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Uniform meander structure is one of the key issues in developing high-detection-efficiency nanowire superconducting single photon detectors. We present our effort on investigating their local photon detection efficiency distribution in high spatial resolution.

articleTitle: A facetless laser suitable for monolithic integration
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel facetless laser diode is proposed and demonstrated. The facetless laser is realised by etching deep slots into the mirror sections of a multi-section semiconductor laser which provide the feedback for laser operation.

articleTitle: Complete determination of the first-order degree of coherence of amplified spontaneous emission sources with femtosecond resolution
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using radio-frequency spectral analysis we experimentally retrieve the amplitude and phase of the degree of coherence of a broadband ASE source around 1550 nm with a resolution of 6.5 fs along a 3-ps span.

articleTitle: Enhancement of diffraction-based biosensor sensitivity via a Bloch surface wave
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a biosensor based on the diffraction of Bloch surface waves (BSWs) in periodic dielectric stacks. Great enhancement of diffraction efficiency by a grating of proteins is predicted when BSW is excited.

articleTitle: Few-cycle femtosecond waveform synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A waveform synthesizer consisting of an octave-spanning Ti:sapphire oscillator and a prism-based pulse shaper is presented. Combined with CEO-phase stabilization the system allows for full control of the electric field on a sub-femtosecond time-scale.

articleTitle: Enhanced erbium emission in photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We fabricated photonic crystal nanocavities to enhance erbium (Er) emission in siliconrich nitride nanocrystals. We observed experimental quality factors of ∼6000 and 20-fold enhancement, in agreement with numerical calculations of the Purcell effect.

articleTitle: Optical shock waves on a partially-incoherent background
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally study dispersive optical shock waves on a partially-spatially-incoherent background. We observe statistical wave damping and demonstrate shock waves using both self-defocusing and self-focusing nonlinearities, corresponding to positive and negative optical fluid pressures.

articleTitle: Optimization of Yb3+:ZBLANP fiber structure for laser cooling
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose an optimized fiber structure for laser cooling. It is shown that a long fiber with a small core can be more beneficial for laser cooling than a short fiber with a large core.

articleTitle: Acceleration of the refractive index response in nonlinear photonic crystal / quantum dot waveguides via the Purcell effect
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A sixfold acceleration of the phase shift recovery time in photonic crystal / quantum dot waveguides having a Purcell enhanced spontaneous emission peak resonant to the excited state of the quantum dots is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Quantum information with superconducting quantum bits and cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have implemented cavity quantum-electro dynamics, in the strong coupling regime, using superconducting phase qubits and a resonant transmission line cavity. We have observed coherent quantum interactions with cavity decay times over one microsecond.

articleTitle: Fourier transform coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (FTCARS) microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate Fourier transform coherent anti-stokes Raman scattering (FTCARS) microscopy and show that an external field combined with the signal can overcome detector dark noise. We discuss conditions for obtaining shot-noise-limited detection and compare the S/N of FTCARS with other methods.

articleTitle: Polarization pulse shaping of femtosecond laser pulse with a multi-pass 2D-SLM
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate time-dependent polarization shaping with no ambiguity of femtosecond laser pulses using a reflective-type two-dimensional spatial light modulator, which can independently control the orthogonal phase and amplitude.

articleTitle: Complete geometric universal single qubit operation of cold two-level atoms
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A complete geometric manipulation of universal single qubit operation on a two-level cold ensemble of sodium atoms was demonstrated using a combination of geometric rotations of the Bloch vector around axes 2 and 3.

articleTitle: Spatial-dispersion-free ultrashort optical-vortex-pulse generation using polarization singularity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The generation method of spatial-dispersion-free optical vortices using polarization singularity due to an axially-symmetric polarizer was proposed and demonstrated with an ultrabroad-band light (∼350 to ∼1000 nm) and an ultrashort optical pulse (∼50 fs).

articleTitle: Gravity-like force suppresses normal GVD and blue shifts frequency of femtosecond pulses in fibres
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a novel mechanism of localization and frequency up-conversion of light pulses with spectra in the normal GVD range of optical fibres, due to the inertial force acting on pulses from the accelerating solitons.

articleTitle: Realizing quantum controlled phase-flip gate through quantum dot in silicon photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Scheme to realize controlled phase gate through single quantum dot in slow-light silicon photonic crystal waveguide is proposed. Enhanced Purcell factor and beta-factor lead to high gate fidelity over broadband frequencies compared to cavity-assisted system.

articleTitle: Synchrotron radiation from laser-accelerated monoenergetic electron beams
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the production of incoherent synchrotron radiation from laser-accelerated electrons propagating through an undulator. Simultaneously recorded electron and photon spectra fit well to undulator theory. Future prospects are ultrashort laser-based synchrotron light sources.

articleTitle: Electro-plasmonics: Dynamical plasmonic circuits with minimized parasitic scattering
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that enhanced electro-optical effect in plasmonic microstructures is accompanied by dramatically reduced parasitic scattering of surface waves. Analytical description of relevant physics and implications for creation of high-performance dynamical plasmonic circuits are discussed.

articleTitle: High efficiency white LEDs with 2D photonic quasi-crystal and patterned sapphire substrate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A high emitting efficiency GaN-based white LED with 2D PQC on surface and PSS were successfully fabricated. After packaging, 21% enhancement in emitting luminous flux was achieved under the driving current 20 mA.

articleTitle: Terahertz detection using optical parametric upconversion and geiger mode avalanche photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Terahertz radiation is nonlinearly upconverted to telecommunication wavelength. The resulting idler is coupled into fiber and detected with a photon counting receiver. Detection with 4.5 pW/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> noise equivalent power and nanosecond temporal resolution is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Ladder operators for optical angular momentum transfer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ladder operators are introduced to analyze the Pancharatnam-Berry(PB) phase. Space-variant PB phase structures are identified in polarization grating and cholesteric liquid crystal. The wavefront shaping and the beam propagation direction alteration are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Coherent control of ultra-high frequency acoustic resonances in photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Acoustic resonances trapped within the glass core (1 mum diameter) of a photonic crystal fibre are excited electrostrictively using laser pulses. Using pulse sequences they can be coherently controlled leading to a 100-fold increase in their amplitude.

articleTitle: Relativistic photoelectron measurements from ionization of argon and xenon in ultrahigh fields
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Photoelectron angular distributions with energies as high as 1 MeV were measured and calculated with a semi-classical tunneling model at relativistic laser intensity. Measurements and theory show directional higher energy electrons and isotropic lower energy electrons.

articleTitle: Frequency combs and hyperspectral sources for absorption spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed numerous laser sources for gathering spectral information from gases. Examples include frequency-comb sources that give complete broadband spectra, and time-division-multiplexed sources that cycle through key wavelengths aligned to gas absorption features (e.g. a source that cycles through 14 wavelengths in the 1325-1666 nm range every 33 mus). We have applied such sources for high-speed measurements of gas properties in combustion flows, for example gas thermometry in the 400-2200 K range at 100 kHz with a precision of 0.2%. Recent and ongoing activities will be summarized, including approaches for gas property imaging by tomographic reconstruction of hyperspectral absorption data.

articleTitle: Blue and yellow electroluminescence of MOSLED made on Si-rich SiOx grown by PECVD with detuning buried Si nanoclusters size
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Blue and yellow electroluminescence of MOSLEDs made on Si-rich SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> with buried Si nanocrystals of different sizes controlled with minimum hydrogen passivation are demonstrated by PECVD at different N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O/SiH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> ratio and total fluence.

articleTitle: Frequency shifts at the fiber-optical event horizon
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Event horizons can be simulated by waves in a moving medium. Using ultrashort pulses in microstructured optical fibers, we have performed the first experimental demonstration of an artificial event horizon in optics.

articleTitle: Entanglement on demand through time reordering
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Entangled photons can be generated on demand in a novel scheme involving unitary time reordering of the photons emitted in a radiative decay. This scheme can be applied to the biexciton cascade in quantum dots.

articleTitle: Highly efficient, ultra low dark current germanium photodetectors integrated on submicron silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate germanium photodetectors integrated on submicron silicon waveguides by low-temperature bonding and ion-cut. The devices show very low dark current of ~100 nA, fiber-accessed responsivity of 0.44 A/W, and quantum efficiency of >90%.

articleTitle: Multiplying photocurrent by utilising non-radiative energy transfer in hybrid nanocrystal/patterned quantum well structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We design, fabricate and demonstrate a hybrid nanocrystal/patterned p-i-n device that utilises fluorescence energy transfer and exhibits a three-fold increase of the measured photocurrent compared to its bare p-i-n counterpart.

articleTitle: Novel ultra-fast broadband laser source at 910nm for Vulcan 10 PW OPCPA laser system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In this paper we have reported a jitter-free ultra-fast broadband OPA amplification in the sub-ps time domain at the repetition rate of 1 kHz. A novel broadband laser pulse source of ~180 nm (FWHM) at ~910 nm was demonstrated for Vulcan 10 PW OPCPA laser system development.

articleTitle: Two-photon interference behind Young’s double slit
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have observed two-photon interference behind Youngpsilas double slit with unprecedented signal/noise ratiopsilas. We demonstrate the complementarity between quantum entanglement in the two-photon field and optical coherence in the projected one-photon field for three different types of illumination: far-field, near-field, and intermediate illumination.

articleTitle: Fast and efficient analysis and design of three-dimensional photonic crystal structures for functional dispersive devices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that the propagation of optical beams inside three-dimensional photonic crystals can be efficiently described by an approximate scalar diffraction model. The main advantage of this model is that it reduces the memory and computation time for direct simulations of three-dimensional photonic crystals by converting the problem into an equivalent problem for which simple geometrical optics can be applied. Then we use this model for efficient design of photonic crystal dispersive devices such as demultiplexers and microspectrometers. Finally, experimental verification of the results for the polymer woodpile structures will be given.

articleTitle: Excitons and cavity polaritons for cold-atoms in an optical lattice
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate collective electronic excitations for ultracold atoms in an optical lattice prepared in the Mott insulator phase. Frenkel like-excitons in these artificial crystals can appear when the atomic excited state line width is smaller than the exciton band width. When the optical lattice atoms are placed within a cavity the excitons and the cavity photons get coupled, and in the strong coupling regime they form two branches of cavity polaritons.

articleTitle: 20-Gb/s PolDM duobinary transmission in a 575-km SSMF link with automatic polarization stabilization and optical dispersion compensation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: 20-Gb/s transmission exploiting duobinary modulation and polarization-division multiplexing is shown. Experimental performances are evaluated in presence of an automatic polarization stabilizer and a double-pass optical dispersion compensator over 575-km SSMF.

articleTitle: Fiber-based two-photon sources for quantum information
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We review the merits of using fiber as a nonlinear media for production of correlated and entangled photon pairs for quantum information applications and we present history, status, and fruits of efforts in this area.

articleTitle: Mg-doped congruent LiTaO3 crystal for large-aperture quasi-phase matching device
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The first OPO experiment using a periodically poled Mg-doped congruent LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> device was demonstrated. The dependence of OPO output wavelength on the period of quasi-phase matching structure could be characterized.

articleTitle: A waveplate hinge model for PMD in installed fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a waveplate hinge model to characterize anisotropic effects in the hinge model of PMD. We compute the outage probability of an individual frequency band using a combination of importance sampling and the cross-entropy method, and the non-compliant capacity ratio by averaging over wavelength bands. We show that there are significant differences between the outage statistics predicted by isotropic and anisotropic hinge models.

articleTitle: Measuring orthogonal components of electric field via optical second harmonic generation in KTiOPO4
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: DC to impulse electric field measurements are performed by combining an electro-optic effect with the second harmonic generation in KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystals. The technique is extended to measure orthogonal components of the electric field.

articleTitle: Optical vector signal generation using double sideband with carrier suppression and frequency multiplication
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This work experimentally demonstrates optical vector signal generation using frequency multiplication based on double sideband with carrier suppression. After transmission over 50-km SMF, the power penalty of 15-GHz 1.25-Gb/s RF signals is less than 0.2-dB.

articleTitle: Time-resolved optical interferometry of polaritonic states in metallic photonic crystal slabs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present time-resolved nonlinear optical measurements on polaritonic states in metallic photonic crystals. The femtosecond time dynamics of the polariton are tailored by an interferometric three-pulse pump-probe technique.

articleTitle: Ultrafast demagnetization dynamics in TbFeCo high-density magneto-optical recording films
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultrafast demagnetization processes of TbFeCo films are studied. Dynamic hysteresis loops measured at different pump-probe delayed times shows that the ultrafast demagnetization originates from electron spin relaxation instead of electron-lattice heat exchange.

articleTitle: Millijoule pulse energy high repetition rate femtosecond fiber CPA system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on an ytterbium-doped fiber CPA system delivering millijoule level pulse energy at repetition rates above 100 kHz corresponding to an average power of more than 100 W. The compressed pulses have a pulse duration of 800 fs. To our knowledge, this constitutes the highest pulse energy ever extracted from a fiber based femtosecond laser system and nearly two orders of magnitude higher repetition rate than in previously published mJ-level fiber CPA systems.

articleTitle: Experimental study of instability in random lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have experimentally studied the pulse-to-pulse instability in Nd:Sc<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>(BO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> random laser. The increase of the instability at the threshold and its reduction at further increase of pumping is in line with the theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Room temperature, Sb-based monolithic EP-VCSEL at 2.3 μm including 2 n-type DBR
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a 2.3 mum emission at RT under quasi-CW operation from a Sb-based monolithic VCSEL. The structure is composed of 2 n-doped AlAsSb/GaSb DBR, a type-I GaInAsSb/AlGaAsSb QWs active region and a tunnel junction.

articleTitle: Multi-pass frequency conversion of the CW optical pumped semiconductor laser in the UV range
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Multi-pass external cavity doubling of OPSL for 244 nm in BBO crystal is demonstrated. Conversion efficiency increases in 18 and 7 times with narrow and broad linewidths, respectively, for 4 pass resonant doubling compared to one-pass conversion.

articleTitle: Enhanced photoluminescence excitation in surface plasmon coupling with an InGaN/GaN quantum well
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe the enhancement of photoluminescence excitation through the coupling of an InGaN/GaN quantum well (QW) with surface plasmons which are generated on an Ag nanostructure deposited on the SiN-coated QW epitaxial sample.

articleTitle: 50 kHz, 62μJ femtosecond pulse SHG at 389 nm from a single stage Ti:sapphire regenerative amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have demonstrated the second harmonic generation with output pulses of a 50 kHz Ti:sapphire regenerative amplifier. 280 fs pulses with an average power of 3.1 W were generated at 389nm.

articleTitle: Time-resolved carrier dynamics and the quantum confined Stark effect in a bilayer quantum dot waveguide at 1340nm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Quantum confined Stark effect and pump probe measurements are reported for the first time in a bilayer quantum dot waveguide at 1340 nm, showing a shift of 40 nm and ultrafast absorption recovery of 5ps.

articleTitle: Atomic fluorescence emitted into an optical nanofiber: Coupling effciency and spectrum
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present an analysis of the lineshape and strength of the fluorescence emitted by optically excited atoms and coupled to an optical fiber. We show the frequency-position selectivity and asymmetry of the spectral emission line. The theoretical analysis is compared with experimental data.

articleTitle: Parametric origin of optical magnetism
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Intense magnetic scattering in insulators is shown to be a second order process, depending on the product of optical electric and magnetic fields. Quantitative agreement (no free parameters) is achieved with saturated magnetic response.

articleTitle: Phase matching using ridge Bragg Reflection Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ridge Bragg Reflection Waveguides are used to phase-match second harmonic generation at 1600 nm. Exact phase-matching bandwidth of 4.5 nm with an internal conversion efficiency of 8.6%/W is obtained.

articleTitle: Amplified spontaneous emission and optical gain coefficient of SiOX based planar waveguide with buried silicon nanocrystals on silicon substrate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Si-rich SiOx planar waveguide with Si nanocrystals contributed amplified spontaneous emission at 750–850 nm is characterized by variable stripe length method to demonstrate optical gain and loss coefficients of 60 and 16 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, respectively.

articleTitle: Temporal shaping of a heralded single-photon wave packet
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the temporal shaping and nonlocal control of a heralded single-photon wave packet, conditionally prepared by detecting the idler trigger photon of the signal-idler photon pair born in the process of spontaneous parametric down-conversion.

articleTitle: Photoacoustic tomography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The field of photoacoustic tomography has experienced considerable growth in the past few years. Although several commercially available pure optical imaging modalities, including confocal microscopy, two-photon microscopy, and optical coherence tomography, have been highly successful, none of these technologies can provide penetration beyond ~1 mm into scattering biological tissues because they are based on ballistic and quasi-ballistic photons. Heretofore, there has been a void in high-resolution optical imaging beyond this depth limit. Photoacoustic tomography, which combines high ultrasonic resolution and strong optical contrast in a single modality, has filled this void. In this invited presentation, the fundamentals of photoacoustics are first introduced. Then, scanning photoacoustic microscopy and reconstruction-based photoacoustic tomography (or photoacoustic computed tomography) are covered. Recent progress are highlighted.

articleTitle: Enhancement of broadband Terahertz radiation by carrier dynamics modulation with a single chirped optical pulse
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Over 60% enhancement of broadband THz radiation and two-fold bandwidth broadening are demonstrated by a single positive chirped optical pulse. A model of carrier dynamics modulation is proposed to explain this phenomenon.

articleTitle: High-Q photonic nanocavity with a 2-ns photon lifetime
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed a photonic crystal nanocavity with a quality factor of 2.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> and a photon lifetime over 2 ns. This lifetime is the longest recorded thus far in photonic crystal cavities.

articleTitle: Extraction of single photons by a cavity-QED system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The nonlinear dynamics of a classical photon pulse occurring at a two-sided cavity QED system in the weak-coupling regime is investigated theoretically. It is shown that this system functions as a single-photon filter.

articleTitle: OLEDs on fibers and AFM cantilevers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This talk will discuss recent work on novel device architectures that include ITO-free OLEDs deposited on fibers, on highly corrugated surfaces and sharp tips for for solid-state lighting and microscopy applications.

articleTitle: The imbert-fedorov and goos-Hänchen shift at metamaterial interfaces
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We analyze beam displacements that occur upon reflection at interfaces between homogeneous media and metamaterials. Emphasis is put on system requirements, the techniques to predict the shift and the peculiarities in the presence of metamaterials.

articleTitle: Two-photon luminescence imaging using a MEMS-based miniaturized probe
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present two-photon luminescence (TPL) imaging of cancer cells through a 10 times 15 times 40 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> miniaturized probe employing a two-axis MEMS scanning mirror and an air-core photonic crystal fiber. The combination of TPL imaging with a small probe represents a potential method of distinguishing cancerous cells in tissue for diagnosis.

articleTitle: A self-referenced diode-pumped Yb:KYW frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A diode-pumped Yb:KYW frequency comb system is described. Spectral broadening in microstructured fiber allows detection and control of the carrier-envelope offset frequency. The integrated residual phase noise on f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is 0.3 radians (0.1 Hz-0.5 MHz).

articleTitle: Temperature dependent properties of novel functionalized anthradithiophene and dicyanomethylenedihydrofuran derivatives
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present optical, fluorescent and photoconductive temperature dependent properties of novel high-performance solution-processable functionalized anthradithiophene and dicyanomethylenedihydrofuran derivatives. Changes in fluorescence lifetime, fluorescence quantum yield, and photoconductivity with temperature are discussed.

articleTitle: Coupled quantum electrodynamics in photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe a scalable nanocavity array, with single quantum dots, for universal single-operation N-qubit quantum gate. A single two-level system controls the lineshapes, departing from optical-analog of electromagnetically-induced-transparency, with high fidelity and low photon loss.

articleTitle: Two-photon-induced photoluminescence imaging of tumors using near-infrared excited gold nanoshells
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report strong two-photon-induced photoluminescence (TPIP) from silica/gold nanoshells (NS). We demonstrate its potential application for imaging the 3D distribution of NS in tumors using a NIR laser scanning multi-photon microscope.

articleTitle: The higher mode lasing scheme of 1.56μm Si-InGaAsP hybrid laser diode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A hybrid laser diode consisted of Si slab waveguide and III-V ridge waveguide has been investigated. This structure is efficient for enhancing the confinement factors in the silicon region and the III-V active region simultaneously.

articleTitle: Time-bin entanglement with single photons from a quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
