abstract: We report a Franson-type experiment where two single photons from an InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot in a pillar micro-cavity reach two different, spatially separated 2-by-2 couplers at the same time and interfere with high visibility.

articleTitle: High enhancement in light output of InGaN-based micro-hole array LEDs by photoelectrochemical (PEC) oxidation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: InGaN micro-hole-array LEDs (μ-LEDs) with and without oxide-film on it were fabricated. Compared with conventional LED, output power of μ-LEDs without and with oxide film have enhancement of 38% and 82% at 20 mA, respectively.

articleTitle: Fast-decay-time scintillation of LaF3:Ce colloidal nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Positron emission tomography requires high-brightness fast-decay scintillators for coincidence counting of positron annihilation events. We demonstrate that LaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>:Ce nanocrystals show promising characteristics for that application. Scintillation response and photoluminescence lifetime below 27 ns are measured.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional microscopic interferometer by frequency sweep of supercontinuum frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A three-dimensional microscopic interferometer by the interval frequency sweep of the supercontinuum frequency comb generated by an optical pulse synthesizer was demonstrated. The spectral bandwidth was 80 nm. The interferometric peak width was 35 μm.

articleTitle: Bright and color-saturated emission from blue light emitting diodes based on solution-processed colloidal nanocrystal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a bright and color-saturated blue light-emitting-diode based on colloidal core/shell-CdS/ZnS quantum-dots. Broad-band, long-wavelength emission from the deep-traps in QDs is, for the first time, minimized to less than 5% of the total emission.

articleTitle: Identification of weak inversion and inversion-rotational transitions within excited vibrational state of ammonia
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that a widely-tunable far-IR source developed by us recently can be used to identify weak inversion and inversion-rotational transitions within the v<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>=1 excited state of NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> molecule. Seven transition peaks have been observed.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous dielectric mixtures in the terahertz frequency range: Theory and experiment
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a new physical model for describing heterogeneous dielectric mixtures in the terahertz frequency range, which overcomes drawbacks of established models. The theory is confirmed by highly accurate data on polymeric compounds.

articleTitle: Exciton Raman coherence revealed in two-dimensional fourier transform spectroscopy of semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Raman coherence between heavy-hole and light-hole excitons in quantum wells is isolated in an alternative spectrum and contributions from single exciton and correlated two-exciton states are studied experimentally and theoretically by excitation with different polarizations.

articleTitle: Wide ridge low-divergence metal-metal terahertz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We utilize plasmonic side-absorbers to enforce lasing in the TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> mode in wide ridge metal-metal terahertz quantum cascade lasers, which results in improved power outcoupling and reduced far-field divergence for both surface- and edge-emitting devices.

articleTitle: Scanning probe optical microscopy using an integrated submicron organic photodetector
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A high-resolution scanning optical microscopy technique is developed by using focused ion beam milling and vacuum thermal evaporation to fabricate an organic photodetector with sub-micron size on a scanning probe cantilever. Optical and topographic data are recorded simultaneously and demonstrate sub-micron resolution. Potential applications of the probe include materials characterization, biology, and nanophotonics, and are aided by the fact that the probe is compatible with conventional atomic force microscopy (AFM) systems and does not suffer some of the practical difficulties of existing near-field scanning optical microscopy (NSOM) systems.

articleTitle: High-order harmonic generation in high intensity laser-solid interactions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We will discuss the two mechanisms involved in high-order harmonic generation from plasma mirrors, and show that they can be clearly identified experimentally. The phase and coherence properties of these harmonics will be analyzed.

articleTitle: CPA free sub-picosecond ultrafast laser amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a diode-pumped Ytterbium ultrashort pulse laser amplifier, avoiding chirped pulse amplification, resulting in a simple and robust laser sources. The average power exceeds 10 W for repetition rates between 50 and 100 kHz.

articleTitle: Gain competition and mode shifts in ZnO nanorod lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the lasing of individual ZnO nanorod resonators. We focus on the dynamics of the laser modes in terms of gain competition and shifts. Furthermore the influence of temperature on lasing thresholds is discussed.

articleTitle: Repulsive and attractive surface soliton potentials at boundaries between periodic media
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An interface between two periodic 1D arrays with self-focusing Kerr nonlinearities is shown experimentally to support strikingly different families of surface solitons due to differences in surface potential near the boundary.

articleTitle: Comparison of four-wave mixing in quantum dots and quantum wells for wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally investigate wavelength conversion in quantum-dot and quantum-well optical amplifiers via four-wave mixing. Our results show superior conversion efficiency in a quantum dot device compared to a quantum well device with identical gain.

articleTitle: Widely tunable picosecond fiber ring laser mode-locked by a single-wall carbon nanotube (SWNT)-polycarbonate composite film saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A widely tunable fiber ring laser, utilising a SWNT/polycarbonate film mode-locker and a 3-nm tunable filter, has been realized. 2.3 ps pulse generation over 27 nm spectral range is achieved for a constant pump power of 25 mW.

articleTitle: Magneto Optical Pump Probe Imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a new technique for imaging magnetic domains with a confocal optical resolution. It is based on a magneto-optical pump-probe imaging (MOPPI) using femtosecond laser pulses. Its efficiency on various magnetic structures is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Laser-scanning coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) microscopy is ready for biomedical applications. Initial works have shown its great potential in the study of cancer, multiple sclerosis, and cardiovascular diseases.

articleTitle: A microelectromechanically tunable asymmetric Fabry-Perot quantum well modulator at 1.55 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an InP-based microelectromechanically tunable asymmetric Fabry-Perot quantum well modulator that operates in the optical C-band. The device exhibits contrast ratios over 20 (13 dB) with less than 8 volts bias.

articleTitle: Gap-dependent nonlinear optical activity in chiral gold nanodimers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: T-shaped gold nanodimers with nanogaps are chiral when their horizontal and vertical bars have non-orthogonal orientations. The resulting optical activity in second-harmonic generation exhibits unexpected gap dependence, which is explained by local-field effects.

articleTitle: Photon-photon correlations from a resonantly driven quantum dot in a microcavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate strongly driven resonance fluorescence from a single InGaAs quantum dot in a planar microcavity by measuring the coherent oscillations in the second-order correlation function, g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(t), of the photoluminescence.

articleTitle: Experimental verification of spatial distribution of photodarkening in large mode area ytterbium doped fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated that photodarkening is not uniformly distributed in the cross-section of bent LMA fibers. Photodarkening distribution depends on coiling diameter, and affects the use of fibers in applications and their photo-darkening propensity measurement.

articleTitle: Vertical integration of ultrafast semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We discuss a passively modelocked VECSEL with both gain and saturable absorber integrated into a single semiconductor structure. We refer to this new kind of laser as the modelocked integrated external-cavity surface emitting laser (MIXSEL).

articleTitle: 2-micron optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier for long-wavelength driven high harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An optical parametric chirped pulse amplification system producing high-energy, few-cycle pulses at 2.0-mum wavelength with low superfluorescence noise background for high harmonic generation in gas jets is demonstrated.

articleTitle: High Accuracy Numerical Method for Index of Refraction Estimation with Surface Plasmon Bandgap Structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Eigenvector analysis on 2D surface plasmon photonic bandgap images is used for refractive index estimation. High precision (rms error of 3.8 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup>RIU) and large dynamic range (n = 1.305 to 1.375) are achieved with noisy data.

articleTitle: Measurement of the oxygenation level of hemoglobin with spectroscopic spectral-domain optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the measurement of hemoglobin oxygen saturation level in human blood with a spectroscopic spectral-domain optical coherence tomography system based on the cross-over behavior of Hb and HbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> absorption coefficients around 800 nm.

articleTitle: From positive- to negative-index materials: Transitional phenomena
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate light propagation through a transition layer between the positive- and negative-index materials with linearly changing material parameters. Strong enhancement of TE-and TM-wave components near the point of zero refractive index is predicted.

articleTitle: Tapered hollow-core photonic crystal fiber for cascaded Stimulated-Raman-Scattering
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the fabrication of a tapered hollow-core photonic crystal fiber with a transition-length as long as 40m for cascaded Stimulated-Raman-Scattering applications. The structural and optical characterization demonstrates the linearity of the taper.

articleTitle: 52%-efficient single-pass SHG in a PPLN waveguide by frequency doubling of a cw-DFB RW laser diode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: 159 mW diffraction limited blue light at 488 nm could be generated in a periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide crystal by frequency doubling of a continuous wave distributed feedback laser diode.

articleTitle: Frequency doubling of 300J/1ns Nd:glass laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Two types of interaction at second harmonic generation of Nd:glass laser are compared theoretically and experimentally. If beam depolarization >1%, ooe-interaction is preferable. A 72% efficiency has been obtained at the fundamental harmonic of 300 J.

articleTitle: Preparation and characterization of arbitrary states of four-dimensional qudits based on biphotons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report an experiment on preparation and characterization of general four-dimensional quantum states using ultrafast-pumped frequency-nondegenerate spontaneous parametric down-conversion. We also discuss two additional experimental schemeswhich offermore complete control of the state purity and entropy.

articleTitle: Side-detection of out-coupled core light from a microfluidic fiber microslit
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The interactions of the core-propagating light with an intersecting microslit within a conventional single-mode fiber are investigated. Orientation-dependent out-coupling of core light was utilized to create side-detection, miniature fiber rotation sensors.

articleTitle: Interferometric measurement of high-order harmonic fields with attosecond temporal resolution
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate interferometric spectroscopy of high-order harmonic fields with a resolution of the XUV optical period. In addition, we obtain an interferometric fringe of an attosecond pulse train by reconstruction from these harmonic fields.

articleTitle: Application of phase retrieval for predicting a high-intensity focused laser field
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Multiple-focal-plane spatial phase retrieval for a chirped-pulse-amplification laser is demonstrated for the first time. Advantages of this method are simplicity of setup, ability to measure angular dispersion, and potential integration into precision, on-shot focal-spot diagnostics.

articleTitle: UV laser radiation inhibits domain inversion in lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Continuous wave UV laser (lambda = 244 nm) irradiation of the +z face of lithium niobate single crystals inhibits ferroelectric domain inversion in the volume of the crystal which lies immediately below the UV exposed surface.

articleTitle: Compact diode laser trace gas system with an optical fiber coupled flexible high-finesse external cavity based on cavity ringdown spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A fiber coupled high-finesse external cavity diode laser for cavity ringdown spectroscopy was successfully demonstrated. The sensitivity of 1x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−7</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> was achieved in a 1 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> remotely located ringdown cavity as a sensor head.

articleTitle: Middle-IR Random lasing of Cr:ZnS nanocrystalline powder - from diffusion to photon localization regimes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: First room temperature mid-IR lasing due to intra-shell transitions in the doped semiconductor nanocrystals (NC) is reported. The 27 nm Cr:ZnS NCs oscillate at 2200 nm with 325 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> laser threshold. Temperature dependence of photoluminescence decay, lasing threshold and lasing wavelength maxima of Cr:ZnS NCs are studied.

articleTitle: Amplification of high energy picosecond pulses using Slab-Coupled Waveguide Amplifiers at 1550 nm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate amplification of picosecond pulses centered at 1550 nm using slab-coupled waveguide amplifiers. For bias currents less than 1 A, we obtained a maximum unsaturated gain of 12.3 dB and a pulse saturation energy of ~50 pJ.

articleTitle: Ultrafast coercivity and magnetization dynamics in GaMnAs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using time-resolved magneto-optical Kerr effect spectroscopy, the magnetization and coercivity dynamics in GaMnAs are investigated. A subpicosecond ferromagnetic to paramagnetic phase transition is observed, followed by coercivity enhancement on longer time scales.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: High-energy direct amplification of femtosecond pulses in the nonlinear regime
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on direct amplification of femtosecond pulses in large-mode area fibers, where nonlinear effects dominate over dispersion. Careful compression allows the generation of muJ sub-80 fs pulses with good temporal pulse quality.

articleTitle: Investigating high-speed modulation characteristics of quantum dots in red emitting quantum dot-light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the high-speed modulation characteristics of quantum dots in red emitting quantum dot-light emitting diodes, in which the -3dB cutoff frequency for 6-mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> device is 1.5 MHz under optimized conditions. The introduction of a positive offset DC bias voltage greatly increases the modulation speed at low applied voltage range.

articleTitle: Information with light in random media from spatial speckle correlations over excitation position
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that the spatial correlation of speckle intensity patterns over the source excitation position is sensitive to polarization, scatter, and source arrangement. This should prove important for sensing in the presence of scatter.

articleTitle: Ultrafast probing of the complex refractive index in an active mid infrared quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Time and phase resolved spectroscopy of broadband mid infrared pulses transmitted through the active medium of a mid infrared quantum cascade laser reveal the full complex refractive index and its derivatives over a wide spectral range. Using electro-optic sampling, we can monitor the optical response even above threshold and study effects of gain depletion and decoherence.

articleTitle: First report of absorption and fluorescence singularities in the Nd:YCOB monoclinic crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report measurements in polarized light of angular distribution of absorption and fluorescence of a monoclinic crystal. Patterns are close to the biaxial index surface topology but main values are not in the dielectric frame.

articleTitle: Third-harmonic generation in organic thin films as an alternative to degenerate four-wave mixing ultrafast optical image processing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the use of noncollinear third-harmonic generation in thin organic films for ultrafast optical image processing using 80 fs pulses at 1550nm and compare it with the traditional degenerate four-wave mixing approach.

articleTitle: Wavepacket expansion in nonlinear disordered lattices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present experimental and numerical results of wavepacket expansion in one-dimensional disordered nonlinear waveguide arrays. We show that in 1D there is a direct transition from ballistic expansion to localization, which is accelerated by nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic gate operation using near-field energy transfer between InAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated nanophotonic gate operation of coupled InAs quantum dots using the pump-and-probe micro-photoluminescence measurement. The result indicates that we can select either AND- or NOT-gate operation by controlling the pulse intensity.

articleTitle: Microwave phase shifter based on Mach-Zehnder intensity modulator and polarization rotation in an SOA
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We introduce a novel scheme based on nonlinear polarization rotation in an SOA and the polarization characteristics of a Mach-Zehnder intensity modulator, to implement a large controllable phase shift over 20GHz modulation bandwidth.

articleTitle: Low loss ring resonator waveguides in self processing photopolymers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a method for making low loss ring resonators in self processing photopolymers via direct-write lithography. This direct-write method compensates radiation mode coupling to first order, significantly reducing bend loss.

articleTitle: Sub-5-fs real-time spectroscopy of transition states in bacteriorhodopsin during retinal isomerization
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The C=C stretching mode of bacteriorhodopsin was modulated by torsion of the C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</inf>=C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</inf> double bond with a period of 200 fs. The real-time data elucidates the relations among the real-time torsion angle, bond order.

articleTitle: Templated self-assembly and nano-plasmonics of nano-void surfaces
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Three-dimensionally nano-structured metal surfaces containing nano-scale voids produce strong localised plasmons. We show here the correlation between physical structure and photonic and electronic properties for several significant applications.

articleTitle: Ultrafast surface plasmon pulses and their limitations using prism coupling excitation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We characterize femtosecond surface plasmon pulses that are excited through conventional prism coupling on metal films. The resonant excitation mechanism causes spectral narrowing and phase changes that result in temporal broadening of ultrafast plasmon pulses.

articleTitle: Photoelastic tomographic characterization of stress distribution in fibers in dependence of drawing parameters
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Residual stress distribution is experimentally analyzed in different optical fibers thanks to photoelastic tomography characterization to demonstrate the dependence by fiber drawing parameters, such as speed tension and temperature.

articleTitle: Generation of intense ultra-short laser pulse from argon-filled hollow waveguide using MIIPS
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a method for generation of ultra-broad bandwidth laser spectrum using self-phase modulation in the argon-filled hollow waveguide and pulse compression with multiphoton intrapulse interference phase scan technique.

articleTitle: Femtosecond resonant pulse propagation in quantum cascade lasers: Evidence of coherent effects
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultrafast upconversion is employed to investigate pulse propagation in quantum cascade lasers. The authors have observed advances of the pulse peak to early times, pulse re-shaping, and evidence of a coherent contribution to pulse propagation.

articleTitle: “Pick and place” Positioning of diamond nanocrystals on microcavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Diamond nanocrystals are deterministically positioned on high-Q SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> microdisks using a fiber taper. The fiber taper is then used to collect cavity modified NV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup> nanocrystal emission.

articleTitle: Conditional and unconditional g(2)(0) measurements of a microstructure-fiber-based heralded single-photon source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using photon pairs created via four-wave mixing in a microstructure fiber, we measure g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(0) of idler photons heralded by a signal photon to be well below one, and six times less than unconditional g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(0).

articleTitle: Emission characteristics of a surface-emitting composite organic photonic-crystal laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Lasing action of a composite organic thin-film laser with a 2nd-order two-dimensional photonic crystal structure of triangular lattice is investigated. The analysis of band theory is adopted and the emission pattern is also presented.

articleTitle: Light propagation and effective parameters of nanowire based metamaterials: An analytical approach
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An alternative way to determine the dispersion relation and the effective material parameters is presented. The introduced model can be applied to treat the double wire as well as the split ring resonator geometry, while the first one is presented in this paper. The approach combines the electric and magnetic multipole expansion of a single structure to describe the propagation properties of the respective effective medium. The electron dynamics in the composite structure is described by a coupled harmonic oscillator. Thus all higher order multipoles can be calculated explicitly and the macroscopic Maxwell equations can be solved self consistent for electromagnetic plane waves. A final comparison to numerically obtained parameters validates the applicability of the model.

articleTitle: Terahertz emission from charge transport in inhomogeneous fields
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study terahertz emission due to charge transport in inhomogeneous fields of semiconductor devices. The dependence on the applied field unveils individual constituents such as intervalley transfer of electrons and the contribution of hole transport.

articleTitle: Photonic components for short range optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optical interconnect technology will play an increasingly important role in servers and supercomputers as a means to keep pace with the increasing intra-system bandwidth requirements. Low-cost and high density optical packaging concepts are required.

articleTitle: Lasing in sub-micron semiconductor disk
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Lasing was realized a sub-micron GaAs disk, which was fabricated by standard optical lithography and wet-etching method. As the disk thickness is comparable to the disk radius, 3D-FDTD was used to simulate the resonant modes.

articleTitle: High-accuracy interferometer with a prism pair for measurement of the absolute refractive index of glass
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Interferometer for precise refractive-index measurement of glass-prism without prior knowledge is developed using a direct comparison of optical-path-changes in glass and air. Preliminary result shows uncertainty of 4.4 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> agreeing with the manufacturerpsilas values.

articleTitle: Hong-Ou-Mandel interference with a LED
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe the first electrically-driven single-photon source which can demonstrate Hong-Ou-Mandel type interference. Experiments were performed under both pulsed and CW excitation, and we discuss the factors limiting visibility in both cases.

articleTitle: Photosensitizer-doped organic light-emitting diodes for near infrared to visible optical upconversion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The optical upconversion of infrared light to visible light has been achieved in infrared photosensitizer-doped organic light-emitting diodes. This work brought forth a prototype design for novel flexible organic optical upconversion device.

articleTitle: Picometrology of ultra-thin gold film by spinning-disc interferometry
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We obtain the complex refractive index of ultra-thin gold film (down to 20 picometers) on thermal oxide on silicon by the combination of in-line (IL) and differential-phase-contrast (DPC) channels of spinning-disc interferometry (SDI).

articleTitle: Optical anisotropy in InGaN/GaN quantum-well light-emitting diodes with a general crystal orientation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have studied the crystal orientation effect on optical anisotropy in InGaN/GaN quantum-well light-emitting diodes. The absolute value of the anisotropy is found to increase rapidly with increasing crystal angle.

articleTitle: Range sensing using photometric differentiation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a passive optical ranging method consisting of three photometric measurements from the light reflected by an object. The measurements are taken from a single position using a CCD camera and different apertures.

articleTitle: High speed cross gain modulation using quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifiers at 1.3 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on ultra-fast small signal sinusoidal cross-gain modulation using quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifiers exceeding a 40 GHz bandwidth in frequency and 40 nm in the wavelength domain.

articleTitle: Impedance of photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show how the concept of impedance can be defined rigorously in terms of Bloch modes for photonic crystal applications and then exploit this to accurately and efficiently design multilayer anti-reflection coatings for photonic crystals.

articleTitle: High-power red-green-blue all solid state laser based on an optical superlattice
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A stable red, green and blue output was obtained by frequency doubling and tripling an alternate resonant dual-wavelength Q-switched Nd:YAG laser with an optical superlattice in a LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> crystal as a frequency converter.

articleTitle: Bright photoluminescence from GaAs and InGaAs nanoneedles grown on Si substrates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report novel single-crystalline (In)GaAs nanoneedles with 2~5 nm tips, smooth 6-9deg taper angles and lengths up to 3-4 mum, grown aligned to [111] orientation on Si substrates. Bright photoluminescence is obtained from quantum-well nanoneedles.

articleTitle: 3D-chiral metamaterial with artificial magnetic response
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Artificial magnetism, negative permeability and zero refractive index are demonstrated in 3D-chiral metamaterial that shows giant polarization rotation and circular dichroism.

articleTitle: Coherent enhancement in Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present direct measurements of almost ten orders of magnitude enhancement in coherent over spontaneous Raman. The measured ground state coherence is in good agreement with theory, and is verified by the molecular concentration dependence.

articleTitle: Influence of erbium-doped fiber amplifiers on the timing stability of optical pulse trains
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The influence of an erbium-doped fiber amplifier on the timing stability of an optical pulse train was characterized with balanced optical cross-correlation. Under optimized conditions, an added timing jitter of 0.5 fs was achieved.

articleTitle: Self-organized plasma planes create nanogratings on NiTi alloy surfaces
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Nanogratings spaced at 630 nm on NiTi alloy surfaces are produced by self-organized nanoplasma planes following scan of linearly-polarized femtosecond laser pulses. Their formation characteristics are investigated. Theoretical analysis matches well with our observations.

articleTitle: Micro-photoluminescence from a single InGaN-based nano-pillar fabricated by focused ion beam milling
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Micro-photoluminescence from GaN/InGAN multiple quantum wells embedded in a nano-pillar structure with a diameter of 300 nm is characterized. The emission spectrum shows a blue shift of 68.3 meV in energy due to strain relaxation.

articleTitle: Self-starting Kerr-mode-locked polycrystalline Cr2+:ZnSe laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a middle-infrared self-starting Kerr-mode-locked Cr:ZnSe laser operating at 103 MHz repetition-rate with estimated lower limit of the pulse width of 300 fs and output power of 50 mW at 2.4 mum wavelength.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: The CHSH-Bell inequality and Tsirelson’s bound with postselection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show the necessary and sufficient conditions on loss for valid CHSH-Bell experiments, and propose an experiment with loss which should violate Tsirelson’s bound for entangled states.

articleTitle: Plasma properties during the formation of “nanograting” structures inside fused silica
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The influence of accumulation effects on the creation of ldquonanogratingrdquo structures has been investigated. Furthermore, the plasma electron density has been measured with a spectral interferometry pump-probe technique.

articleTitle: Resonantly enhanced near-field lithography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose the combination of a planar optical resonator and a solid immersion lens for resonantly enhanced non-contact near-field lithography. Subwavelength small spots can be produced by exciting the Bessel modes of the resonator.

articleTitle: Quasi-flat-top —Frequency-doubled Nd:glass laser for Pumping of High-power Ti:sapphire Amplifiers at 0.1 Hz A Repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Nd:glass laser delivers up to 120 J-energy with flat-top profile at 0.1 Hz. The output is frequency doubled with 50% efficiency and used to pump Ti:sapphire. The developed design is perspective for ultra-high-intensity-lasers.

articleTitle: 3D nanoscale pattern formation in porous silicon
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A simple and effective processing technique for 3D nanoscale pattern formation in light emitting porous silicon is reported. The technique is based on metal assisted chemical etching and defined by the 2D nanoscale metal pattern.

articleTitle: Terahertz semiconductor gain medium: Static properties and dynamic behavior
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Study of gain medium of terahertz quantum cascade lasers based on the interaction with broadband coherent radiation is presented. The phase resolved emitted field provides information on gain bandwidth, saturation recovery dynamics and coherent processes.

articleTitle: Effect of loss on slow-light enhanced absorption in liquid-infiltrated photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study slow-light enhancement of absorption measurements in photonic crystals composed of lossy dielectrics. We find that the material loss has an unexpected limited drawback and may even increase the bandwidth for low-index contrast systems.

articleTitle: Cascaded over- and under-coupled resonators (COUR): reducing group delay dispersion and overcoming the sensitivity-bandwidth trade-off
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Cascaded over- and under-coupled resonators (COUR) result in slow light followed by fast light. COUR can be used as a notch filter and phase modulator that overcomes the trade-offs of extinction-ratio—group-delay and sensitivity—bandwidth.

articleTitle: High garmonic generation and extreme nonlinear optics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: With the recent developments of new X-ray light sources and measurement techniques, the field of ultrafast X-ray science has tremendously advanced. Laser based high harmonic sources deliver nowadays attosecond and or keV X-ray pulses.

articleTitle: Generation of THz pulses in Teflon bonded periodically inverted GaAs structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel technique for low-temperature bonding of GaAs wafers using an interboundary Teflon film is developed. A 2 x 2 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> quasi-phase matched structure of 5 wafers pumped by CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser lines generated the narrow-band THz radiation.

articleTitle: Topological stability of stored optical vortices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report an experiment in which an optical vortex is stored in a vapor of Rb atoms. Because of its 2pi phase twist, this mode is topologically stable and cannot unwind even under conditions of strong diffusion.

Author Keywords: (020.1335) Atomic and molecular physics: Atom optics
(020.1670) Atomic and molecular physics: Coherent optical effects

articleTitle: Phase coherent, injection-seeded table-top soft x-ray lasers at wavelengths down to 13.9 nm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have realized the first demonstration of soft X-ray lasers with essentially full spatial and temporal coherence at sub-20 nm wavelengths by high harmonic seeding of soft X-ray plasma amplifiers created by irradiation of solid targets.

articleTitle: Full C-band tunable laser based on electroholgraphy in the g44 configuration
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An electrically tunable laser covering the entire C-band is presented. The laser tuning device is an electrohologram in the g44 configuration implemented in a potassium lithium tantalate niobate crystal.

articleTitle: Laser drilling using a high repetition rate and high average power femtosecond fiber CPA system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on laser drilling experiments on copper and stainless steel samples using a novel ultrafast fiber CPA laser amplifier. Effects of particle shielding and heat accumulation at high average powers are discussed.

articleTitle: Waveguide induced spectral bandwidth enhancement of slow light group index caused by stimulated Brillouin scattering in optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that the spectral bandwidth of slow light systems based on stimulated Brillioun scattering in optical fibers can be massively increased by waveguide induced spectral broadening, to a telecom-scale value of ges10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Laser terahertz emission microscopy toward high-resolution imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: As an unique terahertz application, we have been developing a laser terahertz emission microscope (LTEM) for not only a study of basic science but also industrial application such as an inspection tool for semiconductor integrated circuits. In order to establish high resolution system, we employed a high-refractive solid immersion lens and a beam expander in LTEM system, by which a focused beam spot size can be minimized effectively. Using the modified LTEM, nondestructive terahertz emission images of samples patterned as line-and-space structure on InP was obtained with a spatial resolution better than 1.5 μm.

articleTitle: Femtosecond coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering measurement of gas-phase species and temperature
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The use of femtosecond lasers for coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering measurements in gases is reviewed. Coupling of femtosecond laser radiation with gas-phase resonances, determination of temperature from frequency-spread dephasing, and single-shot measurements are discussed.

articleTitle: Observation of double-EIT in a four-level tripod atomic system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present an experimental observation of simultaneous EIT for probe and trigger fields (double EIT) in a four-level tripod EIT system in <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb atoms D1 line.

articleTitle: Achievement of ultra-low threshold excitation power (8 nW) in a nearly-single quantum dot nanocavity laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate photonic crystal nanocavity laser with nearly-single quantum dot gain. Continuous-wave lasing was achieved at photocarrier generation rate of 5 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup>/s, corresponding to several carrier injection into nearly-single quantum dot.

articleTitle: Probing bacterial surfaces using 4Pi spectral self-interference fluorescence microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present nanometer scale axial localization of fluorescent markers to probe subcellular structures using self-interference based fluorescence microscopy. We show probing the membrane topography of a gram-negative bacterium, Shigella flexneri, and discuss further applications.

articleTitle: Decay control via discrete-continuum modulation in optical waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on fractional decay suppression as well as decay deceleration and acceleration of an unstable quantum mechanical state. The decay is directly observed in a system of optical waveguides.

articleTitle: Low voltage defect heterogeneous quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a quantum cascade laser employing two different injector regions and matched 4.6 mum optical transitions for low-voltage-defect operation. The laser has a pulsed wall-plug efficiency of 19% at 80 K and operates pulsed at 300 K.

articleTitle: Topological phase for spin-orbit transformations on a laser beam
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the topological phase associated with the SO(3) representation in terms of maximally entangled states. An experimental demonstration of this topological phase is provided for polarization and spatial mode transformations of a laser beam.

articleTitle: Extension of quasi-supercontinuum generation in multiple-bandgap semiconductor quantum-dash laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a viable approach for ultrabroad-stimulated emission in InAs/InAlGaAs quantum-dash laser. This method involves the integration of multiple diodes with respective bandgaps tuned to different energies along a single laser cavity using postgrowth-intermixing process.

articleTitle: Angular-dependence of molecular photoionization cross-sections studied by time-resolved EUV spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We obtain angular data on molecular EUV photoionization. We impulsively align N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and then ionize using high-harmonic pulses. By measuring the ion yield versus delay we extract angle-dependent cross-sections.

articleTitle: Demonstrations of analog-to-digital conversion using a frequency domain stretched processor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Proof-of-concept analog-to-digital conversion demonstrations are presented for a photonics based frequency-domain, stretched processor. Here 800 MHz bandwidths and >26 dB dynamic range are shown, with models suggesting 10-bit performance over 20 GHz bandwidths.

articleTitle: Backward Raman amplification in a plasma waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Backward Raman amplification of a short laser pulse in a plasma waveguide is demonstrated. Besides providing a larger gain, the plasma waveguide also suppresses premature Raman backscattering of the pump pulse.

articleTitle: Coherent Raman micro-spectroscopy with a mode-locked Ti:Sapphire oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a simple, femtosecond-oscillator-based system for CARS microscopy, wherein impulsive Raman excitation is combined with narrow-band time-delayed, and therefore, background-free probing.

articleTitle: 90° phase-matched χ(3) third-harmonic generation in BiB3O6
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: BiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> has been found to be 90deg phase-matchable for type-I and type-2 chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> third-harmonic generation at 0.3263 and 0.3837 mum at 20degC. The improved Sellmeier equations that correctly reproduce the new data are presented.

articleTitle: Vertically emitting distributed feedback laser for active label free biosensing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A distributed feedback laser has been demonstrated as a label free biosensor. The stimulated emission wavelength changes with the refractive index variations on the sensor surface. The sensor exhibits high resolution and wide dynamic range.

articleTitle: Single particle plasmon spectroscopy of silver nanowires
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The excitation of surface plasmons on individual silver nanowires is studied by high-resolution electron energy loss spectroscopy in a transmission electron microscope, and the results are compared to ensemble optical spectra. The transverse and longitudinal modes of these nanostructures were selectively resolved, confirming the plasmon peak shift versus nanowire length.

articleTitle: Femtosecond thin disk lasers with ≫10 μJ pulse energy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a SESAM-modelocked Yb:YAG laser generating nearly transform-limited femtosecond pulses with 11-muJ energy at 4 MHz repetition rate and excellent beam quality. We discuss the key challenges for further increase of the pulse energy.

articleTitle: Quantum path interference in the wavelength dependence of high-harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the fundamental-wavelength dependence of high-harmonic generation yield. Superimposed on a smooth power-law dependence, we find surprisingly strong and rapid fluctuations on a fine wavelength scale, due to quantum-path interferences.

articleTitle: Fourier plasmonics: Diffractive focusing of in-plane surface plasmon polariton waves
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An in-plane Fresnel zone plate for focusing surface plasmon polariton (SPP) fields has been designed, fabricated and tested. Diffractive SPP fields from each Fresnel zone constructively interfere and focus at the designed focal point.

articleTitle: Surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy of aromatic compounds on silver nanoclusters
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy is used to characterize monolayers of different aromatic compounds in the proximity of silver nanoclusters. Based on theory and experiment we determine the origin of specific spectral shifts of Raman lines.

articleTitle: Polarization preservation of white-light supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that the supercontinuum picosecond generation (SC) preserves the polarization state, linear, elliptical and circular, of the pump source. Additionally, an analysis of the main mechanism was done based on the spectra polarization dependence.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable mid-infrared extraordinary optical transmission gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Active control over the resonant frequency of a surface plasmon excitation is demonstrated. Tunable semiconductor-based extraordinary optical transmission gratings were fabricated, designed for transmission between 7 and 10 mum, showing a tuning range of over 25 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Perfect coherence preservation in an atom interferometer perturbed by optical standing wave pulses acting as a kicked rotor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally studied the effect of standing wave pulses on an atom interferometer. Despite the external field perturbations the coherence is perfectly preserved for the conditions similar to quantum resonances of a quantum kicked rotor.

articleTitle: Stabilizing carrier-envelope phase by controlling grating separation of compressor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The carrier-envelope phase of amplified laser pulses was stabilized to 230 mrad by controlling compressor grating separation. This technique can be used to synthesize two amplified laser pulses.

articleTitle: Narrow spectral line, efficient 1172nm Raman fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the design and performance of an injection-seeded single-pass cascaded fiber Raman laser producing 10.5 W average output power at 1172 nm. The linewidth is < 0.1nm and optical to optical conversion efficiency is 35%.

articleTitle: Optical detection of THz-induced strong field effects in ensembles of neutral donors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Narrowband THz radiation drives transitions between bound electron states in GaAs neutral donors. Elastic light scattering from a donor bound exciton resonance allows time-resolved measurements of the excited state lifetime and THz-induced AC stark effect.

articleTitle: Subwavelength imaging via dark state
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We theoretically study possibilities of creating spatial patterns having subwavelength length by using so-called dark states. These dark states are formed via interaction with bichromatic optical fields. Performing experiments in Rb vapor, we experimentally demonstrated spatial patterns that are smaller than the length determined by the difraction limit of optical system used in the experiment. This approach has applications to interference lithography and can be used in coherent Raman spectroscopy to reach subwavelength spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Subwavelength imaging opportunities with a non-magnetic slab lens
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe the imaging properties of a non-magnetic slab lens without restrictions on material parameters. The best performance appears to be with an anisotropic slab that converts evanescent fields to propagating waves.

articleTitle: Beam slowing down in a laser plasma accelerator by laser-induced betatron oscillation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The beam in a laser wakefield can be slowed down by laser-induced, large-amplitude betatron oscillation, leading to potential larger dephasing length between the beam and the wake field and in turn a higher beam energy.

articleTitle: Direct pulse compression of Yb-doped fiber amplified pulses by use of a dazzler
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of 56 fs, 0.23 muJ high quality pulses at 20 kHz from a stretcher-free fiber amplifier. Compression is achieved through active control of the spectral phase using an acousto-optic programmable filter.

articleTitle: Nonperturbative detection of microwave radiation using fiber attached electro-optic sensors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Tests are described using fiber-attached, all-dielectric EO field sensors for the noninvasive detection of microwave fields generated by horn antennas and GTEM cell.

articleTitle: Wavelength selection in high-power cladding-pumped Er,Yb and Yb fibre lasers using volume Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report high-power operation of double-clad Yb-doped and Er,Yb-doped fiber lasers at 1066nm and 1553nm respectively using volume Bragg gratings for wavelength selection. Both lasers yielded output powers over 100W limited by available pump power.

articleTitle: Catastrophic optical damage in high-power diode lasers monitored by real-time imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Combined thermal and near-field imaging monitors the catastrophic optical damage dynamics in diode lasers. Red-emitting high-power lasers display a very rapid and spatially confined catastrophic process with re-absorption as the key-mechanism of device degradation.

articleTitle: Shortening of laser pulses at the focus of a chromatic lens
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that a long self-modulated laser pulse can be shortened at the focus of a chromatic lens as the result of a destructive superposition of the field due to the radius-dependent group delay.

articleTitle: Extreme-contrast front end for high-power laser systems
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A high-energy, high-contrast seed source for high-power lasers is directly generated using parametric amplification, with a temporal contrast better than 100 dB within 5 ps of the pulse peak and an extremely fast rising edge.

articleTitle: N×N all-optical packet sorter
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a 2times2 all-optical packet sorter which can be used as a building block for an NtimesN packet sorter for all-optical packet-switched network. Both the header and payload rates are 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: 200 kHz, 73 W highly stable Yb:YAG thin disk green laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: As a pump laser of a Ti:sapphire femtosecond laser, we developed high power, high repetition rate and highly stable Yb:YAG thin disk green laser. We achieved 200 kHz, 73 W operation.

articleTitle: Optical beam shaping by spatial light phase modulator with bidirectional tilt-piston micromirror array
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have succeeded in controlling the optical beam profile by MEMS spatial light phase modulator experimentally. The modulator proposed by our group has 1-D array of bidirectional tilt-piston micromirrors driven by electrostatic force.

articleTitle: Novel scheme for code preserving regenerative NRZ-DPSK wavelength and format conversion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a novel code-preserving NRZ-DPSK wavelength and format converter. It is based on optical filtering and a bi-stable device. It can be applied both to continuos and packet/burst traffic. Regenerative capability is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Growth of GaAs whiskers by MBE on LPCVD Si(111) nanowire trunks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the heteroepitaxial growth of wurtzite GaAs nanowhiskers on Si(111)-nanowire trunks forming hierarchical star-like structures with a six-fold symmetry, grown in the [0001] direction perpendicular to the Si-NW {112} facets.

articleTitle: “Effective index method”- Is it valid for nano-circuitry based on Plasmonic gaps?
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The effective index concept validity is studied for plasmonic gap nano-circuitry: waveguides, resonators and self-guiding. Contrary to unique and adverse characteristics of plasmonic modes in nano-devices, the EI analysis fairly agrees with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Energy transfer between four-wave and six-wave mixing processes in rubidium atoms via atomic coherence
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Efficient four-wave mixing (FWM) and six-wave mixing (SWM) processes are generated simultaneously in a four-level, inverted-Y atomic system via dual-EIT windows. Energy exchange during propagation between the FWM and SWM processes was experimentally observed.

articleTitle: Performance of THz-TDS using 1.5 μm femtosecond fiber laser with InP Schottky and DAST emitters
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Terahertz emission properties from photoconductive antenna made of Fe:InP Schottky diode have been studied upon femtosecond fiber laser excitation at a wavelength of 1560 nm in comparison with DAST. The InP emitter generates THz waves efficiently and it has proven that the fiber-laser-based THz-TDS using the InP and DAST emitter is a potential broadband spectroscopy system.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Time-domain THz spectroscopy of vibrational modes in a quasi-one-dimensional charge-density-wave crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Time-domain terahertz spectroscopic studies of the quasi-one-dimensional material PtI(en) reveal a highly anisotropic complex refractive index, including a strongly polarized infrared-active phonon absorption at 2.24 THz corresponding to modulation of the charge-density-wave structure.

articleTitle: Photophysics of Si nanostructures: Ensembles and single particles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The optical properties of Si nanostructures of varying dimensionality, size and fabrication methods is discussed. The Auger coefficient of TiSi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-catalyzed Si nanowires is 2times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-13</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s, lower than that of Si nanoparticles. To avoid ensembles artifacts, fabrication and optical analysis of single nanowires and nanoparticles is presented.

articleTitle: Low-repetition-rate femtosecond operation in long cavity modelocked Yb:CALGO laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on long-cavity modelocked laser with Yb:CALGO crystal, with, first, a 27-MHz, sub 100-fs single-pulse regime and, second, a very atypical double-pulse dualwavelength femtosecond regime.

articleTitle: Observation of the entanglement sudden death
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate, using an all-optical setup, the difference between local and global dynamics of entangled quantum systems coupled to independent environments. Even when the decay of each system is asymptotic, quantum entanglement may suddenly disappear. We also demonstrate experimentally that measurements performed in the environment affects the local evolution.

articleTitle: Material dynamics from laser pulse filamentation to permanent structural modifications in fused silica
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using pump-probe imaging techniques we monitor the formation of plasma strings, the subsequent emergence of transient electronic defects, and their transformation to permanent refractive index modifications in fused silica following sub-picosecond ultraviolet laser pulse filamentation.

articleTitle: The strength of surface plasmons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measure the femto-Newton forces produced by 2D surface plasmon optical traps able to trap micro-colloids at a patterned metal surface under low laser intensity.

articleTitle: Simultaneous monitoring of pulse carving misalignment and phase modulation depth in RZ-DPSK generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel method to simultaneously monitoring pulse carving misalignment and phase modulation depth in RZ-DPSK generation is proposed. It is simple but effective and requires only one low-speed detector and processing circuit.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional photonic band gap structures made by direct laser writing and silicon single-inversion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We realize a variety of silicon photonic crystal structures. Direct laser writing of polymeric templates (square/circular spirals and slanted pore structures) combined with a silicon single-inversion procedure leads to band gaps in the near infrared.

articleTitle: THz quantum cascade lasers grown by low-pressure metalorganic vapor phase epitaxy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A terahertz quantum cascade laser (QCL) has been successfully grown by low-pressure MOVPE. Very high quality semiconductor interfaces are demonstrated as well as very promising lasing performance as compared to MBE-grown THz QCLs.

articleTitle: Polarization control of wafer-fused long-wavelength VCSELs using sub-wavelength shallow gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Polarization stable, wafer-fused 1310 nm VCSELs employing sub-wavelength shallow gratings on their top DBR and emitting 1.5 mW single mode output power in the 20degC-75degC temperature range are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Scale-dependent optical near-fields in InAs quantum dots and their application to non-pixelated memory architecture
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate scale-dependent near-field photoluminescence of InAs quantum dots. Our analysis, based on eigen-decomposition, leads to a novel non-pixelated memory architecture thanks to spectral diversity obtained at an optimal scale of optical near-fields.

articleTitle: Laser action at high k-space values in anti-correlated multi-wavelength quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A two-wavelength quantum cascade laser is reported in which one wavelength lases between subband states high in the k-space. Laser action at the two wavelengths is strongly anti-correlated in output power and threshold behaviour.

articleTitle: 0.1–15THz generation using BNA (N-benzyl-2-methyl-4-nitroaniline) crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate widely tunable terahertz-wave generation using difference frequency generation (DFG) in an organic N-benzyl-2-methyl-4-nitroaniline (BNA) crystal. The frequency tuning of the BNA-DFG was obtained between 0.1 and 15 THz.

articleTitle: Spectral effects in terahertz apertureless near-field microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe dramatic changes in the spectrum of radiation scattered from a near-field tip with decreasing tip-sample distance. This arises from a balance between direct tip scattering and signals associated with the near-field image dipole.

articleTitle: On-chip high-order frequency filter with fabrication error recovery
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a high-order frequency filter based on microring pairs, capable of restoring distorted transmission functions by dynamically adjusting resonance parameters. Individual rings are thermo-optically tunable and are adjusted based on an evolutionary algorithm.

Author Keywords: (310.6845) Thin Films: Thin film devices and applications

articleTitle: Power scalable visible supercontinuum generation using amplified nanosecond gain-switched laser diode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Supercontinuum covering 0.45–1.2μm is scaled from 250–740mW by varying the repetition rate of a frequency doubled telecom laser diode. Efficient SC generation requires minimal non-linearity in the amplifier and fiber dispersion matched to the pump.

articleTitle: From frequency doubling to efficient generation of high-order harmonics of Fourier-transform-limited CO2 laser at 10.6 μm from GaSe crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Coherent ns pulses for 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>, 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>, and 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonics of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser frequency were efficiently generated from GaSe crystals, with corresponding output peak powers as high as 443 W, 23 W, and 2 W, respectively.

articleTitle: Femtosecond broadband Stimulated Raman Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Femtosecond stimulated Raman spectroscopy is a new time-resolved vibrational technique that enables the recording of high resolution (10-20 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) vibrational spectra of dynamic and reactive chemical and biological systems with < 50 fs time resolution.

articleTitle: Nanosecond interrogation of surface plasmon resonance sensors using chirped femtosecond optical pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel interrogation technique using chirped femtosecond pulses to realize high speed SPR measurements is proposed. The scanning time can be as short as several nanoseconds. Its ability to make sensitive measurements is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Modulating linear and nonlinear nanoplasmonic effects using the metal-insulator transition in vanadium dioxide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Linear and nonlinear nanoplasmonic effects - such as resonant absorption, second-harmonic generation and extraordinary optical transmission- are modulated in metallic nanostructures when the local dielectric environment is altered by the ultrafast metal-insulator transition in vanadium dioxide.

articleTitle: Metal-dielectric cavities for subwavelength light confinement in the THz region
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
