abstract: Experimental study of new type of plasmonic cavities is reported. We demonstrate the excitation of localised modes, with very high light confinement. The cavities are suitable for devices operating in the strong light-matter coupling regime.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigation of Beam Propagation inside an index antiguided fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We numerically investigate the beam propagation inside an index antiguided fiber laser. The results show that reflection on the air-cladding boundary of a fiber has strong influence on the guided beam profile along the core.

articleTitle: Silicon based colloidal quantum dot photonic crystal light emitters at telecom wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A high-density colloidal quantum dot film emitting at telecom wavelengths is evanescently coupled to a Si photonic crystal cavity, and the possibility of making a laser from the structure is discussed.

articleTitle: UV fluorescence of hydrothermal method grown ZnO for fast EUV scintillators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The scintillation properties of a hydrothermal method grown ZnO crystal are evaluated for EUV laser excitation. The excitonic emission decay at 380-nm is determined to be 1.3-ns, almost identical to ultraviolet laser excitation cases.

articleTitle: Design of photonic crystal microcavities in diamond films for quantum information
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We design photonic crystal microcavities in diamond films for applications in quantum information yielding high quality factors Q>66000 and small mode volume Vap1.1(lambda/n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The calculated quality factors show a strong dependence on material absorption.

articleTitle: Dielectric microcavities for THz radiation: Identical mode spectrum and coupling in poly-ethylene disks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the fabrication and characterization of identical dielectric whispering gallery microcavites for teraherz (THz) radiation. The THz radiation is coupled via a tapered waveguide into the coupled cavities. Mode splitting is observed.

articleTitle: Room temperature terahertz emission from two-dimensional plasmons in doubly interdigitated grating gate heterostructure transistors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observed intensive room temperature broadband terahertz emission from two-dimensional plasmons in dual grating-gate high electron-mobility transistors. Experiments were performed using infrared spectroscopy with a Silicon bolometer. Simulation reveals the thermal excitation of the plasmons.

articleTitle: Pulse dynamic in a passively mode-locked chirped-pulse fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report experimental and numerical results on the pulse dynamic of passively modelocked Yb-doped fiber laser operating in the chirped-pulse regime. A newly design cavity with a CFBG provides positive dispersion with negligible nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Process characterization of experimental photonic one-way quantum computing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate process characterization of basic gates of an optical cluster-state quantum computing. We present complete process tomography of a single-qubit gate and evaluate the bounds on the process fidelity of a two-qubit gate.

articleTitle: Plasmonics: Chip-based component devices and metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Dispersion control and active materials integration have yielded plasmonic components including i) three-dimensional single layer plasmonic metamaterials ii) all-optical, electro-optic and field effect modulation of plasmon propagation iii) plasmon-enhanced absorption in solar cells.

articleTitle: Ultrafast atomic and molecular dynamics with high-order harmonic probes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: High order harmonics are used for atomic molecular dynamics studies by core-level transient absorption spectroscopy and photoelectron spectroscopy. High field ionization of Xe atoms, strong field coupling effects, and dissociative ionization are investigated.

articleTitle: Adaptive error compensation for photonic analog-to-digital converters
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Factors limiting the accuracy of a wideband optically sampled analog-to-digital converter are analyzed. An algorithm for adaptive error compensation in a post-processing step is proposed and shown to be effective against various system imperfections.

articleTitle: Leaky and bound modes of finite planar metal-insulator-metal plasmonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Consideration of finite planar metal-insulator-metal plasmonic waveguides reveals bound and leaky modes with a spectral gap between them. Antenna mode formed in the leaky radiation region offers both free-space coupling mechanisms and beam steering devices.

articleTitle: Integrable semiconductor optical isolators towards larger optical isolation utilizing nonreciprocal phase shift
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have theoretically estimated optical isolation of larger than 30 dB in Co-InGaAsP semiconductor active optical isolators based on nonreciprocal phase shift. The length of the nonreciprocal phase shifting region is as short as 1.3 mm.

articleTitle: Specular reflection of THz coherent acoustic phonons at solid-liquid interfaces
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate significant reductions and spectral oscillations in THz coherent-phonon reflectivity at GaN-water interfaces. Our results indicated that the nanoscaled interfacial structures and water molecular resonances are responsible for the observed specular coupling characteristics.

articleTitle: Group velocity mismatch and third-order nonlinearities in domain-disordered quasi-phase matching waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Simulations show that group-velocity-mismatch and third-order effects reduce second harmonic generation efficiency by 23% and 33%, respectively, in GaAs/AlAs superlattice waveguide. Also, optimal waveguide lengths were found to be longer than the walkoff length.

articleTitle: Widely tunable mirror based on 3D hollow waveguide for tunable photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A 3D-hollow-waveguide based tunable-mirror is proposed to realize widely tunable and temperature insensitive photonic devices. The giant tuning in wavelength of 150-nm is reported, exhibiting much larger tuning efficiency than that of slab hollow-waveguide-mirrors.

articleTitle: Surface-normal fano filters based on transferred silicon nanomembranes on glass substrates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report here the design and experimental results on surface-normal optical filters based on Fano resonance in patterned single crystalline silicon nanomembranes (SiNM), which were fabricated and transferred onto transparent glass substrates using a disruptive SiNM wet transfer process. The measured filter transmission results agree well with the design. Further design and process optimizations can lead to high Q filters, suitable for ultra-compact surface normal filters, switches and modulators.

articleTitle: Evaluation of density-dependent lifetime of 1s paraexcitons in Cu2O by cw laser based excitonic Lyman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The lifetime and the Auger coefficient for 1s paraexctons in Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O from 5 K to 70 K was measured directly using excitonic Lyman spectroscopy. A possible experiment for realizing excitonic Bose-Einstein condensation is discussed.

articleTitle: Measurement of gain and subband non-parabolicity in a λ∼10μm Quantum Cascade Laser from single-pass transmission measurements
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Sensitive single-pass transmission measurements for probing the electron distribution of Quantum Cascade lasers under an applied bias are used to extract the intersubband nonparabolicity and single-pass gain of a λ∼10μm Quantum Cascade laser.

articleTitle: Observation of a comb of optical squeezing over many gigahertz of bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally measure optical squeezing at multiple longitudinal modes of an optical parametric amplifier. We present data up to 5.1 GHz that shows the magnitude of the squeezing is greater than observable at baseband.

articleTitle: Digital reconstruction of nonlinear beam propagation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We extend the technique of digital holography to the case of propagation through nonlinear media. We experimentally verify the technique by reconstructing nonlinear wave dynamics within a self-defocusing medium and nonlinearly imaging through it.

articleTitle: Deep-UV harmonic generation and applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using 2.3 mm thick KBe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>BO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> crystal optically-contacted with CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in a prism-coupled device we obtained an average output power as much as 360 mWat 200 nm, an output power of 50 mW with a narrow spectral width of 0.007 pm at 193.5 nm.

articleTitle: InAs/InP quantum dot photonic crystal microcavities — A scalable route to single and entangled pair sources
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a scalable route to single and entangled photon pair sources at telecoms wavelengths based on single InAs/InP quantum dots embedded within photonic crystal microcavities. The electrostatic gating of such dots is discussed.

articleTitle: Ultrafast magnetostriction in the itinerant ferromagnet SrRuO3 studied by femtosecond x-ray diffraction
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The ultrafast buildup of optically induced stress in ferromagnetic nanolayers of a SrRuO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/SrTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> superlattice is analyzed by femtosecond X-ray diffraction. Below the Curie temperature, magnetoelastic contractive stress reduces the expansive anharmonic phonon stress.

articleTitle: Bound-soliton states under a periodic phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report experimental results of multi-solitons in an active FM mode-locked fiber laser. Periodic phase modulation in the laser plays an important role in stabilization and determination of number of solitons in the bound states.

articleTitle: Visible and telecom-wavelength single quantum dots in 1-D photonic bandgap chiral microcavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: CdSe/PbSe single quantum dots were doped into chiral-photonic-bandgap cholesteric microcavities for visible/telecom wavelengths. High-purity circularly polarized fluorescence of definite handedness from single quantum dots was observed for the first time because of microcavity spiral structure.

articleTitle: 3-μm Continuous-wave singly resonant OPO
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a continuous-wave, single-longitudinal-mode, singly resonant OPO oscillating at 3.3 mum with 60% pump depletion. We observed optical bistability, thermal guiding, and clamped pump depletion for this OPO.

articleTitle: Two-photon absorption induced photoluminescence and the ultrafast dynamics of para-sexiphenyl nano-needles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Two-photon absorption induced photoluminescence of para-sexiphenyl nano-needles with high polarization and directional property was observed. The time-resolved measurement shows a very fast photoresponse and the absorption polarization selectivity of ground state.

articleTitle: Excitation dependence of non-Markovian dynamics in a dense potassium vapor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The transient four-wave mixing signal from a dense potassium vapor, which displays non-Markovian dynamics, depends on the excitation strength. Theoretical fits reveal the excitation dependence of the parameters employ ed in a two-time correlation function.

articleTitle: Intense THz supercontinuum generation in femtosecond laser-gas interactions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Intense coherent THz radiation from two-color laser interactions with various gas species is examined. Peak THz energy of Gt4.5 muJ per pulse with a bandwidth in excess of 70 THz is routinely produced.

articleTitle: Continuous-variable entanglement in a two-mode three-level cascade laser with a parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We analyze the squeezing and entanglement properties of the two-mode light produced by a composite system consists of a nondegenerate three-level laser and a parametric amplifier employing the pertinent master equation. It so turns out that the two-mode light is in a highly squeezed and entangled state.

articleTitle: Controlling disclinations in liquid crystal planar Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Direct-UV-written liquid crystal tunable planar Bragg gratings exhibit complex wavelength tuning with threshold points and hysteresis. We discuss the role of disclinations in the liquid crystal and whether they may allow faster wavelength tuning.

articleTitle: Nondestructive 3D imaging of femtosecond laser written buried structures using optical coherence microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have demonstrated nondestructive 3D imaging of the femtosecond laser written 3D structures of both index change and optical breakdown within fused silica by using the optical coherence microscopy providing high lateral and depth resolution.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of a Quantum Channel from a LEO Satellite to the Earth
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The single-photon exchange between a satellite and an Earth-based station has been investigated using satellite-laser-ranging retroreflectors in orbit. A return rate of 5 photons-per-second was measured from satellite Ajisai at 1650 km from the observer.

articleTitle: Attosecond control of electron localization in one- and two-color dissociative ionization of H2 and D2
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present one-color (IR) and two-color (single attosecond XUV pulse + IR) experiments where the sub-cycle evolution of the electric field of light is used to control the dissociative ionization of hydrogen and deuterium molecules.

articleTitle: Entanglement detection of GHZ states of electronic and two nuclear spins in NV center in diamond
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We consider creation and detection of GHZ state of one electronic and two nuclear spins of carbon isotopes <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>C in the first coordination shell of NV center in diamond. The method of entanglement detection is based on construction of an entanglement witness operator.

articleTitle: Fidelity of a conditional quantum teleportation protocol based on collective spontaneous emission
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We employ quantum trajectory theory to model temporally and spatially resolved photodetection of collective emission to investigate the performance of a conditional quantum teleportation protocol. The fidelity approaches unity with a success probability of 0.25.

articleTitle: Low dispersion slow light and nonlinearity enhancement in lattice-shifted photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We fabricated lattice-shifted photonic crystal waveguides stably showing low dispersion slow light in a wide wavelength bandwidth. The two photon absorption and self-phase modulation were clearly enhanced for sub-ps optical pulses.

articleTitle: High power, pulsed flash-lamp pumped erbium laser designed for medical applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A record 2,4 MW peak power, actively Q-switched Er:YAG laser is presented. For 10 Hz repetition rate 21 mJ, 86 ns pulses at the wavelength of 2940 nm were achieved. The beam divergence was 2,3 mrad.

articleTitle: Label-free and high-throughput screening of biomolecular interactions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a simple label-free multi-analyte detection technique that is easily scalable for high-throughput screening. We have shown a sensitivity of 20 pg/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and a minimum detectable antibody concentration of 15 ng/ml for a specific antigen.

articleTitle: Initial development of supercontinuum in fibers with anomalous dispersion pumped by nanosecond-long pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a simple two-stage model of supercontinuum formation for nanosecond-long pulse. First the sea of solitons is formed, then the spectrum is broadened by Raman interaction. We found a good correspondence with experiments.

articleTitle: Frequency scanning spectroscopy of optical frequency comb with high-resolution on an absolute frequency axis
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose high resolution spectroscopy based on a single-sideband optical modulator and an optical frequency comb technology. It has been confirmed experimentally that the spectral resolution and the frequency measurement range was digit of 1 MHz (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> nm) and 1 THz (10 nm), which is corresponding to the comb bandwidth, respectively.

articleTitle: Trench waveguide in photonic crystal slab
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that trench defect in a photonic crystal slab leads to efficient wave-guiding. Based on trench-waveguide geometry, slow-light devices and coupled-cavity micro-resonator arrays can be fabricated with scalable (holographic) photolithography avoiding electron-beam lithography.

articleTitle: Fabrication of metre-long fibre tapers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a novel fibre taper facility that allows tapering in the intermediate range of lengths of both standard and microstructured optical fibres. In particular, we examine issues related to the diameter fluctuations during tapering.

articleTitle: Generation of broad Raman sidebands with zero carrier envelope offset by locking two pump-laser frequencies to a single optical cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generate broad Raman sidebands with controlled carrier-envelope-offset (CEO) by locking the pump frequencies to a cavity. The CEOs controlled to integer multiples of the cavity FSR are observed both in spectral and temporal domains.

articleTitle: Time-resolved optical studies of InGaN LED structures grown on semipolar and nonpolar bulk GaN substrates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present time-resolved photoluminescence on InGaN/GaN multiple-quantum well LEDs grown on nonpolar and semipolar bulk GaN substrates and investigate increasing indium concentrations toward higher power, longer wavelength light emitters.

articleTitle: Coupling into slow-light in photonic-crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Coupling into the slow-light regime of photonic crystal waveguides is investigated for various taper lengths and terminations by utilizing an integrated Mach-Zehnder interferometer. Experimental results for coupling efficiency as a function of group-index are presented.

articleTitle: AlGaN/GaN multiple quantum wells grown by atomic layer deposition
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Three-pair AlGaN/GaN multiple quantum well structure with superlattice was grown using metal-organic chemical vapor deposition system. The AlGaN barrier and GaN well of the MQW were grown by atomic layer deposition and conventional growth, respectively.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked slow pump optical parametric oscillators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose to use Bragg grating to induce large walk-off between the signal and slow pump in nonlinear crystal for developing passively mode-locked OPOpsilas in which a CW pump is efficiently converted into short pulses.

articleTitle: Efficient coherent combining and wavelength stabilization of tapered lasers with a volume Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe the coherent combining and the wavelength stabilization of 10 tapered lasers in an external Talbot cavity. The use of a volume Bragg grating as feedback element to narrow the spectrum is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Time and frequency filtering of optical combs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Fabry-Perot cavity filtering of broadband optical frequency combs is studied experimentally and theoretically. Effects of dispersion, mirror coatings, and carrier envelope offset frequency are analyzed while highlighting applications to waveform generation and spectroscopic references.

articleTitle: Interaction of high power laser with snow nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We found that snow nanotubes targets absorb more than 95% of the incident light of a high power laser. Fast ions were generated with energies up to 100 keV .

articleTitle: 160-Gb/s NRZ-to-PSK conversion using linear filtering in silicon ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This paper proposes a scheme to achieve high-speed all-optical non-return-to-zero to phase-shift keying (NRZ-to-PSK) conversion by using the linear filtering in the silicon ring resonators. Simulation results are provided to verify the feasibility.

articleTitle: Direct electron-beam structuring of optical waveguides in organic electro-optic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a new, flexible, single-step technique to directly pattern electro-optically active channel waveguiding structures in the highly nonlinear optical organic crystal DAST using e-beam irradiation.

articleTitle: Large optical nonlinearities of conjugated porphyrin polymers in the Near Infrared
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The optical nonlinearities of porphyrin polymers were investigated in the telecommunications band: large values, slow kinetics in solutions revealed efficient optical limiting while large values, fast kinetics in films suggested ultrafast applications should be possible.

articleTitle: THz polarimetric metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a THz-metamaterial that exhibits a frequency selective resonant response based on the polarization of the incident field. The metamaterial is based on an asymmetric split-ring resonator structure. A polarization-insensitive design is also presented.

articleTitle: Demonstration of two-pump photorefractive gain in a BaTiO3 crystal for realizing a whitelight cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated double-peaked gain in a BaTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> crystal using two non-degenerate pump beams. This shows that the negative dispersion necessary for a whitelight cavity for gravitational wave detection can be produced with photorefractive crystals.

articleTitle: Generation and distribution of heralded entanglement between atomic ensembles for scalable quantum networks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Entanglement is generated by path-erasing detection of single photon emitted indistinguishably by two atomic ensembles. We characterize relationship of degree of entanglement to local dephasing. Parallel pairs of entanglement are distributed to polarization entanglement via conditional control.

articleTitle: Improved degenerate four wave mixing for measuring complex χ(3)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report improvements on a technique for measuring the complex χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> of nonlinear polymers using a 2D phase grating and degenerate four wave mixing. These improvements produce a factor of 100 increase in the signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: Hybrid prism/chirped mirror compressor for multi-mJ, kHz, sub-30 fs, CEP stabilized Ti:Sa laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We achieve pulse compression down to 24 fs with 1.1 mJ energy and full carrier-envelope phase (CEP) stabilisation at 1kHz using a compressor combining prisms and chirped mirrors. We demonstrate that this hybrid compression scheme can be scaled in order to produce CEP-stabilized sub-30 fs pulses at the multi-mJ level.

articleTitle: Characterization of the effect of small perturbations on the optical modes in high Q microdisk cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have investigated the effect of small perturbations on the optical modes in a silicon microdisk using a NSOM system. The scattering loss and mode coupling due to NSOM tip and cavity interactions are studied.

articleTitle: Development of dual-phase-modulators integrated QPM-SHG waveguide—equilateral/inequilateral-scheme—
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Novel waveguided PPLN-SHG device was demonstrated. Two type of dual-phase modulated PPLN device was fabricated and investigated. Inequilateral-type was similar to previously reported. Equilateral-type was newly proposed and demonstrated for first time.

articleTitle: Metal nanocluster metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present theoretical and experimental studies on a new metamaterial architecture based on metal nanoclusters. The nanoclusters support magnetic Mie resonance and a nanocluster array may exhibit negative permeability at optical frequencies.

articleTitle: Suppressing noise-induced intensity pulsations in semiconductor lasers by means of time-delayed feedback
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show by analytical and numerical results that coupling an external Fabry-Perot resonator to a semiconductor laser can efficiently suppress noise-induced intensity pulsations (relaxation oscillations). This constitutes a realization of time-delayed feedback control.

articleTitle: Stimulated emission of laser dyes in opal — like matrix (photonic crystal) under nanosecond pulsed laser excitation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Transformation of fluorescence to stimulated emission in synthetic opals with voids filled by ethanol solutions of organic dyes is studied. Simultaneous shift of fluorescence and laser spectra maxima because of Bragg reflection is observed.

IEEE Keywords: Active matrix organic light emitting diodes

articleTitle: Study of magneto-optical effect in (Al,Ga)As optical waveguide with embedded micro-sized Fe pillar for non-volatile optical memory applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The dependence of waveguiding loss on the magnetization of Fe pillar embedded into (Al,Ga) As optical waveguide was studied. The optical reading of the magnetization direction of Fe pillar was demonstrated for the pillar size of 3 um x 4 um and 3 um x 8 um with signal-to-noise ratio of 4.8 dB and 6 dB, respectively. This results demonstrates feasibility of using the magnetization dependent loss in a semiconductor/metal waveguide as a reading method for future non-volatile all-optical memory.

articleTitle: Optical spin state tomography using selection rules for photon-spin quantum state transfer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose optical quantum state tomography for a single electron spin. The orientation of the spin in an arbitrary superposition state can be determined from the Faraday rotation measurements.

articleTitle: Angular quasi-phase-matching in MgO:PPLN
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that quasi-phase-matching corresponding to a propagation in a periodically poled non linear medium at any angle with the grating vector provide wider wavelength tuneability and spectral acceptance. The case of MgO:PPLN is studied.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of electromagnetically induced transparency in acetylene-filled kagomé and triangular lattice hollow core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Experimental comparison of triangular-lattice and kagome-lattice HC-PCF with regard to electromagnetic induced transparency is reported. The results show that the mode beating, responsible for the noisy background, is dramatically suppressed in kagome HC-PCF.

articleTitle: Ultra thin HCG in a NEMO tunable VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present nano-electromechanical optoelectronic (NEMO) tunable VCSELs utilizing an ultra-thin, electrostatic-actuated single-layer (140nm), high-contrast subwavelength grating designed to strongly reflect TE-polarized light. A 2mW single-mode (SMSR ∼45dB) VCSEL with ultra-fast tuning speed ∼90 ns is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Large spectral tuning of liquid microdroplets using the optical scattering force
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By exerting optical scattering force at 1064 nm on glycerol/water microdroplets situated on a superhydrophobic surface, we have observed large spectral tuning of the whispering gallery modes up to 29.5 nm near 590 nm.

articleTitle: Local tuning of photonic crystal cavities using chalcogenide glasses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We developed a method to locally tune refractive index in photonic crystals. The technique, based on photodarkening of chalcogenide glasses, enables 3 nm resonance tuning of GaAs photonic crystal cavities operating at 940 nm.

articleTitle: Coherent phonon dynamics in exciton self-trapping in the strong coupling limit
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We probe the coupled electronic and lattice dynamics of exciton self-trapping in a strongly coupled quasi-one-dimensional system. The coherent phonon response reveals both optical and acoustic phonon contributions to the localization dynamics.

articleTitle: Coupled resonant modes of dual L3-defect planar photonic crystal cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the realization of 2-D photonic crystal cavities with a dual L3-defect geometry. The experimental results show consistent and predictable splitting of the fundamental modes and reveal clear evidence for strong cavity-cavity coupling.

articleTitle: Quantum Key Distribution over 25 km, using a Fiber Setup Based on Continuous Variables
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe a complete continuous variable quantum key distribution setup, reaching more than 2 kbit/s over 25 km. Time-multiplexing is used, and reconciliation is performed using fast and efficient LDPC error correcting codes.

articleTitle: Waveguide fabrication and supercontinuum generation in an ultrafast laser inscribed chalcogenide glass waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the fabrication and characterisation of waveguides fabricated in a GeS based chalcogenide glass. A wide range of waveguiding structures were fabricated, and supercontinuum generation was demonstrated for a highly multimode waveguide.

articleTitle: Integration of three dimensional photonic crystals for refractive index sensing in microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the concept of a refractive index sensor based on integration of a three dimensional photonic crystal with a microchannel by femtosecond laser fabrication. The sensor performance was characterized by FTIR spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Design and realization of an inherently gain flattened erbium doped fiber amplifier+
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report design and results on realization of an asymmetric co-axial dual-core fiber for an inherently gain flattened EDFA with median gains ges 28 dB and gain excursion within plusmn 2 dB across the C-band.

articleTitle: Gaussian-state analysis of biphoton imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Previous work on biphoton imaging configurations is recast in the more inclusive framework of Gaussian-state quantum fields. This formulation shows that biphoton image formation is classical, but not its image-to-background ratio.

articleTitle: Ultra fast electro-optic tuning of optical quality factor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate ultra fast tuning of the optical quality factor of a resonator on a silicon chip using electro-optic tuning. We tune the cavity quality factor from 20,000 to 6,000 in 100 ps.

articleTitle: Efficient tunable diode-pumped Yb:YAG ceramic laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We developed the diode-pumped 6.8-W cw Yb:YAG ceramic laser with the slope efficiency of 82% at 20°C and demonstrated the tunable oscillation of the laser. The tunable range was from 1021.0 to 1083.6 nm.

articleTitle: Performance enhancement of continuous-wave, singly-resonant optical parametric oscillators using signal coupling
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Major improvements in performance of continuous-wave singly-resonant optical parametric oscillators are reported by exploiting signal output coupling. Substantial enhancements in output power, extraction efficiency, and practical tuning range are obtained at minimum cost to threshold.

articleTitle: Backward THz-wave generation from collinearly phase-matched difference-frequency mixing in periodically poled lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate difference frequency generation of backward THz waves from collinearly phase-matched, periodically poled lithium niobate. Coherent THz waves between 457~507 mum were generated by using kW pump power at a kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Numerical design of bidirectional surface plasmonic polaritons wave coupler
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have investigated the Bragg gratings for surface plasmonic polaritons modes in the metal-dielectric-air waveguide and proposed a bidirectional coupler which is capable to guide the incident light at different wavelengths along two predetermined directions.

articleTitle: 808-nm TM polarised high power broad area Lasers with 69.5% power conversion efficiency at 71-W
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report TM polarized 808-nm lasers bars with 69.5% efficiency at 15degC. Performance is limited by the low-strained InGaAsP quantum well, which has high threshold, low slope and high sensitivity to packaging induced stress.low-strained quantum well,packaging induced stress.

articleTitle: Sub-10nm nanolithography and direct pattern transfer on III-V compound semiconductor using sol-gel derived ZrO2
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A new approach for direct sub-10nm pattern transfer using spin-coated ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is presented. The sample InP compound etching selectivity to ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is over 13:1 with highest aspect ratio of 35:1. The smallest feature is 9nm.

articleTitle: An injection-seeded pulsed optical parametric oscillator with a self-adaptive cavity for high-resolution spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An injection-seeded, self-adaptive optical parametric oscillator cavity with a photorefractive phase-conjugate reflector generates tunable nanosecond-pulsed output. Its narrow, single-longitudinal-mode optical bandwidth is verified by high-resolution spectroscopic measurements.

articleTitle: Polarization independent DPS-QKD system using up-conversion detectors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a differential phase shift quantum key distribution experiment using up-conversion detectors. Though the detectors had polarization dependency, we were able to make the system polarization-independent by using polarization modulation.

articleTitle: Amplified spontaneous emission in large size, high gain Yb3+:YAG amplifiers: Numerical modeling and experimental test bench for foreseen kJ-range Diode Pumped Solid State Laser facilities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We will present a three-dimensional Monte-Carlo model calculating the impact of amplified spontaneous emission on large size, high gain quasi-three level laser materials, especially Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YAG and compared it to experimental results, currently under progress.

articleTitle: Heterodyne interferometry using high harmonic generation in mixed gases
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We develop a heterodyne interferometry using high harmonic generation in mixed gases. The structure of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> was encoded in the interference modulation of harmonics generated in mixed gases of aligned CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and its reference atom.

articleTitle: High sensitivity refractometric sensor based on embedded optical microfiber loop resonator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel refractometric sensor based on an embedded optical microfiber loop resonator is presented. The device sensitivity has been studied in two typical configurations and its dependence on the nanowire diameter and coating thickness determined.

articleTitle: On-resonant trion Rabi oscillations and spin quantum beats in a singly charged InAs quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate, to our knowledge, the first coherent transient measurements of a single self-assembled InAs quantum dot charged with a single electron. The measurements show both trion Rabi oscillations and spin quantum beats.

articleTitle: Design of bright, fiber-coupled and fully factorable photon pair sources for quantum information processing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We derive conditions for full spatio-temporal factorability in non-collinear type-I spontaneous parametric downconversion. We show that fulfilment of these conditions leads to a higher single-mode fiber-coupled brightness, compared to sources rendered factorable through spectral filtering.

articleTitle: Hybrid modelocking in high power (220 mW) electrically pumped semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have obtained optical pulses via hybrid modelocking in monolithic slab coupled optical waveguide lasers with average powers exceeding 220 mW at a wavelength of 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Efficient in-band-pumped Er:Sc2O3-laser at 1.58 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present an efficient in-band-pumped Er(0.2 at.%):Sc<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-laser at 1581 nm with a maximum output power of 0.95 W and a maximum slope efficiency of 31%.

articleTitle: Tunneling times through dielectric stacks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measure the photon tunneling time through bandgaps of dielectric layer stacks with alternating refractive indices. We observe subtle structural changes in dielectric stacks drastically affecting photon traversal times, allowing for sub- and superluminal effects.

articleTitle: Quasi phase matching with quasi-periodic poling
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Quasi periodic modulation of the nonlinear coefficient enables to phase match any arbitrary set of 3-wave mixing processes. Multi-wavelength and multi-directional doubling are experimentally demonstrated in one and two-dimensional quasi-periodically poled ferroelectric crystals.

articleTitle: Hollow waveguide as an online microliter spectroscopy sensor for gas chromatography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Quantum Cascade laser is coupled into Hollow Waveguide as an inline sensor after GC separation. We show the sensor has high ppbV sensitivity for carbon and other species, yet maintaining the GC peaks.

articleTitle: Quantum computation with donor-based qubits in silicon photonic cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a quantum computation scheme, which combines a silicon donor quantum computing architecture with the optical initialization, manipulation, and detection processes already demonstrated in ion traps. The errors in the implementation of logic gates would be bellow the threshold for scalable quantum computation.

articleTitle: Multi-millijoule, diode-pumped, picosecond regenerative amplifier at 999-nm wavelength with cryogenically-cooled Yb3+:LuLiF4 crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A diode-pumped, cryogenically-cooled Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:LuLiF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> regenerative amplifier has been developed for the first time to our knowledge, which generated ~6-mJ, 13-ps pulses at 999 nm wavelength without a pulse compressor.

articleTitle: Trigonal symmetry of type I collagen probed by SHG polarization anisotropy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Conventional second-harmonic-generation anisotropy of collagen is modeled with cylindrical symmetry. We demonstrated that with thin fibrils, trigonal symmetry of constituent triple-helix molecules dominates the anisotropy, but it converged into cylindrical symmetry with thicker fibrils.

articleTitle: High-throughput microscope for label-free detection of protein and small-molecule chemical microarrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe a novel scanning optical microscope that enables high-throughput label-free detection of end-points and kinetics of multiple biomolecular reactions on microarrays with more than 10,000 protein or small-molecule targets.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of core-level relaxation dynamics on a surface-adsorbate system using ultrafast x-rays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first direct measurement of inner shell relaxation dynamics on complex systems, in this case an adsorbate on a surface. We measured a lifetime of 7 fs for N-shell vacancies of Xe on Pt(111).

articleTitle: Predicting amplitude and phase noise of modelocked lasers from the pump noise power spectrum
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: From a measurement of the noise power spectral density of the pump laser, we predict and verify the amplitude and phase noise of a modelocked laser using the noise transfer function method.

articleTitle: Development of re-entrant Cavity Ring Down or multi-pass absorption spectroscopy for measurement of gas properties
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present two long-path absorption systems, one based on cavity ring down and another on a Herriott cell, both with a re-entrant configuration to enhance spectral resolution and setup easiness, to measure weak absorption coefficients.

articleTitle: Self-stabilization of the optical frequencies and pulse repetition rate in a coupled optoelectronic oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A self-stabilized coupled optoelectronic oscillator is described where a single intracavity etalon is used for optical supermode selection, optical frequency stabilization and repetition rate determination and stabilization.

articleTitle: Quantum-confined Stark effect in intersubband transition in InAs/GaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Quantum-confined Stark effect (QCSE) in intersubband transition in InAs/GaAs quantum dots (QD) is reported. The QCSE induced linear shift of the absorption spectrum was observed and analyzed to be in good agreement with theoretical predication.

articleTitle: Suspended core high numerical aperture multimode polymer fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The transmission performances of a novel high numerical aperture polymer made multimode fiber are presented. The suspended core structure offers a low propagation loss in the visible and enables microfluidic capabilities.

Author Keywords: (060.4005) Fiber and Guided-Wave Amplifiers, Lasers & Devices

articleTitle: “Colorful” solid-core Bragg fibers guiding in the visible
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the fabrication and characterization of intensely colored solid core all-polymer Bragg fibers. By modifying the reflector layer thickness we illustrate that bandgap position can be adjusted at will in the visible.

articleTitle: The origin of efficiency droop in GaN-based light-emitting diodes and its solution
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The physical origin of efficiency droop in GaN-based light-emitting diodes when driven with high current is systematically investigated. Based on our simulations and experimental results, a polarization-matched active region is proposed as the solution.

articleTitle: Geometry-enhanced modulation of group velocity in nano-waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that modulation of geometry of nanoscale waveguides may dramatically enhance the modulation of group velocity in dispersive media and illustrate the developed formalism on examples of plasmonic nanorod and metamaterial photonic funnel.

articleTitle: Visibly “White” light generation in uniform photonic crystal fiber using a microchip laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe how to extend the bandwidth of the supercontinuum generated in uniform fibers pumped at 1064 nm. The spectra extend to ~400 nm, some 50 nm deeper into the blue than previously with the same pump source.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional metamaterials at optical frequencies
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the implementation of three-dimensional optical metamaterials. We investigate the interaction between adjacent stacked layers using the method of plasmon hybridization and analyze the optical properties of stacked metamaterials with increasing layer numbers.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Layers

articleTitle: Localized substrate removal technique enabling strong-confinement microphotonics in bulk Si CMOS processes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel post-processing fabrication technique, based on XeF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> etching, has been developed to locally remove the silicon substrate beneath polysilicon waveguides, enabling integration of low-loss strong-confinement microphotonics into standard bulk-silicon CMOS process flows.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an electronic photonic integrated circuit in a commercial scaled bulk CMOS process
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the first photonic chip designed in a commercial bulk CMOS process (65 nm node) using standard process layers combined with scalable post-processing, enabling dense photonic integration with high-performance microprocessor electronics.

articleTitle: Crosstalk between three-dimensional plasmonic slot waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate in detail the crosstalk between three-dimensional plasmonic slot waveguides. We show that, with appropriate design, the crosstalk between such waveguides can be greatly reduced, without significantly affecting their modal size and attenuation length.

articleTitle: Steganographic fiber-optic transmission using coherent spectral-phase-encoded optical CDMA
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Stealth communication using coherent SPE-OCDMA is demonstrated. The coherent approach can provide higher spectral efficiency than incoherent optical CDMA.

articleTitle: Laser RIN and linewidth requirements for direct detection optical OFDM
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We identify experimentally the effects of laser linewidth and intensity noise on optical OFDM systems, and show that commercial DFB lasers are suitable transmitters even when operated at low powers.

articleTitle: Stimulated emission of surface plasmon polaritons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have observed stimulated emission of surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs) propagating at the interface between a silver film and a film of optically pumped polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) doped with rhodamine 6G (R6G) dye.

articleTitle: Effectively-single-mode large core passive and active fibers with chirally-coupled-core structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Chirally-coupled-core fibers with core sizes well exceeding those of conventional LMA provide robust single-mode output irrespective of mode excitation and fiber coiling, are spliceable, and can preserve mode-area in tight bends and reduce nonlinear effects.

articleTitle: Terabit capacity passive polymer optical backplane
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel, low-loss, low-crosstalk optical backplane with scalable architecture using a planar array of multimode polymer waveguides is presented. Passive strict non-blocking interconnection of 10-cards is enabled via 100 waveguides each capable of 10 Gb/s operation.

articleTitle: Nanoscale optical microscopy in the vectorial focusing regime
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By using extreme numerical-aperture solid-immersion microscopy at 1553 nm we demonstrate, under certain circumstances, polarization-sensitive imaging with resolution values approaching 100 nm which substantially surpass the classical scalar diffraction-limit embodied by Sparrowpsilas resolution criterion.

articleTitle: High-speed silicon electro-optical modulator that can be operated in carrier depletion or carrier injection mode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A high-speed silicon optical modulator has been demonstrated which can operate either in forward bias using carrier injection, or in reverse bias using carrier depletion. In forward bias, the device requires less than 10 mW of drive power, but has a low bandwidth of 100 MHz. In reverse bias, the device has a nearly flat response to 18 GHz, but requires 700 mW for large modulation depths.

articleTitle: Slab-coupled optical waveguide photodiode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the first high-current photodiode based on the slab-coupled optical waveguide concept. The device has a large mode (5.8 times 7.6 mum) and ultra-low optical confinement (Gamma ~ 0.05%), allowing a 2-mm absorption length. The maximum photocurrent obtained was 250 mA (R = 0.8-A/W) at 1.55 mum.

articleTitle: Supercollimation in photonic crystals composed of nano-scale silicon rods
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Supercollimation is the diffraction-less propagation of light using the dispersion properties of specially-designed photonic crystals. We have measured supercollimation in photonic crystals composed of nano-scale rods over distances of up to one thousand lattice periods.

articleTitle: Contribution of electric quadrupole resonance in optical metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Contribution of electric quadrupole resonance is studied in optical metamaterials through numerical simulation. For nanostructures, its radiation is often comparable to that from magnetic dipole. Their individual contributions can be determined by angle-resolved scattering spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Terahertz time-domain reflectometry applied to the investigation of hidden mural paintings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Terahertz time-domain reflectometry has been used to investigate hidden layers of mural paintings. Images of graphite underdrawings and dielectric paint patterns have been resolved through plaster. The reflectivity of several historical paint pigments were compared.

articleTitle: All-optical oscillator based on a single bistable Vertical-Cavity Semiconductor Optical Amplifier (VCSOA)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel all-optical oscillator is demonstrated for the first time by employing a cascadable VCSOA inverter in a closed optical loop, which generates a self-sustained square-like waveform with ∼80ps switching time and 5:1 extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Simultaneous transmission of two channels operating at the same wavelength in standard multimode fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Spatial domain multiplexing is a novel multiplexing technique providing a method to transmit multiple channels of same wavelength inside an optical fiber. Two such analog channels on optical fibers for LAN applications are reported.

articleTitle: All-optical label swapping using bistable semiconductor ring laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A semiconductor ring laser all-optical flip-flop is used to realize all-optical label swapping. Old address is erased by blocking the switching optically and new address is inserted by modulating the output from SRL.

articleTitle: Silicon micro-resonators for on-chip optical networks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Recent results on compact silicon photonic circuits employing micro-resonators is reported including optical delay lines, electro-optic modulators, broadband optical switches, wavelength filters, etc..

articleTitle: 17 G directly modulated datacom VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The next generation 850 nm datacom VCSEL to go into production will be the 17 G VCSEL. It is not certain that direct modulation will be suitable given the reliability, supply voltage, and temperature range required. This paper is a first look at VCSELs designed and targeted for production 17 G use. The design is discussed and LIV and small signal frequency response is presented.

articleTitle: Cavity ring-down in a photonic bandgap fiber gas cell
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Cavity ring-down spectroscopy is demonstrated in a spliced photonic bandgap fiber cell with fs-laser-machined side micro-channels. The increase in ring-down time observed when the cell is filled with acetylene provides quantitative information on gas concentration.

articleTitle: Large-scale FBG sensors utilizing code division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a practical low-cost interrogation system for large scale FBG sensor arrays utilizing code division multiplexing (CDM). Using our proposed system which is based on the correlation property of the CDM code, we can interrogate all the sensors simultaneously. For a 100-sensor system, the sensor detection speed can increase 250 times comparing with TDM based scheme without compromise on detection accuracy

articleTitle: Evanescent field sensing in novel flat fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Recently developed novel psilaflat fiberpsila substrate promises flexible, long-haul integrated optical devices. Here, we present the first demonstration of one such device; an evanescent field sensor, based upon direct UV written Bragg gratings.

articleTitle: Optical OFDM
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) is a type of electronic dispersion and nonlinearity compensation that is scalable to extremely-high data rates, offering plug-and-play convenience in free-space, multimode and long-haul communication systems.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of a λ/4 phase-shifted 1310 nm laterally-coupled distributed-feedback laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe the design and fabrication of a lambda/4 phase-shifted laterally-coupled distributed-feedback laser. The third-order grating for distributed-feedback is fabricated without regrowth using stepper lithography, a process that is amenable to high-yield, low-cost manufacturing.

articleTitle: Optical signal processing using InP-based quantum-dot semiconductor mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This paper summarizes recent advances on optical processing using InAs/InP quantum dot semiconductor mode-locked lasers. In particular, all-optical clock recovery at 40 and 160 Gbit/s with excellent phase noise characteristics will be demonstrated using these lasers.

articleTitle: 1.5 μm all fiber pulsed lidar for wake vortex monitoring
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A pulsed fibre lidar based on 1.5 mum fibre technology has been demonstrated for wake vortex monitoring on airport sites. The wake vortex cores position resolution is plusmn2 m, the error on circulation 10%.

articleTitle: Highly-chirped dissipative solitons in anomalous-dispersion fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A new modelocking regime governed by the Ginzburg-Landau equation is demonstrated in an anomalous dispersion fiber laser. Output pulses are long, flat-topped, and highly-down-chirped, with energies above 150 nJ and repetition rates below 300 kHz.

articleTitle: Microwatt-level terahertz sources based on intra-cavity difference-frequency generation in mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report 5 THz quantum cascade laser sources based on intra-cavity difference-frequency generation in dual-wavelength mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers. Our devices produce microwatt-level terahertz output at 80 K and approximately 200 nW output at 250 K.

articleTitle: Multi-watt mid-IR fiber-pumped OPO
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have demonstrated a multi-watt mid-IR ZGP OPO pumped by a pulsed Tm-doped fiber laser operating at 1.995 um. 2 W of total mid-IR output power has been generated in the 3.4-3.9 mum and 4.0-4.7 mum spectral regions simultaneously.

articleTitle: All-optical flip-flop operation using 1.55 μm polarization bistable VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigated detuning and repetition-frequency dependencies of minimum polarization switching optical power for all-optical flip-flop operation using 1.55-μm polarization bistable VCSELs. We demonstrated it up to 3.1-GHz switching frequency by 10-fJ optical pulses.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of loop-coupled microring resonators for optimally sharp optical filters
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of recently proposed loop-coupled resonator device concepts, with characteristic transmission zeros, enabling optimally sharp passbands for channel add-drop filter applications. Fourth-order SiN-core and Si-core strong-confinement microring-resonator designs are described.

articleTitle: Spatial-dispersion-free spectral beam combining of high power pulsed Yb-doped fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Pulsed fiber laser spectral beam combining is demonstrated using spatial-dispersion-free approach based on 1nm-sharp spectral-edge filters. Three beams separated spectrally by ∼2nm are combined with ≫90% efficiency yielding 52-W combined power and 1.9-mJ combined energy.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity enhancement and dispersion management in bismuth microstructured fibers with a filled slot defect
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate nonlinearity enhancement and dispersion management in microstructured fibers with a slotted-defect infiltrated with highly-nonlinear liquid. Using slot-defected-core bismuth microstructured fibers, γ as high as 11,000 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and dispersion-flattened characteristics at telecom-band is possible.

articleTitle: Raman response function and supercontinuum generation in chalcogenide fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show the Raman response function and dispersion curve for a chalcogenide fiber. We then model and reproduce the experimental bandwidth of IR supercontinuum generation using a chalcogenide PCF.

articleTitle: In-band pumping of high-power Ho:YAG lasers by laser diodes at 1.9μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present for the first time a high-power Ho:YAG laser in-band pumped by a (AlGaIn)(AsSb) laser diode stack with 1910 nm centre wavelength. Using a single 60 mm long Ho:YAG rod in a simple and compact plane-plane resonator geometry a maximum laser output power of 40 W and a slope efficiency of 57% with respect to the absorbed pump power were obtained. A beam quality of M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> < 4 was found.

articleTitle: Improving the efficiency of high-power semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a 71% increase in electrical-to-optical conversion efficiency in a slab-coupled optical waveguide amplifier (SCOWA) by employing multiple contacts. At a saturated output power of 26.4 dBm, the amplifier has an efficiency of 11.5% and a gain of 15 dB.

articleTitle: Absolute extinction cross section of individual magnetic split-ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measure the absolute extinction cross section spectra of individual split-ring resonators (fundamental magnetic resonance at 1.4-mum wavelength). The experiments are compared with a simple electric-circuit model and with microscopic calculations.

articleTitle: Quasi-phase-matched wavelength converter with adhered ridge waveguide for hybrid silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A Mg:LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-based adhered ridge waveguide was fabricated by dry etching on a silicon platform. Efficient QPM-SHG (normalized efficiency: 450%/W) and -DFG (efficiency: −9.8 dB for pump power 38 mW) were achieved in the telecommunication band.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion and 2R-regeneration using one semiconductor optical amplifier with cross-gain modulation compression
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A simple all-optical wavelength conversion scheme with 2R-regeneration based on SOA is presented, exploring the cross-gain modulation (XGM) compression phenomenon and performing both the conversion and regeneration in one single device.

articleTitle: Commissioning the Astra Gemini petawatt Ti:sapphire laser system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Astra Gemini is a dual-beam petawatt Ti:sapphire laser at the Rutherford Appleton Laboratory in the U.K. We report measurements characterising the laser beam quality, pulse energy, and pulse duration of the first beam line.

articleTitle: Laser transmitter for the Lunar Orbit Laser Altimeter (LOLA) instrument
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the final configuration of the space flight laser transmitter as delivered to the LOLA instrument. The laser consists of two oscillators on a single bench, each capable of providing one billion plus shots.

articleTitle: Efficient high power passively mode-locked Yb:Lu2O3 thin disk laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The first passively mode-locked Yb:Lu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> thin disk laser generates 370-fs pulses with 20.5 W average power. Yb:Lu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is an excellent alternative to femtosecond Yb:YAG thin disk lasers, achieving higher optical-to-optical efficiencies and shorter pulse durations.

articleTitle: Silicon photomultiplier: Detector for highly sensitive detection of fluorescence signals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate use of silicon photomultipliers (SiPMs) in single photon counting mode for detection of very weak laser induced fluorescence (LIF). Detection of LIF in DNA-sequencing has been performed with three different commercially available SiPMs.

articleTitle: Electro-optically Q-switched Tm:YAG laser pumped ZGP optical-parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present what is believed to be the first Tm:YAG laser pumped ZGP-OPO. Pump energies of 4 mJ and OPO 3-5 mum output energies of 1 mJ were achieved at 100 Hz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband THz field detection beyond 170THz with a photoconductive antenna
