publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate ultrabroadband THz field detection with a photoconductive antenna using a combination of ultrashort laser pulses of 6 fs duration and a DAST crystal. We successfully observed ultra-high frequency component beyond 170 THz in near-infrared region.

articleTitle: High-power coherent beam combination of semiconductor laser arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have coherently combined a total power of 7.2 W CW using an individually addressable 10-element-array of 980-nm slab-coupled optical waveguide lasers (SCOWLs). The robust, passive phase-locking is accomplished using a fractional Talbot external cavity.

articleTitle: Polarization maintaining hybrid TIR / bandgap all-solid photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on fabricated all-solid fibers which guide by a combination of bandgap and TIR mechanisms. The fibers show high birefringence and possess a dispersion characteristic similar to the pure bandgap guiding form.

articleTitle: External-cavity mode-locked quantum-dot lasers for low repetition rate, sub-picosecond pulse generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: External-cavity mode-locking of a quantum-dot laser is demonstrated with record-low repetition-rates of 310 MHz, and harmonic repetition-rates up to 4 GHz. Fourier-limited 930 fs pulse generation is achieved. The pulse-energy of ~0.45 pJ is independent of operating conditions.

articleTitle: Ultrafast laser inscription of a three dimensional fan-out device for multicore fiber coupling applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A three dimensional fan-out device has been fabricated using ultrafast laser inscription. The device allows each core of a multicore fibre to be addressed individually by a single mode fiber held in an FVA.

articleTitle: Geiger-mode quad-cell array for adaptive optics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report an array of Shack-Hartmann wavefront sensors using high-fill-factor Geiger-mode avalanche detector quad cells hybridized to all-digital CMOS counting circuits. The absence of readout noise facilitates fast wavefront sensing at low light levels.

articleTitle: Tunable 100 Gb/s photonic integrated circuit transmitter and receiver
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate 100-Gbps tunable transmitter (Tx) and receiver (Rx) photonic integrated circuits (PICs) with minimal performance penalties over a 150 GHz tuning range.

articleTitle: Near-field focusing plates: Theory and experiment
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using a modulated grating-like surface, referred to as a near-field plate, we experimentally demonstrate focusing of microwave radiation in a pattern that mimics that of a negative-index slab. The near-field platepsilas resolution, of lambda/20, is well beyond the diffraction limit.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dispersion in silicon photonic wires
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first full theoretical and numerical analysis of the influence of the waveguide geometry and intrinsic material frequency dispersion of the nonlinearity, on the Si wires effective third-order nonlinearity and its frequency dispersion.

articleTitle: Realization of low loss and polarization maintaining hollow core photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Antiresonant core walls in 7-cell hollow core fibers are used to reduce the attenuation to 9.3 dB/km and create an intentionally highly birefringent fiber with a beatlength as low as 0.2 mm.

articleTitle: DNA target detection using gold-coated tilted fiber Bragg gratings in aqueous media
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Plasmon resonances in the transmission spectrum of a tilted Bragg grating in gold coated fibers are used to detect the binding of thiolated single stranded DNA and the further binding of the complementary target DNA.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of mode-locked quantum-dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A dynamic model of passive mode-locking in quantum-dot laser diodes is presented. It is found that in contrast with quantum-well lasers, rapid gain recovery is key for mode-locking of quantum-dot lasers.

articleTitle: All-solid photonic bandgap fiber with large mode area and high order modes suppression
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present all-solid bandgap fiber design with the small ratio of cladding elements diameter to pitch (0.24), with MFD of 36 m at 1 m wavelength and higher order mode suppression caused by the propagation loss difference.

articleTitle: Femtosecond-laser pulse shaping with microoptical retroreflector arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An effective method to control the temporal structure of femtosecond pulses by microoptical retroreflector arrays is presented. Multipulses of variable delay or variable pulse duration were generated and detected by second order autocorrelation.

articleTitle: InP-based photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The monolithic integration of a number of photonic components on a single InP chip for increased functionality and reliability as well as decreased power dissipation and cost is becoming an accepted goal for most component vendors. This tutorial will review current integration approaches and results, emphasizing our UCSB work.

articleTitle: Long-wavelength 2-D VCSEL arrays for optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a monolithically integrated, individually addressable 2D VCSEL array. These lasers, based on InP, emit at 1.55 mum and provide, with 10 GHz modulation bandwidth at moderate biasing conditions, high-speed capabilities for optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 1550-nm photon-counting receiver with ≪ 0.5 detected photon-per-bit sensitivity at 187.5 Mb/s
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We implemented a photon-counting optical receiver using a periodically-poled lithium niobate waveguide and an emulated array of silicon Geiger-mode avalanche photodiodes. We achieved a sensitivity of < 0.5 detected photons/bit at 187.5 Mb/s.

articleTitle: Femtosecond erbium-doped fiber lasers with large normal cavity dispersion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Femtosecond pulse generation by spectral filtering of a chirped pulse is demonstrated at 1550 nm. An erbium fiber laser with large normal dispersion and a spectral filter generates 200-fs and 1-nJ pulses.

articleTitle: Fiber-wireless networks and radio-over-fibre technique
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Dense WDM access network of co-existing analog radio over fiber and digital FTTH systems is presented, by focusing on enabling techniques including optical frequency interleaving, supercontinuum light source, and optical channel allocation for wireless services.

articleTitle: Two-photon fluorescence correlation spectroscopy through a dual-clad optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the use of a dual-clad optical fiber for two-photon excited fluorescence correlation spectroscopy. The ability to detect nanoparticles has been demonstrated. This technique shows the potential of conducing FCS measurements in vivo.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon polaritons mediated by ITO at near infrared wavelength
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: ITO supports surface plasmon polaritons above 2.28 mum wavelength in symmetric glass-ITO-glass waveguides. Here, we report the dispersion relationship and experimental findings.

articleTitle: Cladding-pumped distributed feedback phosphate glass fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Distributed feedback (DFB) phosphate glass fiber lasers that are cladding pumped with multimode diodes have been demonstrated. Single and cascaded DFB lasers with outputs up to 160 mW and 1 W, respectively, have been achieved.

articleTitle: Highly normal dispersion Er-doped fiber laser mode-locked with a SESAM
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a passively mode-locked erbium fiber laser operating in a highly-positive dispersion regime. Highly-chirped pulses with 5.4 ps duration and 8 nm spectral bandwidth are generated. They are compressed down to 757 fs.

articleTitle: Vertically emitting microdisk lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the realization and modelling of microdisk lasers displaying vertical emission. The devices are THz quantum cascade lasers with metallic gratings fabricated along the circumference.

articleTitle: Thin-film sensing with terahertz split-ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the limitations of using THz metamaterials as thin-film chem-bio sensors, by depositing dielectric overlayers onto split-ring resonator arrays. We also study resonance shifts by conjugating biomolecules using avidin/silane linkers attached to the resonators.

articleTitle: 640 GHz real-time recording using temporal imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: 640 GHz chirped beat waves are recorded on a real-time scope and 2.2 ps pulses are recorded on a single-shot streak camera with 1000:1 dynamic range after -30times time magnification.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s, 850 nm VCSEL based large core POF links
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate 10 Gb/s VCSEL based transmission over 100 m of larger core (120 mum) graded-index perfluorinated plastic optical fiber, thus establishing that multi-transverse-mode VCSELs are compatible with highly alignment tolerant plastic optical fiber.

articleTitle: Small core ultra high numerical aperture fibers with very high nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have demonstrated ultra high NA fibers of core diameters down to 1.2μm, low confinement loss and very high nonlinearity. Efficient supercontinuum generation is demonstrated in a 2μm core fiber. These fibers can also be spliced to conventional fibers with low loss.

articleTitle: Temperature insensitive 1305 nm InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot distributed feedback lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Based on high quality p-modulation doped InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot (QD) material we realized highly temperature stable operation of distributed feedback (DFB) lasers in the temperature range from 25degC to 85degC.

articleTitle: Multimode-interference waveguide crossing coupled microring-resonator-based switch nodes for photonic networks-on-chip
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose two-dimensional nonblocking low-power photonic switch nodes for networks-on-chip using multimode-interference-based waveguide crossing-coupled microring electro-optic switch array in silicon-on-insulator.

articleTitle: Square-root law thermal response in VCSELs: Experiment and theoretical model
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A simple theoretical model is used to derive closed form expressions for the FM response of VCSELs. These match measurement results very well and give a significant improvement over the usually assumed first order model.

articleTitle: 488 nm irradiation induced photodarkening study of Yb-doped aluminosilicate and phosphosilicate fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Photodarkening in highly Yb-doped aluminosilicate and phosphosilicate fibers, under 488 nm irradiation, is presented. Both irradiation-induced excess loss and post-irradiation temporal loss evaluations reveal that Yb-doped phosphosilicate fiber is highly resistant to photodarkening.

articleTitle: Effect of damping and gain compression in purcell-enhanced nanocavity lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We simulate the rate equations of nanocavity lasers, introducing gain compression of both the stimulated and spontaneous emission. The resonance frequency and damping are simultaneously enhanced by the Purcell effect, greatly limiting the modulation bandwidth.

articleTitle: Mie scattering of a Laguerre-Gaussian beam for position detection of microbubbles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The Mie scattering of a Laguerre-Gaussian beam is studied. Applications to position detection in optical tweezers are considered. The cross-talk between the position signals predicted by simulations is confirmed in experiments.

articleTitle: Hybrid silicon evanescent phase modulator based on carrier depletion in offset multiple-quantum-well
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a phase modulator based on carrier depletion on the hybrid silicon evanescent platform. The device has a modulation efficiency of 4Vmm, along with a bandwidth of 100nm and power capability up to 20mW.

articleTitle: 25 Gbit/s-100 °C operation and high reliability of 1.1-μm-range VCSELs with InGaAs/GaAsP strain-compensated MQWs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We developed 1.1-mum-range oxide-implant VCSELs with InGaAs/GaAsP strain-compensated MQWs. 25 Gbit/s-100degC error-free operation and high reliability over 3000 hours under 150degC operation were successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Coherently controlled ballistic currents in single-walled carbon nanotubes and graphite
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Phase-related 1.4 and 0.7 mum, 150 fs pulses induce directional charge motion in unaligned and aligned carbon nanotubes and graphite at 300 K. The THz radiation emission reveals peak currents of ~300 pA per nanotube.

articleTitle: 40-GS/s all-optical sampling using four-wave mixing with a time- and wavelength-interleaved laser source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate 40-GS/s all-optical wavelength division sampling using four-wave mixing in a dispersion-flattened photonic crystal fiber. Our 4x10-GHz time- and wavelength-interleaved sampling laser source is generated through multiwavelength cross-absorption modulation and optical dispersion management.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical spectroscopy of photonic metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We probe the nonlinear optical properties of a fishnet metamaterial via second harmonic generation (SHG) and third harmonic generation (THG) spectroscopy. We show that the resonance enhancement of nonlinear response in metamaterials is distinct from molecular case.

articleTitle: Large simultaneous band gaps for photonic and phononic crystal slabs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show the existence of simultaneous frequency band gaps for both photons and phonons in a slab of silicon with a periodic arrangement of cylindrical holes perpendicular to the slab surface with different lattice geometries. The advantages and disadvantages of different lattice structures for integration of photonic and phononic crystal functionalities will be discussed.

articleTitle: Double-notch-shaped microdisk resonator-based devices in silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate double-notch-shaped microdisk resonator-based filters with waveguide butt-coupling in silicon-on-insulator. Our filter demonstrates whispering-gallery-like modes with Q exceeding 104. We also propose and fabricate electro-optic modulators using this structure integrated with a metal-oxide-semiconductor capacitor.

articleTitle: Fabrication of nanophotonic circuit components by thermal nano imprint lithography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Nanophotonic components are fabricated using thermal nano imprint lithography (NIL). A silicon-on-insulator Mach-Zehnder interferometer with 20 dB extinction ratio is demonstrated. Grating couplers fabricated by a two-step imprint process demonstrate over 14% coupling efficiency.

articleTitle: Laser direct write near-field nanopatterning using optically trapped microspheres
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We use Bessel beam optical traps to self-position microsphere objectives near surfaces. Pulsed laser illumination of these objectives is used to perform near-field direct-write subwavelength optical nanopatterning with 100 nm feature sizes.

articleTitle: Ultra-high intensity-high contrast 300-TW laser at 0.1 Hz repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The highest intensity -high contrast -300 TW laser is demonstrated by developing additional amplifying stage to the HERCULES-50 TW laser. To out knowledge this is the first Petawatt-scale laser at 0.1 Hz repetition rate.

articleTitle: High-brightness 210 μJ pulsed Raman fiber source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a 210 muJ pulsed high-brightness fiber source based on a cladding-pumped Raman fiber. It delivers Stokes light at 1112 nm, of 500 ns duration, 420 W peak power, and M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> 1.8.

articleTitle: Power gain of homodyne detection over direct detection receivers for free space optical communication in the presence of interference
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Diversity mitigates fades, but increasing diversity does not always improve direct detectionpsilas performance in the presence of interference. We find the power gain of homodyne over direct detection with optimal diversity, with and without interference.

articleTitle: Single-frequency Tm-doped fiber master-oscillator power-amplifier with 10 W linearly-polarized output at 1943 nm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report efficient operation of a narrow-linewidth master-oscillator power-amplifier (MOPA), based on a Tm-doped fiber distributed-feedback laser and two amplifier stages, in-band pumped at 1565 nm. The MOPA yielded 10 W of linearly-polarized single-frequency output at 1943 nm.

articleTitle: Quantum theory of spontaneous emission in multilayer dielectric structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A full quantum-mechanical formalism has been developed in order to evaluate the spontaneous emission rate of dipoles embedded in multilayer dielectric structures. A realistic example of an antisymmetric Silicon waveguide is shown and discussed.

articleTitle: A new model for CW supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed a new pump source model for CW supercontinuum generation which shows closer agreement to experiment, and rests on a stronger physical basis, than previous models.

articleTitle: The Z-Petawatt Laser at Sandia National Laboratories
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Performance characteristics and first experiments on Sandiapsilas Z-Petawatt (ZPW) laser will be presented. This system will provide enhanced backlighting capabilities on the Z-Accelerator by achieving multi 10 keV X-rays in less than a picosecond.

articleTitle: Micro- and nanostructures inside sapphire by fs-laser irradiation and selective etching
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Micro- and nanofabrication of cavities in the volume of sapphire was performed by femtosecond laser irradiation followed by chemical etching with aqueous solution of HF acid. Depending on the focusing conditions self-organized nanostructures or elliptical microchannels are produced. This manufacturing technique is potentially usable for photonic crystals in integrated optical elements or microfluidic devices for applications in life science, biology or chemistry.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Tunable narrow-bandwidth picosecond pulses by spectral compression of femtosecond pulses in second-order nonlinear crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We exploit second-harmonic generation with large group velocity mismatch to efficiently convert femtosecond pulses into tunable narrowband picosecond pulses. The temporal shape of the picosecond pulses can be tailored by engineering the aperiodically poled crystal.

articleTitle: A deterministic single-photon source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We are developing an experimental setup to deterministically create single photons using spontaneous downconversion. We expect our source to output a single photon with a probability of 70%, and two photons with less than 3%.

articleTitle: Uncooled 2x2 quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifier based switch
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This paper highlights the potential of an integrated 2times2 quantum dot switch for uncooled switching applications. High gain of 11.6 dB and <0.6 dB power penalty over lldB dynamic range is demonstrated at temperatures up to 70degC.

articleTitle: Point-by-point inscription of sub-micrometer period fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Point-by-point inscription of sub-mum period fiber Bragg gratings with good spectral quality, 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> order Bragg resonances within the C-band is achieved. Distinct polarization characteristics are further observed in these fiber gratings.

articleTitle: 7-ENOB resolution photonic analog-to-digital conversion of narrowband microwave signals at 40 GHz
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An optical sub-sampling downconversion receiver for analog-to-digital conversion of narrowband high-frequency microwave signals is demonstrated. The measured SNDR in 2-MHz bandwidth at 40-GHz carrier frequency is 44 dB corresponding to 7-ENOB resolution.

articleTitle: Effect of aligned nitrogen molecules on atmospheric propagation of ultrashort laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A 90 fs pulse is focused in air, to non-ionizing intensity. A collinear probe pulse follows the pump into a region of spontaneously re-aligned N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The aligned molecules can affect the focusing and filamenting of the probe.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave phase-matched generation of Raman sidebands in a dispersion-managed optical cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate highly efficient continuous-wave-based four-wave mixing beyond a small signal approximation. This is achieved in a high-finesse cavity with controlled dispersion for phase-matched interaction.

articleTitle: Aperture symmetry and lattice arrangement modulated second-harmonic emission from sub-wavelength metallic apertures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measure strong angular dependent second-harmonic generation from sub-wavelength aperture arrays with disordered, Penrose and square arrangements with different shapes. These measurements help to resolve the role symmetry plays in second-harmonic generation from aperture arrays.

articleTitle: Optical biosensor based on one-dimensional photonic crystal in a total-internal-reflection geometry
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a novel sensor for label-free biomolecular assay using a one-dimensional photonic crystal in a total-internal-reflection geometry. This configuration creates a unique open biosensing interface for real-time detection with ultrahigh sensitivity.

articleTitle: Near-field mapping of infrared optical antennas
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The near-field distribution of linear optical antennas is measured with phase-contrast scattering-type near-field microscopy (s-SNOM). A distinct scaling behavior with antenna length is observed for different structures with and without gap.

articleTitle: Novel gas targets for efficient high-harmonic generation and more energetic attosecond pulse generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a 10-fold increase in high-order harmonic generation in argon and neon for long (25 fs) and short (5 fs) pulses by optimizing the gas distribution in the laser interaction zone.

articleTitle: Real time amplitude noise and jitter comparison of supercontinua generated at different dispersion regimes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An experimental investigation on noise performances of supercontinua generated in normal and anomalous dispersion fibers is carried out. The supercontinuum in the normal dispersion fiber has lower real time amplitude noise and timing jitter.

articleTitle: Chirped-pulse slow and fast light in SOA with a record delay-bandwidth product of 10.7
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A delay-bandwidth product of 10.7 is achieved using ultra-fast intraband nonlinearities in semiconductor optical amplifiers to generate fast light. A novel chirped-pulse scheme enhances the fast light effect and generates delays in addition to advance.

articleTitle: Measurement of the optical properties of graphene from THz to near-IR
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present experimental results on the optical absorption spectrum of graphene from near-IR to THz frequencies for the first time. At near-IR and mid-IR wavelengths the interband optical absorption is found to have a flat spectrum consistent with the relativistic massless Dirac-Fermion energy dispersion relation of electrons and holes in graphene. At THz frequencies intraband absorption dominates and is well described by a plasmon model. We relate the measured optical features to the dispersion of electrons, holes, and plasmons in graphene.

articleTitle: Photon confinement in multi-slot waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a multi-layer waveguide that can confine light in low refractive index layers. M-line measurement verified our simulation results. This structure can be used for silicon light emission device because free-carrier losses are avoided.

articleTitle: Microstructure-fiber-based source of high-flux hyperentangled photon-pairs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generate hyperentangled (time-bin and polarization) photon-pairs using a microstructure-fiber Sagnac interferometer. Two-photon interference visibilities in both degrees of freedom are > 84%, and Bellpsilas inequality is violated by 27 sigma at 1-kHz coincidence rate.

articleTitle: Spectroscopic properties of Er:YAG at elevated temperatures and their influence on the 4I13/2 laser emission
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present spectroscopic results on Er:YAG at 300 K-550 K with respect to resonant pump absorption at 1.53 mum and laser emission at 1.61 mum and 1.64 mum and numerical results on laser performance.

articleTitle: Linear guidance of dipole modes in an optically induced ring lattice with a low-index core
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Linear guidance of dipole modes in an optically induced ring lattice with a low-refractive-index core is demonstrated both theoretically and experimentally. These dipoles are guided in the low-index region of the lattice. Such guidance results from anti-resonance or bandgaps in waveguides rather than the total internal reflection.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope stabilization of high-average-power ultrafast laser amplifier systems
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report results from thorough characterization of a high average-power, cryogenically cooled, carrier-envelope phase (CEP) stabilized ultrafast laser system. We also discuss the effect of signal averaging on measured RMS noise in CEP.

articleTitle: Adaptive control of transient vibrational wave-packet motion by using chirped pulse sequences
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We applied adaptive pulse-shaping for real-time observation of coherently controlled wave-packet motions. Individual excitation of twisting and bending modes was successful in a cyanine dye molecule by using a chirped pulse sequence.

articleTitle: Impact of modal interference on the output beam properties of large-core cladding-pumped fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Modal interference in few-moded large-core fiber amplifiers can yield output beams with good beam quality (M2∼1.2 – 1.4) giving the impression of single-mode operation despite significant higher-order mode content. The implications for high-power devices are discussed.

articleTitle: Atom microscopy beyond diffraction limit by resonance fluorescence spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We proposed an atom microcopy scheme measuring distance between two identical atoms placed in a standing wave laser field by measuring fluorescence spectrum or g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> function’s spectrum. It has fractional-wavelength precision from about λ/550 to λ/2 .

articleTitle: Laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) for aerosol analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This paper will focus on the status of LIBS for quantitative analysis of individual aerosol particles. Emphasis is on recent efforts to understand the laser-particle interactions, and the improvement of analyte response and precision.

articleTitle: Photoionization of Xe clusters under intense XUV irradiation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the study of xenon clusters irradiated by intense, femtosecond XUV pulses. Focused 38 nm high harmonic radiation irradiates clusters of ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> atoms, producing energetic ions consistent with a collective cluster response.

articleTitle: Analysis of resolution and feature size in extreme ultraviolet microscopy images
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe a correlation algorithm that allows for the simultaneous determination of object size and resolution in images of nanoscale objects. The method was used to analyze images recorded with a 13.2 nm laser.

articleTitle: Electro-optic reconfiguration of quasi-phase matching in a Dammann domain grating for WDM applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have investigated electro-optic reconfiguration of quasi-phase matching in microstructured lithium niobate crystals patterned with a Dammann domain distribution. The number of possible WDM conversion channels in a same physical device can be considerably enhanced.

Author Keywords: (190.2620) Nonlinear optics: Harmonic generation and mixing

articleTitle: EBIC and HR-TEM study of catastrophic optical damaged high power multi-mode InGaAs-AlGaAs strained quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report our investigation of catastrophic optical damaged high power multi-mode InGaAs-AlGaAs strained quantum well (QW) lasers using electron beam induced current (EBIC), focused ion beam (FIB), and high-resolution transmission electron microscope (HR-TEM) techniques.

articleTitle: Asymptotic pulse shapes in filamentary propagation of femtosecond pulses and self-compression
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate asymptotic pulse shapes arising from a balance of Kerr-type and plasma-mediated self-amplitude modulations. These self-stabilizing soliton-like solutions closely resemble experimental data and constitute the major mechanism for self-compression in femtosecond filaments.

articleTitle: 10W green output by second harmonic generation of a hybrid bulk-fiber MOPA system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a pulsed bulk-fiber source producing a peak power of 100 kW at 100 kHz and an average power of 20 W. An SHG efficiency of 51% was obtained by a LBO crystal.

articleTitle: Efficient phase and intensity modulation in substrate removed GaAs/AlGaAs nanowires
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Substrate- removed GaAs/AlGaAs nanowire phase modulators with 0.51V pi phase shift efficiency were fabricated. Quasi push-pull driven Mach-Zehnder intensity modulators made out of these phase modulators have record low 0.3V drive voltage for 7mm long electrode.

articleTitle: Practical performance limits on optical frequency transfer over fiber optic links
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present theory and experiment quantifying the limitations to stable transport of optical frequencies over optical fiber. These are fundamental fiber noise, propagation delay, bidirectional propagation and system noise in the measurement interferometers.

articleTitle: Self-aligned planar GaAs nanowires grown by MOCVD on GaAs (100) substrates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The growth of self-aligned planar GaAs nanowires on GaAs (100) substrates is demonstrated using Au-catalyzed metalorganic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD). The effect of growth temperature on nanowire orientation and the growth mechanism are discussed.

articleTitle: Dispersionless three-dimensional metamaterial with a very high refractive index
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present metamaterials that can possess arbitrarily high refractive indices over very broad frequency range. Nearly independent control of permittivity and permeability can be achieved by geometrical designs, without using dispersive, resonant elements.

articleTitle: Excited state absorption and femtosecond lifetime dynamics in a new series of near IR dyes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Large excited-state-absorption (ESA) spectra and lifetime dynamics for a new series of NIR cyanine-like dyes are compared to similar visible dyes. Strongly red-shifted (200–300 nm) and increased ESA are observed and explained through quantum-chemical calculations.

articleTitle: Passive timing synchronization between Ti:sapphire laser and Yb-doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated passive timing stabilization of mode-locked Ti:sapphire and Yb-fiber oscillators. The timing jitter of two femtosecond laser pulses was 3.2 fs from 10-kHz to 1-Hz integration.

articleTitle: Enhanced fluorescence via photonic crystal slabs incorporating nanorod structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The emission intensity of a fluorescent dye is increased by 104 times through the combined effects of enhanced near-fields produced by a 1-dimensional photonic crystal and enhanced surface area provided by a nanorod coating.

articleTitle: Entanglement, decoherence, and quantum information
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Multiphoton entangled states are important for quantum cryptography, quantum computation, precise measurements, and subtle tests of quantum mechanics. I will review recent progress in this area, emphasizing some basic applications and the role of decoherence.

articleTitle: Quasi-periodicity probes the origin of transmission resonances in nanoapertures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on experimental and theoretical studies of enhanced transmission through 1D and 2D nanoapertures. We show that this transmission possesses vertical resonances and is therefore independent of the spatial aperture arrangement.

articleTitle: Controlling the radiative rate of electrophosphorescent organometallic complexes by engineering the singlet-triplet splitting
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We address the role of singlet-triplet splitting in controlling the radiative rate for deep-blue electrophosphorescent metal complexes. An enhanced radiative rate correlates with a small splitting, highlighting the road map to efficient electrophosphorescence.

articleTitle: All-optical subcarrier phase modulation for WDM radio-over-fiber system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Based on polarization rotation of DGD, an all-optical subcarrier phase modulation scheme for WDM radio-over-fiber system in one optical path is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The working bandwidth is up to 2.7GHz at 20GHz carrier.

articleTitle: High energy amplification of a continuous wave mode-locked picosecond Nd:YVO4 laser by a pulsed grazing-incidence slab amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A single pass, side pumped grazing incidence Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> amplifier, optimized for minimum ASE noise, was used to increase the energy of 10-ps mode-locking seed pulses from 1 nJ to 210 muJ, with M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=1.3.

articleTitle: Layer-by-layer three-dimensional chiral photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have fabricated and characterized polymeric three-dimensional layer-by-layer chiral photonic crystals. The obtained circular dichroism from polarization stop bands centered around 1.55 mum is comparable with that of recently demonstrated circular-spiral photonic crystals.

articleTitle: Spectral gain narrowing in THz quantum cascade lasers above laser threshold using THz-time domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy is used to determine the gain of terahertz quantum-cascade lasers. Gain clamping and spectral gain narrowing are observed above threshold, giving insight into subband alignment as a function of the applied voltage.

articleTitle: Two dimensional dynamic focusing and optical switching of laser light by ferroelectric devices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Two dimensional dynamic focusing is demonstrated by using lens-shaped ferroelectric domain stacks. The devices were fabricated on lithium tantalate and tested at 633 nm. Novel designs and numerical simulations are presented for optical switching applications.

articleTitle: Double optical gating of high harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a novel optical switch to control the high-order harmonic generation process so that single attosecond pulses can be generated with ∼10 fs input pulses. The technique combines polarization gating and two-color gating.

articleTitle: Power scaling by removal of negative differential conversion efficiencies for THz generation in InP
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By removing negative differential conversion efficiencies for THz generation, observed on InP, we have increased the THz output power by one order of magnitude, making InP comparable to ZnTe and InAs as highly efficient emitter.

articleTitle: Four wave mixing (FWM) and electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) based coherent image storage in hot atomic vapors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate storage of images carried by optical pulses in hot vapors using a combination of FWM and EIT and show that the images retrieved are robust to diffusion.

articleTitle: Near-wavelength resolution extreme ultraviolet imaging with a desktop-size laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have realized the first demonstration of imaging in the extreme ultraviolet (EUV) with near-wavelength spatial resolution, 54 nm, using a uniquely compact full-field microscope that can produce images with a single one nanosecond exposure.

articleTitle: Modeling of high power 977 nm Yb fiber laser with ring doping in a high-order-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A 977-nm Yb fiber laser is calculated to have high efficiency when operating in the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">07</sub> high-order mode of a large core diameter (43 mum) fiber, with Yb doped in a ring inside the core.

articleTitle: Mid-IR pulse shaping for enhanced 2D IR spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The capability of 2D IR spectroscopy for elucidating time-evolving structures is enhanced by a programmable mid-IR pulse shaper that greatly improves the ease, speed and accuracy of data collection. We demonstrate our technique on a model metal carbonyl compound and then apply it to study the structural disorder of amyloid fibers composed of aggregated human islet amyloid polypeptide (hIAPP).

articleTitle: Phase, amplitude and polarization microscope using a robust and compact interferometer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We coupled a compact and robust phase-shifting and shearing interferometer (sampling field sensor) to the imaging port of a standard, infinity corrected, transmission microscope to obtain phase, amplitude and polarization images of unstained biological samples.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced transparency in rubidium-filled kagome HC-PCF
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Electromagnetically induced transparency is observed in rubidium-filled kagome structure hollow-core PCF with polymer-coated core. We show that the 6 MHz transparency linewidth is below that expected from a bare fiber.

articleTitle: Towards single time-bin entangled photons using quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present our results on fluorescence and photon statistics of quantum dots. We show evidence for photon antibunching and cross-correlation measurements within the biexciton-exciton cascade using a new set-up. We also discuss directions towards a demonstration of time-bin entangled photons from a single dot.

articleTitle: Characterization of Ce:LuLiF4 as fast scintillator using storage ring free-electron lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ce:LuLiF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> as fast scintillator is evaluated using a storage ring free-electron laser operated in deep ultraviolet region. The response time is found to be varied for the excitation of the different absorption band.

articleTitle: Coherent control of ac-Stark allowed transitions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that initially dipole-forbidden atomic transitions can be effectively controlled by bichromatic laser fields. Such transitions become dynamically allowed due to ac-Stark effect. Gain, dispersion and spectral properties of these transitions are discussed.

articleTitle: Tunable ferroelectric photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Spectral tuning of photonic band gap (PBG) in photonic crystals is attained due to temperature changes of the refractive index of sodium nitrite infiltrated into the porous silicon template, composed by electrochemical etching of n-type silicon. Optical second harmonic generation measurements prove the ferroelectric state of the infiltrated NaNO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and reveal the ferroelectric behavior different from spinning films of sodium nitrite that is attributed to nanocrystalline and surface effects of NaNO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> inside porous silicon matrix. The tuning of PBG up to 15 nm is achieved in the temperature interval from 50degC to 200degC.

articleTitle: Gain measurements in quantum cascade lasers at high temperatures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Multisection-cavity gain measurements of quantum cascade lasers operating near room temperature are presented. In some devices clear evidence of Bloch gain is reported. A strain compensated 4.7 mum laser is also discussed.

articleTitle: Polarization-squeezed triphoton states and their Wigner representation on the Poincaré sphere
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present reconstructions of Wigner distributions for the polarization state of three indistinguishable photons on the generalized Poincare sphere. We study a variety of states including coherent, phase and NOON states.

articleTitle: Modulation instability & Bragg soliton formation in a highly nonlinear As2S3 waveguide Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe modulational instability and pulse train generation in an integrated waveguide Bragg grating written in highly nonlinear chalcogenide glass. This Bragg soliton effect occurs at pulse energies 10,000 times lower than any previous reports.

articleTitle: Electro-optic polymer microring resonators based on Charon coupler design
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a new type of electro-optic microresonators, where the shape of the transmission spectrum is controlled by losses and phase shifts induced at the asymmetric coupler between the cavity and the bus waveguide.

articleTitle: Attosecond excitation of electron wavepackets
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present experiments, supported by time-dependent Schrodinger simulations, on the dynamics of Helium bound states after an attosecond excitation in the presence of a strong infrared laser field.

Author Keywords: (020.2649) Atomic and molecular physics : Strong field laser physics

articleTitle: Compensation algorithm for deterministic phase ripple
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Phase ripple arising from imperfections in novel dispersive devices can severely distort broadband optical signals. We experimentally and theoretically demonstrate an algorithm that corrects for these distortions while simultaneously reducing the effects of additive noise.

articleTitle: Application of corrugated plasma waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report progress towards the application of corrugated plasma waveguides[1] to THz generation[2] and direct electron acceleration[3]. These waveguides are generated in hydrogen, nitrogen and argon plasmas with a wide range of controllable parameters.

articleTitle: Generation of ultrashort optical pulses using multiple coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering in LiNbO3
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate Fourier synthesis of multiple coherent anti-Stokes Raman-scattering signals in a single crystal of LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> at room temperature. Isolated pulses with 25-fs duration and 640–780-nm wavelength range are generated without any active chirp compensator.

articleTitle: Polarization insensitive detection of optical phase modulation via two-wave mixing in Er-doped fiber with saturable absorption
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Adaptive detection of phase modulated optical signal in polarization insensitive configuration based on two-wave mixing in Er-doped fiber is proposed. Experiments were performed in a birefringent 0.5m long Er-doped fiber at λ=1492nm.

articleTitle: Nanoscale optofluidic sensor arrays for Dengue virus detection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In this paper we present our work towards the development of nanoscale optofluidic sensor arrays (NOSAs) for Dengue virus detection. Our approach is based on the use of optically resonant devices whose resonant wavelength is shifted due to a local change in refractive index caused by a positive binding event between a surface bound molecule and it solution phase target. A special two stage micro-/nanofluidics architecture is used to first functionalize the devices and then to deliver the targets. Experimental results measuring the bulk sensitivity of the device are shown to agree extremely well with theory. Preliminary data showing the successful detection of one of the four Dengue virus serotypes is also presented. The primary advantage of these devices over the state of the art is that they combine the extensive property sensitivity (mass limit of detection) of nanosensor devices with the parallelism of the microarray format.

articleTitle: Why asymmetrical nanoscale plasmonic waveguides are guiding plasmons?
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Highly asymmetrical plasmonic waveguides exhibit guiding in dimensions below the expected cutoff. A new family of discrete guided modes of asymmetrical waveguides with losses is found, which assists in nano plasmonic guiding.

articleTitle: Passive mode-locking of diode-pumped Yb:KYF4 laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the first demonstration of passive mode-locked operation of a diode-pumped Yb:KYF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> crystal. Transform-limited pulses with duration of 170 fs, average power of 60 mW, and repetition rate of 55 MHz are obtained.

articleTitle: Extreme-ultraviolet polarimetry with laser-generated high-order harmonics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We developed an extreme ultraviolet polarimeter, which employs laser-generated high-order harmonics as the light source. Reflection scans made with this instrument show agreement over three orders of magnitude with data obtained at the advanced light source.

articleTitle: Effect of hole shape in cathodoluminescence of subwavelength holes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Single and multiple holes in optically thick gold layers are investigated with cathodoluminescence to obtain optical information beyond the diffraction limit. Excitation patterns and spectral shapes are observed to shift when the hole shape is varied. It is shown that the specific relative orientation of dimers and trimers of holes leads to shifts in the spectrum and changes of the excitation patterns.

articleTitle: Single photon spectrometer for high speed detection of multi-color fluorescence radiation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This paper describes design of the new sensor system for fluorescence detection applications. Based on single photon detection technique proposed system has unique combination of characteristics - high detection speed and wide linearity dynamic range.

articleTitle: Nonlinear gain amplification due to two-wave mixing in a broad-area semiconductor amplifier with moving gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Two-wave mixing in a broad-area semiconductor amplifier with moving gratings is investigated. It is shown that depending on direction of the moving gratings and the anti-guiding parameter the optical gain may increase or decrease.

articleTitle: Polarized supercontinuum from a 1064nm microchip laser and application to tunable visible/UV generation in BIBO
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generate a 99% polarized supercontinuum from a 1064 nm microchip laser by use of a highly birefringent photonic crystal fiber. We also demonstrate tunable visible/UV generation in BIBO pumped by the polarized continuum source.

articleTitle: Absolute phase measurement for broadband collinear Raman generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We use collinear Raman generation in cooled hydrogen and obtain a wide comb of equidistant frequencies spanning over an octave of bandwidth. We adjust the frequencies to be commensurate and observe an f-to-2f interference.

articleTitle: Fiber optic parametric amplifiers - properties, applications and challenges
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This tutorial reviews the basic properties, applications and challenges for fiber-based parametric amplifiers.

articleTitle: Graded index optical lens using inhomogeneous metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We numerically demonstrate a low loss optical lens (~1.55 mum) with inhomogeneous graded index metamaterials. Parametric optimization studies are presented. For a (64times64)lambda<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> sample f=3.2 mm with T=0.76. This structure can be easily fabricated with standard semiconductor processing techniques.

articleTitle: 15 dB cross loss modulation by cw pump injection of mW-class in 1.5-mm long nano-wire waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: GaAs nano-wire waveguides were successfully fabricated on a SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si substrate for the first time. 15 dB cross loss modulation was achieved by a few mW continuous-wave pump power within a 1.5 mm-long waveguide.

articleTitle: Single crystal source of polarization entangled photons at non-degenerate wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a bright, narrowband, compact single-crystal source of polarization entangled photon pairs at non-degenerate wavelength. This work is instrumental for quantum key distribution and entanglement transfer from photonic to atomic qubits.

articleTitle: Efficient mid-IR spectral generation via 4th order cascaded-Raman amplification
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A simple and robust 2.14 um fiber-based laser source is demonstrated via higher order cascaded Raman scattering in silica fiber. The temporal and spectral characteristics of the laser are compared with simulations.

articleTitle: Atom interferometry using beam splitters based on multi-photon Bragg diffraction: A tool for precision measurements
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We apply multi-photon beam splitters based on Bragg diffraction in atom interferometers transferring up to 24 photon momenta in a single process. Ultimately, this may lead to atom interferometric measurements of increased precision.

articleTitle: Coherence properties and photon statistics of quantum-dot based microcavity lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present results of a microscopic theory for the photon correlation functions g (1)(tau) and g (2)(tau) describing the first-order coherence and the photon statistics of quantum-dot-based microcavity lasers with large spontaneous emission coupling.

articleTitle: Characterization of a passively mode-locked Raman fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the noise characteristics of an ultra-high repetition rate Raman fiber laser mode-locked by dissipative four-wave mixing and demonstrate a significant reduction of the number of supermodes by incorporating a subcavity into the laser.

articleTitle: High-power THz generation, THz nonlinear optics and THz nonlinear spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A review of generation of high-power terahertz single-cycle and shaped pulses by tilted pulse front excitation with up to 200 MW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> intensity is given. Recent demonstrations of terahertz nonlinear optics and spectroscopy are then presented.

articleTitle: Phase shift of the retrieved light caused by microwave field
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have theoretically investigated the large phase rotation of the retrieved light field caused by a microwave field based on light storage with very low intensity of the microwave field.

articleTitle: Radiation from an electron wave packet driven by a strong laser field
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We argue against treating driven free-electron wave packets as extended classical charge distributions for computing scattered light. We have designed an experiment to test this by measuring light scattered out the side of a focus.

articleTitle: Visualizing ultrafast nonlinear dynamics with X-FROG
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Cross-correlation FROG is a versatile tool for observing complex nonlinear dynamics in waveguides. Structures ranging from femtosecond solitons to continuous waves to supercontinua as well as their interactions can be visualized in time-frequency simultaneously.

articleTitle: An Inline automated Stokesmeter
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A Stokesmeter can be used for image segmentation, differentiation and remote sensing applications. We demonstrate an Inline Stokesmeter that is more efficient than a conventional one, and can be easily integrated with a CCD camera.

articleTitle: Beat-wave-seeded, pulsed optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show in simulation and experiment the generation of comb-like sidebands and compressed pulses from a beat-wave-seeded optical parametric amplifier. Under suitable group-velocity mismatch, 50-fold pulse compression can be achieved for the output laser pulse.

articleTitle: Suppression of self-pulsations in dual-clad, ytterbium-doped fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Regimes of self-pulsing in fiber lasers have been characterized. Experiments show that the addition of a long section of passive fiber in the laser cavity can stabilize the laser and largely suppress the self-pulsations.

articleTitle: Carrier leakage in GaInNAsSb quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We assess the non-radiative recombination mechanisms in GaInNAsSb structures by comparing p-doped, n-doped and un-doped material. Our results indicate a contribution from thermally activated leakage in 1.55 mum GaInNAsSb Quantum well lasers at elevated temperatures.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate broad-band CARS spectroscopy in supercontinuum optical trap. Methods for suppressing or smoothing non-resonant background are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Single-shot measurements of ultrafast dynamics in a dense plasma
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The ultrafast dynamics in a dense plasma were studied with a single-shot measurement of the time-dependent reflectivity and phase shift at the rear surface of a free standing aluminum foil following femtosecond irradiation.

articleTitle: Polarization state characterization of ultrashort laser pulses by self-referenced tomographic reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a self-referenced method for characterizing of the polarization state of an ultrashort laser pulse field. It can be used with any existing measurement technique that measures intensity and phase of a single polarization.

articleTitle: Novel model on thermal conductivity in laser media: Dependence on rare-earth concentration
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Authors have proposed a novel model on thermal conductivity in various laser media. The rare-earth doping effects were also discussed by comparing the measured value in Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>, YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, and GdVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Storage and retrieval of optical pulses using a two-color optical memory
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The complete waveforms of 1.4 mus optical signal pulses are delayed and stored using a coherently prepared warm Rb vapor, and then recovered up to 500 mus later (with a factor of 2 temporal pulse broadening). Mediated by four-wave mixing, frequency-shifted idler pulses are generated, and then stored and retrieved simultaneously with the signal pulses. The intensities of the retrieved pulses depend linearly on the intensity of the retrieving coupling beam.

articleTitle: Broad angular and spectral anti-reflection employing GaN nano-pillar structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Angular and spectral reflectivities of GaN nano-pillar structures are investigated for heights of 350nm, 550nm and 720 nm. Calculations based on rigorous coupled-wave analysis show excellent agreement with the measured reflectivities for s- and p-polarizations.

articleTitle: Optical microchip detection of nuclear magnetic resonance
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate optical detection of nuclear magnetic resonance on a microchip. A theoretical optimization indicates detection limits that are competitive with that demonstrated by microcoils in high magnetic fields, without requiring superconducting magnets.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s packet reshaping with no wavelength shift using SOA cross gain compression
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a scheme for reshaping 40 Gb/s packets that is wavelength-preserving. The scheme, based on cross-gain-compression in an SOA, is polarization-independent and does not suffer from any transient effect at packet edges.

articleTitle: Terahertz inverse-Fourier transform image synthesis
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Starting from terahertz time-domain spectroscopy, we obtain electric field vector images at each frequency component. We then synthesize images for diffraction from a single slit for an arbitrary incident waveform by inverse Fourier-transformation.

articleTitle: Enhanced optical activity of a terahertz wave with complimentary double-layered metal chiral gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate polarization rotation of a terahertz electromagnetic wave with complimentary double-layered metal chiral gratings. We obtain an isotropic polarization rotation free from the birefringence of the structures.

articleTitle: Broadband cascaded four-wave mixing in high-Q silica microspheres
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate broadband, continuous-wave cascaded four-wave mixing parametric oscillation in the anomalous dispersion regime of a high-Q silica microsphere with an overall bandwidth greater than 100 nm and spectral features smaller than 10 MHz.

articleTitle: Nano-optical and terahertz near-field studies of surface plasmon generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate sub-wavelength diffraction by a single slit, both in nano-optical and in terahertz regimes. The wave-front in optical regime separates itself into forward propagating beam and surface-bound 90-degree diffracted wave, i.e., surface plasmon polaritons.

articleTitle: Remote inline all optical signalling and monitoring in passive optical network scenarios by means of erbium doped fiber amplifier pump modulation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In a passive optical network signalling and monitoring are very important architecture functions. The modulation of a booster amplifier laser diode pump can assist this function without corruption of downlink signals towards subscribers.

articleTitle: Er doped As2S3 photoresist for 3-D direct laser fabrication of 3-D nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a novel high-index-of-refraction (2.45) photoresist material based on erbium doped arsenic trisulfide. It shows room temperature photoluminescence at 1.5 microns wavelength, and can directly be used for direct laser writing.

articleTitle: Polarization dependence of SBS in small-core PCFs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) generated from noise in small core PCFs exhibits a strong dependence on pump polarization. The birefringence of two small core PCFs is investigated, yielding unexpected results.

articleTitle: Passively modelocked bi-directional vertical external ring cavity surface emitting laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a modelocked bi-directional VECSEL with a double V cavity configuration. The laser generates 1.04 mum optical pulses with a 0.76 GHz repetition rate and a total average output power of 4 mW.

articleTitle: Analysis of an effective optical filtering technique to enhance microwave phase shifts based on slow and fast light effects
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We theoretically analyze and interpret an effective mechanism, which employs optical filtering to enhance the microwave phase shift that can be achieved in semiconductor optical amplifiers based on slow and fast light effects.

articleTitle: Fine tuning of nonlinear interactions in a solid-state ring laser gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a strong reduction of nonlinear interactions in a solid-state ring laser gyroscope when the gain medium is vibrated inside the cavity. This considerably improves the quality of rotation sensing for this device.

articleTitle: Microdisk laser linewidth and spontaneous emission rate enhancement
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An increase in the spectral width of microdisk laser spectra biased slightly above threshold is experimentally observed, and an increase in spontaneous emission rate in devices with small optical mode volume is demonstrated.

Index Terms: Enhancement Of The Spontaneous Emission Rate

articleTitle: Inherent enhancement of nonlinear generation terms in DC-induced three wave mixing coupled mode equations
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
