abstract: Coupled mode equations are derived for three wave mixing processes induced in centrosymmetric materials by thermal poling. It is found that degeneracy of the DC field involved inherently doubles terms associated with nonlinear generation.

articleTitle: Two-branch Er:fiber laser emitting 11 fs tunable pulses with attosecond relative timing jitter
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present an Er:fiber laser generating two 11 fs pulse trains individually tunable between 1200 and 1300 nm. A relative timing jitter of 43 as is measured after frequency conversion and compression.

articleTitle: New detection scheme for THz radiation - photon momentum detector
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The radiation of a quantum cascade laser (QCL) at 2.8 THz is detected using the transmitted photon momentum to drive a quartz tuning fork. The radiation is modulated and focused onto the side of one prong giving rise to a driven oscillation of the tuning fork which is measured using the generated piezo current.

articleTitle: Refractive index sensing utilizing CW photonic crystal nanolaser and its arrayed configuration
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We achieved a record high index sensitivity of 400 nm/RIU in a cw photonic crystal nanolaser with a potential spectral linewidth of 0.1 pm order. We also demonstrated spectrometer-free sensing utilizing nanolaser array.

articleTitle: Highly efficient Brillouin slow light generation using a single mode tellurite fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate highly-efficient Brillouin slow-light-generation in a low loss tellurite fiber. A time-delay of 74ns is achieved for an input pulse of 40ns width in a 200m long fiber with a pump power of 19.7mW.

articleTitle: Modeling and characterization of Mach-Zehnder silicon electro-optical modulators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a comprehensive study of silicon Mach-Zehnder modulators based on carrier injection. Detailed comparisons between simulation results and measurements are made and excellent agreement is obtained for DC and AC characteristics.

articleTitle: Fully flexible terahertz Bragg reflectors based on titania loaded polymers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate fully flexible, high performance terahertz Bragg reflectors and filters based on TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-loaded polymers. Broadband terahertz reflection measurements with corresponding transfer matrix simulations are shown and the effect of curvature is analyzed.

articleTitle: Near-optimal quantum state discrimination of optical coherent states
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a new scheme for the discrimination of binary-encoded optical coherent states. We show that the average error probability of our approach beats the ones obtained by standard receiver schemes for any signal amplitude.

articleTitle: Sub-THz photonic-transmitters based on GaAs/AlGaAs Uni-traveling Carrier Photodiode and micromachined circular disk monopole antenna for ultra-wideband communication
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By incorporating GaAs/AlGaAs based uni-traveling-carrier photodiodes with broadband micromachined monopole antennas, the demonstrated photonic-transmitter can radiate strong sub-THz pulses (20mW peak-power) with a wide bandwidth (100~250GHz), which was measured by another photonic-receiver for ultra-wideband communication.

articleTitle: The OMEGA EP high-energy, short-pulse laser system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: OMEGA EP (extended performance) is a petawatt-class addition to the existing 30-kJ, 60-beam OMEGA Laser Facility at the University of Rochester. Activation of the OMEGA EP laser is near completion and results will be described.

articleTitle: Quartic-phase limited grism-based ultrashort pulse shaper
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By using a grism in a pulse shaping apparatus, we show that it is possible to pre-compensate for large amounts of dispersion (Gt5000 fs<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), thus reserving the dynamic range of the pulse shaper for active control.

articleTitle: All-optical quasi-phase matching and quantum path selection of high-order harmonic generation at 140 eV using counterpropagating light
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We extend all-optical quasi-phase matching of high harmonic generation to 140-150 eV, where conventional phase matching is not possible. We also demonstrate, and present a model for, selective enhancement of a single quantum trajectory.

articleTitle: Ultra stable coupled optoelectronic oscillator based on slab-coupled optical waveguide amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We built an ultra stable coupled optoelectronic oscillator using a slab coupled optical waveguide amplifier, generating pulses at 10.24 GHz with a repetition rate drift of only 513 Hz in 10 minutes without active stabilization.

articleTitle: Intensity and polarization nano-patterns in a 2D system of interacting dipoles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated that predicted by us phenomenon of sub-wavelength nano-stratification of local field is feasible not only for 1D, but also for 2D-structures, where it can produce huge field enhancement via size-related resonances.

articleTitle: Suppression of up-conversion luminescence in Er3+-codoped oxyfluoride silicate glass
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>, Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-codoped oxyfluoride silicate glass having composition with molar concentrations of 61SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-12Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O-3Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-12LaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-12PbF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, the upconversion luminescence was greatly reduced by introducing Ce<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ions without significantly reducing the lifetimes of lasing level.

articleTitle: Acousto-optic programmable filters in Mercury Halides for Mid-Infrared laser pulse shaping
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Mercury halides AOPDFs for direct laser pulse shaping in the mid-infrared are designed. Due to long wavelengths and low acoustic velocities in these materials, a new class of high resolution perpendicular diffraction devices is introduced.

articleTitle: Impulsive alignment of hot, centrifugally distorted, molecules
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We achieve impulsive alignment in a 400 K sample of diatomic iodine. Polarization measurements of rotational wave-packet revivals reveal dispersed oscillatory structures. These structures are due to centrifugal distortion resulting from the high temperature.

articleTitle: Opening hybrid band gaps in two-dimensional photonic crystals of Pb(Mg1/3Nb1/3)O3-PbTiO3 having very low refractive index contrast
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The effect of anisotropy on photonic crystals of Pb(Mg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/3</inf>Nb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/3</inf>)O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-PbTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> rods in air matrices was analyzed.. Despite a low refractive index contrast (n=1.47), hybrid photonic bandgaps were achieved after optimization of the structure and the anisotropy.

articleTitle: Active near-field optical microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Near-field probe was used to tune the resonance wavelength of a linear cavity. Theoritical and experimental study are presented to show the effect of the probe material on the cavity resonance.

articleTitle: Large third and fifth order optical nonlinearity of organic-inorganic CdS quantum dots in an optically transparent thin film
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report large values of the two- and three-photon absorption coefficients at 532nm (252 cm/GW) and 1064nm (160 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/GW<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) in surfactant-capped CdS quantum dots. The cross-sections of absorption were approximately 1e-44 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>s/photon (532nm) and 8e-73 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/photon<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (1064nm).

articleTitle: Electromagnetic spin-orbit interactions via scattering
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The longitudinal components of orthogonal-circularly polarized fields gain or lose topological charge after sub-wavelength-aperture transmission depending on the polarization handedness. We verify our analysis experimentally and numerically, and produce shadow-side spiral-phase fields of arbitrary vorticity.

articleTitle: Reversible switching of QCL-modes using a pH-responsive polymeric cladding
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a novel method for the reversible switching between different emission wavelengths for a grating-free mid-IR QCL utilizing the absorbance changes of a pH-responsive cladding under ambient conditions.

articleTitle: Grating Induced Transparency (GIT) and the Dark mode in optical waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A new type of optical mode that possesses a formal analogy to the Dark atomic state involved in Electromagnetically Induced Transparency. It displays a transparency and Slow light behavior free from the bandwidth-delay product constraint.

articleTitle: Terahertz photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The integration of photonic crystal (PC) resonators into the active region of terahertz quantum cascade lasers emitting around 2.7 THz is presented. The PC acts as frequency selective mirror and allows the tuning of the emission frequency throughout the entire gain region of the active zone. The PC and the gain region are embedded in a double-metal wave guide.

articleTitle: Disorder induced localized photonic modes in planar microcavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We detect localized modes in a planar microcavity containing a layer of quantum dots and measure their spatial intensity distribution. Theory based on disorder induced most probable fluctuation in the dielectric constant explains our findings.

articleTitle: Photon statistics of superradiant photon pairs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Photon statistics in the cooperative spontaneous emission (Dickepsilas superradiance) is investigated by Monte-Carlo simulations. Giant photon bunching due to generation of superradiant photon pairs is predicted.

Author Keywords: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: High-resolution mapping of electric field inside organic optoelectronic devices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By combining confocal microscopy with electroreflectance spectroscopy we directly map electric field amplitude distribution between electrodes in a prototypical organic semiconductor device. We demonstrate this approach on a copper phthalocyanine photodetector.

articleTitle: Angle-dependent effective properties of metamaterials — material vs. wave parameters
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We introduce a procedure to retrieve angle- and polarization-dependent effective parameters of metamaterials based on reflection and transmission at a finite slab. Their meaning in the presence of strong spatial dispersion and anisotropy is discussed.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Layers

articleTitle: Optical parametric generation and oscillation in a two-dimensional nonlinear photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Anomalously high parametric gain and simultaneous generation of two signal beams are unique properties of an optical parametric oscillator based on a quasi-phase-matched photonic crystal with a tetragonal lattice structure.

articleTitle: High-temperature all-optical intersubband terahertz wave switch
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose an intersubband all-optical THz switch. Adjusting the optical control switch beam even strong THz probe signals with intensities of up to 1 MW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> can be modulated with extinction ratios of -80 dB/mm.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive sub-two-cycle carrier-envelope stabilized pulses using engineered chirped mirrors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An octave spanning carrier-envelope phase stabilized frequency comb is demonstrated using selective output coupling of the f and 2f frequency components, enabling use of the full output power of the laser.

articleTitle: Gradient index polymer optics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We developed novel lenses from gradient index, multi-polymer sheets. The sheets were processed into lenses with spherically-symmetric index profiles. An F/2.25 GRIN singlet produced images with 4times better contrast than a commercial F/2.25 glass singlet.

articleTitle: Optical cavity modes in micro-pyramids
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the fabrication and investigation of pyramidal GaAs micro-cavities on top of a Bragg mirror. A finite-difference time-domain simulation supports the experimentally found optical mode structure for such a cavity shape.

articleTitle: Detection of neural cell activity using plasmonic gold nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Metal nanoparticles have been studied intensively for their applications using localized surface plasmon polariton (SPP) resonance. We have demonstrated for the first time that using gold nanoparticles, one can detect electrical activities from the neurons.

articleTitle: Precision measurement of refractive indices of the atmospheric gases using a frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report high precision refractive indices measurement of air and its constitute gases using an unbalanced Mach-Zehnder interferometer with frequency combs. Our experiments demonstrate sensitivities in levels of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: Realization of two independent Fourier-limited solid-state single-photon sources
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We combined high resolution laser spectroscopy and microscopy to identify individual molecules in two independent microscopes. Then the Stark effect was exploited to tune the transition frequencies of the molecules and thus obtain indistinguishable single photons.

articleTitle: Intracellular photodisruption with targeted silver/dendrimer nanocomposites and femtosecond lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Folate-targeted silver/dendrimer nanocomposites were developed and tested on a human oral epidermoid cancer cell line. We observed a reduced threshold in targeted cells for femtosecond-laser-induced optical breakdown, which leads to selective photodisruption of cancer cells.

articleTitle: A distance meter using a sub-terahertz intermode beat in an optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We proposed a novel method of phase measurement of terahertz intermode beat in optical frequency comb, to enhance the dynamic-range of distance meter. Utilizing nonlinear optical process, distance measurement with 130GHz equivalent frequency was realized.

articleTitle: Coherence in optics and transport in terahertz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Coherence in optics and transport is investigated for quantum cascade lasers. While coherence provides oscillations in the gain recovery if the tunnel coupling surpasses the broadening, incoherent hopping transport can fail in the opposite case.

articleTitle: Resonant-enhanced dipolar interaction between THz-photons and confined acoustic phonons in nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We proved the existence of resonant-enhanced dipolar interaction between THz-photons and confined acoustic phonons in nanocrystals. By a specific core-shell charge separation, the dipolar (l=1) confined acoustic modes was activated to absorb THz waves.

articleTitle: Non-equilibrium many-body theory of two-dimensional fourier spectroscopy of semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A non-equilibrium Green functions formalism for two-dimensional Fourier spectroscopy of semiconductors is developed. Equations of motion are derived for various initial states including pre-existing plasmas. Diagram methods are developed for analysis.

Author Keywords: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Observation of two-dimensional lattice interface solitons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first experimental evidence of two-dimensional surface solitons at the interface between femtosecond laser-written square and hexagonal waveguide arrays in fused silica.

articleTitle: Apex-enhanced second harmonic generation from asymmetric nanoscale arrays in a gold film
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The second harmonic generation from a non-centrosymmetric nanostructure in gold film is studied comprehensively. The sunglass aperture shape is chosen to have an apex to increase the local field.

articleTitle: Two-color fiber amplifier for mid-infrared generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: 20μW of average power at ∼18μm is generated by difference frequency mixing the 300mW, two-color output of a Yb:fiber amplifier. The mid-infrared power was not limited by two-photon absorption allowing it to be scaled.

articleTitle: Focus optimization with binary wave-front coding
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Novel schemes to optimize the focusing condition of Gaussian beam are proposed. Super-resolution is achieved along a DOF 4 times larger than the confocal parameter. The experimental results are presented by use of an OALV.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical response of metal nanoantennas
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have excited bowtie-shaped metal nanoantennas fabricated with colloidal lithography by picosecond light pulses. The spectrum emitted by the nanoantennas consists of a broadband continuum overlapped with a narrowband second harmonic signal.

articleTitle: Ultra-short pulse mode-locked rod-type fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the generation of ultra-short pulses with energies above 250 nJ from a self-starting mode-locked Ytterbium-doped large-mode-area rod-type fiber laser operating in the dispersion-compensation-free regime and discuss scaling possibilities beyond the muJ barrier.

articleTitle: 12 × 12 image amplifier based on Yb3+-doped multi-core phosphate optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate image amplification in a 12×12 pixel optical image amplifier array based on high gain per unit length Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped phosphate glass optical fiber. We achieve 12dB of pump-induced pixel gain from a 10cm-long fiber.

articleTitle: Room temperature continuous wave operation of single-mode, edge-emitting photonic crystal Bragg lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the first room temperature CW operation of two dimensional single-mode edge-emitting photonic crystal Bragg lasers. Single-mode lasing with single-lobed, diffraction limited far-fields is obtained for 100μm wide and 550μm long on-chip devices.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a photonic crystal directional coupler switch with ultra short switching length
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We evaluated the effect of a flat band in photonic crystal directional coupler optical switch for shortening the switching length. And we experimentally demonstrated that the flat band shortened the switching length by 29 times.

articleTitle: Near-infrared non-collinear optical parametric amplification in bulk potassium-titanyl phosphate with ≫2500 cm−1 bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report non-collinear optical parametric amplification in a bulk KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> (KTP) crystal generating ultra-broadband near-IR pulses, that cover simultaneously the wavelength region ~1050-1450 nm with a bandwidth Gt2500 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Frequency tunable terahertz metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a hybrid metamaterial semiconductor device capable of 20% tunability of the center resonance frequency via photoexcitation of the semiconductor regions, thereby addressing the metamaterials drawback of narrow bandwidth operation.

articleTitle: Quantum interface between light and matter: New approaches and applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We will describe experimental realization of two novel approaches to quantum interface between single photons and spins in atomic and solid-state systems. Progress towards implementation of potential applications of these techniques will be discussed.

articleTitle: Generation of broadband mid-infrared pulses from an optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generate broadband mid-IR pulses from an 800-nm-driven optical parametric amplifier in LiIO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. Exploiting its broad phase-matching bandwidth around 1 μm, we produced 2-μJ idler pulses in the 3–4 μm range supporting 30-fs transform-limited duration.

articleTitle: Asymmetric transmission through chiral symmetry breaking in planar metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report that small chiral asymmetry of the unit cell of planar metamaterials leads to strong resonant asymmetric transmission for circularly polarized light due to excitation of enantiomerically sensitive trapped modes.

articleTitle: Large pitch hollow core honeycomb fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A new kind of hollow core photonic crystal fiber (HC-PCF) for broadband guidance is introduced. Structural and optical properties of a fabricated example are detailed.

articleTitle: Integrated optical sensing in a lab-on-chip by femtosecond laser written waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Integrated optical detection in a commercial microfluidic chip for capillary electrophoresis has been implemented by means of femtosecond laser written optical waveguides for excitation and a high numerical aperture optical fiber for collection.

articleTitle: Preparation and Reconstruction of Non-classical Field States in a Cavity QED Experiment
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We prepare Schrodinger cats and other non-classical photonic states in a high-Q cavity. We reconstruct them using maximum entropy principle from an incomplete set of quantum non-demolition measurements performed with Rydberg atoms crossing the cavity.

articleTitle: Optical parametric chirped-pulse-amplification contrast enhancement by regenerative pump spectral filtering
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A method for fundamentally improving the temporal contrast of optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification (OPCPA) systems by using a volume Bragg grating to regeneratively filter the OPCPA pump spectrum is demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Polarization, phase and amplitude control of ultrafast laser pulses with a single linear spatial light modulator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Complete control over the polarization, phase and amplitude state of an ultrafast laser pulse is demonstrated using a single, linear spatial light modulator placed in a near-common-path, polarization-split Martinez stretcher.

articleTitle: Implications of electronic structure for optical magnetism
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Magnetic radiation from intense parametric scattering in different insulators exhibits the intensity dependence and saturation predicted by a simple classical theory, but growth rates vary with molecular structure.

articleTitle: Lasers with nanopatterned active regions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The structures, processing methods and challenges, experimental results, and spectral analyses for patterned quantum dot lasers and nanopore ordered array lasers are presented and compared with otherwise identical quantum well laser diodes.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Raman spin rotations of electrons in quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Short pulses detuned below the absorption edge of GaAs quantum wells are used to rotate electron spins through a Raman process. Faraday rotation measurements demonstrate significant rotations with negligible excitation of electrons and holes.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Fluid-filled tunable mold for polymer lenses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Polymer lenses were fabricated using a fluid-filled tunable molding process providing a simple and cost-effective way to control lens curvature and shape. This approach enables fast prototyping and shortens the design cycle for optical systems.

articleTitle: Complete characterization of high harmonic pulses by photoelectron spectral shearing interferometry
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The complete characterization of the19th harmonic of Ti:sapphire laser was demonstrated using the photoelectron spectral shearing interferometry for the first time. The frequency chirp of a harmonic pulse was sensitively detected by this method.

articleTitle: GaN photonic-crystal surface-emitting laser operating at blue-violet wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a first successful operation of current-driven GaN photonic-crystal surface-emitting laser, which can operate in blue-violet wavelength regions at room temperature.

articleTitle: Absolute carrier-envelope phase signature in THz emission from a femtosecond filament in argon
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on our investigation of THz emission from femtosecond filaments in argon and propose a single-shot scheme for determination of the absolute carrier envelope phase with a 2-pi ambiguity.

articleTitle: Raman resonant probe gain and pump depletion in rubidium vapor for simultaneous slow and fast light effects
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous slow and fast light effects using Raman resonant probe gain and pump depletion in rubidium. The use of a weak probe to produce anomalous dispersion in a pump highly simplifies metrological applications.

articleTitle: Origin of thermal dephasing in CW SHG in Mg:SLT
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigated the properties of single-pass second-harmonic generation of CW 542 nm radiation with high efficiency by QPM in Mg:SLT. Heat generation turned out to be directly related to green light absorption in the material.

articleTitle: Active switching of light in silicon based self collimating photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In this paper, we present a PhC modulator-switch that demonstrates active control over signal routing. We design and characterize a photonic crystal (PhC) based silicon electro-optic modulator.

articleTitle: 31μJ, 220fs, 1MHz fiber chirped pulse amplification system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a fiber CPA system producing 31 muJ energy pulses at a repetition rate of 1 MHz, with pulse duration of 220 fs, leading to a peak power up to 120 MW.

articleTitle: Random laser emission from ZnO nanocomposite hybrids
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Highly scattering ZnO-hybrid nanostructures are produced exhibiting random laser action upon optical excitation. Studies that investigate the influence of pump pulse duration on the random laser efficiency are presented along with coherence length measurements.

articleTitle: Sagnac-interferometer multipass-loop amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate an interferometrically stable pulse multiplexing-amplification-recombination scheme for direct laser amplification of picosecond pulses. Switching from single pulse amplification to the burst mode increases extraction efficiency, gain in cw-pumped crystals and output energies.

articleTitle: Ultrafast photoinduced ferromagnetic phase enhancement in ion implanted GaMnAs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the dramatic ultrafast photo-enhancement of ferromagnetism on a 100 picosecond timescale in ion-implanted semiconductor GaMnAs via photoexcited transient carriers. This non-thermal, transient cooperative magnetic process surprisingly quenches at low temperatures, significantly bellow the Curie temperature.

Author Keywords: 320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: High energy femtosecond fiber chirped pulse amplification system with adaptive phase control
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate threefold increased autocorrelation peak from an Yb-fiber CPA system operating with strong self-phase modulation by pre-shaping the pulse spectral-phase. The adaptive control loop used feedback from the output autocorrelation. High-quality 800 fs, 65 muJ recompressed pulses were produced.

articleTitle: Hong-Ou-Mandel dip using photon pairs from a PPLN waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally observed a Hong-Ou-Mandle dip with 1.5-mum photon pairs generated in a periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide with integrated mode demultiplexer. The visibility of the dip was 78% without subtraction of any noise.

articleTitle: Efficient Q-switched Yb:YAl3(BO3)4/Cr4+:YAG lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Q-switched diode-pumped Yb:YAl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>(BO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> lasers provide an average output power of 4.15 W, pulse energy of 139 muJ, pulse duration of 18 ns, and a slope efficiency of 59% operating near 1040 nm at room temperature.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: New mid-IR nonlinear optical crystal: CdSiP2
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report for the first time the phase matching properties of a new negative uniaxial crystal, CdSiP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, which can be pumped at 1 or 1.5 microns to generate mid-IR output in the 2–9μm spectral range.

articleTitle: Nonlinear light propagation in rotating waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally and theoretically study nonlinear propagation in a rotating waveguide array, created by propagating a self-rotating vortex lattice inside a self-defocusing photorefractive crystal. Non-inertial effects on discrete diffraction and soliton formation are observed.

articleTitle: Artifacts in near-field scanning optical microscope spectroscopy and imaging of nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: NSOM spectroscopy and imaging of nanoparticles in both illumination and collection mode were studied. The artifacts of red-shifting in NSOM spectra and polarization dependant dark fringe patterns associated with each scattering resonant peak were explained.

articleTitle: Photonic RF-receiver based on all-optical down-conversion in an optomechanical oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a photonic RF down-converter based on optomechanical oscillation in a silica microtoroid. Preliminary results show that the optomechanical oscillator can simultaneously serve as mixer and local oscillator in photonic RF-receiver architectures.

articleTitle: Analysis and realization of novel optical fields with elliptical symmetry of linear polarization
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the tight focusing properties of a novel polarization field with elliptical symmetry. The eccentricity of the incident field assists in controlling the focal field properties, allowing matching the field distribution to specific applications.

articleTitle: Theoretical and experimental limits of cavity-dumping in passively mode-locked thin-disk oscillators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Dynamical properties of mode-locked thin-disk lasers with cavity-dumping are studied with numerical simulations and experimental data. Limitations are identified, design criteria for future systems are deducted, and estimates of possible pulse energies given.

articleTitle: Nanoscale heat transport probed with soft-x-rays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We characterize heat transport in nanostructures, using coherent soft-x-rays to probe thermal surface deformation. By varying the substrate temperature, we observe the transition from diffusive to quasi-ballistic heat transport regimes.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic energy converter using ZnO quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Two sizes of ZnO quantum dots with resonant energy levels were mixed to confirm the energy transfer and resultant energy conversion using time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy. The energy transfer time was found to be 130 ps.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence comparison analysis of patterned and self-assembled quantum dots by MOCVD
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Power-, temperature-dependent, time-resolving, and micro-photoluminescence studies are performed to characterize patterned and self-assembled quantum dots (QDs) to understand the band structure. Carrier filling, relaxation, recombination and lifetime are different for these two QD growth modes.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical behavior of ultrashort pulses in scattering media
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science

authors.preferredName: Peter J. M. van der Slot

abstract: The nonlinear optical behavior of powdered systems remains difficult to model because the spatial intensity distribution. We present a novel way to calculate time dependent second harmonic generation in powders and resulting autocorrelation signals.

articleTitle: Pound-Drever-Hall frequency stabilization of Q-switched solid state laser oscillators in the Sub-MHz range
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Frequency stabilization of Q-switched laser oscillators following a Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) method is demonstrated for a dual rod Nd:YAG oscillator. It emits pulses of 21mJ pulse energy at 400Hz repetition rate with stability better 1MHz.

articleTitle: Single-photon generation using excitation energy transfer between quantum dots via an optical near field
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated a single photon generator using quantum dots coupled by an optical near field. This nanometric single photon generator has two blockade mechanisms to create an ideal single photon source.

articleTitle: Enhanced light extraction of light-emitting diodes with photonic crystal pattern fabricated by nanoimprint
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A hexagonal array of sub-micron sized holes was fabricated on InGaN/GaN quantum-well light-emitting diodes using nanoimprint lithography. Photoluminescence measurement confirms that light extraction of the LED was enhanced with two-dimensional photonic crystal patterns.

articleTitle: Optical shockley-like surface states in light-induced superlattices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We provide the first demonstration of linear Shockley-like surface states in optically-induced semi-infinite photonic lattices with alternating strong/weak couplings. Such surface states appear in superlattices only when the surface termination is specially designed.

articleTitle: Optical interference in nonlinear photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a generalized quantitative analysis of the origin of optical interference in two-dimensional nonlinear photonic crystals. The results are verified by a second harmonic generation experiment in a 2-D periodically-poled LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> crystal.

articleTitle: Terahertz surface plasmon on chirped groove grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The excitation of terahertz surface plasmon on metallized chirped groove gratings is studied in time- and frequency-domain. These gratings have a potential to launch and decouple broadband terahertz surface plasmon necessary for integrated optical circuits.

articleTitle: Significant carrier envelope offset frequency linewidth narrowing in a prism-based Cr:forsterite frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a dramatic reduction in the linewidth of the carrier envelope offset frequency of a frequency comb generated by a femtosecond prism-based Cr:forsterite laser due to changes in the wavelength-dependent intracavity loss.

articleTitle: Engineering optical space with metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Metamaterials are expected to open a gateway to unprecedented electromagnetic properties and functionality unattainable from naturally occurring materials, thus enabling a family of new "meta-devices". We review this new emerging field and significant progress in developing metamaterials for the optical part of the spectrum. Specifically, we describe recently demonstrated artificial magnetism across the whole visible, negative-index in the optical range, and promising approaches along with challenges in realizing optical cloaking. The new paradigm of engineering space for light with transformation optics will be also discussed.

articleTitle: High-throughput in vivo genetic and drug screening using femtosecond laser microsurgery and microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We developed microfluidic devices, imaging algorithms and femtosecond laser microsurgery technologies to manipulate large numbers of small-animals on a single chip for sub-cellular resolution high-throughput genetic and drug screens on neural degeneration and regeneration.

articleTitle: Advanced length metrology exploiting the frequency comb of a femtosecond Laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The frequency comb of a femtosecond laser is exploited as the wavelength ruler for length metrology. This permits absolute distances to be precisely measured with uncertainty directly traceable to the atomic clock of time standard.

articleTitle: High average power fs frequency comb from an optically injection locked amplification cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a scalable approach for the generation of high average power fs pulse trains by optically injection locking an amplification cavity. Initial results generated 4.7 Watts average power and 70 fs pulses.

articleTitle: A hydrogen sensor based on metallic photonic crystal slabs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A hydrogen sensor based on a metallic photonic crystal using gold and WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is presented. Hydrogen exposure influences the optical properties of this device by gasochromic mechanisms with a theoretical limit in the sub-1000-ppm-range.

articleTitle: Terahertz coherent control of the internal quantum state of dark excitons in Cu2O
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Intense multi-terahertz fields of order MV/cm coherently promote 70% of the quasiparticles of an optically dark, dense, and cold 1s-para exciton gas in Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O into the 2p state via a partial internal Rabi oscillation. Electro-optic sampling monitors the Larmor precession of the Bloch vector in real time.

articleTitle: Short-wavelength GaInNAs semiconductor disk lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a GaInNAs/GaAs semiconductor disk laser with fundamental emission in the 1150-1200 nm waveband, allowing frequency-doubled operation to the yellow/orange. Output power was 1W at 1197 nm with a slope efficiency of 23%.

articleTitle: Preparation, joining and packaging concepts for high power fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on preparation, joining and packaging of photonic crystal fibers for high power applications. Fusion splices of air-clad fibers with losses down to 0.03 dB and a transmitted pump power of 3.2 kW are obtained.

articleTitle: Tunable terahertz amplification in optically-excited biased semiconductor superlattices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We simulate the coherent carrier dynamics of an optically-excited, updoped AlGaAs superlattice in the presence of a Terahertz pulse using an excitonic formalism that includes 1s excitonic states as well as higher in-plane excited states and allows for dephasing and population decay. We show that this system exhibits large tunable terahertz gain due to excitonic effects, even in the presence of large number of unbound excitons.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Generation of ultrahigh-power supercontinua and self-compressed single-cycle pulses in metal-dielectric hollow waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate a novel approach for ultrahigh-power soliton-induced supercontinuum generation based on argon-filled metal-dielectric hollow waveguides and predict the generation of MW/nm spectral power densities with ~0.1 mJ energy and self-compressed isolated 1.7-fs pulses.

articleTitle: High average output power, picosecond thin-rod Yb:YAG regenerative chirped pulse amplifier with 200 μJ pulse energy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A LD-pumped, thin-rod Yb:YAG regenerative chirped pulse amplifier was developed. An average output power of 20 W was obtained at a repetition rate of 100 kHz with an output pulse width of 2 ps.

articleTitle: Measurement of spontaneous emission quantum efficiency in InGaAs/GaAs quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The spontaneous emission quantum efficiency of molecular beam epitaxy grown InGaAs/GaAs quantum wells is determined using photoluminescence measurements. The quantum efficiency is inferred from the power law that links pump power and integrated photoluminescence signal.

articleTitle: Optical super-resolution through aperture-function engineering and vectorial-focusing effects
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate optical super-resolution by using custom obscuration apertures and polarization effects to manipulate the pupil-function and focal-plane point-spread-function in a two-photon microscope used for semiconductor flip-chip imaging. Experimental results suggest sub-100 nm performance.

articleTitle: Efficiency of InGaN LEDs incorporating Surface Plasmon Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We estimated the influence of surface plasmon polaritons on the internal efficiency of LEDs by 3D FDTD calculations. It turns out, that SPP LEDs outperform standard LEDs if non-radiative losses are high.

articleTitle: Systematic study of the influence of the high orders spectral phase on XPW generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first comprehensive study of the role of spectral phase on cross-polarized wave generation using sub 30 fs pulses. We derive the acceptable residual phase to define Fourier transformed ultrashort pulses.

articleTitle: Mono-crystalline rare earth doped (Gd, Lu)2O3 waveguiding films produced by Pulsed Laser Deposition and structured by reactive ion etching
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Epitaxially grown Nd(0.5%):(Gd, Lu)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and Er(0.6%):(Gd, Lu)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> waveguides deposited on Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> by Pulsed Laser Deposition, providing peak emission cross sections comparable with those of Lu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> bulk crystals, have been fabricated and structured. Rib waveguiding has been shown.

articleTitle: Electro-optical microring resonators in epitaxial crystalline organic and ion sliced inorganic materials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Electro-optically tunable microring resonators and waveguides were fabricated in submicrometer thin ion-sliced LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> films and epitaxially grown organic single crystalline materials. The organic crystalline waveguides show large electro-optical effects and superior photo and thermal stability as compared to polymeric materials. Electro-optical resonatorsmicroring resonators crystalline epitaxial organic material son sliced.

articleTitle: Interference between monochromatic Terahertz sources
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a method to improve spatial resolution and available power at the same time by mutual coherent emission of distant CW-Terahertz photomixers spaced by less than the coherence length of the mixing lasers.

articleTitle: Terahertz near field microscopy of metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We apply terahertz microscopy for studying metamaterials with resonances in the terahertz band. The data provide insight into the metamaterial’s local response on scales much smaller than the unit cell of the structure.

articleTitle: Orbital angular momentum Hall effect via multiple-filamentation in nonlinear Kerr Media
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that the orbital angular momentum Hall effect occurs during multiple-filamentation in Kerr media. Counter-rotating instabilities accumulate different phases and result in the spatial separation of copropagating orthogonal-polarization optical vortices of different helicity.

articleTitle: Tunable light-matter interactions with cold ensembles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Effective interactions between a cold atomic ensemble and probe light can take the ldquoQND,rdquo ldquobeamsplitter,rdquo and ldquotwo-mode squeezingrdquo forms, useful for quantum cloning and memory. We describe experiments with dipole-trapped <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb using these interactions.

articleTitle: Fabrication of noble metal nanoparticles in intense optical field by femtosecond laser irradiation of aqueous solution
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated a novel fabrication technique of highly monodispersed noble metal nanoparticles by femtosecond pulsed laser irradiation of aqueous solution.

articleTitle: Compact bandwidth tunable microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate microring resonators on silicon-on-insulator with bandwidth tunable from 0.1 nm to 0.7 nm, an extinction ratio of 23 dB and a footprint of less than 0.001 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> using interferometric couplers and thermal tuning.

articleTitle: Over 10W single-pass second harmonic green light generation with periodically poled MgO doped congruent LiNbO3
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: 10.2W green light was generated by single pass SHG from quasi CW operated 33W microchip Nd:YVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> laser with periodically poled MgO-doped congruent lithium niobate (PPMgLN). PPMgLN length and thickness were 20mm and 1mm, respectively.

articleTitle: Photonic metamaterials by direct laser writing and silver chemical vapor deposition
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We fabricate planar magnetic photonic metamaterials via direct laser writing and silver chemical vapor deposition, an approach, which is also suitable for three-dimensional structures. Retrieval of the effective metamaterial parameters reveals the importance of bi-anisotropy.

articleTitle: A novel optical correlator and its application to packet-header recognition
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a novel, fiber-based correlator for processing temporal optical signals. We demonstrate its operation by performing all-optical packet-header recognition at 100 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Multimode memories with longitudinally broadened ensembles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Quantum storage of multiple optical modes affords improved performance for quantum repeaters. We present new analytic and numerical results unifying the scaling of the multimode storage capacity for various memory protocols in artificially broadened ensembles.

articleTitle: Designing randomness — the impact of textured surfaces on the efficiency of thin-film solar cells
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We analyze experimentally and theoretically light localization at randomly textured ZnO surfaces and light absorption in thin-film amorphous Si deposited conformal on it. Guidance is provided to tailor such surfaces for optimizing the absorption.

articleTitle: Ultrafast rotational wave packet dynamics observed through third harmonic conversion of a femtosecond probe pulse
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe rotational wave packet dynamics in CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> through third harmonic generation (THG). The conversion efficiency of THG is modulated by the wavepacket through ultrafast perturbations to linear and third-order optical susceptibilities.

articleTitle: Efficient second-harmonic generator and electro-optic polarization-mode converter in single aperiodically poled lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the first attempt on constructing an aperiodically poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> for optimally integrating dual nonlinear-optical devices. >50% second-harmonic-generation conversion efficiency enhancement over a conventional cascaded periodically poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is obtained with such a device.

articleTitle: Optical heterodyne saturation spectroscopy in ammonia filled hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have applied the frequency-modulation (FM) technique in the 1.5 mum wavelength region to observe saturated absorption in ammonia in hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers (HC-PBFs). Previously blended lines have been resolved.

articleTitle: Adaptive spectral selection of a super continuum source using optical MEMS for biomedical diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present an innovative approach for digital selection of precise spectral regions from a super-continuum beam using an array of electrostatically-actuated micro-mirrors. The device allows spectral and temporal encoding of selected spectral bands.

articleTitle: Elliptic optical filters with all-positive couplings based on the double-microring ladder architecture
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Compact elliptic optical filter architectures based on arrays of parallel-cascaded microring doublets are proposed. These devices can realize general filter transfer functions with imaginary transmission zeros using only synchronously-tuned microrings with non-negative couplings.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh-Q nanocavities realized by using a very narrow photonic crystal with built-in air slots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A new photonic crystal nanocavity combined with built-in air slots achieved an experimental Q of over 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> even when the photonic crystals on either side of the line defect had only a few lateral periods.

articleTitle: Enhanced formation of electron-hole droplets in diamond by a weak pulse injection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The electron-hole droplets (EHD) formation in diamond is remarkably enhanced due to the irradiation by a weak pulse hundreds of picoseconds after a stronger excitation pulse.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Maximum scaling of Second-Harmonic Generation in One-dimensional Photonic Crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate maximum scaling of second-harmonic generation as the eighth power of the photonic crystal length without phase matching (PM). This result challenges a commonly held view regarding the necessity of PM for large scaling.

articleTitle: Excess Noise Control in Gaussian-modulated Coherent State Quantum Key Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel polarization-frequency-multiplexing scheme is implemented to suppress noise in a fiber-based Gaussian-modulated coherent-state quantum key distribution system. The achievable secrete key rate is 0.30bit/pulse with a 5km-fiber and 0.05bit/pulse with a 20km-fiber.

articleTitle: Ultra-low-power parametric frequency conversion of high data rates on-chip
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-low-power parametric frequency conversion of 5-Gbit/s data in a silicon photonic structure via microcavity-enhanced four-wave mixing. Our modeling predicts high conversion efficiency up to 0-dB is possible through GVD-engineering and free-carrier lifetime reduction.

articleTitle: Narrow-bandwidth Mid-IR generation based on a large aperture periodically poled Mg-doped LiNbO3 optical parametric pump system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed a narrow-bandwidth (<2 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) mid-IR optical parametric system with a large-aperture PPMgLN based 2 mum pump system. The system tuned from 4.7 to 10.6 mum, and the maximum output energy of 1.7 mJ was obtained.

articleTitle: Ultrafast gigantic photo-response in charge-ordered organic salt (EDO-TTF)2PF6 on 10-fs time scales
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The initial dynamics of photo-induced phase transition in (EDO-TTF)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>PF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> was investigated using 10-fs laser pulses. We observed sub-20-fs gigantic photo-responses (|DeltaR/R|>100%) and a clear signature of a structural bottleneck (~60 fs) for the first time.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Analysis of N + 1-core fiber laser cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Mode structure and oscillation condition of a multicore fiber laser are derived using coupled mode theory, yielding conditions for in-phase and flattened supermode operation. An inhomogeneous facet reflectivity can be used for mode control applications.

articleTitle: Characterization of pulse timing jitter of actively stabilised 1-GHz vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting semiconductor laser producing 500-fs pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The rms timing jitter of 500-fs optical pulses from a passively mode-locked, actively stabilised vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting laser was determined by the Von der Linde method to be 350 fs over 500 Hz - 500 KHz.

articleTitle: Nondegenerate-wavelength ghost imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study nondegenerate-wavelength thermal ghost imaging and found that the spatial resolution of the ghost image depends strongly on the wavelength of the light illuminating the object but not on that in the reference arm.

articleTitle: Carrier dynamics and slow light in semiconductor nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We give an overview of slow and fast light effects in semiconductor waveguides. Experimental and theoretical results are presented, emphasizing the physics as well as the limitations imposed by the carrier dynamical processes.

articleTitle: Probing ultrafast dynamics of electrons and holes in graphene
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using pump-probe techniques, we study the ultrafast relaxation dynamics of photoexcited carriers in graphene. We find an initial fast relaxation transient (70-120 fs), followed by a slower relaxation process (0.4-1.7 ps). We relate the measured time scales to carrier-carrier and carrier-phonon intraband and interband scattering processes and also to crystal disorder in the material.

articleTitle: Breakdown of the Dipole Approximation for Large Quantum Dot Emitters Coupled to an Interface
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measured time-resolved photoluminescence from large quantum dots near a semiconductor-air interface. Far from the interface our data are consistent with dipole theory, but near the interface they question the validity of the dipole approximation.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of blue light-induced near-infrared absorption of ferroelectric crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We studied blue light-induced near-infrared absorption (BLINIRA) and its temperature dependence in ferroelectric crystals, i.e., MgO-doped stoichiometric-LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, congruent-LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, MgO-doped stoichiometric-LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, and stoichiometric-LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. We found the BLINIRA decreased with the increase of temperature.

articleTitle: Synchronously-pumped near-degenerate doubly resonant optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the characteristics of a low-loss type-II phase matched synchronously-pumped DRO. Numerical simulations using a split-step Fourier method agree well with experimental results.

articleTitle: Polarization control in silicon-on-insulator waveguides using gap plasmon polaritons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Resonant coupling to highly confined plasmonic modes in a metal-dielectric nanoscale multilayer on top of a silicon guiding core is proposed for polarization control in silicon-on-insulator waveguides.

articleTitle: Phase locking of nanosecond pulses of passively Q-switched microchip lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that nanosecond pulses of passively Q-switched microchip lasers can be phase locked without affecting the pulse duration by coupling the lasers to a low-Q resonator.

articleTitle: Wavelength-flattened asymmetric directional couplers written by focused femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Asymmetric directional couplers were written inside bulk borosilicate glass by a high repetition rate femtosecond laser. Wavelength-dependent coupling ratios were tuned by laser exposure and coupler geometry, yielding flattened spectral response (plusmn5%) over >400-nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Detection-time-bin-shift polarization encoding quantum key distribution system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A detection-time-bin-shift scheme for polarization encoding QKD is proposed. This scheme reduces cost and overcomes the security loss caused by dead-time and unbalanced characteristics of detectors. This scheme is experimentally demonstrated with the B92 protocol.

articleTitle: Generation of TW-class 2-cycle pulses using a pressure-gradient hollow fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate generation of intense 5 fs pulses using a pressure gradient hollow fiber. The beam after pulse compression could be focused to a diffraction-limited spot with an intensity of 3times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Observation of non resonant coupling of single quantum dots to photonic crystal nanocavity modes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We compare single photon generation from quantum dots emitting into a two-dimensional photonic bandgap and a nanocavity mode using auto and cross-correlation spectroscopy. Quantum correlations are observed, even for detunings > 12 meV, indicating the presence of a remote optical coupling mechanism.

articleTitle: Time-bin encoding for narrow-band single photons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Quantum networks require the reliable encoding of quantum information in narrow-band single photons which couple efficiently to transitions in atomic ensembles. We show time-bin encoding for photons of 10 MHz width via unbalanced Michelson interferometers and show the applicability of our scheme in a quantum key distribution experiment.

articleTitle: Numerical model of the optical stark effect as a mode-locking mechanism for femtosecond vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A pulse is shortened by repeated transits of a quantum well absorber in which the band-edge is detuned to higher energy. The calculated effect is consistent with the experimentally observed formation of 448-fs transform-limited pulses.

articleTitle: Soliton self-frequency shift and spectral broadening in air-core photonic crystal fibres
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report numerical investigation of the soliton self-frequency shift in air-core photonic crystal fibres, accompanied by the emission of Airy waves and strong cut-off of the input pulse spectrum due to Raman response of air.

articleTitle: Conductively cooled Ho:Tm:LuLiF laser amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A conductively-cooled Ho:Tm:LuLiF laser head can amplify 80mJ/340ns probe pulses into 400mJ when the pump pulse energy is close to amplified spontaneous emission (ASE) threshold, 5.6J. For a small signal, the double-pass amplification exceeds 25.

articleTitle: Thermally induced local-depolarization in thin YAG ceramics for high-power lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate a spatially-distributed local-depolarization induced by thermal-birefringence for the power scaling in Nd:YAG ceramics. We found the variation of local-depolarization was dramatically increased when the thickness of ceramics becomes comparable to the grain size.

articleTitle: Strong enhancement of local fields and second-harmonic generation in a resonant waveguide grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
