abstract: We observe over 5000-fold enhancement of second-harmonic generation from an all-dielectric resonant waveguide grating. The enhancement is due to interaction of strong local fields with the inherent surface nonlinearity of the structure.

articleTitle: Optical topography system for laser ablation plume measurements
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We image the nanoscale plasma plume of laser-ablated titanium metal by using a Shack-Hartmann based optical topographic system. We show this diagnostic produces data with ultrafast temporal resolution that is concurrent with simulations.

articleTitle: High-throughput protein binding end-points and kinetics in microarrays using label-free OI-RD microscopes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The potential of biomolecular microarrays on glass for high-throughput kinetics assays has not previously been fully exploited. We demonstrate real-time label-free optical detection of antibodies binding to drug-antigen microarrays using oblique-incidence reflectivity difference (OI-RD) microscopes.

articleTitle: Designer femtosecond pulse shaping using grating-engineered quasi-phasematching in lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Tailored femtosecond pulses with fully engineered intensity and phase profiles are demonstrated using second-harmonic generation of an Er:fiber laser in an aperiodically-poled lithium niobate crystal. The profiles created include square, stepped, double and triple pulses.

articleTitle: Ti:sapphire comb laser devised for direct frequency comb spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We built up, for the first time to our knowledge, a Ti:sapphire comb laser directly referring to cesium 822.5 nm two-photon transition. The novel devices were designed for the flexibility of direct frequency comb spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Experimental Observation of Rabi oscillations in a one-dimensional photonic lattice
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe Rabi oscillations in one-dimensional waveguide arrays. Adiabatic transitions, both direct and indirect (phonon-assisted), between extended Floquet-Bloch modes associated with different bands are stimulated by index-gratings inducing periodic modulations along the propagation direction.

articleTitle: Coherent control of resonant two-photon excitation of excitons in Cu2O by phase modulated pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By using a pulse shaping method, we control the resonant two-photon excitation probability of 1s orthoexcitons in Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O and suppress the undesired three-photon interband transition which emerges at a high power excitation.

articleTitle: HAFs having λ0 in a 1.0μm band and high non-linearity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We designed and fabricated simple-structure HAFs having λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> in a 1.0μm band as well as low confinement loss and single mode operation over wide range of wavelengths. The developed HAFs showed high non-linearity and good connectivity.

articleTitle: Chemical fluid deposition of semiconductors inside a microstructured optical fiber for optoelectronic applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A technique to fill semiconductors inside a microstructured optical fiber is developed. The structural, electrical and optical properties are investigated. All-optical modulation of light and an in-fiber field effect transistor are demonstrated using this device.

articleTitle: Spontaneous recombination rate and luminescence efficiency of staggered InGaN quantum wells light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Spontaneous emission characteristics and power-dependent cathodoluminescence (CL) of staggered InGaN quantum wells (QWs) light emitting diodes were analyzed. The measurements indicated ∼4-times improvement in integrated CL intensity and ∼50% reduction in non-radiative recombination rate.

articleTitle: Enhancement of group velocity in a random composite metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate group velocity enhancement in a composite metamaterial consisting of ensembles of dielectric and metallic particles. This finding introduces another class of metamaterials that lack spatial order but nonetheless possess peculiar electromagnetic properties.

articleTitle: Group-IV quantum cascase laser operating in the L-valleys
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We design a lattice-matched Ge/Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.76</sub>Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.19</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.05</sub> quantum cascade laser emitting at 49 mum. This particular alloy composition gives a ldquocleanrdquo conduction band offset of 150 meV at L-valleys with all other energy valleys sitting higher in energy.

articleTitle: Influence of the wavelength dependence of the effective area on infrared supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Influence of the effective area spectral dependence on midinfrared supercontinuum generation is demonstrated. The behaviors of photonic crystal and step index fibers is compared. A 700nm width reduction is shown in step index ZBLAN fibers.

articleTitle: High-dynamic-range, single-shot cross-correlator using a pulse replicator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A single-shot, third-order cross-correlator is implemented using a pulse replicator that generates a sequence of spatially distinct, temporally delayed sampling pulses. A 250-ps temporal range with 60-dB dynamic range is demonstrated in single-shot operation.

articleTitle: Ring resonator induced data timing skew in on-chip WDM optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Device induced data timing skew in optical interconnects is investigated. Up to 28 ps timing skew is induced by ring-resonator cavity Q variation in 10 Gb/s NRZ on-chip scenario, which may lead to 6 dB signal eye opening penalty.

articleTitle: Superconducting nanowire photon number resolving detector at telecom wavelength
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a photon-number-resolving (PNR) detector, based on parallel superconducting nanowires, capable of resolving up to 5 photons in the telecommunication wavelength range, with sensitivity and speed far exceeding existing approaches.

articleTitle: Relative-phase measurement of multicolor pulses for characterization of fourier-synthesized waveform
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The phase relation among phase-locked multicolor pulses was measured by interference between dual simultaneous frequency-mixing processes in a thin nonlinear crystal for characterization of Fourier-synthesized waveform.

articleTitle: High-energy, diode-pumped, cryogenically-cooled Yb:LiYF4 chirped-pulse amplification system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a cryogenically-cooled Yb:LiYF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> chirped-pulse amplification system with an energy of Gt100-mJ boosted by regenerative and multi-pass amplifiers for pumping multi-terawatt, few-cycle optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification.

articleTitle: Embedded-mirror side pumping of double-clad fiber lasers and amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Embedded-mirror side pumping enables fabrication of compact, efficient fiber sources using a variety of pump sources. It is the only method capable of employing the output of an unformatted diode bar. We discuss recent progress.

articleTitle: Channel waveguide formed by “One Shot” implantation of He+ ions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Channel waveguide was fabricated in a KLTN crystal. The waveguide was produced by a selective implantation of He<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ions into the crystal through a gold stopping mask, which created a trough shaped cladding.

articleTitle: Homodyne state tomography with photon number resolving detectors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We introduce a complete tomographic reconstruction scheme geared toward low photon-number states. To demonstrate this method we reconstruct various single-mode coherent states.

articleTitle: Tunable superluminal pulse propagation on a silicon chip
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate superluminal pulse propagation on a silicon chip using an all -optical analog to electromagnetically induced absorption created by the coherent interaction between two micro-resonators. We show group indices tunable between −1158 and −312.

articleTitle: Large amplitude modulation of high-order harmonic generation from vibrationally excited molecules
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe large vibrationally-induced modulations in high order harmonic conversion in N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>. We explain this unexpected result as due to the changing electronic structure induced by the vibration, leading to preferential emission at the outer turning point of the vibration

articleTitle: Terahertz optical activity of a subwavelength helix
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study terahertz pulse propagation through a subwavelength helix; it is shown that polarization rotation accrues linearly within the helix, revealing a direct relationship between the optical activity of a helix and its geometrical chirality.

articleTitle: Mapping entanglement in and out of quantum memories
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report entanglement generation in atomic quantum memories via deterministic mapping of photonic entanglement. The atomic entanglement is retrieved back into photon modes after a programmable storage time, with an overall efficiency of 17%.

articleTitle: Nonlinear refraction and absorption in highly transmissive one-dimensional metal-organic photonic bandgap structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the optical properties of a metal-organic photonic bandgap structure showing a peak transmission ∼44 % and that enhances the nonlinear optical properties of bulk Copper by up to an order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Coherent pulse injection into a monolithic passively mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate conditions for optically coherent injection locking of a monolithic mode-locked semiconductor laser. An interferometric technique is used to quantify the relationship between modal detuning, pulse shape, and optical spectrum.

articleTitle: Dynamic tuning of birefringence in silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This paper is the first report on dynamic control of birefringence in silicon-on-insulator (SOI) waveguides by electronically tuning the stress in the waveguide. The dynamic stress is induced by a thin-film piezoelectric transducer integrated on top of the waveguide. Integrated piezoelectric transducers are used to electrically vary the dispersion in a silicon optical waveguide.

articleTitle: Development of composite silver-polymer metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have synthesized and studied a series of composite silver-polymer photonic metamaterials with composition-tunable electric permittivity epsiv. The demonstrated value epsivpsila = 12.8 at lambda = 2.4 mum appears to be the highest in the near-to-mid-IR spectral range.

articleTitle: Resonance effects governing modulation instability of incoherent light
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate, theoretically and experimentally, resonance effects associated with modulation instability of incoherent light. The resonance is exemplified in a sharp transition of the spatial-frequency of maximum-gain, and in the absence of threshold.

articleTitle: Electrically driven high-Q quantum dot-micropillar cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on high quality electrically driven quantum dot micropillar cavities with Q-factors up to 16.000. The high Q-factors allow the observation of pronounced single dot resonance effects with a Purcell enhancement of about 10.

articleTitle: Optically induced spin echoes in rubidium atoms: On- and off-resonant manipulations of spins
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optically induced spin echoes are observed. Two types of spin echoes, on- and off-resonant manipulations by the control pulse, are discussed. Possibility of spin rotation around arbitrary axis by using the off-resonant manipulation is given.

articleTitle: Characterization and analysis of micro-fluidic VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A parametric study of micro-fluidic photonic crystal vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers is carried out which shows a larger fluid-induced wavelength shift with smaller lattice constant. An effective index model is developed which is consistent with measurements.

articleTitle: Excited-state absorption in high-power mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The loss due to excited-state absorption into the continuum was calculated for high-power mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers. We find this loss to be a significant fraction of the gain at the laser wavelength.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal laser cavities optimized by the geometric projection method
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the quality factor and spectral characteristics of a photonic crystal cavity laser optimized by the geometry projection method. Fabricated devices show 30% improvement in quality factor, consistent with a predicted two-fold increase.

articleTitle: Probing laser-induced structural changes using coherent phonon detection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We find the onset of laser-induced InSb thermal dissociation using coherent optical phonon detection under asynchronous optical sampling. Additionally, laser-induced annealing of Sb thin films is monitored in photoacoustic measurements of sound velocity in real-time.

articleTitle: Observation of broadband self-collimation in fs laser-written waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the first experimental observation of self-collimation of white-light beams in specially designed fs laser-written curved waveguide arrays, where discrete diffraction was suppressed over the spectral range extending from blue to infrared wavelengths.

articleTitle: Secure optical communications using antisqueezed light with enhanced fluctuations
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Secure optical communications using antisqueezing are a realistic application of quantum information technologies. Antisqueezed light with enhanced fluctuations was transmitted over 100 km. Greater difficulty of eavesdropping than in a coherent-state case was shown.

articleTitle: Optimizing the bandwidth and coherence of supercontinuum in soft glass microstructured fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A genetic algorithm is used for the first time to design soft glass microstructured optical fibers with low flat dispersion that can be used to generate highly coherent supercontinuum extending into the mid-infrared.

articleTitle: Quantitative broadband chemical sensing in air-suspended solid-core fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a sensitive evanescent field sensor using air-suspended solid-core fibers. Excellent agreement between measured and calculated mode profiles allows us to measure quantitative broadband absorption spectra with sample volumes as low as 1 μL.

articleTitle: Polarization properties of a long-period grating written in a pure fused silica photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Polarization properties of a long-period grating inscribed in a single-mode photonic crystal fiber are presented. A strong modulation in the spectra of polarization-dependent loss and differential group delay with periods of 2.6 and 1.3 nm is reported.

articleTitle: Entangled images from 4-wave mixing in rubidium vapor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that non-degenerate 4-wave mixing in an atomic vapor can produce highly multimode twin beams. The process can be used to generate arbitrarily-shaped continuous-variable entangled twin beams that contain quantum-correlations in time and space.

articleTitle: Silk fibroin-based active optofluidics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The ancient silk fiber finds resurgence in a new paradigm of highly functional optofluidic devices embodied by an active oxygenation sensor comprising a hemoglobin infused cast silk integrated diffraction grating for spectral analysis.

articleTitle: Slot waveguide cavities for electrically-pumped silicon-based light sources
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We fabricate horizontal slot waveguides and resonators using layers of polycrystalline and single crystalline silicon. We demonstrate waveguide propagation losses of 7.3 dB/cm and ring resonators with an intrinsic quality factor of 76,000.

articleTitle: High power laser operation of sesquioxides Yb:Lu2O3 and Yb:Sc2O3
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A comparative study of highly-efficient laser operation of high-purity Yb:Lu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and Yb:Sc<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is reported. In thin-disk laser geometry an output-power of 36.3 W at 1034 nm with a slope-efficiency of 80% was obtained from a 5at.%-doped Lu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-disk.

articleTitle: Longitudinally single mode laser-diode fabricated with Nanoimprint Lithography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate diode lasers with integrated feedback gratings using nanoimprint lithography. Our process is developed for epitaxially grown semiconductors. Due to the feedback from the grating longitudinally single mode lasing is achieved.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulses generation with the Mazzler active spectral broadening and the XPW pulse shortening technique
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated the Mazzler with XPW filter approach to obtain ultrashort pulses with Gaussian shape at the output of the laser system. This scheme can be scaled to higher output energy and sub 10 fs pulses.

articleTitle: Electrooptic control of quasiphase matched second harmonic generation with periodic electrode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have investigated theoretically the performance of electrooptic control of quasiphase matched second harmonic generation efficiency in periodically poled ferroelectric crystals for the case where a periodic electrode is used.

articleTitle: Nonlinear recovery of noise-hidden signals via modulation instability
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a spatial, all-optical version of steganography in a nonlinear medium. After hiding a coherent image in spatially-incoherent noise, we recover the signal by seeding modulation instability in a self-focusing photorefractive crystal.

articleTitle: Role of carrier diffusion and recombination in photonic crystal nanocavity optical switches
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We studied the spatio-temporal behavior of the carriers in photonic crystal nanocavities and showed that diffusion enables fast switching, which is the advantage of nanocavity switches over other larger optical switches.

articleTitle: A single-pixel terahertz camera
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe a single-pixel, pulsed terahertz camera which uses random patterns to enable high-speed image acquisition. Our method requires no raster scanning of objects, nor detection using a focal-plane array.

articleTitle: Strong-field induced vibrational coherence in the ground electronic state of hot I2
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe large amplitude coherent vibrations in ground state neutral I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> created by strong-field ionization, through ldquoLochfrass,rdquo or ldquoR-selective ionization.rdquo Simulations show that the vibrational coherence is stronger for hot molecules than for cold molecules.

articleTitle: 70 nm lensless diffractive microscopy using tabletop soft x-ray sources
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We use curvature correction and high-numerical-aperture imaging to demonstrate a soft-X-ray diffraction microscope with 70-90 nm resolution using two tabletop coherent sources. This near-diffraction-limited resolution of 1.5lambda is a first for X-ray diffractive imaging.

articleTitle: Short wavelength quantum cascade lasers emitting around 3 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on recent progress in the development of short wavelength InAs/AlSb QCLs: a new short wavelength limit of 2.75 mum and high power, high temperature pulsed operation above 3 mum are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Brillouin spectrum for fiber based slow light systems
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This article shows simulation results and first practical investigations of the optimization of a Brillouin spectrum with the natural bandwidth superimposed with two losses for fiber based slow light systems.

articleTitle: Transmission properties of selectively gold-filled polarization-maintaining PCF
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the optical properties of a polarization-preserving PCF in which two enlarged hollow channels on opposite sides of the core are filled with gold. Surface plasmon resonances and intriguing polarisation effects are observed.

articleTitle: Nonlinear THz-pump/THz-probe measurements of semiconductor carrier dynamics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A table-top THz source has been employed to study the nonlinear response of semiconductors to near-half-cycle femtosecond pulses. We report nonlinear field-induced changes in the far infrared absorption coefficient, associated with impact ionization processes.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Application of nonlinear MLSE based on Volterra theory in NZ-DSF optical communication systems
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that a nonlinear adaptive MLSE receiver based on Volterra theory with 4-bit ADC and 3-fold oversampling can result in a reach of 960 km over 10 Gb/s NZ-DSF fiber-optic communication systems.

articleTitle: 1.2–2.2-μm tunable Raman soliton source based on a Cr:Forsterite-laser and a photonic-crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A widely tunable femtosecond light source based on a Cr:Forsterite laser and a nonlinear photonic-crystal-fiber is reported. With a 910 nm tuning range, this simple, easily-tunable, and low-cost source could be widely applicable for many applications.

articleTitle: Low loss THz fibers with multiple subwavelength holes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose the design of a THz fiber that is composed of a polymer rod containing a hexagonal array of subwavelength air holes. A high air fraction gives an absorption loss of 0.018 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Tunable optical delay with signal regeneration using cross-absorption modulation wavelength conversion and chromatic dispersion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a compact tunable delay scheme with simultaneous signal regeneration using an electro-absorption modulator and a chirped fiber Bragg grating. Over 580-ps delay range is obtained with 2-dB improvement in the receiver sensitivity.

articleTitle: Waveguides operating in the restrahlen band
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate characteristics of waveguide using highly-reflective semiconductor in the Restrahlen band. We identify spectral operating regions within the Restrahlen band of a cladding layer that offers advantages over both traditional dielectric waveguide and metal clad waveguides using surface plasmon polaritons.

articleTitle: Attosecond-resolution timing jitter characterization of free-running mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Timing jitter characterization of free-running mode-locked lasers is demonstrated using balanced optical cross-correlation in the timing detector and the timing delay configurations. The limitation set by shot noise is 470 attoseconds in 10-MHz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Ultrashort-pulse laser calligraphy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Control of structural modifications inside silica glass by varying the direction of pulse front tilt is demonstrated, achieving a calligraphic style of writing. Anisotropic cavitation is observed in the vicinity of the irradiated region.

articleTitle: A novel optical signal monitoring method of DPSK signal based on delay tap sampling and Hausdorff distance measure
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate an optical signal monitoring method for NRZ-DPSK signals using asynchronous delay tap sampling and Hausdorff distance measure. The application of the technique for residual dispersion monitoring is demonstrated and high tolerance to other impairments and pulse shape is shown.

articleTitle: Fluorine-doped silica fiber with high transparency and resitivity to deep ultra violet light
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Transmittance exceeding 92 %m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> at 266 nm and its permanence after 4 G pulses of laser irradiation are realized in fluorine-doped silica fiber due to the optimized fiber-manufacturing processes such as perform-fabrication and fiber-drawing.

articleTitle: Novel long period fiber grating-based filter configuration enabling arbitrary linear filtering characteristics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The novel filtering scheme proposed here allows for implementation of arbitrary spectral transfer functions. It is demonstrated on design and realization of a filter for transform-limited 1.6-ps flat-top pulse synthesis.

articleTitle: Time-domain terahertz mapping of thickness and degradation of aircraft turbine blade thermal barrier coatings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Time domain terahertz (TD-THz) non destructive evaluation (NDE) imaging is used to two-dimensionally map the thickness of yttria stabilized zirconia (YSZ) thermal barrier coatings (TBC) on aircraft engine turbine blades. Indications of thermal degradation can be seen. The method is non-contact, rapid, and requires no special preparation of the blade.

articleTitle: Real-time sensing of gas phase mixtures via coherent Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Hybrid CARS experiments on ambient air and gas mixtures suggest that the technique, developed initially for biohazard detection, might become indispensable for local sensing of gas composition, e.g. real-time quality control of pipeline natural gas.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable RF waveform generation using optical incoherent sources
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An RF waveform generator operating with incoherent broadband light is successfully implemented. Complex RF ~10 GHz bandwidth waveforms are generated by means of incoherent wavelength-to-time mapping. Our technique can be scaled to the mm-wave range.

articleTitle: Common-path interferometer for incorruptible detection of the carrier-envelope phase drift
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel quasi-common-path variant of the f-to-2f interferometer that widely removes undesired residual phase drift from femtosecond pulse trains and improves the utility of stabilization schemes in frequency metrology and attophysics.

articleTitle: Nano-stratification of local field and atomic bistability in low-dimensional structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Nano-scale strata due to broken uniformity of local field in strongly self-interacting low-dimensional structures are predicted. They result in giant field resonances and atomic optical bistability, including ultimate case of two coupled atoms.

articleTitle: OLEDs for solid state lighting
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Organic light emitting devices represent an exciting potential technology for solid state lighting. In this tutorial, key areas of progress in performance and low cost fabrication are described and compared to solid-state lighting needs.

articleTitle: High speed observation of ultrafast machining dynamics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous drilling and coaxial depth imaging of holes in stainless steel at axial rates of 46 kHz. Depth measurement with 6 mum resolution is performed using the machining beam via Fourier-domain interferometry.

articleTitle: Compact, high peak power, passively Q-switched micro-laser for ignition of engines
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Spark plug-size, passively Q-switched Cr:YAG/Nd:YAG micro-laser was developed for ignition of engines. Optical power intensity of ≫5TW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was obtained at the focal point and the enhanced combustion for leaner gas mixture was realized.

articleTitle: Terahertz transmission through rectangular apertures: Far- and near-field studies
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report that the terahertz transparency occurs at the fundamental shape resonance of the rectangular holes regardless of the areal coverage. The funneling of energy at the fundamental resonance is also confirmed at the near-field.

articleTitle: Efficient upconversion of coherent radiation at 10.26 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Upconversion of laser beam at 10.26 μm to 1.187 μm was achieved in a GaSe crystal via difference-frequency generation with the highest conversion efficiency measured to be 19%. Saturation due to pump depletion was evidenced.

articleTitle: Optimization of coupling between a metal nanocavity and a free-space Gaussian mode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We minimize scattering losses and maximize coupling to a given free-space mode from sub-wavelength metal aperture surrounded by periodic corrugations via optimum choice of parameters of the structure.

articleTitle: Dispersion properties of “Kagome” hollow-core fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The dispersion of a broadband-guiding hollow core photonic crystal fiber, possessing a Kagome cladding structure, can be adversely influenced by weak residual mode interactions. The impact on pulse propagation is explored.

articleTitle: 6.4-dB small signal gain enhancement in Raman-assisted fiber optical parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We reported a 6.4-dB gain enhancement of a Raman-assisted fiber optical parametric amplifier over the sum of the gains of the individual Raman and parametric amplifiers by keeping the amplifiers out of the saturation region.

articleTitle: A physical layer perspective on current and next-generation passive optical networks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This tutorial will focus on physical layer issues associated with passive optical networks. Corresponding technologies of present and future deployments will also be discussed.

articleTitle: Fully automated, phase corrected Long Crystal SPIDER for the characterization of broadband pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present an optimized and automated implementation of the compact Long-Crystal-SPIDER design. The integrated phase-corrections allow for precise pulse reconstruction up to bandwidths of 17 THz and linear chirp detection at bandwidths exceeding 40 THz.

articleTitle: Silicon microring filters
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Detailed performance of silicon microring filters is analyzed, including amplitude, phase, bandwidth and free spectral range. With experiments and simulations, we show that unavoidable trade-off must be taken among these parameters.

articleTitle: All-fiber 32x1 pump combiner with high isolation for high power fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present an all-fiberreg pump combiner with 32 ports. This device is designed to provide high isolation providing intrinsic pump protection. We demonstrated that over 200 W of pump power can be deliver in 20/400 mum fiber.

articleTitle: All-optical response of semiconductor ring laser bistable to duo optical injections
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The all-optical response of a semiconductor ring laser to two optical injections demonstrates very digital hysteresis with externally controllable switching threshold, enabling the device to be used for all-optical pulse regeneration.

articleTitle: Brillouin optical correlation-domain reflectometry with 13-mm spatial resolution and 50-Hz sampling rate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Distributed strain sensing with a high spatial resolution is demonstrated in optical fibers based on Brillouin optical correlation-domain reflectometry. The Brillouin frequency shifts of 3-cm fiber sections are successfully measured with a spatial resolution of 13 mm and sampling rate of 50 Hz. This spatial resolution is the best result ever reported in Brillouin-based reflectometries.

articleTitle: A portable QKD system based on entanglement
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a fully functioning and portable QKD system based on polarisation entanglement for long time usage. We further show the distribution of secure keys a rate of 1kbit/s over 25km for 24 hours.

articleTitle: 320-fs thulium-doped fiber-ring-laser with a pulse energy of 3.5-nJ
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A femtosecond thulium-doped passively modelocked fiber laser with internal dispersion compensation is presented. It generates pulses at a center wavelength of 1985 nm with a dechirped pulse duration of 320 fs and an energy of 3.5 nJ. Pulsed operation is achieved using additive pulse mode locking, dispersion compensation is facilitated by an internal grating arrangement.

articleTitle: Tunable slow light in quantum well vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser at 40 GHz
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This investigation experimentally demonstrates tunable slow light in a quantum well vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser at 40 GHz. Tunable optical delays are achieved by adjusting the bias current and wavelength detuning.

articleTitle: Characterisation of an InAs quantum dot semiconductor disk laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the performance of a 1030nm semiconductor disk laser with gain region consisting of multiple sub-monolayers of InAs/GaAs quantum dots. Maximum output power of 512mW was achieved with 20% slope efficiency.

articleTitle: Demonstration of enhanced spontaneous Raman scattering in slow-light silicon photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The direct observation of spontaneous Raman scattering in silicon photonic crystal waveguides is reported. In addition, enhancement of the spontaneous Raman scattering observed in the slow-light region of the fundamental mode on-set.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked 832-nm vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting semiconductor laser producing 15.3-ps pulses at 1.9-GHz repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The authors report the first passively mode-locked 830- nm vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting laser. A semiconductor saturable absorber mirror with carrier recovery time governed by surface recombination was used to demonstrate pulses of 15.3 ps duration.

articleTitle: Dual-band planar electric thz metamaterial with resonator yield analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: THz radiation transmission through a dual-band electric metamaterial is presented, where we analyze manufacturing defects in the metamaterial. Removing different resonator percentages allows us to quantify the effects of manufacturing defects on the material response.

articleTitle: The impact of nonlinearity during femtosecond pulse compression in fibers on continuum coherence
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Amplified erbium-fiber-laser pulses compressed in large-mode-area fiber show significantly reduced nonlinearity compared to standard-single-mode fiber. Consequently, supercontinuum generated with the pulses compressed in large-mode-area fiber show a 10 dB increase in cross-coherence fringe visibility.

articleTitle: Enhanced terahertz pulses emission from inas surface by femtosecond laser pulses with tilted intensity front
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: It is shown that using femtosecond laser pulses with tilted intensity front allows controlling the direction of terahertz emission from InAs surface and by that way achieving significant increase in the generated power.

articleTitle: Peak power from 60-μm broad area single emitter limited to 50-W by carrier escape
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Passivated 1100-nm broad area lasers reach maximum power of 50-W from a 60-mum stripe under short pulse conditions. Simulations predict and spontaneous emission measurements confirm power is limited by carrier escape from the active region.

articleTitle: The National ignition facility: Status and performance of the world’s largest laser system for the high energy density and inertial confinement fusion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The National Ignition Facility (NIF) at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory has been designed to support a wide variety of high energy density science (HEDS) experiments, including the demonstration of inertial fusion ignition and burn. To meet this goal, its 192-beam frequency-converted neodymium-glass laser must deliver up to 1.8-MJ total energy at 351nm, with peak power of 500 TW and precisely-controlled temporal pulse shapes spanning two orders of magnitude. Over the past two years, a series of detailed measurements have been performed on one beamline of the NIF laser at 1ω(1053nm), 2ω(526.5nm), and 3ω(351 nm). Results of these experiments lend confidence to the expectation that NIF will meet its laser performance design criteria and that it will be able to simultaneously deliver the temporal pulse shaping, focal spot conditioning, peak power, shot-to-shot reproducibility, and power balance required for indirect-drive fusion ignition campaigns. The NIF final optics system has also been demonstrated to be capable of operating at 2ω energies of up to 17.9kJ/beamline—3.4MJ for a similarly configured 192-beam NIF. We discuss the status of NIF commissioning, and the nature and results of these measurement campaigns.

articleTitle: Quasimode-projection approach to quantum-dot-photon interactions in photonic crystal slab coupled-cavity systems
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We treat multiple-quantum-dot-multiple-photon dynamics in coupled-cavity photonic crystal slab systems by projecting the Hamiltonian onto a discrete basis of quasimodes. We apply this approach to spontaneous emission into two coupled cavities.

articleTitle: Simultaneous teleportation of the spectral and polarization states of a photon
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe how spectrally multimode, polarization-entangled photons simultaneously teleport quantum information encoded into the spectral and polarization degrees of freedom of a single photon using sum frequency generation to implement a Bell-state measurement.

articleTitle: CW operation of fabricated semiconductor ring lasers based on retro-reflector cavities with parabolic mirrors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: CW operation is achieved in novel semiconductor ring lasers based on retro-reflector cavities with parabolic mirrors downsized to equivalent ring radius of 16mum at room temperature. L-I curves and optical spectra are observed.

articleTitle: A new kind of PM fiber, using cylindrical vector beams
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generate radially polarised beams, attractive for many scientific and technological applications, as stable eigenmodes in an optical fiber. This yields a new class of fibers that are polarization-maintaining even though they are strictly cylindrically symmetric.

articleTitle: An optimized Frequency Locked Loop in a small scale CPT based rubidium atomic clock
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe optimization of frequency locked loop in atomic clock which is based on coherent population trapping in <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb-D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> transition. The clock performance was optimized to have an Allan deviation of 2.8middot10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> at 1 sec.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of a diffractive unstable resonator with Gaussian outcoupled beam using a VECSEL amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally realized a diffractive unstable laser resonator with a Gaussian shaped outcoupled beam. The structured mirror is assembled with a VECSEL which produces a high beam quality even for the highest amplifier gain.

articleTitle: Nitride /organic hybrid heterostructures for photodetector devices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the study of incorporation of organic thin film semiconductors with GaN to explore new types of photodetector or solar cell application. Photovoltaic effect and photoconductivity gain have been demonstrated using GaN/CuPc and GaN/alpha -NPD hybrid device structure, which offer new opportunities in design of versatile optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: Narrowband and tunable parametric amplification in Bismuth-Oxide-based highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have experimentally, for the first time, demonstrated one-pump optical fiber parametric amplification (OPA) in Bismuth-Oxide-based highly nonlinear fiber (Bi-HNLF), and realized narrowband (0.75nm) and tunable gain spectrum as high as 58dB.

articleTitle: Production of controllable Rb-vapor densities in photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generate a highly-controlled, optically-dense, and repeatable Rb vapor inside of a hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber using light-induced atomic desorption. Here we present its generation dynamics and use for nonlinear quantum optical applications.

articleTitle: Injection locked mode-locked laser with long-term feedback stabilization
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A semiconductor based, CW injection stabilized, 2.46 GHz harmonically mode-locked laser using a feedback loop for long term stabilization is demonstrated. Optical supermode suppression of 36 dB and significant timing and amplitude noise reduction are observed.

articleTitle: Efficient single-axial-mode operation of an Er:YAG ring laser at 1645 nm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report an Er:YAG ring laser employing an acousto-optic modulator to enforce unidirectional operation. The laser yields 4.7 W of single-frequency output at 1645 nm in a beam with M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>~1.03 for 14 W of pump power at 1532 nm.

articleTitle: Evidence for optically induced heating of the GLAS/ICESAT doubler crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Numerical modeling results of optically induced heating of the GLAS doubler explain the performance degradation in output energy of laser-I and II and partially laser-III and are consistent with the on-orbit telemetry.

articleTitle: Symmetry-breaking bifurcation in a vertical grating-waveguide coupler
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a new scheme to observe the symmetry breaking dynamics of two counter-propagating beams in a Kerr-type nonlinear waveguide. Using a grating to couple light vertically allows for a single-beam geometry.

articleTitle: Bandwidth enhancement with tunable optical equalizer for high speed intensity modulation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate bandwidth enhancement of external- and direct-modulated lasers using a tunable optical equalizer. Modulation bandwidth of ≫50 GHz for LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> modulators was obtained. Also, the equalizer permits the increased-speed and chirp-reduction simultaneously for direct-modulated VCSELs.

articleTitle: Prospects for epitaxial c-Er2O3 as a CMOS-compatible lasing material
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The emission of high-Q c-Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> resonators displays little inhomogeneous broadening, robust vacuum-Rabi splitting, and strong upconversion. Considering these effects and a rate-equation model, we analyze the prospects for optically pumped on-chip lasing using c-Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>.

articleTitle: Photonic quantum computing: Shor’s algorithm and the road to fault-tolerance
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This work describes the implementation of a compiled version of Shor's algorithm in a photonic system by utilizing single photons and by employing the nonlinearity induced by measurement. This study also demonstrates the core processes, coherent control, and resultant entangled states that are required in a full-scale implementation of Shor's algorithm. Results show that the performance of quantum algorithm is not the same as the performance of the underlying quantum circuit, and stress the importance of developing techniques for characterising quantum algorithms.

articleTitle: Microstructured hollow-core rib waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We examine the properties of a new type of hollow-core fiber with a rib-waveguide geometry. Based on photonic band-gap fibers, these new designs offer intriguing possibilities for gas and liquid sensing.

articleTitle: Noninvasive assessment of optical clearing of epithelial tissues with OCT
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Selective translucence of epithelial tissues is key technique for imaging in highly scattering media. Here we demonstrate capability of OCT for noninvasive and depth-resolved quantification of tissue optical clearing by application of various hyperosmotic agents.

articleTitle: Broadband supercontinuum using single-mode/dual-mode tellurite glass holey fibers with large mode area
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate broadband 1.0-2.4 mum infrared supercontinuum generation with 0.4 mW output, using single-mode and few-mode tellurite holey fibers with very large mode area, of up to 3000 mum<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Nonlinear response of silicon double-notch-shaped microdisk resonators with non-evanescent coupling
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report double- notch-shaped microdisk resonators for silicon nonlinear-optic applications with direct in/out coupling via the microdisk notches. We measure optical bistability and resonance wavelength redshifts induced by the notch-coupled pump light.

articleTitle: Characterisation of millimetre wave multimode radio-over-fibre systems
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Millimetre wave radio-over-fibre links using both singlemode and multimode fibres are demonstrated over a 0-50 GHz bandwidth operating at 1550 nm. Results show that good link gain can be achieved with both single mode and multimode detectors.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical limits to power in fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Stimulated Brillouin scattering, stimulated Raman scattering, four-wave mixing, self phase modulation, self focusing, and optical dielectric breakdown limit the power obtainable from fiber amplifiers. We explore the limits on nanosecond pulse amplification in LMA fibers.

articleTitle: MEMS chemical sensors using waveguide Fabry-Perot microcavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate waveguide Fabry-Perot microcavities coupled to in-plane microbeam resonators. The microcavities enable measurement of mechanical resonant frequency shifts resulting from mass loading due to analyte sorption. High selectivity sensor arrays are possible.

articleTitle: First demonstration of laser emission from an Yb:YAG single crystal fiber grown by the micro-pulling down technique
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first laser demonstration obtained from an Yb:YAG single-crystal fiber directly grown by the micro-pulling-down technique, with 2.2-W of average output power at 1031-nm for 50-W of incident pump power at 940-nm.

articleTitle: Laser beam combining by beam cleanup in a gradient index Brillouin ring cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and investigate a new beam combining setup using stimulated-Brillouin-scattering in a multimode gradient-index-fiber within a ring cavity. 50% efficiency and 99% slope are achieved with 2 ErYb doped fiber amplifiers without external control.

articleTitle: Characterization of wavelength swept laser for optical coherence tomography imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the characteristics of a wavelength swept laser with a scanning fiber Fabry-Perot filter in the 1300 nm. We investigate the dependence of the scanning frequencies of the conventional and Fourier domain mode-locked (FDML) wavelength swept laser. In the FDML swept laser, the transient intensity profiles and the tuning bandwidths were investigated according to the injection currents and detuning of the scanning frequency. In addition, the transient intensity profiles showed significant asymmetric behavior according to the detuned frequencies.

articleTitle: First indirectly diode pumped Yb:SFAP laser, reaching the watt level at 985 nm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first demonstration of the three-level-laser transition at 985 nm in an Yb:S-FAP crystal intracavity pumped at 914 nm. We obtained 940 mW output power at 985 nm for 20 W incident pump power at 808 nm.

articleTitle: Pre-compensated resonant higher-order mode suppression in coiled large mode area amplifier fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An improved strategy for resonant suppression of higher-order modes is presented. HOM suppressing structures in the cladding are pre-compensated for the bend-induced shift of coupling resonances. Simulations confirm that excellent HOM suppression is achieved.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked and cavity-dumped Yb:KY(WO4)2 oscillator with positive dispersion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a passively mode-locked Yb:KYW oscillator operated in the positive dispersion regime generating pulse energies exceeding 2 muJ at 1 MHz repetition rate. The chirped pulses are externally compressed down to 400 fs.

articleTitle: Near-infrared fluorescent labeling of tissue transglutaminase substrates for imaging tumor boundaries
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel strategy is developed to optically image tumor boundaries by cross-linking near-infrared fluorescent-labeled tissue transglutaminase substrates into tumor boundary tissue.

articleTitle: Coupling single NV centers in diamond to optical microcavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Coupling of the NV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> ZPL to a silica microcavity and tapered fiber is demonstrated at cryogenic temperatures. Coupling to a high-Q cavity should enhance the usefulness of the NV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> for quantum information applications.

articleTitle: Observation of energy exchange between intersecting filament-forming beams freely propagating in air
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate two-beam coupling between crossed filament-producing beams freely propagating in atmosphere, producing energy transfers of 10%, controllable by a relative delay of +/-20 fs. Prospects of filament regeneration and control will be discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of optical gain in Al2O3:Er channel waveguide amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Reactively co-sputtered aluminum oxide layers with low background loss and varying Er concentrations have been deposited. Net optical gain of 0.76 dB/cm was obtained for an Er concentration of 0.9times10<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sub> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> in a channel waveguide.

articleTitle: High resolution waveguide THz-TDS of melamine
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: THz absorption spectra of planar ordered polycrystalline films of melamine were measured at 295 K and 77 K with linewidths considerably narrower than for conventional THz (far-infrared) spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Analytical expressions and simplified formulas for GVD and TOD of reflection grism compressors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We obtain expressions for the GVD and TOD of reflection grism compressors for compensating material dispersion, and provide useful approximations for practical grism designs.

articleTitle: 33MHz repetition rate semiconductor mode-locked laser using eXtreme Chirped Pulse Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An XCPO generates stretched pulses ≫ 10 ns at a 33MHz repetition rate from semiconductor mode-locked laser. The spectral bandwidth is scalable depending on the group delay of CFBG and the pulse repetition rate.

articleTitle: All-optical on-chip memory based on ultra high Q InGaAsP photonic crystal nanocavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical bistable memory operation with 1.3Q-InGaAsP photonic crystal nanocavities based on refractive index modulation caused by carrier-induced nonlinearity. The minimum bias power for bistability is extremely low at a few tens of μW and the operating energy required for switching is only 30 fJ.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Light interaction with skin: Microspectroscopy of light-induced changes in collagen matrix
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Femtosecond pulses derived from a Ti:sapphire oscillator are used to locally modify collagen-rich tissue. Raman and fluorescence microspectroscopy are employed for in situ observations of structural transformations of collagen matrix.

articleTitle: Reducing the oscillator strength in semiconductor quantum dots with a lateral electric field
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We modulate the oscillator strength of self-assembled quantum dots embedded in a semiconductor ridge waveguide by applying an electric field with two coplanar contacts. We estimate a 20 % reduction at 40 V.

articleTitle: Optimally biased coherent I/Q analog photonic link
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optimal operation for a homodyne analog link with in-phase/quadrature detection is obtained for biasing to equalize photocurrents. We show a net link gain >5 dB with <15 dB noise figure can be obtained with >12 mA photocurrent.

articleTitle: A self-calibrating fiber optic probe for tissue optical spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Calibration of diffuse reflectance spectrum for instrument response and time-dependent fluctuation is complicated, time-consuming and potentially inaccurate. We demonstrate a novel fiber optic probe with real-time, self-calibration capability that can be used for tissue spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Trapping of dispersive waves by solitons in long lengths of tapered PCF
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We numerically analyze supercontinuum generation in a long length of tapered PCF to understand the soliton trapping dynamics leading to the enhanced Blue/UV supercontinuum recently achieved experimentally in such fibers.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of an ultra-compact silicon on insulator demultiplexer based on arrayed waveguide gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the design and fabrication of a SOI ultra-compact wavelength-demultiplexer based on arrayed-waveguide-gratings. The size of device is <0.1 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and the simulation shows that crosstalk is >30 dB between channels and insertion loss is ~1 dB.

articleTitle: A non-interferometric pulse-stacker for diagnostic and energetic laser applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a passive, robust pulse-stacker and pulse-shaper which eliminates interpulse interference of stacked pulses while producing a top-hat spatial beam profile.

articleTitle: Tunable high energy femtosecond soliton fiber laser based on hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A tunable femtosecond fiber laser source based on pulse compression and soliton formation in hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber is presented. Efficient frequency-doubling produced 166 nJ pulse energy with 14 nm tuneability at green wavelengths.

articleTitle: Free-carrier absorption in Si nanocrystals probed by microcavity photoluminescence
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Resonant photoluminescence of Si-nanocrystals is used to determine their free-carrier absorption cross-section (sigma<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">FCA</sub>) at visible/near-infrared wavelengths. Rate-equation modeling, including ensemble effects, yields sigma<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">FCA</sub> = 7:8 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-18</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 895 nm. This has implications for Si-based laser design at various wavelengths.

articleTitle: Microdrop Raman laser and plasmon enhancement effects
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report room-temperature Raman lasing in electrodynamically levitated pure glycerin microdrops. The possibility of lowering the lasing threshold through surface plasmon enhanced scattering in glycerin microdrops doped with Ag nanoparticles is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generation of a 12-fs ultraviolet optical pulse using two types of coherent molecular rotations
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A 100-fs ultraviolet pulse is compressed to 12 fs using two types of coherent molecular rotations. Precise control of the time delay between the pulse and the molecular rotations reduced sub-pulses in the temporal profile.

articleTitle: Waveguide ring resonators with gain at the quantum limit
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An expression for the quantum-limited frequency resolution of active waveguide ring resonator spectrometers is derived, and a 1.6 cm diameter, diode-pumped, active waveguide, ring resonator is demonstrated in a neodymium-doped glass with finesse of 250.

articleTitle: Spin Hall effect of light via weak measurements: Sharp and smooth index variations
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using ldquoquantum weak-measurementsrdquo as a coherent enhancement technique for small signals, we have measured the recently proposed ldquospin Hall effectrdquo of light at an air-glass interface, and are working on the smoothly varying refractive-index case.

articleTitle: All-optically generated ultrashort voltage pulses on planar transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that shift currents generated by all-optical excitation of (110)-oriented bulk GaAs can be employed to launch ultrashort voltage pulses with frequency components exceeding 1 THz on planar transmission lines.

articleTitle: Electric field enhancing properties of the V-shaped optical resonant antennas
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Both dipolar and quadrupolar modes are proved to be effectively excited and strong field enhancement is found in the gap of the V-shaped optical resonant antenna by using FDTD simulations.

articleTitle: Raman spectroscopic study of silicone-based hydrogel polymers with large index changes induced by femtosecond laser micromachining
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Raman spectroscopy has been used to study the femtosecond laser micromachined regions inside silicone-based hydrogel polymers. No significant changes in the Raman spectrum are observed even when index change is as large as +0.06.

articleTitle: Application of mid-infrared attenuated total reflectance spectroscopy using broadly tunable OPOs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A singly resonant optical parametric oscillator based on MgO:PPLN is used as a tunable light source for attenuated total reflectance spectroscopy. Because of high emitted power spectral densities, diluting the sample can be avoided.

articleTitle: Coupling surface plasmons: Index matching and dielectric pillar arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study coupling between surface plasmons in metal-hole arrays. We observe avoided crossings in the measured transmission spectra for metal-hole arrays with a dielectric pillar in each hole and for arrays in index matching liquid.

articleTitle: Ridge waveguides of rare earth doped ZBLAN by pulsed laser deposition and ultrafast laser micromachining for green integrated waveguide lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ridge waveguides are manufactured using laser radiation for the deposition of thin films and the micro structuring of the wave guiding structures. The optical properties of erbium and praseodymium doped ZBLAN thin films and waveguides are investigated in view of the manufacturing of green integrated waveguide lasers.

articleTitle: Differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution utilizing decoy pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution scheme utilizing decoy pulses is proposed. Alice sends a coherent p p pulse train that occasionally includes high-level decoy pulses. Eavesdropping is revealed from photon counting rates around the decoy pulses.

articleTitle: Gain & thermal distorsion investigation on the Yb:YAG diode pumped LUCIA oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the latest investigations performed on the LUCIA Yb:YAG diode pumped oscillator (260 mJ, 49 ns, 2 Hz). Thermal distortions as well gain measurements have been explored.

articleTitle: Fiber surface enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) sensors based on a double substrate “sandwich” structure
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A new configuration was designed and tested based on ldquosandwichingrdquo target analyte molecules between two metal nanostructure substrates using surface enhanced Raman scattering (SERS), which exhibits significantly higher SERS enhancement compared to just one substrate.

articleTitle: Sequential preparation, optical control, and detection of single quantum dot hole spin
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a Rabi rotation of the positive trion, which is conditional on the initial spin state.We use photocurrent detection to make picosecond time-resolved measurements of the single quantum dot spin.
