Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Optimum detection of quantum entangled fiber solitons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Two-partie and multi-partie time-multiplexed fiber solitons after nonlinear interaction are rigorously proved to be quantum entangled in the sense that their quadrature components of internal modes satisfy the EPR non-local criterion. The optimum homedyne local oscillator pulse-shape for entanglement detection is determined.

articleTitle: Polariton spectroscopy of three-level atoms inside an optical cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Distinct peaks associated with atom-cavity polaritons are observed in the transmission spectrum of three-level rubidium atoms in an optically-dense vapor cell inside an optical ring cavity.

articleTitle: Investigation of relations among matrix elements of second-order nonlinear susceptibility tensor of GaSe crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By investigating dependence of THz output power on pump polarization, ratios of elements for second-order nonlinear susceptibility tensor have been measured for GaSe, which significantly deviate from those dictated by Kleinman’s symmetry and structural symmetry.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a refractometric sensor based on optical microfiber coil resonator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a novel refractometric sensor based on a coated optical microfiber coil resonator which is robust, compact, and comprises an intrinsic fluidic channel. The measured sensitivity has an excellent agreement with theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Improving Squeezing purity from a KNbO3 crystal by temperature tuning
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show a method to increase the purity of a squeezed state generated by a femtosecond laser and down-conversion crystal. The method relies on temperature tuning the down- and up-converting crystals, which changes the spatial and spectral output mode of the down-converter to match the local oscillator.

articleTitle: Tunable laser operation of Yb:NaY(MoO4)2
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: CW laser operation of Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> in the disordered flux-grown NaY(MoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is demonstrated. The maximum slope efficiency with Ti:sapphire and diode laser pumping is 57.5% and 38.6%, respectively. The tunability extends from 1005 to 1059 nm.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Evolution of SBS gain spectra in high-power single-frequency ytterbium doped fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present theoretical modelling and experimental heterodyne measurements of spontaneous and stimulated Brillouin scattering gain spectra from a single-frequency ytterbium doped fiber amplifier system delivering 130 W of output power.

articleTitle: Distance dependant amplification of molecular fluorescence via photonic crystal slabs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Theoretical and experimental verification of near-field fluorescence amplification from PC slabs is performed. Key results indicate absence of quenching at small resonator-molecule separations and ability to tune the interaction volume to accommodate various fluorescent assays.

articleTitle: Piezoelectricity induced terahertz photon absorption by confined acoustic phonons in wurtzite CdSe nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observed the first piezoelectricity induced terahertz (THz) photon absorption related to the confined acoustic phonons in nanoparticles. It provides a new mechanism for THz photon-phonon conversion in low dimensional systems.

articleTitle: Design of a tunable time-delay element with high data fidelity using dispersion management
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a design method for a tunable time-delay element based on the eye-diagram metrics of a system. Two approaches using dispersion management are given, and both show improved fractional delay with high data fidelity.

articleTitle: Coupling of Self-Assembled InAs Quantum Dots to Surface Plasmon Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: InAs quantum dots have been placed at different distances to a silver mirror. We extract the coupling of quantum dots to surface plasmon polaritons as a function of the distance by time-resolved spontaneous emission measurements.

articleTitle: Number-resolving, single photon detection with no deadtime
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a new scheme of a photon-resolving measurement with a superconducting microbolometer. Based on known “instrumental function” of the microbolometer, we convert its analog output into a digitized record of photon detections without deadtime.

articleTitle: Optical-layer multicast in wavelength-routing network
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An optical-layer multicast was studied and implemented efficiently, safely, block-free, and with transparency to data rate and format in a wavelength-routing self-healing network employing chirped fiber gratings and optical circulators.

articleTitle: Loss-reduced rectangular ring laser based on active vertical coupler through asymmetric double shallow ridge and ICP/ICP cascade etching
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Rectangular ring lasers based on an active vertical coupler structure are fabricated through asymmetric double shallow ridge and ICP/ICP cascade etching. 25% reduction of I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub> and the single mode operation with SMSR 23dB are achieved.

articleTitle: Longitudinal mode selection in a fiber-coupled microlensed microchip VECSEL
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate spectral control of a 1.055 mum fiber-coupled microlensed microchip VECSEL by using a coupled-cavity effect. The coupled-cavity created between the fiber and the microchip output coupler facilitates single-mode operation with fiber-coupled power above 18 mW.

articleTitle: Fundamental mechanisms and advances in crystalline up-conversion lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Excitation mechanisms and requirements on materials, and pump sources for crystalline up-conversion lasers will be discussed. Using suitable pump- and resonator arrangements significant improvement of existing results concerning room temperature up-conversion lasers could be achieved.

articleTitle: Observation of slow light in coupled-resonator-induced transparency
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observed slow light in a coupled-resonator induced transparency in a tandem microsphere-fiber-taper system. Nearly Gaussian-shaped pulses propagated with a large positive delay of 6.2 ns and 78% transmission through a transparent frequency window.

articleTitle: Quasi super continuum generation using programmably controlled wavelength tunable soliton pulses for optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Quasi super continuum generation for ultrahigh resolution optical coherence tomography is demonstrated using ultrahigh speed wavelength tuning of femtosecond soliton pulse. In this light source, center wavelength, bandwidth, and spectrum shape can be changed arbitrarily.

articleTitle: Revealing subsurface defects in semiconductors using near-field fluorescence lifetime imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Simultaneous near-field fluorescence lifetime imaging and atomic force microscopy identify radiative, interface and subsurface defect recombination sites in GaAs/GaInP heterostructures. Such unique characterization plays a significant role in identifying candidate samples for laser cooling.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive amplification of optical signal by an SOA in a nonlinear Sagnac interferometer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Phase-sensitive amplification of picosecond optical pulses was demonstrated using an SOA as the nonlinear medium inside a Sagnac interferometer with a weak control signal. Numerical simulations using a semiconductor amplifier model are consistent with experiments.

articleTitle: A strobed liquid spatial light modulator for ultraintense laser pulses - application to filamentation control
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have implemented and tested a reflective spatial light modulator capable of patterning the far field intensity distribution of an intense pulsed laser beam, leading to spatially regularized multiple filamentation in air.

articleTitle: Single-photon detection at the nanoscale with superconducting nanowires
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We evidence the nanoscale nature of photodetection in superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors by a spatially-resolved efficiency measurement. A novel nanoscale detector, with 100times100 nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> active area, is also demonstrated using an artificial constriction.

articleTitle: Single-polarization large-mode-area Yb-doped photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on an ytterbium-doped, single-polarization, single-mode large-mode-area rod-type photonic crystal fiber. The active core possesses a diameter of 70 mum and a single-polarization window ranging from 1030 to 1090 nm. In a laser experiment without any intracavity polarization control up to 163 W of output power are obtained, with a degree of polarization better than 85% and a M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-value of 1.2.

articleTitle: An accurate positioning system based on optical zooming method
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A positioning system based on optical zooming interferometer was developed using stabilized diode lasers by fs-comb. It achieved 1.3 nm accuracy and 30 pm stability by simplify the system and treatment of optical source’s polarization.

articleTitle: Miniaturized two-photon fluorescence and second harmonic generation microscope with a 24Hz frame-rate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: With miniaturized tube lenses and two-dimensional asynchronous scanning of the micro-electro-mechanical-system mirror, we demonstrated a 24Hz frame-rate miniaturized two-photon fluorescence/second-harmonic-generation microscope system. Sub-micron transverse resolution of sectioning images can be achieved.

articleTitle: Temperature sensitivity of ytterbium fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated a method of characterizing temperature sensitivity of ytterbium-doped fiber amplifiers based on deriving Stark parameters from measured emission and absorption spectra. Temperature sensitivity is found to be mainly determined by P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">out</inf>/P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pump</inf>, when P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">out</inf>/P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pump</inf>≫0.4.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s optical clock recovery based on an optical parametric oscillator with photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a 40 Gb/s optical clock recovery based on optical parametric oscillator using a highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber as the dynamic gain medium.

articleTitle: Time-resolved characterization of single photons by upconversion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a new technique of efficient, time-resolved, infrared single-photon detection using non collinearly phase-matched frequency upconversion by an ultrafast pump, allowing nearly background-free sub-picosecond characterization of 1582-nm time anti-correlated entangled photons.

articleTitle: Ultrafast self-pulsation in a silicon microdisk
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a novel scheme for the self-generation of ultrashot pulses inside a silicon microdisk. We report the generation of pulses as short as 96 ps, close to the cavity photon lifetime.

articleTitle: Ionization gating for tunable isolated attosecond pulse generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ionization gating confines high-harmonic generation to the leading edge of the driver pulse. Experimentally produced soft-X-ray continuous radiation is spectrally broad and tunable. The method suggests isolated attosecond-pulse production with long driver pulses.

articleTitle: Coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) microscopy for three-dimensional flow characterization in microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The composition of fluids mixing inside of microchannels, as measured by CARS microscopy, is related to the flow field for the purpose of resolving non-symmetric velocity profiles.

articleTitle: A windowed-stripe quantum-dot laser structure for self-pulsation generation and lasing dynamic study under femtosecond optical pulse excitation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated a new device structure with a central window on the quantum-dot laser stripe to generate the self-pulsation phenomenon. Furthermore, we apply the same device to study laser dynamics under femtosecond optical pulse excitation.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductor

articleTitle: Measurement of a flat lens focusing in a 2D photonic crystal at optical wavelength
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using scanning near field optical microscopy (SNOM), we observed the focusing effect provided by negative refraction in a 2D photonic crystal. Experimental observations are analyzed in light of FDTD 3D simulations.

articleTitle: Observation of accelerating Airy beam ballistics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that Airy beams can perform ballistic dynamics in a way totally analogous to that of projectiles moving under the action of gravity. The possibility of circumventing opaque obstacles is discussed.

articleTitle: First laser-based determination of deuterated water vapor in human breath
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Following the ingestion of only 5 mL D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O, an infrared laser spectrometer determines the D/H isotope ratio increase in exhaled water vapor for the first time. No preliminary breath sample preparation is required.

articleTitle: Bi2O3-based fiber for highly nonlinear applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have fabricated Bi2O3-based microstructured fiber using a novel method. It was experimentally revealed that this fiber shows nonlinearlity ∼780 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and GVD ∼ −25 ps/nm/km simultaneously.

articleTitle: Controlled-rotation quantum logic gate in a single self-assembled quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate conditional exciton-biexciton Rabi rotations in a single self-assembled InGaAs quantum dot using picosecond optical excitation and photocurrent readout, thereby implementing a two-qubit controlled-rotation (C-rot) quantum logic gate.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Threshold current reduction and electrical modulation of degree of circular polarization in InAs/GaAs quantum dot spin-VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Threshold current reduction and polarization modulation of an electrically injected spin-polarized VCSEL operating at 200 K have been investigated experimentally and theoretically.

articleTitle: Direct observation of higher-order whispering-gallery modes in a defect-free surface micro-structure VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a direct method to observe higher-order whispering-gallery modes in vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs) at room temperature by embedding a defect-free a surface micro-structure. Up to the 23rd azimuthal order whispering-gallery mode confined laterally by the native oxide layers is observed in experiments and identified by the spectrum in experiments as well as numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Ultrafast dynamics of individual air-suspended single-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The photoluminescence lifetime of individual, air-suspended carbon nanotubes was measured to be 57 plusmn 7 ps using femtosecond excitation correlation spectroscopy. With an excitation spot size larger than the nanotube, photoluminescence approaches a definite saturation limit.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Tuning coherent radiative thermal conductance in multilayer photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Photonic crystals can be used to drastically influence coherent radiative thermal conductance. In a multilayer crystal, radiative thermal conductance can transit from above to below vacuum value when temperature increases, due to photonic band effects.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of the electron density driving the laser particle acceleration with thin foils
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A method for time resolved optical probing of laser ion acceleration using interferometry is presented. The electron density in the accelerating fields were reconstructed in a time series with 100 fs resolution.

articleTitle: Matrix-free plane wave modal expansion approach for robust design of photonic structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Fourier operator is used in the vectorial Helmholtzpsilas equation for the calculation of layer modes in a 2D slice of a photonic device. The slice modes are then propagated throughout the device via scattering matrices.

articleTitle: Experimental implementation of entanglement concentration using Schmidt projection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We implement entanglement concentration by the Schmidt projection protocol, known for its optimal efficiency for large number of qubits, using photon pairs entangled in polarization and momentum and employing single-photon two-qubit quantum logic.

articleTitle: On the “quantum nature of a strongly coupled single quantum dot-cavity system”
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Recent measurements on the unique quantum nature of a single-quantum-dot strongly coupled to a photonic-crystal nanocavity highlight two apparent mysteries. Here we introduce and exploit a quantized medium-dependent theory to help explain these mysteries.

articleTitle: Polarization state dynamics in femtosecond filaments
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study polarization state dynamics, white-light generation and self-compression in femtosecond filaments for linear, circular and elliptically polarized input light. For elliptically polarized input laser light strong nonlinear elliptic polarization rotation is observed during filamentation.

articleTitle: Tunable mode-locked semiconductor fiber laser using a nonlinear optical loop mirror
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Tunable and multi-wavelength mode-locked operation of a fiber laser is demonstrated. A loop mirror with highly nonlinear fiber is used as an all-optical modulator; tuning is achieved through dispersive gratings and a tunable optical delay.

articleTitle: Tunable semiconductor hybrid mode-locked laser using a tapered amplifier as gain medium
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A semiconductor laser, using only a tapered amplifier as gain medium, is mode-locked with a multiple quantum well saturable absorber and RF modulation, generating 0.5 ps pulses without dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: On the practicality of quantum interferometry using photonic N00N states
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that attenuated N00N states lead to a worse phase estimate than an equally attenuated N separable state unless the transmittance of the medium is very high.

articleTitle: Interaction and cooling of the indirect excitons in elevated traps
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present studies of 2D indirect excitons in an in-plane trap created by a laterally modulated gate voltage. Our data indicates an effective evaporative cooling of excitons in the elevated trap regime. We also observed narrow PL lines which correspond to the emission of localized and delocalized states of the indirect excitons in the trap. The homogeneous line broadening due to interaction increases with density and dominates the linewidth of the indirect exciton emission at high densities.

articleTitle: Uncompensated 10.7 Gb/s transmission over a 470 km hybrid fiber link with in-line SOAs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate uncompensated WDM transmission over a 470 km hybrid fiber link using two versions of duobinary and in-line SOA amplification. MLSE receiver technology partially mitigates the accumulated dispersion of approximately 3300 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Ultra-narrow dual-channel filter based on sampled fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have proposed a new kind of ultra-narrow dual-bandpass fiber Bragg gratings. Based on the proposed grating, an ultra-narrow dual-channel filter is designed. Our filter has the same bandwidth and the even strength, as well as the ultra-narrow bandwidth as small as ≪1 pm.

articleTitle: Electrically injected cavity polaritons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have realised an electroluminescent device in which electron are injected into intersubband polariton branches. We reproduce electroluminescence spectra by using a phenomenological model, in which a voltage dependent injection is taken into account.

articleTitle: A coherent tunable source of high-power nanosecond pulses at ∼840 nm, near the Fourier limit of optical bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A chirp-controlled nanosecond-pulsed tunable optical parametric oscillator and two-stage Ti:sapphire amplifier generate high-power coherent light at ∼840 nm, with frequency stability and narrow optical bandwidth as needed for high-resolution ultraviolet spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal single-mode DFB laser array with precise frequency spacing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed integrated DFB laser arrays using photonic crystal waveguide on membrane. They exhibit stable and controlled single-mode emissions with wavelength spacings as small as 0.3 nm.

articleTitle: Semiconductor disk laser pumped Cr2+:chalcogenide lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The optically-pumped semiconductor disk laser is shown to be a practical low-noise pump source for Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:chalcogenide lasers. Results on cw-pumping of a Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnSe and quasi-cw-pumping of a Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:CdZnTe laser are presented.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Control of decoherence of many-body excitations in a Bose-Einstein Condensate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We measure the effects of reservoir engineering on the decay of a coherent, many-body excitation in a BEC loaded into an optical lattice. We show both enhancement and suppression of decoherence vs. lattice depth.

articleTitle: Surface plasmons in periodically coupled gold nanoparticles: A semi-analytical model
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The surface plasmon coupling between gold nanoparticles in a periodic array is theoretically modeled. The calculated dispersion relation and loss properties of an array of chains at air/glass interface agree well with FDTD simulation results.

articleTitle: Spatially-resolved self-heterodyne spectroscopy of lateral modes of broad-area laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The fine structure of broad-area laser diode optical spectrum is investigated with ~30 MHz resolution using spatially-resolved self-heterodyning. Demonstrated method is capable of measuring the individual lateral mode intensity and spacing.

articleTitle: Polymer-based Microstructured Fiber towards Imaging Application
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: PMMA-based MOF with 547 air holes was fabricated by extruding and stretching of an big-size preform with hole diameter of 1.5 mm and hole spacing of 1.9 mm. The high image resolution was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Electrically pumped GaSb-based VCSEL with buried tunnel junction
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the concept and first results of a continuous wave room temperature operating electrically pumped GaSb-based VCSEL with buried tunnel junction as current aperture. Laser emission has been achieved at 2.3 mum.

articleTitle: 17 Watts continuous wave Rubidium laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A laser diode array pumped continuous wave Rubidium laser with slope efficiency of 53%, total optical efficiency of 46% and output power of 17 Watts has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Characterization of plasmonic bragg reflectors with implementation in isolation applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Integrated plasmonic devices may be isolated using plasmonic Bragg reflectors (PBRs). Systematic experimental characterization shows optimal reflection for three PBR layers, 45 nm deep. Isolation between series of nanohole array structures using PBRs is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Rapid beam shaping using tunable acoustic gradient index of refraction lenses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A MHz-rate device employing acoustic waves within a fluid is used to modulate an incident laser beam and form patterns including focal spots, Bessel beams, and doughnut beams. Theory, experiment, and applications are presented.

articleTitle: Mode-locked laser operation of a diffusion-bonded Yb:KY(WO4)2/KY(WO4)2 Crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the shortest pulses (62 fs) ever produced with an Yb-doped monoclinic double tungstate laser by passive mode-locking of diffusion-bonded Yb:KY(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/KY(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> achieving an average power of 182 mW at 1029 nm.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: InGaAs quantum dot population and polarisation dynamics for ultrafast pulse train amplification
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The ultrafast population and polarisation dynamics in electrically pumped InGaAs QDs is studied experimentally and theoretically. Limits for ultrafast pulse train amplification with THz repetition rates at high, electrically-injected, non-equilibrium carrier densities are discussed.

Author Keywords: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Interband optical pulse injection locking of a quantum dot mode-locked semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that the slave laser oscillating on the ground state (GS) or excited state (ES) transitions can be locked through the injection of optical pulses generated via the opposite transition bands, i.e. the ES or GS transition, respectively.

articleTitle: Tunable laser operation of Tm:NaY(WO4)2
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: CW laser operation of Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> in Czochralski-grown disordered NaY(WO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> crystals is demonstrated. The tunability extends from 1847 to 2069 nm. The maximum slope efficiency and output power amount to ≈43% and ≈400 mW, respectively.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Modified optical cavity transmission by an intracavity dispersive medium
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By balancing the sharp linear and nonlinear dispersions of an intracavity electromagnetically induced transparency medium, the cavity transmission linewidth can be significantly modified and controlled. Cavity linewidth narrowing, broadening, and white-light cavity are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: From fast optical bistability to thermo-optical excitability in a two dimensional Photonic Crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show excitable optical pulses in an InP-based photonic crystal slab close to bistable operation. Possible applications of excitability such as the realisation of all-optical delay lines in coupled micro cavities will be discussed.

articleTitle: Wavelength transparent SBS slow light using XGM-wavelength converter and Brillouin fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a signal wavelength independent SBS slow light architecture using a XGM-wavelength converter and a Brillouin fiber laser. The signal is wavelength converted to become automatically aligned with the resonance induced by SBS.

articleTitle: Demonstration of traffic control and WDM routing in all-optical Data Vortex node
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical traffic control and self-routing of WDM optical packets in a cascaded two-node all-optical Data Vortex switching node. In the experiment, WDM optical packets are successfully routed while maintaining a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−10</sup> or better.

articleTitle: GaAs under intense photoexcitation: Ultrafast carrier and phonon dynamics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultrafast eletro-optic sampling is used to observe the response of n-doped GaAs with varying photoexcitation. Photocarrier density dependent coherent LO phonon-plasmon dynamics are observed. Time-resolved analysis reveals complex spectral evolution.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Strongly coupled surface plasmon-exciton excitations in small-diameter carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study theoretically the interactions of excitonic states with surface electromagnetic modes of a single-walled carbon nanotube. We show that these interactions result in the exciton-plasmon coupling that is significant in its strength due to the presence of weakly-dispersive low-energy (~0.5-2 eV) interband surface plasmon modes and large exciton excitation energies ~1 eV in small-diameter nanotubes. We estimate the exciton-plasmon Rabi splitting to be ~0.1 eV which is close to that in organic semiconductors and much larger than that in hybrid semiconductor-metal nanoparticle molecules. We calculate the exciton absorption lineshape and show the line splitting effect as the exciton is tuned to the nearest interband surface plasmon resonance of the nanotube.

articleTitle: Using electromagnetically induced transparency to assign the hyperfine transitions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Here, we propose a new method of identifying the unknown hyperfine transitions without a wavemeter, by the electromagnetically induced transparency. EIT is a phenomenon of quantum interference between two propagating electromagnetic radiations.

articleTitle: Active Q-switching in semiconductor ring lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the integration of semiconductor ring lasers with tunable directional couplers to modulate the Q-factor of the ring cavity. Active Q-switching is demonstrated with 120 ps pulses, up to frequencies of 1.8 GHz.

articleTitle: Return-to-zero technique for eliminating wavelength abnormalities in high-power DBR lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The characteristics of the longitudinal mode hops of 1060-nm high-power DBR lasers are studied. We demonstrate a return-to-zero technique for eliminating large mode hops and wavelength hysteresis caused by the photon-induced gain saturation effect.

articleTitle: Long-term CEP stabilization of a grating-based high-power femtosecond laser by the direct locking method
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: CEP of a high-power femtosecond laser was stabilized using the direct locking method. CEP stabilization was maintained for several hours with phase jitter of 180 mrad by adjusting the grating separation of a pulse compressor.

articleTitle: Micro-pulling down method grown Ce:LiCAF as ultraviolet laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the first successful micro-pulling down method growth and ultraviolet emission from a Ce:LiCAF crystal. With two-side pumping configuration, 23% slope efficiency is obtained from the 290-nm emission of a 30 mm-long, 2 mm-wide Brewster-cut crystal.

articleTitle: Prospects for “green” microstuctured optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A powder-filling technique was used to fabricate a variety of biodegradable microstructured polymer optical fibers using poly(epsiv-caprolactone) and cellulose derivatives. These fibers hold potential for light delivery and sensing.

articleTitle: The effect of metamaterials on Anderson localisation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study 1D stacks comprising alternating layers of normal and metamaterials, with disorder in both refractive index and layer thickness, and show strong suppression of localisation with only index disorder.

articleTitle: Flexible millimeter-wave comb synthesis using a novel time-multiplexed optical pulse shaping scheme
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Millimeter-wave combs are synthesized using a novel time-multiplexed optical pulse shaping scheme by integrating fast wavelength switching, optical frequency comb generation, and spectral line-by-line pulse shaping.

articleTitle: Filament induced electric events in thunderstorms
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Following positive laboratory-scale experiments, we investigated the ability to trigger real-scale lightning using ionized filaments generated by ultrashort laser pulses in the atmosphere. Under thunderstorm conditions, we observed electric events synchronized with the laser pulses.

articleTitle: Characterization of higher-order-mode content in large mode-area fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Higher-order modes propagating in large-mode-area fibers are characterized using spatially-resolved modal interference. The measurements provide the fraction of power contained in multiple higher-order-modes, and allow for mode identification without prior knowledge of the fiber characteristics.

articleTitle: Quantum optical adaptive phase estimation of sidebands
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present experimental results of the use of continuous adaptive feedback in quantum optical measurement of phase of the sidebands on continuous-wave (cw) coherent light, consistent with theoretical predictions (Berry and Wiseman, 2002).

articleTitle: 3-dimensional measurement using electronically controlled wavelength-tunable ultrashort pulse fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: High-speed 3-dimensional measurement system is demonstrated using electronically controlled wavelength-tunable ultrashort pulse fiber laser and fiber interferometer. Clear images of metallic samples are obtained from a few meter long distance at speed of 1,000 points/s.

articleTitle: Filamentation in turbulent air
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present experimental and theoretical results on the robustness, beam pointing accuracy and survival probability of femtosecond filaments in turbulent air.

articleTitle: Nanophotodetector array for nano-imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel near-field nano-imager based on nanophotodetector(NPD) array is presented. Simulation shows λ/10 resolution could be obtained by NPD array. The initially realized NPD devices at 1.5μm wavelength have the smallest pixel size of 50nm.

articleTitle: Remote and in-situ calibration of linear scale by low-coherence tandem interferometer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Technique of transferring length-information between two distantly-located low-coherence-interferometers through a single-mode-optical-fiber for remote and in-situ calibration of linear scale is developed. Results of 200 nm-deviation and 100 nm-standard deviation for 50 mm-length is preliminary achieved.

articleTitle: Degradation of organic light-emitting diodes: Dependence on deposition rate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The dependence of device degradation of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) on film deposition rate is presented. The OLEDs made by lower deposition rates exhibit short device lifetime, which is attributed to the formed ordered aggregates.

articleTitle: DPSK wavelength multicasting using FWM with three unequally-spaced pumps in a bismuth-oxide highly-nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a compact 1-to-5 DPSK wavelength multicasting scheme using FWM with three unequally-spaced pumps in a 2-m-long Bi-HNLF. Power penalties are within 1.9-dB for all the converted signals.

articleTitle: Silicon self-suspended resonant grating filters at telecommunication wavelength
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A silicon self-suspended grating was fabricated using nanolithography technology. Experimental results showed that it served as an optical filter through guide mode resonance, which agreed with theoretical simulations by rigorous coupled wave method.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of dark-bright exciton splitting in individual single-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have performed low-temperature micro-photoluminescence studies on individual single-walled carbon nanotubes in magnetic fields up to 5 T and directly measured the dark-bright exciton splitting magnitude through the observation of magnetic brightening.

articleTitle: Operation features of regenerative amplifiers at high repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Peculiar dynamics of high repetition rate regenerative amplifiers limits the system power efficiency. A basic model of regenerative amplifiers dynamics and experimental verification of operation efficiency are presented.

articleTitle: Long period fiber gratings made in active fibers: Rigorous analysis and its experimental verification
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The presented novel and rigorous analysis, which includes grating-assisted diffraction of amplified spontaneous emission generated along the entire grating structure, predicts accurately performance of the studied devices in terms of both the amplitude and phase.

articleTitle: Optically injection-locked VCSEL for bi-directional optical communication
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate for the first time a communication system scheme with an OIL-VCSEL acting both as a transmitter and as a receiver, under an identical forward-bias condition.

articleTitle: Microscale flexible image projection device for spatiotemporal excitation in the research of visual system development
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed a microscale flexible image projection device, integrating a matrix addressable blue/green two-dimensional LED array to a multicore imaging fiber. Spatiotemporal patterns of illumination have been used to study amphibian visual system development.

articleTitle: Swept-wavelength optical resonance-Raman device (SWOrRD) for detection of chemicals and microorganisms
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Detection of microorganisms and chemicals using multi-wavelength resonance-Raman spectroscopy is described. Combined with a proper algorithm, this technique may lead to contactless sensor, capable of real-time detection of biological and chemical threats in complex environments.

articleTitle: Generation of 260-μW Fourier-transform-limited nanosecond THz pulses by frequency-mixing two CO2 lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Coherent THz pulses at 328.2 μm were generated by mixing two CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser frequencies based on collinear phase-matched difference-frequency generation in GaSe crystals. The highest average output power was measured to be 260 μW.

articleTitle: Observation of plasmonic field-enhancement of the nonlinear response of gold thin films
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the nonlinear optical response of gold thin films of different thicknesses. Field enhancement effects lead to counterintuitive results which we interpret in terms of the excitation of plasmonic resonances at the metal-dielectric interfaces.

articleTitle: Extreme ultraviolet holography with wavelength resolution
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Holographic images of carbon nanotubes 50-80 nm in diameter were obtained with a spatial resolution matching the wavelength of the compact capillary discharge extreme ultraviolet (EUV) laser used for illumination, 46.9 nm.

articleTitle: Realization of an ultra-flat silica surface with angstrom-scale average roughness using nanophotonic polishing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report that nanophotonic polishing of a silica substrate using a nonadiabatic photochemical reaction drastically reduced the average surface roughness, R a, and the dispersion of R a.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband wavelength-tunable actively and harmonically mode-locked fiber ring laser using a bismuth-oxide-based erbium-doped fiber and a bismuth-oxide-based highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate an actively and harmonically mode-locked laser employing a 151-cm-long bismuth-oxide-based erbium-doped fiber and a 250-cm-long bismuth-oxide-based highly nonlinear fiber. Stable 10-GHz short pulses are obtained with a 60-nm tuning range covering the CL-band.

articleTitle: Intense field ionization of methane, ethane, butane, and octane: Transition from molecular to atomic response
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ion yields of C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+n</sup> (n<6) from methane, ethane, butane and octane are measured from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, with photoelectron spectra up to 0.5 MeV. As one reaches 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> the molecular response becomes atomic-like.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked ytterbium fiber laser with integrated hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An ytterbium fiber oscillator is demonstrated comprising a hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber fusion spliced to single-mode fibers in the cavity generating pulses of 4.1 nJ energy and pulse width of 210 fs.

articleTitle: Energy transfer and gain analysis for Tb3+-Yb3+ co-doped silicate glasses under the 0.98 μm excitation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The energy transfer coefficients for Tb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-codoped silicate glasses was obtained by a rate equation model. The proposed model can be used to understand the amplification properties in the 0.54 μm band under the 0.98 μm pumping.

articleTitle: Self-aligning “smart” microcavities and picometer-scale optomechanical control through optical forces and potentials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a new class of all-optical self-adaptive optomechanical circuits, enabling the manipulation of cavity resonances through resonantly tailored optomechanical potentials, leading to control of cantilevers with picometer precision and self-aligning microcavities.

articleTitle: Laser dynamics of asynchronously modelocked fiber soliton lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Laser dynamics of asynchronously modelocked Er-fiber soliton lasers is investigated theoretically and experimentally. The pulse parameters are found to exhibit complicated slow periodic variations and can be examined experimentally by analyzing the RF spectra.

articleTitle: The effect of injection barrier thickness and doping level on a λ ∼ 8 μm quantum cascade structure
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: For a high-performance quantum cascade laser structure, a 50% reduction in doping level and 33% reduction in injection barrier thickness yields 5 times stronger luminescence, 20% smaller optical transition width, and improved current-voltage characteristics.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable microfluidic photonic crystal cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate reconfigurable microfluidic photonic crystal double-heterostructure cavities by local fluid infiltration of select air holes. Properties of the microfluidic cavities are experimentally studied by evanescent coupling and analyzed by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Multimillijoule optically synchronized and CEP-stabilized chirped parametric amplification at 1.5 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Efficient infrared 35-THz-wide parametric amplification with energies above 3 mJ is obtained in a 3-stage OPCPA using a combination of a 1030-nm 200-fs Yb- and a 1064-nm 60-ps Nd amplifier seeded with a common Yb oscillator.

articleTitle: A practical protocol for quantum networking with semiconductor quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A protocol is presented for generating entanglement between spatially separated quantum dots with different emission wavelengths and radiative lifetimes. This protocol can be practically implemented in semiconductor systems where emitters suffer from large inhomogeneous broadening.

articleTitle: Very small (≤ 1.2 – 1.7 W) heat dissipation, room temperature, continuous-wave quantum cascade lasers at λ ∼ 5.3 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using a 0.5 mm short cavity and high reflectivity coating on both laser facets, room temperature, continuous-wave Quantum Cascade lasers at λ ∼ 5.3 μm are realized with heat dissipation of less than 1.2–1.7 W.

articleTitle: UV written evanescent devices fabricated in micro-structured substrates for optofluidics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report our recent developments in micro-structured evanescent devices. Micro-machining prior to direct UV writing of channel waveguides provides additional flexibility to fabricate evanescent interacting devices such as modulators and sensors, which allow adiabatic operation.

articleTitle: Manipulation of single-photon states encoded in orbital angular momentum
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We analyze possibilities to create/manipulate photon states encoded in spatial degrees of freedom. We show stringent limits for symplectic transforms acting on paraxial modes, and how to overcome these with novel classes of non-Gaussian operations.

articleTitle: The lasing action of GaN-based two-dimensional surface-emitting photonic crystal lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report fabrication of GaN-based two-dimensional surface emitting photonic-crystal lasers and successful demonstration of lasing action at room temperature with the emission wavelength at 424.3 nm and a low threshold pumping energy density of 3.5 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Hot and cold phonons induced by electric field and resonant Raman scattering in GaN/AlN triangular quantum well
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have evidenced hot and cold longitudinal-optical (LO) phonons induced by electric field and resonant Raman scattering in GaN/AlN triangular quantum well, probed by first-order and second-order resonant Raman scattering of 3-ps light pulses.

articleTitle: Realization of a tiled-grating compressor for the OMEGA EP Petawatt Laser System
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Eight tiled-grating assemblies (TGApsilas) have been developed for the OMEGA EP Petawatt laser system. The methods and results for tiling individual TGApsilas and for optimizing the overall tiling performance of the compressors will be described.

articleTitle: Fourier pulse shaping with enhanced spectral control using a 2-D VIPA grating pulse shaper
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate Fourier pulse shaping over a wide bandwidth with high spectral resolution allowing a large number of controllable features utilizing a grating and a VIPA in a 2 dimensional configuration as the spectral disperser.

articleTitle: Coherent control of two-photon excited fluorescence with ultrabroadband optical pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present that adaptive control can be applied to achieve the highest contrast ratio at the desired fluorescence intensity from a target fluorophore in the selective excitation with ultrabroadband optical pulses.

articleTitle: Gain and phase dynamics of InAs/GaAs quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The gain/phase transients of InAs/GaAs quantum-dot semiconductor-optical-amplifiers are analysed using a 2-colour heterodyne pump-probe arrangement. Key processes highlighted include hole dynamics for the gain, and wetting-layer electron dynamics for the phase.

articleTitle: All-optical injection, control, and detection of ballistic charge transport in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ballistic pure charge currents are injected into GaAs quantum wells using quantum interference techniques and are spatially and temporally resolved for the first time. The dynamics are dominated by momentum relaxation and space charge effects.

articleTitle: Fabrication and investigation of photonic crystal device with MEMS activated defects insertion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A GaAs/AlGaAs-based photonic-crystal device with MEMS activated insertion/removal of defect posts into/from sub-micron photonic-crystal holes has been fabricated and investigated. This allows the device to actively create/remove point resonators or waveguides in the photonic-crystal membrane.

articleTitle: Core-surround shaping of hollow core photonic crystal fiber via fiber etching
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a technique to pattern the shape of the core surround of hollow-core PCF. Different shapes were fabricated and a relationship between surface mode positions and core surround thickness is experimentally observed.

articleTitle: CW lasing of current injection blue GaN-based vertical cavity surface emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated CW laser operation of GaN-based VCSELs under current injection at 77K. CW laser action was achieved at a threshold current of 1.4mA, emitting at 462nm with a narrow linewidth of about 0.15nm.

articleTitle: OFI rare-gas excimer amplifier for intense sub-picosecond VUV pulse generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the Ar<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> amplification with a gain-length product of 6 pumped by a high-intensity laser and the generation of subpicosecond seed pulses at 126 nm using harmonic radiation of an infrared Ti:Sapphire laser.

articleTitle: Propelling micro beads with femtosecond light bullets
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A femtosecond ldquolight bulletrdquo can propel a micro glass bead through laser ablation process. Theoretical analysis confirms the experimental observations and gives satisfactory explanations to the observed propulsion phenomenon.

articleTitle: Two distinct types of resonances in optical bowtie slot nanoantennas
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the resonance properties of optical bowtie slot antennas in experiment and numerical simulations. The dependence of the plasmonic and Fabry-Perot-like resonances on the antenna geometry and metal properties is investigated.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation in single-crystal thin membranes of LiNbO3 fabricated by patterned He+ ion implantation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate room-temperature phase matching of second-harmonic generation by waveguide dispersion (WGD) in 3-mum-thick LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> membranes. The membranes were made using patterned deep-ion-implantation-guided etching.

articleTitle: Decoherence in single and two-particle correlations in optically excited semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Decoherence between exciton states is compared with their decoherence with the ground state of a semiconductor in the presence of an electron-hole plasma. Non-equilibrium Green functions are used for deriving dynamical equations.

Author Keywords: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Tunable high repetition-rate mid-infrared optical combs from a compact amplified Er-doped fiber oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Tunable optical combs spanning the 6.5-8.5 mum range are obtained as a result of a difference-frequency-generation process between pulse-trains emitted by an amplified 100 MHz Er-fiber oscillator with unprecedented average power of tens of microwatts.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal optical limiting filter
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An optically tunable narrowband reflectance filter is fabricated on a plastic substrate over large surface areas using nanoreplica molding. The reflection peak wavelength was tuned −25 nm using an optically active azobenzene liquid crystal film.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked Yb-doped large-mode-area microstruture fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on passively mode-locked all-normal dispersion fiber lasers based on ytterbium-doped microstructure fibers and using semiconductor saturable absorbers. Average powers as high as 3.3 W and pulse durations shorter than 500 fs are generated.

articleTitle: Picosecond pulse amplification in semiconductor optical amplifiers: A multiple-scale analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a systematic way for analyzing gain-recovery dynamics in semiconductor optical amplifiers using a multiple-scale analysis and show that the resulting analytical solution for the amplified pulse agrees well with numerical solutions.

articleTitle: Generation of 1.5-μm band polarization entanglement using silicon wire waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first experimental generation of 1.5-μm band polarization entanglement based on spontaneous four-wave mixing in a silicon wire waveguide. Two-photon interference fringes with ≫83% visibilities were successfully obtained.

articleTitle: Optical properties of PT synthetic structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate for the first time optical beam dynamics in parity-time (PT) synthetic structures. We show that PT symmetric systems can exhibit a host of intriguing characteristics such as non-reciprocal Bloch modes and power oscillations.

articleTitle: Advances in microwave photonic devices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Devices for rf/light signal conversions are very essential to build various microwave photonics systems. Among variety of photonic devices for MWP systems, the present talk will be focused especially on devices based on electrooptic modulation.

articleTitle: Probing the 4I13/2 level lifetime of Er-ions embedded in ultrafast laser inscribed waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultrafast laser inscription has been used to inscribe an optical waveguide in ErYb-doped glass. We demonstrate that the irradiation does not degrade the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13/2</sub> lifetime of Er-ions embedded in the modified material.

articleTitle: All-fiber coherent combining of Er-doped fiber amplifiers by active resonantly-induced refractive index control in Yb-doped fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on all-fiber coherent combining of 1.55 mum Er-doped single mode amplifiers achieved by means of active phase control that specifically employs the refractive index changes in Yb-doped fiber induced by 980 nm laser diode.

articleTitle: Near-field optical spectroscopy of Ga nanoparticles for plasmonics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Near-field optical spectroscopy of nanoscale Ga droplets on GaAs exhibits quenching of photoluminescence emission due to coupling with surface plasmon. Ga droplets exhibit antenna like behavior associated with a red-shift in the near-field photoluminescence emission.

articleTitle: Cost efficient narrow linewidth laser transmitter for coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Authors present a cost efficient narrow linewidth laser transmitter for future coherent detection systems. The spectral purity of the laser allows the phase modulation of data signals at bit rates as low as 155 Mb/s.

articleTitle: Feedback-controlled interferometric ultrashort pulse reconstruction method
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a three-fold phase accuracy improvement in optical pulse reconstruction based on Hilbert transform temporal interferometry using a feedback-control for minimizing the phase errors associated with instabilities in the fiber-based interferometer.

articleTitle: Harmonics generation from rod-type Yb doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We presents a compact diode pumped, Q-switched Yb doped rod-type fiber laser producing near diffraction limited frequency doubled and tripled beams with a conversion efficiency of respectively 62% and 38%.

articleTitle: Mode discrimination in injection locked high-power single-frequency lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present an injection locked single-frequency laser with an asymmetric resonator for transversal mode control. To characterize the laser at the operation point the TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> mode content was measured in respect to the pump power.

articleTitle: Size effects and light extraction efficiency optimization of III-Nitride light emitting diodes with SiO2 / polystyrene microlens arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optimization studies of InGaN quantum wells light emitting diodes employing SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> / polystyrene microlens arrays are conducted. The use of microlens arrays leads to increase in light extraction efficiency by 2.7-times, in agreement with simulation.

articleTitle: Experimental verification of zero-n¯ bandgap in photonic crystal superlattices at the near-infrared
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Zero-nmacr bandgap has been observed in photonic superlattices consisting of layered stack of materials with positive index of refraction and photonic crystal slab. An experimental verification of FDTD simulations is reported here.

articleTitle: Temperature dependences of the dielectric constants of lower alcohols revealed by terahertz time-domain attenuated total reflection spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have revealed the picosecond dynamics of lower alcohols by employing terahertz time-domain attenuated total reflection spectroscopy and have found that there exists no temperature-dependent relaxation in terahertz frequency region.

articleTitle: Semi-automatic, octave-spanning optical frequency counter
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We used a monochrometer to determine the mode number difference between two laser combs and derived the comb number without using a wavemeter or scanning the repetition rate for the semi-autometic, octave-spanning optical frequency counter.

articleTitle: Optical confinement by filamentation-induced molecular alignment
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An experimental analysis on the spatiotemporal effects generated in the wake of a filament propagating in Nitrogen is presented. At suitable timedelays, a weak probe light pulse experiences a strong spatial confinement and a noticeable spectral broadening at the same time.

articleTitle: Microwave signal regeneration from mode-locked lasers with 1.9×10−19 Stability
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A 10.225-GHz microwave signal is regenerated from a 200.5-MHz repetition rate mode-locked fiber laser with 6.8 fs rms relative timing jitter in 1-MHz bandwidth integrated over 10 hours. This corresponds to a stability of 1.9×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−19</sup>.

articleTitle: Terahertz reflection properties of periodic subwavelength metallic rectangles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Resonant terahertz reflection of periodic metallic rectangles is investigated. The reflection resonance, primarily attributed to dipolar localized surface plasmons, is influenced by a number of factors and is well fit by the Fano model.

articleTitle: High-power, diode-pumped modelocked Cr3+:LiCAF laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe a diode-pumped Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:LiCAF laser which produces 590 mW of continuous-wave output power using two pump diodes. Passive mode locking with a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror produces 97-fs, 2.8-nJ pulses near 800 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of macroscopic quantum coherence in Gaussian states
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally proved the existence of macroscopic coherences in Gaussian quantum states using a recently proposed criterion [1]. We show interferences with remarkable distances in phase space for squeezed, entangled and even for coherent states.

articleTitle: Creating RZ data modulation formats using parallel silicon microring modulators for pulse carving in DPSK
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose ultra-small silicon microring-based pulse carvers operated at 10 Gb/s. RZ-DPSK transmitter is obtained in chip-size of only tens of mum<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and exhibits lower power-penalty than MZM-based one by 1.7 dB in data transmission.

articleTitle: Non-reciprocal femtosecond laser micromachining
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
