abstract: We demonstrate both experimentally and theoretically that in a non-centrosymmetric crystal modification of the material can be different when femtosecond laser beam propagates in opposite directions. Our result presents the first evidence of non-reciprocal photosensitivity.

articleTitle: High extraction efficiency GaN light-emitting diode with photonic crystal patterns and angled sidewall deflectors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We integrated into GaN LEDs both two-dimensional photonic crystal patterns and angled sidewall deflectors. The resultant devices exhibited about three-fold enhancement in vertical emission intensity when compared with the planar reference LED device.

articleTitle: All-optical signal regeneration using optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate cross-gain modulation in an optical parametric amplifier for all-optical signal regeneration. A degraded 10-Gb/s return-to-zero signal has been successfully regenerated with a 1.3-dB receiver sensitivity improvement at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> bit-error rate level.

articleTitle: Low timing-jitter high repetition-rate femtosecond pulse trains via locking to external Fabry-Perot cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Generation of low timing-jitter 150-fs pulse trains at 1560 nm with 2 GHz repetition rate is demonstrated by locking a fundamentally mode-locked 200 MHz fiber laser to a high finesse (F=2000) external Fabry-Perot cavity.

articleTitle: Diffractive optic near-field interference based fabrication of telecom band diamond-like 3-dimensional photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A single laser exposure method of fabricating three-dimensional polymer photonic crystal having large number of layers has been demonstrated using a novel multi-layer diffractive optical element. Strong photonic stopbands are reported in the telecom band.

articleTitle: 2D resonant grating optical filters for 850 nm wavelength, in normal and oblique incidence
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Performances of narrow-band 2D resonant grating filters working for normal or high oblique incidence at 850 nm are investigated. Maximum reflectivity of 54% with 0.4 nm FHWM, and quasi-polarization independence are achieved.

articleTitle: Influence of excitonic effects on two-color injection of ballistic electrical currents in a bulk semiconductor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Currents in CdSe are coherently controlled using phase-related omega/2omega femtosecond pulses at 80 K. For carrier excitation just above the exciton energy, CdSe reveals an additional delayed and phase-shifted source term via the THz emission.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: High-energy femtosecond optical parametric amplifier for soft x-ray harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A total output energy exceeding 8 mJ with 50 fs pulse duration has been achieved in the infrared region by power scaling of a parametric amplifier chain, making this source suited as a driver for soft x-ray harmonic pulses.

articleTitle: Intense XUV femtosecond pulses selected by a time-delay-compensated monochromator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Extreme-ultraviolet pulses, produced by high-order harmonic generation, have been spectrally selected by a time-delay-compensated monochromator. Temporal characterization has been obtained using cross-correlation method: pulses as short as 8 fs, with high photon flux, have been measured.

articleTitle: Laser precision engineering from microfabrication to nanoprocessing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Laser precision engineering has unique advantages of non-contact process, flexible setup and high speed processing in air. In the last decades, we have witnessed its extensive applications in various production lines. Combined with other advanced processing tools, laser nanofabrication will play a much more important role in the next generation manufacturing.

articleTitle: Robust fluorescent tomography using likelihood priors: Phantom experimental results
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A method is proposed for improving the robustness of fluorescent tomography by estimating the likelihood of non-zero concentration at any voxel. Phantom experimental results demonstrate robust reconstruction despite significant modeling mismatch due to optical heterogeneities.

articleTitle: Probing the dynamic of a Zeeman coherence grating stored in a cold atomic ensemble
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the observation of collapse and revival of a spatial light grating stored into the Zeeman coherences of cold cesium atoms. Bragg diffraction is employed to probe the dynamic of the stored grating.

articleTitle: The study of embedded reflection gratings for distributively-pumped ytterbium-doped fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Embedded reflection gratings for distributed pumping by laser diode bar in Yb-doped fiber lasers are studied. The best optimal coupling efficiencies of ≫92% and ≫82% are obtained in binary and blazed gratings, respectively. At 915-nm pumping, fabrication and alignment tolerances are analyzed.

articleTitle: Extreme ultraviolet interferometric lithography with a desk-top system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate an amplitude division interferometer that using illumination from a high brightness desk top extreme ultraviolet (EUV) laser creates large area arrays of lines, holes and dots with sub-100 nm feature size.

articleTitle: Vector-model simulation of all-normal-dispersion fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Fiber lasers operating in the normal dispersion regime with a filter are analyzed with simulations of coupled-field equations. This model predicts new operating modes previously unrecognized by scalar simulations.

articleTitle: THz interferometric imaging using subwavelength plastic fiber based THz endoscopes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a continuous-wave THz fiber-endoscopy by utilizing low-loss THz subwavelength plastic fibers. The reconstructed 3D images not only reflect the depth variation of the object surface, but also reveal the molecular distribution of samples.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of the carrier-envelope phase of amplified pulses with multi-kHz update rates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel all-electronic scheme for real-time measurement and stabilization of the carrier-envelope phase of kHz pulse trains is demonstrated, revealing new insight into the pulse-to-pulse phase fluctuations of such lasers.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of Carbon Nanotube— polymer saturable absorbers for mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A method to fabricate Carbon Nanotube-doped Polymer composites is proposed and the merits of adding dopants to the material are analyzed. Passive mode-locked lasing is demonstrated using a thin-film CNT-based saturable absorber.

articleTitle: Palmtop Terahertz-wave parametric generator with wide tunability
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have realized palmtop and tunable THz-wave parametric generator and observed output THz-wave with tuning range of 1-3 THz, with power of more than 100 mW (peak), linewidth of less than 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Dual-color superresolution imaging using genetically expressed probes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report dual-color superresolution imaging using endogenously expressed fluorescent proteins. An imaging resolution of 20-30 nm facilitates study of the ultrastructural relationship between proteins present in adhesion complexes at the surfaces of whole, fixed cells.

articleTitle: Generation of biphotons with controllable temporal length
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the generation of time-energy entangled paired photons with subnaturallinewidths and controllable temporal lengths. The photons are generated using EIT and slow light in a high optical depth two-dimensional MOT.

articleTitle: Optomechanical effects in a dispersively coupled high finesse cavity and micromechanical membrane
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By dispersively coupling a dielectric membrane to an optical cavity, we laser-cooled it from 294 K to 6.82 mK. Further, the cavity couples to the square of the membranepsilas displacement - a key for QND energy measurements.

articleTitle: Efficient excitation and emission of single quantum dot by simultaneous coupling to two different photonic crystal nanocavity modes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We utilized simultaneous coupling of higher and ground states of a single QD with two different resonant modes of a PhC nanocavity for efficient excitation and emission. Enhanced emission with strongly suppressed background was demonstrated.

articleTitle: FRET detection in the plasma membrane using Total Internal Reflection Fluorescence Lifetime Imaging Microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We developed a total internal reflection fluorescence lifetime imaging microscope to perform functional imaging of living cells membranes labeled with FRET couples. Forster resonance energy transfer efficiency can thus be followed with subwavelength axial resolution.

articleTitle: Mechanical dissipation in optical microresonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a detailed understanding of mechanical dissipation in toroidal microresonators enabling the design of novel structures that combine ultra-high optical Q(>10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>) and mechanical Q exceeding 50psila000 at frequencies above 20 MHz at room temperature.

articleTitle: Evolution of defect states in 2D photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the evolution of defect states from the band-edges of a 2D photonic crystal. A simple exponential relation is derived for the dispersion of the state, and we investigate the connection with Bloch modes.

articleTitle: Single-photon spin-orbit coupling and LOQC
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: When a photon propagates in an inhomogeneous medium, its spin and orbital degrees of freedom are coupled. We explore consequences of this effect for fiber-based cluster state linear optical quantum computing (LOQC).

articleTitle: Nonlinear long-period gratings in As2Se3 chalcogenide fiber for all-optical switching
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate all-optical switching using an acoustically generated long-period grating in highly nonlinear As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> chalcogenide fiber. The results, with numerical simulations, demonstrate switching at optical powers two orders of magnitude lower than in silica.

articleTitle: An investigation of differences in electron and hole confinement in InAs/InGaAsP quantum dash lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We calculate that strain and confinement effects lead to similar conduction and valence density of states in InGaAsP quantum dashes. Room temperature threshold remains dominated by non-radiative recombination, as in 1.5 mum quantum well lasers.

articleTitle: Imaging spin injection and spin transport in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using scanning Kerr-rotation microscopy, we directly image the injection and subsequent transport of spin-polarized electrons in semiconductors. We discuss optical spin injection as well as electrical spin injection in hybrid Fe/GaAs spin transport devices.

articleTitle: Raman amplification of continuous-wave laser emission in hydrogen-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A continuous-wave laser is amplified in a hollow-core photonic crystal fiber containing molecular hydrogen. The laser power was amplified 1.3-fold, and the effect of beam polarization for pump and probe lasers is investigated.

Author Keywords: 190.2620 Nonlinear optics, Frequency Conversion, 40.3550 Lasers, Raman

articleTitle: Three-core tellurite fiber with multiple rare earth emission
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have fabricated a three core tellurite glass fiber having a different rare earth system in each of its cores. Three distinct sets of emission characteristics are observed with a single pump wavelength.

articleTitle: Optomechanics of strongly-coupled stacked monolithic microdisks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a pair of strongly-coupled, stacked monolithic silicon nitride microdisk resonators coupled to a tapered optical fiber. High-frequency optomechanical interactions between the two microdisks are induced by both optical force and photothermal effects.

articleTitle: Room temperature, CW operation of 5.2 μm quantum cascade lasers with simple ridge structures, grown by MOVPE
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate room temperature, CW operation of a 5.2 μm quantum-cascade laser with single phonon resonance-continuum depopulation structure, grown by MOVPE. The laser exhibits a simple ridge structure without high reflection coatings.

articleTitle: Direct amplification of 12 fs pulses in a terawatt class CPA laser system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have demonstrated the direct amplification of 12-fs pulses in a terawatt-class CPA system of Ti:sapphire laser. Spectral narrowing during amplification is successfully compensated by regenerative pulse shaping featuring a specially designed partial mirror.

articleTitle: Towards polarization insensitive semiconductor optical amplifiers using InAs/GaAs columnar quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report columnar quantum dots (CQDs) with extremely large aspect ratios, showing nearly polarization-insensitive electroluminescence. A systematic experimental and theoretical investigation of their polarization properties as a function of aspect ratio is also reported.

articleTitle: Predicting the filamentation of high-powered beams and pulses without numerical integration
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a new analytical method that predicts the initial filamentation dynamics of high-powered beams and pulses. We demonstrate the method with various input beams and pulses and show good agreement with numerical results.

articleTitle: High power Yb:YAG Innoslab fs-amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: For high throughput applications a diode-pumped Yb:YAG Innoslab fs-amplifier, scalable to several 100W, was realized. At 63.2MHz repetition rate and 77W average output power nearly transform and diffraction limited 786fs pulses are achieved so far.

articleTitle: Fabrication of photonic crystal light-emitting diode with photoelectrochemical wet etching and phase mask interference
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the high light-extraction efficiency by using the photoelectrochemical etching technique for forming photonic crystal structures on an InGaN/GaN quantum-well light-emitting diode through phase-mask interference. More than 90% increase of output power is observed.

articleTitle: Metal-dielectric layered nanostructures as epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) circuit boards for optical nanocircuits
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using analytical-numerical methods, we study near-zero permittivity of stacks of thin layers of noble metals and dielectric materials as circuit boards for our concept of optical nanocircuits, and discuss nanoscale light manipulations in these nanoboards.

articleTitle: Efficient solar-pumped laser by a light-guide/2D-CPC cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A simple fused silica light-guide assembly transmits 6kW concentrated solar power to a 2D-CPC cavity. The calculated laser power of 75.8W is obtained for a 4mm diameter Nd:YAG rod, reaching the conversion efficiency of 11W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Single-shot, space- and time-resolved measurement of rotational wavepacket revivals in H2 and D2
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Femtosecond laser induced alignment and periodic recurrences of room temperature hydrogen and deuterium molecules are measured in a single shot for the first time, using single-shot supercontinuum spectral interferometry (SSSI). The measurements are also performed in oxygen and some other common linear molecular gases. Employing time-dependent first order perturbation theory, an analytical model of rotational wavepacket revivals is derived, which shows good agreement with the experiment.

articleTitle: Fiber optical trap deposition of carbon nanotubes on fiber end-faces in a modelocked laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The fiber optical trap technique for depositing carbon nanotubes on fiber end-faces in modelocked lasers is experimentally characterized. Precise control of optical power and the temperature of carbon nanotubes solution are important in this technique.

articleTitle: Power-scaling of a 1060nm semiconductor disk laser with a diamond heatspreader
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Power scaling by increasing the pump spot area is shown to be intrinsically limited in semiconductor disk lasers with diamond heatspreaders. An output power of 9 W is reported for a 1060 nm device.

articleTitle: Sub-two-cycle light pulses at 1.6 μm from an optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generate 8.5 fs pulses at 1.6 mm from an 800-nm-pumped optical parametric amplifier working at degeneracy, employing a deformable mirror compressor. These are the shortest light pulses in this wavelength range.

articleTitle: Pulse delay and speed-up of ultra fast pulses in an absorbing quantum well medium
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Slow down and speed-up of 180 fs pulses in an absorbing semiconductor beyond the existing models is observed. Cascading gain and absorbing sections give us significant temporal pulse shifting at almost constant output pulse energy.

articleTitle: Experimental test of non-local realism using a fiber-based source of polarization-entangled photon pairs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We test local realistic and non-local realistic theories using a fiber-based source of polarization-entangled photons. Our measurements violate local (certain non-local) hidden-variable theories by 15 (Leggett, A.) standard deviations.

articleTitle: Toward silicon-compatible modulation of plasmonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have modeled plasmonic waveguides that support low-loss modes using configurations compatible with metal-oxide-semiconductor devices. Our experimental verification with visible wavelength analogs demonstrates that silicon-based plasmonic modulators are possible.

articleTitle: Intradyne receivers using FPGA processing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: FPGA-based intradyne real-time receivers have received increasing attention because of ease of implementation. In this paper, we will review the progress that has been made over the last couple of years.

articleTitle: Passively phase-locked multimode semiconductor laser: From millimetre to terahertz wave generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Generation of narrow microwave signals produced from the mode beating of a DBR laser is presented. The application of this process to the cw-THz wave generation is also demonstrated using a slotted FP laser.

articleTitle: Crystal fiber based white light source using Ce,Sm:YAG as the active medium
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: White light source using double-clad Ce,Sm:YAG crystal fiber was fabricated for the first time. The color-rendering index and color temperature are estimated to be 75 and 4610 K, respectively.

articleTitle: A real-time terahertz wave imager
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a terahertz wave imager with an acquisition speed at 3 frame-per-second by implementing a scanning mirror. Moving neither object nor terahertz source opens the possibility of a large area scanning at video rate.

articleTitle: Broadband terahertz lasing in aligned molecules
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: No broadband lasing medium like Ti:Saph has been demonstrated yet for terahertz radiation. We show that laser-aligned molecules can amplify broadband terahertz radiation, allowing high-energy chirped-pulse amplification at terahertz frequencies.

articleTitle: Superresolution imaging in live bacterial cells by single-molecule active-control microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Imaging of a nanoscale emitter naturally provides position information beyond the diffraction limit. We use active control to switch single fluorophores on and off to image structures with 40-nm resolution in a living cell.

articleTitle: Resolved-sideband laser cooling of a micro-mechanical oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Mechanical oscillation-induced sidebands are resolved by the >20-times narrower resonances of ultrahigh-finesse optical microcavities. Tuning a laser to the first lower sideband thus permits resolved sideband cooling from room temperature to phonon occupations below 6,000.

articleTitle: Gas phase study of the reactivity of optical coating materials with hydrocarbons using a compact EUV laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have conducted single photon ionization mass spectroscopy studies of the chemical reactivity of Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>/Ti<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>/Hf<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>/Zr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>/Ru<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>, metal oxide nanoclusters. The results are relevant to the carbon contamination of capping layers in extreme ultraviolet (EUV) reflective coatings.

articleTitle: Non-linearity in chalcogenide glasses and fibers, and their applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: High nonlinearity and large IR transparency make chalcogenide fibers well suited for compact Raman amplifiers, supercontinuum generation and other mid-IR sources. As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> fiber has record high theoretical gain compared with silica fiber for slow-light applications.

articleTitle: Polarization properties of PCF with Ge-nanowire
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A broad-band in-fiber polarizer with suppression ≫25dB over 300nm bandwidth is reported. It is made by introducing a high quality Ge nanowire into one of the hollow channels of a photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Optimized supercontinuum generation and pulse self-compression in filaments from the UV to the IR
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally and numerically investigate supercontinuum generation produced by circularly polarized femtosecond filaments in argon for broadband self-compression. A comparison with linear polarization indicates greater beam pointing stability and extended supercontinuum generation due to varied spatial-temporal characteristics.

articleTitle: Absolute rates of Spontaneous Parametric Down Conversion into a single transverse Gaussian mode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We provide expressions for the absolute emission rate of photon pairs produced in SPDC when all interacting fields are in a single transverse Gaussian mode.

articleTitle: Factoring numbers with interfering random waves
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the successful operation of an analogue computer designed to factor numbers. A sequence of shaped femtosecond pulses is used to implement a Gauss sum . N = 1psila340psila333psila404psila807 has been successfully factorized.

articleTitle: Simultaneous optical delay and NRZ-RZ format conversion via cross-polarization modulation and pulse pre-chirping
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable optical delay with NRZ-RZ format conversion capability by using cross polarization modulation and pulse pre-chirping. Continuous delay up to 8.6 ns with -1 dB power penalty was achieved using this scheme.

articleTitle: Watt-level Single-longitudinal-mode, Tunable dual-wavelength, CW Nd:YVO4 laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a watt-level, single-longitudinal-mode, tunable dual-wavelength, CW Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser. The measured spectral widths and average power were 450 MHz, 1.2 W at 1064 nm and 400 MHz, 0.9 W at 1342 nm.

articleTitle: MRF: Engineering large-scale crystals for improved wavefront
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Magneto-rheological finishing techniques have been applied to Yb:S-FAP and Ti:sapphire crystals to compensate for submillimeter distortions; improving the transmitted wavefront (10times) and increasing the availability of large aperture parts (>10 cm).

articleTitle: Ultra broadband gain from a Bismuth-doped glass waveguide fabricated using ultrafast laser inscription
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Waveguides were fabricated inside a Bi-doped silica glass using ultrafast laser inscription. When optically pumped at 980 nm, ultra-broadband gain was measured from the waveguides, paving the way for compact ultra-broadband optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: 10 nJ-normal dispersion erbium-doped fiber laser exhibiting spectral filtering
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on an ultrafast normal dispersion erbium fiber laser generating 10 nJ pulses externally compressed to <5 fs. The impact of spectral filtering on the mode-locking is discussed via phase noise measurements.

articleTitle: Coherent control of thermal emission from SiC due to coupled resonant cavity structure
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Coherent thermal emission from an anisotropic microstructure upon SiC is presented. The enhanced coherency is due to coupled resonant cavities supported by surface phonon-polaritons. A quality-factor 600 and an angular divergence of 1.4 mrad are obtained.

articleTitle: Optical limiting in Bragg-spaced semiconductor quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a new mechanism for optical limiting in which nonlinear absorption and nonlinear reflection act in concert. The mechanism is based on the light-induced shift of the band gap in Bragg-spaced semiconductor quantum wells.

articleTitle: Single-walled carbon nanotube saturable absorbers for mode-locked laser operation near 1 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Single-walled carbon nanotube saturable absorbers were designed for passive mode-locking near 1 μm. Using Yb:KYW and Yb:KLuW, nearly transform-limited sub-150 fs pulses were generated at 1037 nm and 1048 nm, respectively.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Extremely high coupling and transmission of high-powered-femtosecond pulses in hollow-core photonic
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Amplified femtosecond laser pulses are coupled through a hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber with efficiencies greater than 98%. Peak power intensities greater than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are achieved inside the fiber core.

articleTitle: High thermal and electrical tunability of negative dielectric liquid crystal photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We infiltrate photonic crystal fibers with negative dielectric liquid crystals. 400 nm bandgap shift is obtained in the range 22degC-80degC and 119 nm shift of the long-wavelength bandgap edge is achieved by applying a voltage of 200V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rms</sub>.

articleTitle: Novel heat removal waveguide structure for high performance quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the heat removal capability of different core structures in quantum cascade lasers. We find that due to non-isotropic conductivity, core structures with higher depth dissipate heat faster than the conventional higher-width structures.

articleTitle: Demonstration of low power, thermally stable second-order microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Thermal tuning with an efficiency of 40 muW/GHz/ring is demonstrated in silicon-rich silicon nitride second-order microring resonators. Open-loop thermal stability of the resonant frequency is measured to be within 400 MHz for these resonators.

articleTitle: Demonstration of locking carrier envelope offset by using low pulse energy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a carrier-envelope-offset (CEO)-locked frequency comb with 230-pJ fiber coupling pulse energy by using a passive-modelocked Er-fiber amplifier laser. We succeeded in CEO stabilization at telecommunications wavelengths using the lowest fiber coupling pulse energy.

articleTitle: Ultrafast carrier dynamics in semiconductor nanowires
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ultrafast wavelength-tunable optical measurements on semiconductor nanowires allow us to independently probe the dynamics of electrons, holes, and defect states. These investigations reveal the influence of two-dimensional confinement on carrier dynamics in these nanosystems.

articleTitle: Measuring the spatio-temporal electric field of tightly focused ultrashort pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a spectral interferometer with NSOM probes for measuring focusing ultrashort pulses with high spatial and temporal resolution. We measure a 0.26 NA focus and, for the first time, we observe the forerunner pulse.

articleTitle: Optimized design of flat-band finite-size Coupled Resonator optical waveguides with reduced in-band distortions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Silicon-on-insulator (SOI) finite-size CROWs with optimized flat-band spectrum, excellent group-delay response, and compact size are experimentally demonstrated using direct correspondence with ladder-type LC circuits. Sensitivity analysis attributes residual distortions to non-ideal fabrication rather than coupling-induced-frequency-shifts.

articleTitle: Nonlinear effects in a silica-node of a hollow-core photonic crystal fiber within the photonic bandgap
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on strong nonlinear effects in a specific sub-micron scale silica-node within the cladding of a hollow-core photonic crystal fiber at frequencies lying within the air-guiding cladding photonic bandgap.

articleTitle: Recombination dynamics in quantum dot semiconductor saturable absorber mirrors (QD-SESAMs)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first systematic study of recombination dynamics in InAs QD-SESAMs. Decreasing growth temperature and increasing indium coverage reduces the recovery time from 1500 to 24 ps, leading to shorter pulses in modelocked VECSELs.

articleTitle: Polarization analysis of THz generated by four wave mixing in air
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We examine the generation of terahertz by optical rectification of fundamental infrared beam with its second harmonic in ionized air. From polarization measurements we identify an important, yet so far unreported cross term chi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">xyxy</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup>.

articleTitle: Spectrally breathing femtosecond pulses from an Er-doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report order-of-magnitude spectral breathing in a dispersion-managed Er-fiber laser with an intracavity bandpass filter. This is to our knowledge the highest of any laser reported. Pulse energy is 1.7 nJ, width is 110 fs.

articleTitle: Entanglement-based BBM92 QKD experiment using superconducting single photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report an entanglement-based BBM92 quantum key distribution experiment using superconducting single photon detectors. A 16-kbit sifted key with a quantum bit error rate of 6.9 % was successfully generated after 100 km fiber transmission.

articleTitle: Observation of anti-crossing events via mode-pattern rotation in HC-PCF
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe the effects of anti-crossing events between core and core interface guided modes of a HC-PCF, by monitoring the output of the fiber as the coupled laser is scanned in wavelength.

articleTitle: Super-resolution spatial spectroscopy for mid-IR and THz
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a novel scheme for subwavelength-resolved spatial spectroscopy in the mid-IR and THz bands. Our approach relies on scattering from an acoustic grating and allows far-field detection of high spatial frequency Fourier components.

articleTitle: All-fiber capillary electrophoresis with novel axial in-line detection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An all-fiber capillary electrophoresis system is presented. It enables sensitive in-line electrophoresis separation and fluorescence detection. As a proof of concept, a biological sample (FITC-BSA) is electrokinetically separated and analyzed.

articleTitle: OPO resonator length stabilisation for injection seeding using fibre coupled heterodyne detection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By employing optical heterodyne measurements of injection seeded optical parametric oscillator pulses with the frequency shifted seed laser we present a fibre coupled solution for resonator length stabilisation.

articleTitle: Integrated, ultrahigh-fidelity 17×40 GHz OAWG
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate ultrahigh-fidelity (G Lt 0.4%) optical arbitrary waveform generation using an integrated arrayed-waveguide-grating pair based 128-channel Fourier pulse shaper with computer-controlled-feedback, a 17-mode 40-GHz optical-frequency comb source, and cross-correlation frequency-resolved optical-gating measurements.

articleTitle: InGaAs diode laser system for the generation of 480 fs long pulses with 340 W peak power
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: 480 fs long pulses with 340 W peak power are generated with an InGaAs diode laser MOPA system and a grating compressor, without stretching the pulses before amplification as required in commonly used CPA systems.

articleTitle: Multi-layer planar terahertz electric metamaterials on flexible substrates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Planar electric metamaterials fabricated on thin, flexible substrates are studied using terahertz-time domain spectroscopy. Transmission measurements are performed to analyze dielectric properties on single and multiple stacked samples and reveal strong resonances at 1.2 THz.

articleTitle: Frequency and wavelength standards based on gas filled HC-PBFs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the observation of saturated absorption in several molecules in HC-PBFs. Characteristics of these molecular reference lines are discussed and the locking of fiber lasers to the molecular absorption lines is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A pressure sensor based on the loss birefringence of a microstructured optical fiber containing metal coated elliptical inclusions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By measuring splitting in the wavelengths of maximum propagation losses of the two originally degenerate plasmonic/fiber core modes, one can detect 8.10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> ellipticity of the silver coated air inclusions. Application in pressure sensing is suggested.

articleTitle: Subpicosecond pulse generation at 245 GHz using a quantum-dash-based passive mode-locked laser emitting at 1.53 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate ~590 fs pulse generation at a 245 GHz repetition rate using a one-section Fabry-Perot quantum-dash-based laser. A time-bandwidth product of 0.41 and average output power in excess of 20 mW are achieved.

articleTitle: Fine twin structure in crystal quartz for quasi-phase-matched deep ultraviolet generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We succeeded in fabrication of the finest twins in crystal quartz with a period of 11.9 mum and generation of 266 nm light with 2.2 mW by 2nd-order-QPM through precise control of the temperature and pulsed stress.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of timing jitter reduction based on the temporal talbot effect using LCFBGs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the timing-jitter reduction of repetition pulses by the temporal Talbot effect using linearly chirped fiber Bragg gratings (LCFBGs). Experimental results agree with the simulation taking into account the group delay ripple of LCFBGs.

articleTitle: Generation of sub-30 fs pulses from a mode-locked ytterbium fiber laser oscillator with phase compensation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An ultrashort-pulses mode-locked ytterbium-doped fiber laser has been developed with 28.3 fs duration at 80 MHz. The dispersion was compensated by a grating pair inside the cavity and a prism pair outside the cavity.

articleTitle: Gouy phase compensated quasi phase matching (GQPM)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using an appropriately designed quasi-phase matched structure it is theoretically possible to compensate for the deleterious effects of Gouy phase shift allowing a symmetric frequency response and tighter focussing for higher conversion efficiencies.

articleTitle: Thin-disk laser operation with single-pass pumping
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Single-pass pumping of a thin disk consisting of a 50 μm epitaxial layer of 32% Yb-doped KLu(WO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> deposited on a KLu(WO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> substrate produced 9 W of output power near 1030 nm at 77% slope efficiency.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: 1-μm waveband 10-Gbit/s transmission over a 7-km single-mode hole assisted fiber using a harmonically mode-locked semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: For developing a 1-mum waveband photonic-transport system, we fabricated a harmonically mode-locked semiconductor laser (MLL) RZ-signal source. We successfully demonstrated a 10-Gbit/s error-free transmission over a 7-km single-mode hole assisted fiber (HAF) at 1035- nm.

articleTitle: Thermal distribution of Cu2O paraexcitons in a strain-induced trap probed by excitonic Lyman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe the signal of trapped paraexcitons in Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O by using CW excitonic Lyman spectroscopy. The temperature dependence of the 1s-2p induced absorption of paraexcitons indicates the presence of a strain-induced trap.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of pump lasers and a vertical external cavity surface emitting laser (VECSEL)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Integration of optically-pumped VECSELs with pump lasers is demonstrated using an innovative contacting scheme. Devices for medium-power green conversion (lambda~1060 nm) are fabricated with threshold currents as low as 160 mA and cw output powers exceeding 100 mW.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a photonic analog-to-digital converter scalable to 40 GS/s with 8-bit resolution
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An initial system demonstration is shown for a CMOS-compatible optically-sampled analog-to-digital converter with potential to achieve 40 GS/s with 8-10 effective number of bits (ENOB). Using commercial components, 7.6 ENOB has been achieved.

articleTitle: Spectrotemporal gain bandwidth measurement in an InGaAs/GaAsP quantum well vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Analysis of spectral condensation in a VECSEL with a near-antiresonant gain structure incorporating InGaAs/GaAsP quantum wells emitting around 1030 nm shows the effective FWHM gain bandwidth of this laser to be 32 nm.

articleTitle: Improving quantum efficiency with nanostructured semipolar III-nitride light emitters
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated nanostructured semipolar III-nitride light emitters on low cost c-plane GaN templates using one-step epitaxy. The total light emission efficiency is improved by a factor of 2.6 compared to polar emitters at room temperature.

articleTitle: Molecular recollision interferometry in high harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using extreme-ultraviolet interferometry, we measure π phase shifts in high harmonics generated from transiently aligned molecules. This data directly reflects the quantum interferences in the electron wavepacket due to the two-center molecular structure.

articleTitle: Amplitude-equalized clock recovery using nonlinear polarization rotation in a semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report an all-optical clock recovery technology using nonlinear polarization rotation of reflective semiconductor optical amplifier. Clock amplitude jitter of the recovered clock is lower than 1.5% over a 25 nm tuning range.

articleTitle: 2×2 deflection routing node for optical packet-switched networks
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a 2times2 deflection routing module for all-optical packet-switched networks. Output port contentions are resolved based on all-optical processing of the packet headers. Both the header and payload rates are 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Efficient excitation of polarization vortices in a photonic bandgap fiber with ultrashort laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally investigate the excitation of radially and azimuthally polarized modes in a hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber. With radially-polarized ultrashort pulses, we achieve 91% total transmission through the fiber, including coupling losses.

articleTitle: Fast and simple high resolution optical spectrum analyzer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A simple method for fast optical spectroscopy with high resolution is shown. The method is based on the narrowband Brillouin gain process in optical fibers.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion in a silicon mode-split micro-ring resonator with 1G data rate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the wavelength conversion based on free carrier dispersion effect induced by non-linear absorption in a silicon micro-ring resonator. The pump and signal wavelengths are set by the split resonances spaced by 0.4 nm induced by deformation in the coupling region. The results of 500 Mbps and 1Gbps are presented.

articleTitle: Dispersion engineering of silicon nanophotonic wires using a thin film cladding
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Numerical simulations and experiments are performed to investigate the use of thin conformal silicon nitride cladding layers to engineer the dispersion properties of silicon nanophotonic waveguides.

articleTitle: Strategies for reducing out of plane radiation in photonic crystal double heterostructure resonant cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Directional dependence of optical radiation from photonic crystal double heterostructure resonant cavities is analyzed using the finite-difference time-domain method. Geometries that mitigate out-of-plane radiation loss with dielectric substrates are analyzed.

articleTitle: Low-energy threshold supercontinuum generated in highly nonlinear As2Se3 chalcogenide submicron tapers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We fabricate sub-micron chalcogenide fiber tapers exhibiting ultra-high nonlinearity up to γ ∼ 93 /W/m. This high nonlinearity, with combination of tailored anomalous dispersion, enables low-energy threshold soliton fission leading to supercontinuum generation.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon resonance spectroscopy in the mid-infrared range
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A surface plasmon resonance sensor has been successfully designed in the mid-infrared range. Evidence for surface plasmon resonance will be presented and early results on gas sensing performed with this sensor will be discussed.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked semiconductor disk laser generating sub-300-fs pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the shortest pulses (290 fs) obtained directly from semiconductor lasers. These were achieved using a passively mode-locked semiconductor disk laser with a graded-gap barrier design in the gain section operating near 1036 nm.

articleTitle: On-chip gas detection in silicon optical microcavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We detect acetylene gas on a silicon chip using photonic microcavities and a chip-scale gas cell. We measure refractive index differences as small as 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> between air and acetylene at varying pressures in the near-IR.

articleTitle: Fibre transfer of high stability microwave references with optical frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The 100 MHz repetition rate of a mode-locked erbium-doped fibre laser has been transmitted over 100 km of spooled fibre. With only passive dispersion compensation, short-term frequency instability below 4 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-14</sup> has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Power and modulation response of wavelength locked lasers for WDM-PON applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The optical spectrum and modulation response of wavelength-locked lasers are analyzed. The model is verified against WDM-PON system data. A maximum data rate resulting from a trade-off of chromatic dispersion and modulation damping is predicted.

articleTitle: 105 kHz, 85 ps, 3 MW microchip laser fiber amplifier system for micro-machining applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a fiber amplified passively Q-switched microchip-laser delivering 85ps, 3MW pulses with 105kHz repetition rate. An all-optical synchronization technique reducing the mean pulse to pulse jitter of the microchip laser to 40ps is demonstrated for the first time. In comparison with existing setups at comparable average powers, the repetition rate is nearly on order of magnitude higher and the pulse duration is one order of magnitude shorter, making it a formidable micromachining source with high ablation rates.

articleTitle: Single mode lasing in a gain-guided index anti-guided diode end pumped fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Single mode oscillation in a 200 mum core diameter gain guided index anti-guided fiber laser is demonstrated. Single mode oscillation is maintained for pumping of up to four times laser threshold, limited by available pump power.

articleTitle: Phase shifted multilevel amplitude-shift keying for 100 Gb/s Ethernet applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a new modulation format for 100 Gb/s Ethernet applications. A plusmn49 ps/nm chromatic dispersion tolerance is achieved with a phase shifted multilevel amplitude-shift keying signal for 40 km single mode fiber transmission.

articleTitle: A path for non-invasive glucose detection using mid-IR supercontinuum
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose the use of large bandwidth mid-IR supercontinuum coupled with machine learning algorithms could provide a solution to non-invasive glucose detection. The SC uses millimeters of non-linear optical fiber, lowering costs and enhancing compactness.

articleTitle: Bismuth-doped fiber laser at 1.16 mm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We used a bismuth-doped fiber with high pump absorption, 1.2 dB/m, to make a short (25 m) Bi-fiber laser at 1.16 mum with 10% efficiency. We discuss the influence of host glass and unsaturable absorption.

articleTitle: Polarization mode control in high contrast subwavelength grating VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate deterministic polarization mode control in VCSEL utilizing a single-layer high-index-contrast subwavelength grating mirror. Orthogonal polarization suppression ratio of 36 and 28 dB was obtained under both CW and large-signal pulsed operation.

articleTitle: Optical coherence tomography imaging with k-space linear fourier domain mode locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a Fourier Domain Mode Locked wavelength swept laser source with a highly linear time-frequency sweep characteristic and demonstrate OCT imaging without k-space resampling prior to Fourier transformation with this source.

articleTitle: Flow dependent optofluidic particle trapping
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Interactions between optical and hydrodynamic forces enable selective particle trapping and control inside a planar optofluidic chip. The unique flow-dependent nature of the traps allows for active particle sorting with extensions to immiscible microfluidic systems.

articleTitle: Near-infrared QEPAS sensor for trace ethylene monitoring at atmospheric pressure
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A sensor based on quartz enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy was evaluated for the detection of trace levels of ethylene at atmospheric pressure using a fiber coupled DFB diode laser probing an absorption peak at 6177.15 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Photonic active integrated antennas (PhAIAs) using lossless matching for 2.4-GHz wireless-over-fibre systems
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Lossless matching circuits are integrated into PhAlAs used in a 2.4 GHz wireless-over-fibre link. The system uses a 220 m in-building multi-mode-fibre and results show a greater than 10 dB improvement in signal strength and improved throughput.

articleTitle: Coherent zero-state and π-state in an array of exciton-polariton condensates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report spontaneous buildup of inphase (dasiazero-statepsila) and antiphase (dasiapi-statepsila) states in an exciton-polariton condensate array connected by weak periodic potential barriers. These states reflect the band structure and dynamic characteristics of array exciton-polariton condensates.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped, Actively Internal-Q-switched Nd:MgO:PPLN laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrated a diode-pumped, electro-optically internal-Q-switched laser system fabricated using a Nd:MgO:PPLN. We obtained laser pulses of pulse energy > 2.45 muJ and pulse width ~28 ns from this internal-Q-switched laser system with 2% output coupling.

articleTitle: High power radial polarization conversion using photonic crystal segmented half-wave-plate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generated 110 watts of radial polarized laser beam from Yb fiber laser using photonic-crystal segmented half-wave-plate. This is a promising external radial polarization converter for fiber laser used in the laser cutting industry.

articleTitle: Advances in single crystal ZnGeP2 processing for high energy applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Scale-up of single crystal ZnGeP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> resulting in 30 times 30 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> aperture, high-quality optical samples has been demonstrated. The combination of increased aperture and improved LIDT has resulted in material better suited to high energy applications.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade microlasers with highly deformed spiral-resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the spectral characteristics of spiral-shaped micro-cylindrical quantum cascade lasers with various spiral geometries. With medium deformations and notch angles, our lasers can achieve single-mode emission with a side-mode suppression ratio over 30 dB.

articleTitle: Vortex-antivortex labyrinth wavefunction
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We discuss a possibility of a pinning of quantized matter wave vortices by optical vortices in specially arranged optical dipole traps. The vortex-antivortex optical arrays of rectangular symmetry are shown to transfer angular orbital momentum to support ldquoantiferromagnet-likerdquo matter waves. The separable Hamiltonian for matter waves is proposed which allows to factorize of the 3D -wavefunction exactly in a product of 1D - harmonic oscillatorpsilas ground state and 2D - vortex-antivortex wavefunction. The wavefunctionpsilas phase gradient field associated with the field of classical velocities via Madelung transformation forms labyrinth-like structure. The macroscopic wavefunction of periodically spaced BEC superfluid vortices appears to be less influenced by decoherence.

articleTitle: Loss analysis of non-symmetrical splitters in subwavelength plasmonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Losses were analyzed for non-symmetrical metal-dielectric-metal (MDM) splitters in subwavelength plasmonic waveguides. The simulation results show non-symmetrical MDM splitters have very high transmission and very close power splitting ratios among output ports at 1.5 um wavelength.

articleTitle: Silver clusters as probes for femtosecond laser — glass interaction
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Sub-wavelength structuration by femtosecond laser interaction in a model glass doped with silver ions is investigated. Induced silver clusters are used to probe free carriers distribution. Theoretical mechanism is discussed and compared to fluorescence imaging.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared interband cascade lasers operating CW at thermoelectric-cooler temperatures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Mid-infrared interband cascade lasers with 11-mum-wide ridge width and Au electroplating operated cw to 288 K, where the emission wavelength was 4.1 mum. Another device emitted at 5.1 mum and operated cw to 229 K.

articleTitle: Temperature and wavelength dependence of the nonlinear optical parameters of InP
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Values of the nonlinear absorption and nonlinear refraction coefficients of InP were measured at different temperatures using picosecond and nanosecond durations lasers operating at 1064 nm and 1570 nm.

articleTitle: Modulation property of multi-spatial-mode semiconductor mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Modulation response of multi-spatial-mode semiconductor mode-locked lasers is studied by using coupled multi-mode rate equations and the analysis agrees well with previous experimental results that show the modulation response well beyond the relaxation-oscillation-resonance limit.

articleTitle: Ultrafast magneto-optics made compact
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that the ultrafast magnetization dynamics of magnetic materials can be investigated with a compact magneto-optical pump-probe set-up based on the use of a low power femtosecond fiber laser.

articleTitle: Tuning exchange interaction in colloidal nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We tune the exchange interaction in nanocrystals by manipulating the electron-hole wavefunction overlap under external electric fields and simultaneously probe the electronic structure and rich transient dynamics under strong magnetic fields (8 T).

articleTitle: Widely tunable Tm:YAG, Tm:YAP, Tm:LuAG, Tm:GdVO4, Tm,Ho:GdVO4 and Tm,Ho:YLF lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Diode-pumped Tm:YAG, Tm:LuAG, Tm:YAP, Tm:GdVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, Tm,Ho:GdVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and Tm,Ho:YLF lasers tuned by birefringent filters(BF) are demonstrated and compared. Tuning range of 1.8–2.1 micron is obtained from these six lasers with several watts power output.

articleTitle: Pump/signal induced refractive index changes in Yb-doped fiber amplifier: The origin and properties
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Refractive index changes induced by pump-signal operation in commercial Yb-doped fibers are shown to be of electronic origin with a strong contribution of UV-transitions to the polarizability difference explored for testing wavelength of 1460-1620 nm.

articleTitle: Exciton-plasmon interactions in hybrid structures of semiconductor nanocrystals and metal disc arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using time resolved optical spectroscopy we show that by angle tuning dispersive plasmon modes of metal disc arrays into resonance with emission of adjacent semiconductor nanocrystals we achieve five fold enhancement of radiative transition rates.

articleTitle: Physics of electrically switched fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The physics of electrically switched FBGs was studied in fibers with internal electrodes. Wavelength shifts due to mechanical effects (nanoseconds) and heat (milliseconds) depend quadratically on the electrical pulse voltage and linearly on pulse duration.

articleTitle: Proposed method for quantum correlation(Bell) measurement of two electrons in a single quantum dot based on Faraday/Kerr rotation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An optical non-destructive method is proposed based on the Faraday/Kerr rotation for quantum correlation(Bell) measurement of two electrons in a single quantum dot which is essential in the quantum repeater and its feasibility is investigated.

articleTitle: High energy hybrid fiber - Yb:SFAP laser with dynamic spectral and temporal pulse shaping
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have commissioned a turnkey 500 mJ, 10 Hz front end laser. The system delivers temporally and spectrally tailored pulses to correct signal distortions within itself or subsequent amplifiers from single longitudinal mode to 250 GHz RF bandwidth.

articleTitle: Wavelength tunable femtosecond optical pulse generated from filamentation-assisted fourth-order nonlinear process in KTP crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Visible femtosecond laser pulse is generated during filamentation of an 808 nm femtosecond laser pulse by a fourth order nonlinear polarization. The wavelength could be tuned from 460 to 520 nm.

articleTitle: Observation of Coherent G-mode oscillations in single-walled carbon nanotubes via the spectrum-resolved detection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Coherent G-mode vibrations of single-walled carbon nanotubes are observed in the spectrum-resolved pump-probe measurements. The G-mode oscillation is relatively strong in the edge side of the laser spectrum while being weak for the central region.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: “Nearly zero” modal volume cavities using localized plasmons with some retardation effects
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The Q-factor of a localized plasmon cavity is enhanced significantly when allowing the plasmon to very slightly propagate as an SPP. The resulting mixed plasmon - plasmon polariton resonators retain sub-100 nm volume with enhanced Q-factors.

articleTitle: Anisotropic metamaterials for purely 2D optics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We develop an approach to utilize anisotropic metamaterials to solve the fundamental problem of parasitic scattering of surface waves into freespace modes, paving the way for purely 2D optics.

articleTitle: Running-code O-CDMA based on AOM pulse shapers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on a successful demonstration of a continuously-running-code O-CDMA system. The system utilizes double-pass acousto-optic-modulator pulse shapers as the encoding/decoding devices which are capable of microsecond-scale code-sequence refresh rate.

articleTitle: A new kind of laser microphone using high sensitivity pulsed laser vibrometer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally a new kind of laser microphone using a highly sensitive pulsed laser vibrometer. By using the photo-electromotive-force (photo-EMF) sensors, we present data indicating the real-time detection of surface displacements as small as 4 pm.

articleTitle: All-solid-state sub-200-nm pulsed deep ultraviolet source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using a diode-pumped Q-switched Nd:YAG laser as the pump source, 198.5-nm was constructed. With 1.15 W of average power at 1064 nm, 12 mW of average output power was obtained at 198.5 nm.

articleTitle: Study of the side deposition enhanced Cr4+ concentration in Cr4+: YAG crystal fiber as an ultra broadband amplified spontaneous emitter
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using laser heated pedestal method to grow CaO or MgO side deposited Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG crystal fiber, Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup> concentration was raised by a factor of 110% after re-growth and annealing at 1350 °C in Ca,Cr:YAG crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Optical transport properties of three-dimensional photonic quasicrystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We theoretically describe the optical properties of three-dimensional icosahedral photonic quasicrystals by means of a periodic approximant approach. Experimental findings that were previously ascribed to extrinsic effects are found to be intrinsic properties of quasicrystals.

articleTitle: Using difference frequency generation to lock a CW visible laser to a fiber laser frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the use of difference frequency generation to lock a visible CW Ti:sapphire laser to a femtosecond frequency comb spanning 1 to 2 mum generated by a fiber laser frequency comb.

articleTitle: THz photonic crystal waveguide coupled cavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Numerical simulations are used to design integrated metallic photonic crystal waveguide coupled cavities with sharp resonances. THz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) is used to characterize these waveguides. A good match between theory and experiment is shown.

articleTitle: Novel approach for polarization-sensitive mode measurement and its application in few-mode fiber amplifier systems
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a novel approach for polarization-sensitive measurement of higher-order fiber-modes and use it to analyze mode behavior in a few-mode fiber amplifier, where we show that modes prefer to have orthogonal polarization states.

articleTitle: Entanglement-free, Heisenberg-limited phase measurement
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate experimental Heisenberg-limited scaling of the variance in optical phase measurements. Our algorithm replaces entangled states - often thought essential for Heisenberg scaling - with single photons, multiple phase shift passes, and adaptive measurement.
