articleTitle: GaAs-based buried heterostructure laser incorporating an InGaP opto-electronic confinement layer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a novel process for fabrication of GaAs-based single lateral mode buried heterostructure lasers using a single epitaxial overgrowth in which an n-doped InGaP layer is utilized for both electrical and optical confinement.

articleTitle: High repetition rate, acousto-optic Q-switched, diode pumped Tm:YLF laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Compact, room-temperature, acousto-optic Q-switched, Tm:YLF laser pumped by 30-W fiber coupled diode laser delivers pulses with energies above 10 mJ, peak power above 200 kW, for 133 Hz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Simple multiwavelength time-division multiplexed laser for H2O absorption measurements
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a multiwavelength, time-division multiplexed laser that continuously cycles through 10 stable, tunable and spectrally narrow wavelengths at 30 kHz for absorption measurements in the R-branch of the v1+n3 band of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O (1330-1380 nm).

articleTitle: Characterization of cluster/monomer ratio in pulsed supersonic gas jets
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Combining femtosecond frequency-domain interferometry with time-integrated transverse interferometry and Rayleigh scatter, we completely characterize all parameters - cluster mass fraction, total atomic density and average cluster size - that influence high-intensity laser interactions with clustering gas jets.

articleTitle: Pulse energies exceeding 13 microjoules from a passively mode-locked Yb:YAG thin-disk oscillator by use of a self-imaging active multipass geometry
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate high energy picosecond pulses obtained directly from a thin-disk laser oscillator operating in ambient atmosphere. The average output power was up to 55 W at a repetition rate of 3.8 MHz.

articleTitle: An uncertainty principle for solitons
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The soliton content in optical fibers with realistic attenuation is determined using the novel dasiasoliton-radiation beat analysispsila which does not require integrability. Previous approaches describe the soliton decay in a misleading way.

articleTitle: Intermodal interference in two-mode air-silica microstructure fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Characteristics of modal interference in two-mode air-silica microstructure fibers are discussed. The theoretical result agrees well with the experiment measurement. Furthermore, the fine structure of modal interference is predicted.

articleTitle: THz photonic-crystal lasers with boundary-conditions control
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate single-mode, surface-emitting terahertz lasers at lambdaap110 mum employing photonic-crystal resonators. The devices employ metal-metal waveguides, and the photonic-crystal lattice is implemented by the sole patterning of the top metal contact, without deep-etching the semiconductor into the photonic crystal holes. The device emission wavelength correctly tunes with the photonic crystal characteristics. In addition, we elucidate the role of the boundary conditions of the photonic-crystal resonator. By removing or not the thick doped semiconductor contact layers after processing, we are able to select the lasing mode of the devices.

articleTitle: A prototype miniaturized chip for bio-imaging applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a prototype miniaturized chip for bio-imaging based on semiconductor LEDs. The Epifluorescent images under direct LED illuminations are comparable to the images captured with commercial systems employing solid-state-laser illumination through standard filter sets.

articleTitle: Photoionized plasmas created by soft x-ray laser irradiation of solid targets
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the first experimental study of plasmas created by photoionization of solid targets with focused soft X-ray laser light. The plasma properties are dominantly determined by material absorption, in agreement with model simulations.

articleTitle: Noise figure of high-repetition-rate optical parametric amplifiers in silicon
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A numerical investigation on noise figure (NF) inside the silicon waveguides pumped with high-repetition-rate pulses is carried out. The parameters of pump pulses are important to generate net gain and <7dB NF in silicon waveguides.

articleTitle: Coupling a nanomechanical resonator to a Cooper-pair-box qubit
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate dispersive coupling between a Cooper-pair box (CPB) qubit and a VHF NEMS (nanoelectromechanical systems) resonator. The observed interaction strength is sufficient to pursue more advanced experiments to elicit quantum behavior in NEMS.

articleTitle: Control of femtosecond laser pulses by deterministically aperiodic photonic structures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Control of femtosecond laser pulses by deterministically aperiodic photonic multilayer structures is studied both experimentally and theoretically. We demonstrate that quasiperiodic structure with only 2.8 mum thickness varies duration of phase-modulated pulses up to 30%.

articleTitle: An optofluidic microscope on a chip driven by DC electrokinetics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The use of DC electrokinetics can ensure a uniform and pure translational motion of biological samples in an optofluidic microscope. Its ability to image a single ellipsoidal cell, Chlamydomonas, was demonstrated on-chip.

articleTitle: Continuous variable CNOT gate based on quadripartite box cluster optical entangled states
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally prepare the quadripartite box cluster entangled states using a pair of Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen entangled optical beams and propose a scheme to demonstrate CNOT gate of continuous variables based on the prepared box cluster states.

articleTitle: Direct determination of light beams’ topological charges using diffraction
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a new method to measure the phase singularity of light beams with orbital angular momentum, based on the diffraction by a triangular aperture. We have applied our method to Bessel and Laguerre-Gauss beams.

articleTitle: GaN defect photonic crystal membrane laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the lasing behaviors of a GaN defect photonic crystal membrane structure. The high Q factor and low threshold condition show the effective photon confinement with the full photonic band gap structure.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of noncollinear coupling of filaments in air
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the strong interactions of femtosecond-pulse-induced filaments in air with various crossing angles and polarizations. A significantly enhanced third-harmonic generation up to 16 times is observed as the filaments are coupling together.

articleTitle: Pulsed raman conversion to 2.14 μm by means of a thulium-doped fiber laser and a GeO2 fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Pulsed Raman conversion to 2.14 mum is reported. Peak Stokes power of 210 W (400 mW average) at 30 kHz with a slope efficiency of 62% in a GeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-doped fiber is demonstrated.

articleTitle: High harmonic spectral minimum and phase in Argon and nitrogen
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Measurements of the high harmonic amplitude and phase in Argon and N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> display amplitude and phase modulations which can be related to a Cooper minimum in Argon and recombination interference in N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Continuously tunable compact single-mode quantum cascade laser source for chemical sensing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a compact, single-mode quantum cascade laser source continuously tunable over 8% of its center wavelength of 9 mum. We integrate the source into a compact mid-infrared spectrometer for absorption spectroscopy of liquids and gases.

articleTitle: From slowing down to stopping of electromagnetic waves within ultrawide bandwidth based on plasmonic graded metallic gratings: A novel scheme for “trapped rainbow”
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that since the group velocity of spoof surface plasmon polariton modes at the cutoff frequency is extremely low, electromagnetic waves with different frequencies can be slowed down or even stopped at different positions.

articleTitle: Measurement of mid-infrared alinsb light-emitting diodes with surface patterning
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: 3D FDTD modelling is employed to design a surface pattern for mid-IR LEDs. Measured enhancement factors over an un-patterned device of 8% and 14% are found at 300 K and 25 K respectively.

articleTitle: A new type of surface waves in diffraction-managed optical waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We predict a novel type of defect-free surface waves which, in contrast to previously studied Tamm or Shockley type waves, appear in truncated but otherwise perfect arrays of coupled optical waveguides with periodically bent axes.

articleTitle: Transverse photo voltage induced by circularly polarized light in metallic photonic crystal slabs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We discovered transverse photo-induced voltage in two-dimensional metallic photonic crystal slabs for oblique incident circularly polarized light. Signal sign is reversed by changing the sense of polarization or sign of incident angle.

articleTitle: Real-time optical coherence tomography based on linearly-stretched pulse interference
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate ultrahigh-speed optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging (at 5,000,000 A-lines/s) of biological samples using a recently introduced stretched-pulse interference technique with significantly improved performances in terms of sensitivity (−82dB) and resolution (42-μm).

articleTitle: Generation of multi-octave optical-frequency combs in a Kagome lattice hollow core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A 3-octave spectral comb is generated in a hydrogen-filled hollow-core photonic-crystal-fiber. The spectrum consists of up to 45 high-order Stokes and anti-Stokes lines generated by coherent stimulated Raman scattering in the transient regime of amplification.

articleTitle: Ultra-sensitive detection of nitric oxide at 5.33 μm using an external cavity QCL based Faraday rotation spectroscopic sensor platform
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Magnetic rotation spectroscopy of nitric oxide at most favorable Q(3/2) transition at 1875.8 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> is reported. Detection limit (1sigma) at 5 ppb level was obtained for a ~44 cm long active optical path with 1s lock-in time constant.

articleTitle: Electrically controlled silicon photonic crystal-based chromatic dispersion compensator with ultra low power consumption
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show full 3D simulation and fabrication of an active silicon-based photonic crystal chromatic dispersion compensator with high power efficiency and low power consumption. The device makes use of a novel structure where optical waveguiding and electrical transport properties can be individually tailored to a large extent.

articleTitle: Synchronized optical spiking
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Diode laser with optical feedback can show chaotic intensity fluctuations in the form of short intensity spikes. Two such lasers can be synchronized to give identical isochronal spiking patterns.

articleTitle: Intra-cavity frequency tripling in actively Q-switched ceramic Nd:YAG micro-laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A compact UV-light source for MALDI/TOFMS based on an intra-cavity frequency tripled, actively Q-switched ceramic Nd:YAG micro-laser, with more than 55 muJ pulse-energy and less than 5 ns pulse-width up to 6 kHz repetition, has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fibre source of heralded single photons at 1550nm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a bright fibre source of heralded single photons at 1550 nm with detected rates greater than 10 kilocounts per second. Photon generation and separation is performed in spliced fibre components.

Author Keywords: (270.5585) Quantum optics. Quantum information and processing

articleTitle: Role of electron-phonon scattering on single-quantum-dot vacuum Rabi splitting in a photonic-crystal nanocavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the influence of electron-phonon scattering on the optical properties of a single-quantum-dot embedded within a planar photonic-crystal nanocavity. Regimes of strong coupling and side-coupled light transmission are explored as a function of temperature.

articleTitle: Coherent probing and saturation of a strongly coupled quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We coherently probe a quantum dot, strongly coupled to a photonic crystal nano-cavity, using a resonant laser beam. At higher pump power, the coupled systempsilas response becomes highly nonlinear. This coherent probing method has applications for classical and quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Room-temperature spin-controlled optoelectronic devices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present three spin-dependent optoelectronic devices for spin controlled photonics working at room temperature. A spin controlled light emitting diode is demonstrated which exhibits spin injection through Fe/Tb-multilayers at room temperature and in remanence. Furthermore, we show that a classical vertical resonator laser can amplify spin information even at room temperature due to its nonlinearity at threshold. Accordingly, in combination with the injectors mentioned above it can be used as a spin-controlled emitter, allowing efficient spin-controlled polarization switching of its optical output. Due to the stability of light polarization in comparison to the spin orientation in a semiconductor, spin information can thus be transmitted over long distances and at room temperature with such devices. For detection of such spin information, we present a spin detector. It consists of a pin-diode with Fe/Tb-multilayer contacts and we show that it can create a polarization dependent spin-current also at room temperature and without applied magnetic fields.

articleTitle: Impact of Rayleigh Backscattering on Stimulated Brillouin Scattering threshold evaluation for 10Gb/s NRZ-OOK signals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally verified a decrease of stimulated Brillouin scattering threshold for 10 Gb/s NRZ-OOK signals with respect to theoretical predictions. We relate this reduction to Rayleigh backscattering interaction with Stokes backscattered spectrum. BER curves are shown.

articleTitle: Enhanced spontaneous raman scattering using a photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The output power from spontaneous gas-phase Raman scattering is enhanced using a hollow-core photonic crystal fiber for the gas cell and Stokes light collector, yielding >100 times enhancement over a free-space configuration.

articleTitle: Bragg cavity polaritons in disordered planar lattices
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate polaritons resulting from excitons localized in arrays with energy and oscillator strength fluctuations embedded in microcavities. The polariton emission shape remains robust under oscillator strength fluctuations, but is more sensitive to energy fluctuations.

articleTitle: Quantum dot microdrop laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report room-temperature, low threshold, multi- and single mode lasing in levitated microdrops doped with low concentrations of CdSe/ZnS core/shell quantum dots.

articleTitle: Ultrafast magnetization dynamics in cobalt nanoparticles studied with femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the trajectory of the magnetization in cobalt nanoparticles using femtosecond pulses. We show that the initial pathway of the magnetization vector is mostly determined by the magnetic anisotropy of the assembly of nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Structured illumination for imaging interferometric microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Imaging interferometric microscopy is a synthetic aperture approach to achieving resolutions approaching lambda/4n with a low-NA objective. Structured illumination, adapted to implementation in existing microscopes, extends its capabilities.

articleTitle: Large tunability of an optically pumped mid-IR laser with chirped distributed-feedback grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A CW, single-longitudinal-mode, optically pumped, type-II distributed-feedback laser at 4.3 mum is reported. Tunability of 27 nm (14 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) is obtained with the novel chirped grating design at a fixed temperature of 77 K.

articleTitle: Spatial modulation instability driven by light-enhanced nonlinearities in semiconductor CdZnTe:V crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the observation of spatial-modulation-instability in CdZeTe:V, where the nonlinearities are greatly enhanced by light. We find that the index-change is composed of a huge (~0.01) uniform component and a 20-times smaller periodic component.

articleTitle: Volume holographic phase conjugation through a sub-wavelength hole
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Holographic phase conjugation is used to focus light onto sub-wavelength holes in a gold film directly on top of a photorefractive lithium niobate crystal. This could lead to a high-numerical-aperture-focusing system.

articleTitle: High power tunable Tm3+-fiber lasers and its application in pumping Cr2+:ZnSe lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Tuned by a variable reflective mirror, we achieve 71.2-W free-running and 30-W maximum average power in range of 1866-2107 nm in Tm-doped fiber lasers. Watt-level powers are generated from single crystal and ceramic Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnSe disk lasers.

articleTitle: Use of a high spatial resolution wavefront analyser to predict intensity hot spot in a femtosecond laser chain
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the use of a new wavefront analyser called MIROMA in a laser chain to measure the residual spatial modulations of the beam induced by footprints of a deformable mirror and prevent optical damages.

articleTitle: Nonlinear phase response of a saturable Bragg reflector for modulation depth control
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate an interferometric configuration comprising a saturable Bragg reflector for phase-to-amplitude response conversion. Its static nonlinear phase response is determined and used to obtain tunable nonlinear amplitude depth modulation.

articleTitle: Optical solitons in PT periodic potentials
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the effect of nonlinearity in novel parity-time (PT) symmetric potentials. We show that new types of nonlinear self-trapped modes can exist in optical PT synthetic lattices.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked Yb:KY(WO4)2 thin disk oscillator with cavity-dumping
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first solitary mode-locked thin disk oscillator with cavity-dumping. The laser generates pulse energies of 3 muJ with pulse durations below 700 fs at 1 MHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: UV SHG emission by the QPM technique using ferroelectric fluorides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Ferroelectric fluorides are the key materials for the SHG in the UV/VUV by the QPM technique. Ferroelectric characteristics and large single crystal growth are addressed. UV SHG emission is demonstrated with BaMgF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> QPM devices.

articleTitle: Sub-picosecond time-dependent mobility in low-band-gap polyphenylene:Fullerene blend probed by terahertz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy is used to investigate photoinduced dynamics of charge carriers in a polymer heterojunction. We directly observe instantaneous generation of highly mobile charge carriers followed by a rapid drop in their mobility.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon image dipole effect
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Polarization resolved detection of the scattered light by a gold nano-particle functionalized tip, off a propagating surface plasmon polariton wave enables quantitative studies of the image dipole orientation effects on flat metal surface.

articleTitle: Observation of optical emission from high refractive index waveguide excited by traveling electron beam
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A new scheme for optical emission using a high refractive index waveguide and the traveling electron beam in vacuum was demonstrated. Optical emission around wavelength of 1.5 μm was observed for electron acceleration voltage of 40KV.

articleTitle: Optical properties of metamaterials composed from organic molecules and silver nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: First principle calculations of Ag nanoslab optical functions indicate strong contributions of the surface states to light absorption. Imaginary part of dielectric function responsible for losses is substantially modified due to adsorption of organic molecules.

articleTitle: A neural interface microsystem with all optical telemetry for brain implantable neuroengineering application
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed a prototype cortical neural interface device for brain implantable neuroengineering application, featuring fiber optic guided all optical telemetry for neural data transmission as well as power/clock delivery to the implantable unit.

articleTitle: Fabrication of sharp conical microstructures on Si films by Nd:YAG-laser single-pulse irradiation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Sharp Si micro-cones were obtained by single-pulse laser irradiation (Q-switched Nd:YAG, 4th harmonic), of thin crystalline Si films on insulating substrates. The formation is due to localized melting and is controllable with important technological implications.

articleTitle: Luminescent polymer waveguide amplifiers operating in the near-infrared
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Near-infrared optical gain in luminescent polymeric slab asymmetric waveguides has been investigated by use of amplified spontaneous emission. Upon nanosecond photopumping, the waveguides have shown a small-signal gain coefficient of 37.2 ± 2.1 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> at 820 nm for a pump fluence of 1.57 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (314 kW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). We show that a small-signal gain of 19.7 ± 2.3 dB is achievable in a 1.2-mm-long waveguide.

articleTitle: Nanocrystals in photonic crystal cavities for quantum information processing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By virtue of a silicon high-Q photonic crystal nanocavity, we propose and examine theoretically interactions between a stationary electron spin qubit of a semiconductor nanocrystal and a flying photon qubit.

articleTitle: Molecular interferometric imaging biosensor to study molecular interactions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Molecular interferometric imaging (MI2) approaches the single-molecule limit for label-free direct optical detection. It is simpler, cheaper and more sensitive than surface plasmon resonance for dynamic studies of molecular interactions.

articleTitle: Reduced blue shift in screening the quantum-confined stark effect of an InGaN/GaN quantum well with the prestrained growth of a light-emitting diode
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the reduced spectral blue shift in increasing injection current of an InGaN/GaN quantum-well light-emitting diode with prestrained growth and show that this effect is stronger when the prestained GaN barrier layer is thinner.

articleTitle: Recognition of double-stranded DNA by gold nanoprobes for malignant melanoma detection
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the detection of mutated BRAF gene expressed in malignant melanoma. We demonstrate the detection of short and long, single- and double-stranded DNAs using gold nanoprobes.

articleTitle: Enhancing the light extraction of InGaN light-emitting diodes by patterning the dicing streets
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Patterning the dicing streets technology was used to define the high extraction efficiency region of InGaN-GaN multiple-quantum-well light-emitting diodes (LEDs). The external quantum efficiency (EQE) of the LEDs at 20 mA increased by 12.9% because of the roughening of the passive region which enhanced the escape cone.

articleTitle: 3D optical data storage using third-harmonic generation in silver zinc phosphate glass
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the possibility of 3D optical data storage inside a zinc phosphate glass containing silver by using third-harmonic generation imaging. Information is stored inside the glass below the refractive index modification threshold.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a measurement-based quantum nondemolition interaction
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a quantum nondemolition (QND) interaction, based upon offline-prepared, squeezed ancilla states and homodyne measurements with feedforward. The resulting QND gate is verified via the criteria for QND measurements of each conjugate quadrature.

articleTitle: Terahertz quantum cascade lasers operating up to 178 K with copper metal-metal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report terahertz quantum cascade lasers, with a three-quantum-well active region design and copper metal-metal waveguides, operating up to a record temperature of 178 K. Their performance is compared to devices with gold metal-metal waveguides.

articleTitle: Remote sensing in optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a remotely-sensible optical coherence tomography (OCT) system. Its optical probe is accessible to tens-of-meter distance off the main OCT platform. This remote sensibility facilitates sharing a single high-quality OCT utility for multiple distant applications.

articleTitle: Optical waves on nano-particle chains coupled with metal-dielectric surfaces
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Nano-particle metal chains coupled with a metal-dielectric surface support traveling waves of several types. These traveling waves can be used to guide fields along the chain or to radiate surface wave beams along the surface.

articleTitle: Relativistic electron jets from laser-solid interactions at kilohertz repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Relativistic electron jets with energies up to 1.4 MeV are observed from the interaction of kHz laser pulses with SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> at 2times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The scaling of electron temperature with intensity is also presented for Al plasma.

articleTitle: Multimillijoule picosecond regenerative differentiator-amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: 150-ps-FWHM, 12-mJ pulses have been generated in a diode-pumped regenerative amplifier (DPRA) after differentiating a 3-ns-FWHM, SBS-steepened seeding pulse using a tunable Bragg grating filter as the DPRA resonator spectrally selective mirror.

articleTitle: Low-power light control with light in high Q/V silicon microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate critically coupled silicon microring resonators with intrinsic Q close to 300,000 and mode volume Vap20times(lambda/n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub>)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. For sub-mW optical power, large pump induced resonance shifts were observed for applications in all-optical switching.

articleTitle: Dynamics of gap solitons in random fiber gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that gap solitons self-average fluctuations in random gratings. The soliton trapping inside the grating is explained. The correlation functions of the force and the potential acting on the gap soliton are found.

articleTitle: Photorefractive two-wave mixing in Sn2P2S6:Te at 1.55 μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate fast photorefractive two-wave mixing with a cw-laser at the telecommunication wavelength 1.55 mum for the first time in a bulk ferroelectric crystal (Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>:Te). A high gain (6 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) was achieved without applying an external E-field.

articleTitle: Dissipative solitons of the Ginzburg-Landau equation in normal-dispersion fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Fiber lasers modelocked by filtering of a chirped pulse are analyzed with the Ginzburg-Landau equation. A range of experimental pulse shapes are predicted remarkably well by an exact analytical solution, and constitute dissipative temporal solitons.

articleTitle: Achromatic characteristics in 3-D Sagnac interferometer based on geometric phase shift
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A three-dimensional Sagnac interferometer based on geometric phase is constructed and its nulling characteristics are measured to be 5E-5 for green and red laser light simultaneously.

articleTitle: Combining near-infrared autofluorescence and Raman spectroscopy improves the in vivo detection of cervical precancer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the feasibility of combining near-infrared (NIR) autofluorescence and Raman spectroscopy to enhance the in vivo detection of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia.

articleTitle: Numerical simulations of Yb3+-doped, pulsed fiber amplifiers: Comparison with experiment
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have developed a numerical simulation of cw-pumped Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped fiber amplifiers seeded by pulses at 1064 nm. Results compare well to measurements of longitudinal upper-level ion populations and of output pulse energy versus pump power.

articleTitle: Generation of sub-two-cycle pulses in mid-infrared region by four-wave rectification in air
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Generation of mid-infrared pulses by four-wave mixing through filamentation in air has been demonstrated. The pulse width was measured as 13 fs, which corresponds to 1.3 optical cycles. The output energy reaches 1.5 μJ.

articleTitle: An on-chip Erbium doped three-photon upconversion silica microlaser emitting at green wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report an on-chip Erbium doped silica upconversion toroid laser. Pumped at Infrared wavelengths (1450 nm) with threshold power as low as 689 μW, the laser emits green light via continuously absorbing three pump photons.

articleTitle: Soliton molecules: Phase profiles and binding mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Temporal soliton molecules in dispersion-managed fibers are characterized with the new VAMPIRE technique. Based on the revealed phase and power profiles an analytical model is discussed to explain the binding mechanism of these stable compounds.

articleTitle: Modulation instability of coherent-incoherent mixtures
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study, experimentally and theoretically, the modulation instability of a mixture of coherent and spatially-incoherent beams. In contrast with incoherent-MI, which requires a threshold nonlinearity, we show that any amount of coherent component triggers instability.

articleTitle: Power dependence of Brillouin linewidths in a silica fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the dependence of Brillouin linewidths on the pump power below the threshold of Brillouin lasing in a silica fiber, and explain these experimental results by the distributed fluctuating source model.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation microscopy on the polyhedral inclusion bodies of nuclear polyhedrosis viruses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate second-harmonic-generation (SHG) microscopic imaging on the polyhedral inclusion bodies (PIB) of nucleopolyhedrovirus in living cells. Due to a body-centered-cubic arrangement of polyhedrin trimers, these PIBs generate SHG with polarization anisotropy.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics in silicon nitride waveguide device on silicon chip
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Silicon nitride /silicon dioxide waveguide using plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition is reported, which has the loss of ~4 dB/cm. A ring resonator using the waveguide gives the Q of 12,900 and its nonlinear response is studied.

articleTitle: Superconducting microwave cavities as quantum nanomechanical transducers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show how a superconducting coplanar microwave cavity can be used as a quantum limited displacement transducer for a nanomechanical resonator by demonstrating that nanomechanical squeezing can be detected in the cavity field.

articleTitle: Single-source interferometric multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering with a photonic crystal fiber light source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An interferometric multiplex coherent anti-Stokes scattering (iMCARS) system that utilizes the supercontinuum of a photonic crystal fiber as both the Stokes and local oscillator sources for broadband heterodyne detection is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Sub-5 fs pulse generation in vacuum ultraviolet using four wave mixing in hollow fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the potential of four-wave mixing for VUV pulse generation in hollow waveguides with unprecedented short pulse durations and predict the generation of a 2.5 fs pulse at 160 nm using a 10 fs, 800 nm idler.

articleTitle: The first attosecond pulse train reconstruction of high-order harmonics from laser ablation plasma
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present in this work the first attosecond pulse train reconstruction of high-order harmonics generated from plasma. We demonstrate that, as with gas medium, plasma medium can also be used to generate attosecond pulses in the extreme ultraviolet range. We generate harmonics from chromium plasma, with five harmonics between the 11<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> to the 19<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order. By using the method of Reconstruction of Attosecond Beating by Interference of Two-photon Transitions (RABBIT), we characterize attosecond pulse trains with 300 as duration. This result shows that without using any synchronization method, the five harmonics we generate in chromium plasma had attosecond pulse duration.

articleTitle: Fibre implementation of a Controlled-NOT gate
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a fibre implementation of a controlled-NOT gate using a fibre source of heralded single photons and three partially polarising couplers. We then estimate the bounds for the quantum process fidelity of this gate.

articleTitle: Self-trapping of optical vortices in photonic lattices optically induced with self-defocusing nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate self-trapping of singly- and doubly-charged vortices in a self-defocusing “backbone” photonic lattice. While the singly-charged vortex can evolve into a gap vortex soliton, the doubly-charged tends to turn into quasi-vortex or quadrupole structure.

articleTitle: On-chip spectroscopy using compact silicon microring resonators integrated with microfluidic channels
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate on-chip absorption spectroscopy using silicon microring resonators with integrated microfluidic channels. Using a 40 mum radius resonator with Q>15,000 we show absorption spectra of less than 90 nL volumes of water and methanol from 1460 nm-1560 nm.

articleTitle: Transition from bright to dark, and from discrete to gap spatial solitons by varying optical beam orientation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that a nonconventionally biased photorefractive crystal can support one-dimensional spatial solitons. Transition from bright to dark, and from discrete to gap solitons is realized for the first time by varying optical beam orientation.

articleTitle: Singlemode crystalline fibers for the middle infrared
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Microstructured and step-index fibers from silver halides singlemode at 10.6 mum and 5.5 mum are demonstrated. Experimental and theoretical evidences are presented to establish that the step-index fibers are singlemode at 10.6 mum.

articleTitle: Harnessing attosecond science for visualizing the nanoworld
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: New science and technology is enabled by manipulating and controlling electrons on attosecond timescales. Applications range from new table-top sources of coherent x-rays, to high-resolution tabletop coherent imaging of molecules, nanostructures, and materials.

articleTitle: Scalings for narrow-band MeV proton beams from laser plasmas
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Monoenergetic proton beams were obtained from laser-plasma interactions with unprecedented reproducibility. From hundreds of spectra, we derive an empirical scaling law between proton peak position and laser energy. The results are supported PIC simulations.

articleTitle: Plasmonic filters with IR windows of transparency
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Plasmonic filters were fabricated based on gold fractal nanostructures grown on silica microspheres. The fractal nanostructures were modified using laser irradiation, resulting in decreased extinction in the mid-infrared range.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of a mid infra-red photonic crystal defect laser in indium antimonide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This paper presents 2D FDTD modelling and prototype fabrication of a mid-infrared photonic crystal defect laser. The device is fabricated using a two stage focused ion beam process which results in improved hole profiles.

articleTitle: Phase detection of pulsed narrowband THz-wave radiation with high sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate highly sensitive coherent detection of a monochromatic THz-wave pulse at room temperature using the frequency up-conversion in MgO:LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> combined with balanced homodyne detection. Both the intensity and phase of THz radiation are measured.

articleTitle: Optical tweezers with resonant particles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optical tweezers are typically used on transparent dielectric particles. Particles with optical resonances would experience larger trapping forces and allow trapping of smaller particles. We present a study of increased trapping forces on such particles.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of photonic bandgap tuning in mixed photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated that the photonic bandedges of a mixed photonic crystal system shift monotonically as the mixing composition ratio is varied. Results are in excellent agreement with the virtual crystal approximation.

articleTitle: 1 GeV electron beams from a laser-driven channel-guided accelerator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: GeV-class electron beams generated from laser wakefield accelerator with 40 TW laser pulses using a 33 mm hydrogen-based capillary discharge waveguide. Stable 0.5 GeV e-beams can produce bright radiation from THz to X-rays.

articleTitle: High bandwidth H2O absorption spectroscopy in a flame using a dispersed supercontinuum source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A dispersed near-IR supercontinuum source has been developed, which is capable of acquiring 120 nm wide line-of-sight absorption spectra of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O, in combustion gases, at 5 kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: High noise rejection filter using complementary ring resonators on silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a high noise rejection filter using complementary ring resonators. The device has a much higher signal/noise ratio than a single ring resonator and can be used as a low noise electro-optic modulator.

articleTitle: Aspheric lenses for Terahertz imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present novel lens designs for Terahertz imaging. Kirchhoffpsilas diffraction theory and experimental results show that the achievable resolution depends critically on the lens shape, and a resolution of close to lambda/2 can be achieved.

articleTitle: Numerical and experimental demonstration of a single-fiber probe for optical trapping and analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We numerically analyze and experimentally show the use of an innovative fiber-tweezer based on total internal reflection. By using the realized structure, simultaneous 3D trapping and fluorescence measurements are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generation of uncorrelated photon-pairs in an optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally the realization of heralded pure photons generation in a birefringent optical fiber.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nanocavity for interaction with colloidal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose to use low group velocitymodes on a surface plasmon grating tomediate emission from colloidal quantum dots. We demonstrate the modification of emission wavelength and coupling as the grating periodicity is changed.

articleTitle: Carrier multiplication in nanocrystal quantum dots and solar energy conversion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: This paper discusses aspects of carrier multiplication (multiexciton generation by single photons) in semiconductor nanocrystals such as its mechanism, competing relaxation channels, ultimate efficiencies for photon-to-exciton conversion and implications of this process in photovoltaics.

articleTitle: Optical trapping platform based on highly confining silicon waveguiding structures with microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate strongly enhanced optical trapping forces on sub-micron-diameter dielectric spheres within a pressure-driven microfluidic flow of several hundred mum/s using the evanescent field of the light in silicon waveguides.

articleTitle: Room temperature polariton lasing and BEC in semiconductor microcavities
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Strongly-coupled GaN semiconductor microcavities exhibit polariton effects at room temperature. We show sub-mW thresholds for coherent polariton lasing at 300 K, and discuss polarization evidence for the formation of Bose-Einstein polariton condensates.

articleTitle: Experiments on the 3D disordered Bose-Hubbard model
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An optical speckle field is used to add fine-grained disorder to a 3D optical lattice. We have begun to constrain the disordered Bose-Hubbard phase diagram by studying Bose-Einstein condensates in a disordered lattice.

articleTitle: Correlation detection of photonically-generated ultra-wideband radio-frequency waveforms over wireless link
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report correlation measurements of ultra-wideband radio-frequency signals dispersion precompensated for transmission over a short antenna link. Experimental auto- and cross-correlations of upchirped and down-chirped electrical waveforms demonstrate high contrast.

articleTitle: First and second order coherence of exciton-polariton condensates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We investigate the first and second order coherence of exciton-polariton condensates both in coordinate and momentum space. The measured correlations provide insights into the phase and intensity fluctuations induced by polariton interactions.

articleTitle: High small-signal modulation bandwidth and narrow linewidth microdisk lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In this report, microdisk lasers with -3dB small-signal modulation bandwidths in excess of 17 GHz are demonstrated. Linewidth of these lasers are also measured and a minimum linewidth of 85 MHz is achieved.

articleTitle: Laser action in bulk Nd3+-doped telluride glass
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report on the first observation of lasing in bulk Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped (0.8)TeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-(0.2)WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> glass at 1065 nm. Gain-switched operation was obtained with a slope efficiency of 12% at a pulse repetition rate of 1 kHz.

articleTitle: Ultrafast phase-transition induced by selective vibrational excitation in a magnetoresistive manganite
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that selective excitation of a phonon mode induces an insulator-metal phase transition in a magnetoresistive manganite. The dynamics of such phase transformation are studied by optical pump-probe, transport and X-ray absorption measurements.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Full field imaging and spectroscopy of individual gold nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a method using either laser or white evanescent illumination combined to spatial modulation and camera lock-in detection allowing the measurement of scattering images and spectra of individual gold nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Ultrafast reflectivity dynamics in bis (n-butylimido) perylene thin films
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using pump-probe reflectometry, we study the ultrafast excited-state dynamics in thin films of BuPTCD, an organic semiconductor, deposited on gold nanoparticles. We observe depletion of the ground state and excited state absorption after photo-excitation.

articleTitle: Dual-wavelength interband cascade lasers in midinfrared spectral region
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the world-first successful demonstration of widely spaced dual wavelength interband cascade lasers operating simultaneously in continuous wave near 3.5 and 4.5 microns.

articleTitle: Spectral behavior of three-photon absorption in zinc-blende semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The three-photon absorption (3PA) spectrum of ZnSe was measured using femtosecond Z-scans and theoretically verified using a Kane 4-band model including nonparabolicity and nonzone-center wave functions. Several other semiconductors with various bandgap energies are presented.

articleTitle: Compact node for selective surface plasmon coupling to orthogonal planar metallic wires
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A node for coupling surface plasmons onto planar layers of metallic nanowires is studied via numerical calculations. Coupling to orthogonal arms of wires can be switched by interfering differently-polarized beams incident upon the node.

articleTitle: Development of high damage threshold apodizers for laser applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using laser ablation of a transmissive fused silica window, high damage threshold apodizers were produced in order to modify the spatial and amplitude profile of a high energy laser beam.

articleTitle: Composition dependence of infrared optical phonon modes in AlGaN epilayers grown on sapphire substrates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We reported the systematical study of optical anisotropy of Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>N epitaxial films grown on sapphire using FTIR measurements. The experimental data can be theoretically fitted by employing a four-phase layered model. Several specific absorption dips were observed when the aluminum composition is larger than 24%. The dip intensity increases with the aluminum compositions. According to the reciprocal space map measurements, these dips may be induced due to the effects of strain relaxation in AlGaN epitaxial layers.

articleTitle: Laser power locking for improvement of carrier-envelope phase stability
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The pulse energy fluctuation of a kilohertz femtosecond laser was reduced from 1.33% RMS to 0.28% RMS, which improves the carrier-envelope phase stability from 500 mrad to 200 mrad.

articleTitle: Fiber-optical analogue of the event horizon
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a realistic scheme for an artificial event horizon in optics with ultrashort pulses in microstructured fibers that can probe the quantum effects of horizons, particularly Hawking radiation. We also show experimental progress.

articleTitle: Diffraction-managed solitons and nonlinear beam diffusion in modulated waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first experimental observation of nonlinear beam diffusion and formation of diffraction-managed solitons in periodically-curved arrays of coupled optical waveguides created using femtosecond laser writing in silica glass, and titanium indiffusion in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> crystals.

articleTitle: Highly thermally responsive hybrid in-fiber slab waveguide grating structure with a plastic core and a silica cladding
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A 1.2(height)times125(depth)times500(length) micro-slot was engraved along a fiber Bragg grating by chemically assisted femtosecond laser processing. By filling epoxy and UV-curing, waveguide with plastic-core and silica-cladding was created, presenting high thermal responding coefficient of 211pm/degC.

articleTitle: Interference pattern formation in the second-order intensity correlation with beams orthogonally polarized
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Considering the polarization state of the pseudothermal light beams, we demonstrate that the nonlocal second-order interference pattern formation does not depend on the polarization of the beams crossing the different parts of a distributed double-slit.

articleTitle: Three-photon absorption in MgO-doped LiNbO3 crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Three-photon absorption in MgO-doped LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> crystal has been investigated using the Z-scan and pump-probe techniques with femtosecond pulses at 780-nm wavelength. The microscopic origin for the observed optical nonlinearity is discussed.

articleTitle: Forward Brillouin scattering in tapered optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally study forward Brillouin scattering in tapered fibers. Circularly symmetric acoustic phonons resonant in fibers are observed by using a novel photoacoustic measurement technique. Strong acousto-optic interaction can take place in highly tapered fibers.

articleTitle: Dynamics of the Dielectric Function in fs-Laser Excited Bismuth
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Time-resolved study of the dielectric function of femtosecond laser excited bismuth demonstrates that excitation of coherent phonons leads to a solid-plasma phase transition, and into a quasi-stable excited state lasting up to 4 ns.

articleTitle: Quasi-coplanar plasmonic waveguide for ultracompact photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a novel metal-dielectric structure called quasi-coplanar waveguide for subwavelength scale confinement and guiding of surface plasmon-polaritons. 2D/3D simulations show that various nanoscale photonic integrated circuit elements can be implemented with the structure.

articleTitle: Optical amplification and lasing in self-written active waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A novel type of self-formed active waveguide structure is proposed. The waveguides are self-aligned with input/output fibers and can be easily made to have optical feedback cavities. The optical amplification and laser oscillation were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Transient laser brightness enhancement using a large-stroke bimorph mirror
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A large-stroke bimorph was used to reduce the time-to-full brightness of a Nd:YLF laser by a factor of 3. The 31-element mirror has the potential to combine this transient control with steady state brightness optimisation.

articleTitle: Band structure of terahertz metallic photonic crystals with high metal filling factor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The band structure of two-dimensional photonic crystals consisting of metallic cylinders is investigated both experimentally and by numerical simulations. The crystals show large photonic band gaps in the terahertz spectral range.

articleTitle: Transmission of a chaos-masked signal with in-line all-optical wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In this paper we demonstrate wavelength-conversion, of a message masked by additive chaos, along a transmission line. This result shows that chaos-based communications are compatible with channel-switching and wavelength-conversion as required in reconfigurable networks.

articleTitle: Equilateral-triangle-resonator mid-infrared laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Single-mode, continuous-wave, electrically-injected, GaSb based, 2.1 mum, equilateral-triangle-resonator lasers with a wavelength tuning range of 3.25 nm are demonstrated at 77 K.

articleTitle: Paired electromagnetically induced transparency with dual mode laser: A step towards EIT-Comb
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Coupled electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) has been observed with a dual mode control laser. The technique can be used for generating EIT-comb from optical frequency comb.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional motion of a nanoparticle on the cell membrane observed by non-interferometric widefield optical profilometry
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We directly observe three-dimensional motion of a gold nanoparticle on the membrane of a living cell by using non-interferometric widefield optical profilometry. We identify the occurrence of particle internalization and actin aggregation which indicates endocytosis.

articleTitle: All-optical quasi-phase-Matching techniuqes in high-harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Weak counter-propagating pulse trains or multiple quasi-cw waves can induce complex amplitude and phase modulated structures in the high-harmonic field. These ldquophotonicrdquo structures can be used for quasi-phase-matching the high-harmonic generation process.

articleTitle: Raman spectroscopy of nanoparticles in photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Photonic crystal fibers were demonstrated as an optimal platform for enhancing the Raman signals to study nanoparticles properties in liquids. Raman was used to analyze stages of low concentrations of ZnO nanoparticles growth in solution.

articleTitle: Experimental quantum state estimation with mutually unbiased bases
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first experiment in two-qubit quantum state tomography to take advantage of the power of mutually unbiased bases (MUBs). These bases are optimal for extracting the maximum amount of information about a state from some finite number of measurements. With experimental data and simulation we show that mutually unbiased bases can generally allow better state estimation than the standard set of measurements and discuss the relative advantages of different sets of bases.

articleTitle: Towards coherent pulse synthesis using independently tunable femtosecond oscillators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Pulses at 780 nm from a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator and its Ti:sapphire pump laser were phase-locked as a prerequisite to coherent synthesis at different wavelengths. Coherence was demonstrated using spectral interferometry and interferometric cross-correlation.

articleTitle: Terahertz birefringence of β-BaB2O4 (BBO) crystal
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Birefringence was observed for a beta-BaB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystal in the 0.1 to 1.1 terahertz region. The calculated Deltan value was ~0.296. Moreover, an angle-dependent absorption band observed at ~0.65 terahertz is attributed to low-frequency phonon modes.

articleTitle: Experimental quantum detector tomography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first quantum tomography of a detector, using as examples an avalanche photodiode and a photon-number resolving detector. The resulting POVM set agrees well with one derived from a model of the detector.

articleTitle: Efficient output at 4600 nm in Dy:chalcogenide glass fiber laser with cascade lasing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The output power at 4600 nm in a Dy:chalcogenide glass fiber laser is found through numerical simulations to be significantly enhanced with simultaneous lasing at 3300 nm.

articleTitle: Terahertz quantum cascade lasers: Design and applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Operation of terahertz quantum cascade lasers have now been demonstrated between 1.2 and 4.9 THz. Extremely narrow linewidths and continuous tunability have been reported, with applications in imaging, radio-astronomy and process control.

articleTitle: First optical observation of periodic motion of native human cancer cells
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: It is difficult to observe motions of living cells directly because of their transparency. With the aid of a highly sensitive detector, we are able to observe periodic cellular motions by measuring the scattered light.

articleTitle: Plasmonics-based design: combining surface-enhanced Raman and IR spectroscopies into the same structure
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Plasmonic nanostructures are useful for providing high-intensity fields at metal surfaces for surface enhanced spectroscopies. Plasmon hybridization principles are used to design substrates that enhance both Raman and infrared absorption spectroscopy on the same structure.

articleTitle: Observation of hot electron beams in intense laser-solid interactions characterized with coherent transition radiation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Coherent transition radiation was observed from aluminum foils irradiated by an ultra-intense laser. Comparison of experiments and theoretical calculations indicated two streams of hot electron micro-pulses were generated by resonance absorption and jtimesB heating.

articleTitle: Observation of soliton tunneling phenomena and soliton emission
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study, theoretically and experimentally, nonlinear dynamics of a wavepacket launched inside a potential well. Increasing the power of the wavepacket transforms its dynamics from linear tunneling, to soliton tunneling, and eventually to soliton emission.

articleTitle: Monolithic ytterbium all-single-mode fiber laser with direct fiber-end delivery of nJ-level femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithic, i.e. without any free-space coupling, all-single-mode passively modelocked Yb-fiber laser, with direct fiber-end delivery of 364-405 fs pulses of 4 nJ pulse energy using a low-loss hollow-core photonic crystal fiber compression.

articleTitle: High-speed single-mode photonic crystal VCSEL design
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A photonic crystal fabricated into ion-implanted VCSELs can engineer the spatial overlap between the optical mode and gain for improved high speed operation and reduced relative intensity noise. The ion-implanted aperture should be les 4 um larger than the optical aperture to avoid excessive electrical parasitics.

articleTitle: Study of the dipole-dipole interaction between metallic nanowires trapped using optoelectronic tweezers (OET)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a study of dipole-dipole interaction between silver nanowires trapped using optoelectronic tweezers. Measurement of the maximum repulsion force between nanowires and self-assembly of nanowires to achieve the lowest potential energy configuration are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Theory and experiment in ultraintense laser-matter interaction in nanostructured Ni-nanowire targets
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Nickel nanowires present >90% absorption in an effective skin-depth ~1 mum, making efficient X-ray converters. We present new theoretical and experimental results for intensities from small-signal up to very clean relativistic pulses.

articleTitle: Effect of jitter on linear self-referencing pulse-characterization techniques
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The accuracy of modulator-based linear implementations of spectral shearing interferometry, simplified chronocyclic tomography, and spectrography when jitter is present on the electric modulator drive is studied analytically and simulated.

articleTitle: Saturation of second harmonic generation in plasmon-coupled GaAs-filled hole arrays
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Second harmonic generation (SH) based on the enhancement of localized fields confined in nanoscale periodic, GaAs-filled holes in a metal film is presented. The SH saturates for a fundamental peak power intensity ≫ 20 GW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Ultrafast electroabsorption dynamics in a GaInNAs quantum well waveguide at 1.3μm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Time-resolved electro-absorption is reported for the first time in a GaInNAs quantum well p-i-n waveguide at 1.3 mum. A recovery of 55 ps demonstrates the potential for optical modulator devices.

articleTitle: 10-watt, single-mode, single-frequency, 1.03 μm Yb3+-doped phosphate fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe the first 10-W single-mode, single-frequency Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped phosphate fiber amplifier.
