The fiber is doped with 12 wt% Yb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and only 47.5-cm long. A 25-W phosphate fiber laser with 52.7% slope efficiency is also reported.

articleTitle: Smallest modal volume integrated dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a bowtie geometry in a silicon planar resonator with an ultra-small modal volume .01(lambda/2n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. Bowtie, ring resonators and 1D and 2D photonic crystal resonators are compared for tradeoffs in confinement and quality factors.

articleTitle: Perfect 900 bending and 4-ways memoryless splitting of plasmons in a nano-junction
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Plasmonic wave is perfectly split to 4 identical waves when encountering nano intersection. This is substantially different from photonic waveguides exhibiting negligible coupling to vertical segments. Larger plasmonic junction is exhibiting retardation and memory effects.

articleTitle: Full characterization of an ultrahigh-repetition-rate train of ultrashort pulses generated with phase-coherent Raman sidebands
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We generate a train of highly-stable ultrashort-pulses with a repetition-rate of 10.6 THz by synthesizing phase-coherent rotational-Raman-sidebands in para-hydrogen. We show full characterization of its temporal waveform based on a frequency-resolved-optical-gating method.

articleTitle: Fast hyperspectral imaging using a mid-infrared tunable external cavity quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A hyperspectral imaging system using an external cavity quantum cascade laser and a focal plane array acquiring images at 25 Hz from 985 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> to 1075 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> with a resolution of 0.3 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Concealed object detection by sensing the objects’ acoustic phase with terahertz radiation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a novel terahertz technique for detecting concealed objects by sensing their individual acoustic phase lags when they perform a minute oscillation. The technique is sensitive to virtually all materials.

articleTitle: Observation of an intensity dependent minimum and harmonic dependent linewidths in the high harmonic spectrum of N2
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe an intensity dependent minimum and harmonic dependent linewidths in the high harmonic spectrum of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The quantum mechanical origin of these features and their relevance to molecular orbital reconstruction is discussed.

articleTitle: Polarization changes in diffraction from planar periodic patterns with pure structural and molecular chirality
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We prepare diffractive arrays of metal nanoparticles that possess molecular and structural chirality. Both cases lead to comparative chiral polarization effects, which must be interpreted as arising from chirality of the experimental setup.

articleTitle: Time-gated infrared fourier-domain optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: By combining incoherent time gating (sum-frequency mixing) with coherent gating (optical coherence tomography), we process light backscattered from a sample in the optical domain to improve imaging contrast by 29 dB.

articleTitle: Dispersive pulse compression in hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Dispersive pulse compression in a hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber is studied numerically. The limits to peak power for high pulse quality arising from fiber nonlinearities are investigated, along with the validity of approximate scaling relations.

articleTitle: Nitrous oxide isotope ratio determination by mid-infrared laser spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A fiber-coupled difference frequency generation laser spectrometer for measuring isotopic compositions of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O at trace concentrations is presented. Using wavelength modulation 9<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> precision at 100 ppm is achieved. The accuracy is demonstrated with enriched samples.

articleTitle: Bistability and ultrafast mode switching in microlasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: General theoretical principles for bistability in micro lasers are fonnulated. Bistable lasing is reponed between modes with similar spatial intensity profiles in coupled microcavities, allowing wavelength switching by several nanometers on an ultrafast, picosecond time scale.

articleTitle: Theory of rapid-update line-by-line pulse shaping
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Pulse shaping theory is extended to include rapid waveform update for line-by-line pulse shaping. The fundamental trade-off between response speed and waveform fidelity is illustrated through simulation.

articleTitle: Parametric amplification in electromagnetically induced transparency
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: In an ordinary electromagnetically-induced-transparency setup in sodium vapor, we have observed a probe gain up to 15, attributable to the parametric amplification, accompanying the Stokes (or anti-Stokes) wave with similar output intensity.

articleTitle: Laser and self-doubling operations in a Nd:YCOB sphere
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report experimental results on a laser based on a Nd:YCOB crystal cut as a sphere inserted between two plane mirrors. It is being used as a unique tool for the direct characterization of self-doubling.

articleTitle: Effective amplification of real WDM burst traffic using optical gain clamping
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Experimental studies of real optical burst traffic in WDM systems are performed with optical gain clamping for stabilizing the EDFA amplification. Impairments of power variation due to burst are shown to be negligible.

articleTitle: Hybrid microdisk laser on a silicon platform using lateral-field optoelectronic tweezers assembly
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An InGaAs/InGaAsP microdisk laser is assembled on silicon using lateral-field optoelectronic tweezers, achieving room-temperature pulsed operation with a threshold power of 0.85 mW. The room-temperature assembly enables a post-CMOS process to fabricate micro-lasers on silicon.

articleTitle: 107-GHz Resonance Frequency of 1.55-μm VCSELs under ultra-high optical injection locking
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a record resonance frequency enhancement of 1.55-μm VCSELs from 10 GHz to 107 GHz under ultra-high optical injection locking. Detuning and injection-ratio dependence are characterized to show the broad applicability of the technique.

articleTitle: Tunable millimeter wave generation using a dual-band fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a compact millimeter wave signal generator based on a phase-modulated laser and a dual-band fiber Bragg grating (FBG). Two optical sidebands of a phase-modulated spectrum propagate through two transmission windows temporarily open in a chirped FBG (CFBG) by inducing localized temperature variations. The millimeter wave frequency is tuned by the separate adjustment of each temperature profile.

articleTitle: PbS quantum dot photoluminescence quenching induced by an applied bias
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that a DC voltage applied on a PbS quantum dot embedded organic light emitting diode can partially quench the quantum dot photoluminescence and propose a way to avoid this quenching.

articleTitle: Flexible, large-area metamaterials fabricated on thin silicon nitride membranes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present terahertz metamaterials fabricated on large-area, free-standing thin (les1 mum) silicon nitride membranes with the aim of reducing dielectric losses, enhancing metamaterial sensing capabilities, and enabling flexible and conformable designs.

articleTitle: Impact of receiver imperfections on the performance of coherent intradyne DQPSK receivers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We theoretically investigate the impact of 90deg optical hybrid and balanced detector imperfections on the performance of a coherent intradyne DQPSK system using feedforward frequency and phase estimation.

articleTitle: Integration of magneto-optic garnet waveguides and polarizers for optical isolators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: YIG waveguides and polarizers were integrated monolithically onto semiconductors. The waveguide losses were 1.55 dB/mm with Faraday rotations of 0.2dB/mm. Birefringence was minimized by optimized etching. Photonic crystal polarizers and biasing films completed the isolator.

articleTitle: High efficiency CARS conversion in silicon
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate unprecedented wavelength conversion efficiency of 58% from coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) in a silicon waveguide. CARS is modeled by incorporating Raman scattering and free carrier effects into the nonlinear Schrodinger equation.

articleTitle: Tunable THz source based on intracavity parametric down-conversion in quasi-phase-matched GaAs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We developed an efficient frequency-tunable THz source using intracavity mixing between the two resonant waves of a synchronously pumped doubly resonant OPO. Three types of quasi-phase-matched GaAs were utilized: optically contacted, orientation-patterned, and diffusion-bonded GaAs.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared lasers and the Kruse-Mie theorem in fog for free-space optical communication applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that in NYC metro fog mid-infrared systems transmit over 300% more power and have 3times greater range than conventional FSO systems. We report that the benchmark Kruse-Mie theorem underestimates mid-infrared systems by +200%.

articleTitle: Slow light total-internal-reflection optical switch with 90-degree bend
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a novel optical switch with slowing light in Bragg reflector waveguide. Slowing light gives us large equivalent refractive index change due to its waveguide dispersion, which permits 90-degree bend of crossbar optical switches.

articleTitle: Optofluidic 1×4 switch
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optofluidic 1×4 switch made of a blazed grating in silicon elastomer integrated with microfluidic channel was designed, fabricated and tested. Experiments show 1.7dB insertion loss, extinction ratio of 9.8dB, and response time 60 ms.

articleTitle: Observation of THz emission from InAs nanowires
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report THz emission from free standing InAs nanowires. The radiation is attributed to coherent plasmon motion excited by ultrashort laser pulses and exhibits power enhancement and spectral red-shift compared to an InAs planar surface.

articleTitle: 268 nm period bragg gratings and integrated circuits produced by direct UV writing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate 268 nm period planar Bragg gratings and Mach-Zehnder interferometers fabricated by direct UV-writing. Grating reflectivities of ~30 dB and FWHM of ~0.16 nm were measured at operational wavelengths around 800 nm.

articleTitle: Fourier domain mode locking theory
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a theoretical model for the recently developed Fourier domain mode locked (FDML) lasers. The good agreement with experiment provides valuable insights into the mechanism of FDML operation.

articleTitle: 640 Gb/s RZ eye-diagram evaluation by optical sampling oscilloscope w/o post-processing and ms refresh time
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A polarization insensitive quasi-asynchronous optical sampling oscilloscope with sub-ps-resolution is presented. The scheme is able to resolve tens of ns and provides eye-diagram functionality. Experimental results for a 640 Gb/s data frame are reported.

articleTitle: Transverse patterns for all-optical switching
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Transverse optical patterns, generated by nonlinear interactions, rotate in the presence of a weak switch beam. Using an experimental system with increased symmetry, we observe that the switch can be actuated by ~2100 photons.

articleTitle: Low-loss, InP-based integrated optical isolators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We discuss the development of a monolithically integratable optical isolator. The device is a semiconductor optical amplifier with a magnetized ferromagnetic metal contact. 12.7 dB of isolation combined with optical transparency has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Temperature and pressure compensated microfluidic optical sensor
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a robust double-capillary microfluidic ring resonator optical sensor imbedded into a solid polymer matrix. The device is capable of compensating the temperature and pressure variations and can be generalized to a multi-capillary lab-on-a-chip.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis of high speed semiconductor optical amplifier using tunneling injection structure
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a SOA with a tunnel injection structure and analyze the operation properties. High-speed carrier recovery was suggested in the tunnel-injection SOA. The results indicate tunnel-injection SOAs have a potential of high-speed operation.

articleTitle: Influence of group velocity dispersion on phase-preserving amplitude regeneration by a nonlinear amplifying loop mirror
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The influence of dispersion of the highly nonlinear fiber in the loop of a nonlinear amplifying loop mirror on its performance as a 2R regenerator for phase-encoded optical signals has been studied.

articleTitle: Tunable optical parametric oscillator controlled by a transversely chirped Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a novel technique for locking and tuning of a near-degenerate OPO using a transversely chirped Bragg grating. The signal tuning range was 997-1016 nm and the maximum signal energy was 0.7 mJ.

articleTitle: 15-W reliable operation of 96-μm aperture broad-area diode lasers emitting at 980 nm
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: High-power broad area diode lasers emitting at 980 nm with a maximum output power of 20 W at 15degC and with reliable operation over 2000 h at 15 W and 25degC will be presented.

articleTitle: Mode locked 1550 nm VECSEL using a two quantum wells GaInNAs Saturable Absorber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report a 2 GHz mode locked vertical external cavity surface emitting laser using a hybrid metal-metamorphic Bragg mirror on the gain structure with a resonant two quantum wells GaInNAs semiconductor saturable absorber mirror (SESAM).

articleTitle: Full stabilization of a frequency comb generated in a monolithic microcavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate independent control and full stabilization of the offset frequency and mode spacing of a frequency comb generated in a monolithic microcavity. The comb lines relative deviation from equidistance is less than 7.3times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-18</sup>.

articleTitle: Ultra high extinction-ratio and ultra low chirp optical intensity modulation for pure two-tone lightwave signal generation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Pure two-tone signal generation with spurious suppression ratio of 47 dB was demonstrated by using an optical Mach-Zehnder modulator with precisely balanced operation, where extinction ratio and chirp parameter were respectively 64 dB and 0.0099.

articleTitle: Double-layered monolithic silicon photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Double-layered, self-aligned, silicon photonic crystals are fabricated using directional and isotropic etches - a potential step towards 3D PCs. One structure shows sharper resonances compared to corresponding single layer structure. Another shows high, broadband reflectivity.

articleTitle: Weak coherent state homodyne detection with sequential I-Q measurements
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We design and implement an optical phase estimator for carrier synchronization of a homodyne receiver for weak coherent states, based on sequential I-Q measurements. We report experimental results on performance in BER and phase-number uncertainty.

articleTitle: 60 GHz millimeter-wave generation by two-mode injection-locked Fabry-Perot laser using second-order sideband injection in radio-over-fiber system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A scheme of two-mode injection-locked Fabry-Perot laser using second-order sideband injection is investigated, which can be used for 60 GHz millimeter-wave generation in radio-over-fiber system. Modulation response enhancement of Fabry-Perot lasers is also experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Spatially-resolved thermal coupling in VCSEL arrays using thermoreflectance microscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Thermoreflectance microscopy is used for simultaneous, spatially-resolved temperature measurements of VCSELs in a 1D array. Significant thermal effects such as thermal coupling between neighboring VCSELs and temperature distribution across the apertures are reported.

articleTitle: NRZ-OOK transmission of 16×40 Gb/s over 2800 km SSMF using asynchronous phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We use the cost-effective APM technique to increase the non-linear tolerance of NRZ-OOK, and we demonstrate, in a recirculating loop experiment, the transmission over 2800 km SSMF of 16 NRZ-OOK 40 Gb/s channels with 100 GHz spacing.

articleTitle: Development of laser based spectroscopic trace-gas sensors for environmental sensor networks and medical exposure monitors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report wavelength modulated TDLAS/QEPAS trace gas sensors with reduced size, efficiency, and cost for use in environmental sensor networks and medical exposure monitors. CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> measurements with a 2 mum diode laser dissipate <1 W.

articleTitle: Tunable delays via conversion-dispersion using on-chip four-wave-mixing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate tunable optical delays of 10 Gbit/s data pulses over a total range of 12 ns using a combination of wavelength conversion via four-wave-mixing on a silicon chip and a dispersive element.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal characterization of the signal pulse-shortening in Type II optical parametric amplifier using BBO and BIBO crystals
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Comparison of the performance of an optical parametric amplifier is presented using BBO or BIBO crystals in Type II. The spatio-temporal effect of the parametric pulse-shortening is experimentally investigated with respect to the signal wavelength.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal heterostructure cavity lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate the lasing characteristics of a photonic crystal heterostructure cavity. Feedback to slow Bloch modes using a heterostructure confinement design produces single mode lasing at 1551 nm.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nano-laser based on metallic bowtie cavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a nano-laser utilizing a cylindrical bowtie cavity. The low threshold current and nanometer-scale confinement of the lasing mode are achievable due to the field enhancement from plasmonic and curvature effects of bowtie tips.

articleTitle: Ultrafast fiber amplifier systems: Status, perspectives and applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We will discuss the status of high repetition rate high energy femtosecond fiber laser systems, review their scaling potential in terms of average power, pulse energy and peak power. First micro-machining applications demonstrate the potential of this laser technology.

articleTitle: Conductivity of thin metal films at THz frequencies
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The conductivity of thin metal films was measured via their transmission at THz frequencies. The conductivity of all the films, particularly the thinner films and Al films, were much smaller than the bulk DC value.

articleTitle: New aspects of temporal dispersion in Virtually Imaged Phased Array (VIPA) based Fourier pulse shapers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present new aspects of temporal dispersion in high resolution Fourier pulse shapers using VIPA based setups as a representative example. These effects should become significant in grating based setups when bandwidths approach an octave.

articleTitle: High-speed chromatic dispersion monitoring of a two-channel WDM system using a single TPA microcavity
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Chromatic dispersion monitoring of two 160 Gb/s wavelength channels using a TPA Microcavity is presented. As the microcavity exhibits a wavelength resonance characteristic, a single device could monitor a number of different WDM-channels sequentially.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse shaping on two-color laser superposition pulse using a MEMS Micromirror SLM
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a nova pulse shaping scheme of two-color omega + 2omega pulses using a MEMS Micromirror SLM. This scheme enables synchronous phase & amplitude modulation over two-color femtosecond asymmetric optical e-field pulses.

articleTitle: Self-referenced fCEO stabilization of a low noise femtosecond fiber oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We spectrally broaden a low phase noise Yb-femtosecond similariton fiber oscillator to more than an octave bandwidth. Using the f-2f self-referencing scheme we detect and stabilize its carrier envelope offset frequency.

articleTitle: Planar and vertical Si nanowire photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate scalable Si nanowire photodetectors that function as phototransistors. Etched planar and vertical Si nanowire photodetectors have been fabricated and characterized, showing high (≫35,000) internal gain under UV illumination.

articleTitle: Data inversion and adjustable chirp in 10-Gbps directly-modulated injection-locked 1.55-μm VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate adjustable chirp of directly-modulated injection-locked VCSELs at 10-Gbps resulting from a novel data pattern inversion phenomenon, which leads to chromatic dispersion compensation and a 10X distance increase over standard single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Use of polarization in InP-based integrated optics
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The development of integrated polarization manipulating devices opens the perspective on the use of polarization as a new design dimension in InP-based integrated optics. Examples will be given of how this results in additional functionalities.

articleTitle: Real-time blood analysis using Coherent Anti-Stokes Raman Scattering
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a real-time method of blood analysis. Using a novel coherent Raman technique we record the vibrational spectrum from picoliters of whole blood in milliseconds. This method will allow real-time, in vivo, blood monitoring.

articleTitle: Coherent transfer of light polarization to electron spins in a semiconductor — toward quantum media conversion —
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate that the superposition of light polarization states is coherently transferred to electron spins in a semiconductor quantum well via the light-hole excitons under in-plane magnetic field by using time-resolved Kerr rotation.

articleTitle: Slow pulse propagation in long photonic crystal coupled cavity waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A pulse delay corresponding to a slow group velocity of ∼0.008c was observed in a low-loss coupled cavity waveguide formed by 60 photonic crystal nanocavities whose intrinsic Q was as high as 106.

articleTitle: A linearized phase-modulated analog optical link
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate a linearized phase-modulated analog link that achieves a fifth-order-limited spurious-free dynamic range of ~130 dB-Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4/5</sup>. This result represents a 17 dB improvement over conventional (single-detector) intensity-modulated links for the same received photocurrent.

articleTitle: Receiver sensitivity improvement using decision-aided maximum likelihood phase estimation in coherent optical DQPSK system with nonlinear phase noise
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose a decision-aided maximum likelihood phase estimation receiver for a nonlinear-phase-noise-dominant coherent optical DQPSK system, which requires only linear computation and improves the receiver sensitivity by 3 dB compared to differential detection.

articleTitle: Bit error rate calculation for a single sideband OFDM signal with direct detection optically pre-amplified receivers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We provide a fast and accurate BER calculation for a SSB-OFDM signal by considering the SNR of each subcarrier separately. The numerical results show that our scheme can accurately evaluate the BER for different QAM formats even under a strong optical filtering.

Index Terms: Optical Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing Signal

articleTitle: Analytical solution and design guideline for highly reflective subwavelength gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present an analytical solution for the reflectivity of a sub-wavelength grating in the case of transverse plane wave incidence and propose a design guideline for maximal reflectivity based on this solution.

articleTitle: Effect of fluorescently labeling protein probes on kinetics of protein-ligand reactions
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We study the kinetic effect of extrinsic fluorescent labeling agents on protein-ligand binding affinity and find that the kinetics is related to the loss or change of protein function when proteins are fluorescent-labeled.

articleTitle: Toward photonic crystal optical buffer
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Potential and possibility of a photonic crystal optical buffer is discussed and some recent advances are presented. A wideband dispersion-free tunable delay is experimentally demonstrated using SOI chirped photonic crystal coupled waveguides.

articleTitle: Sub-femtosecond timing distribution of an ultrafast optical pulse train over multiple fiber links
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: The distribution of ultrafast optical pulse trains across 300 meters of fiber with sub-femtosecond timing jitter and 83 femtoseconds of drift over 25 hours, as measured between the outputs from two independent links, is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Characterization of wavelength conversion by four wave mixing in silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We characterize a silicon based wavelength converter using a commercial semiconductor amplifier based wavelength converter as a benchmark. Results show that silicon achieves −5.5dB efficiency, offers broader conversion bandwidth, higher OSNR and negligible channel crosstalk.

articleTitle: All-optical clock recovery from both NRZ and NRZ-DPSK signals at different bit-rates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and demonstrate all-optical clock recovery (CR) from both NRZ and NRZ-DPSK signals at different bit-rates, through simply preprocessing with single optical filter. Clock signal can be extracted successfully by cascading a CR unit.

articleTitle: A novel high-Q resonator using high contrast subwavelength grating
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a novel high-Q resonator using high contrast subwavelength grating. The simulated Q-factor of the resonator can be as high as ∼500,000. A Q-factor of 14,000 is experimentally measured in fabricated devices.

articleTitle: Yellow frequency-doubled self-heated Yb fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: 1160 nm Yb fiber laser with 55% efficiency was realized. ASE was suppressed due to self-heating of the active fiber during lasing. Laser power of 9.1 W was converted to 860 mW at 580 nm.

articleTitle: Enhanced vertical extraction efficiency from a thin-film InGaN/GaN photonic crystal light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An InGaN/GaN thin-film light-emitting diode with the photonic crystal (PhC) on the surface and a TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> omnidirectional reflector on the bottom was fabricated and found the line-width emission spectrum of 5 nm by the PhC.

articleTitle: High power pulse amplification in Tm-doped fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report >20 W of average output power at 1.995 mum from a pulsed Tm-doped fiber amplifier system operating at 100 kHz. Pulse energies of >325 muJ have been generated at 50 kHz with 13 ns pulses in the same amplifier.

articleTitle: Fiber laser pumped high average power single-cycle THz pulse source
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Single-cycle THz radiation was generated by optical rectification of Yb-fiber laser pulses with 250 fs duration and 10 muJ energy. We obtained an average power of 0.5 mW at 1 MHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: 20–50 kHz mid-infrared OP-GaAs OPO
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: An efficient OP-GaAs OPO pumped by a high repetition rate (20-50 kHz) Q-switched Ho:YAG laser is presented. The slope efficiency is 53% at 20 kHz. Influence of pump polarization on OPO performance is tested.

articleTitle: Ultra-low power frequency conversion in high-index glass micro ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present the first demonstration of ultra-low power four-wave-mixing in a high-index glass micro-ring resonator (47.5 μm radius). By using a mW-level CW pump power we obtained an appreciable wavelength conversion in the C-band.

articleTitle: Aberration corrected ultra-compact ultra-large angle curved grating multiplexer and demultiplexer on SOI platform
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe a novel aberration free etched diffraction grating on SOI platform for on chip wavelength multiplexing and demultiplexing. Initial fabrication with 1 micron slit gives 200 GHz channel pass band with < 0.2 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> chip size.

articleTitle: Fiber Bragg grating interrogation for a sensing system based on a continuous-wave fourier domain mode locking fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A fiber Bragg grating sensing system is demonstrated based on a continuous-wave Fourier domain mode locking fiber laser. Fiber Bragg grating interrogation is realized by mapping wavelength measurement to time measurement with an oscilloscope.

articleTitle: Modeling and direct electric-field measurements of passively mode-locked quantum-dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A delay-differential equation model of a passively mode-locked quantum-dot laser reveals pulse asymmetry that is experimentally confirmed through direct electric-field measurements. This finding implies conventional autocorrelators obscure the underlying pulse structure.

articleTitle: Large Kerr nonlinearity in ultra-low loss high-index glass waveguides
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Using self-phase modulation measurements, we show that high-index glass waveguides are a promising nonlinear platform given their ultra-low loss and high nonlinear Kerr response, determined to be 150 times larger than that of optical fibers.

articleTitle: Fine frequency tuning and ±3 MHz frequency stabilisation of a nanosecond mid-infrared doubly resonant optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate 100 GHz continuous tuning and plusmn3 MHz frequency stabilization of the signal radiation delivered by an entangled cavity nanosecond OPO while the frequency fluctuation of the pump radiation is larger than 500 MHz.

articleTitle: Optical transitions in monolayer and bilayer graphene
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optical transitions in grapheme are studied by infrared spectroscopy. The interband transitions in graphene monolayers show a relatively flat spectrum, while those in bilayers are dominated by a van-Hove singularity.

articleTitle: Faraday isolators for high average power: State of the art
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We review all known approaches to suppress thermal effects in Faraday isolator: design with two TGG crystals, cooling to nitrogen temperature, disc geometry, non-traditional magneto-optics material, advanced permanent magnet design, and superconductive solenoid.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of semiconductor ring lasers with distributed Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Monolithic integration of 1.55-mum ring lasers with distributed Bragg reflectors (DBRs) and distributed feedback DFB lasers are presented. Such configurations show potential for mm-wave generation, wavelength tunability and are attractive for nonlinear dynamics studies in semiconductor lasers.

articleTitle: Bi2O3-based Erbium doped fiber laser with over 130 nm tunable range
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We have demonstrated Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-based Erbium doped fiber ring laser. Only 0.2-m of BIEDF as a gain media shows 134 nm tunable range and high signal-to-noise ration over 70 dB for 120 nm tunable range.

articleTitle: Saturated absorption spectroscopy of C2H2 inside a hollow, large-core Kagome photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Saturated absorption spectroscopy in acetylene-filled, 19-cell kagome-structured hollow core photonic crystal fiber is investigated. The large core size of ∼70 μm allows for narrow sub-Doppler features, and the wavelength-insensitive transmission is suitable for frequency measurements.

articleTitle: Flat-top pulse generation based on the combined action of active mode locking and nonlinear polarization rotation
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A pulsewidth tunable 10 GHz flat-top pulse train is generated based on the combined action of active mode locking and nonlinear-polarization-rotation pulse shaping. The SMSR is 65 dB and the timing jitter is 145 fs.

articleTitle: Single-mode laser emission from a multimode core surrounded by a tailored cladding
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report the transversally-single-mode laser emission from a large ytterbium-doped core exhibiting a normalized frequency of 7.25. Strong interaction between the core and an array of high refractive index rods leads to single-mode emission.

articleTitle: Triangular surface-relief grating for reduction of reflection from silicon surface in the 0.1–3 terahertz region
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A triangular surface-relief grating is proposed to reduce reflection from a silicon surface for the light in the terahertz frequency region. Optimum structural parameters of the grating have been numerically determined and confirmed experimentally.

articleTitle: Investigation of bandwidth limitations in separate absorption, charge and multiplication (SACM) avalanche photodiodes (APD)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Bandwidth limitations of SACM-APDs are investigated using an energy balance transport model. A methodology to improve device performance based on the analysis of internal device currents is presented.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion module with +4 dB gain using direct-bonded QPM-Zn: LiNbO3 ridge waveguide
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We fabricate a fiber-coupled module using a highly damage resistant LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ridge waveguide. A low insertion loss (-4 dB) and sufficient parametric conversion gain (+8 dB) enable us to achieve a wavelength converter with +4 dB fiber-to-fiber gain.

articleTitle: Creating and fixing a metal nanoparticle layer on the holes of microstructured fibers for plasmonic applications
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Methods to insert, keep and fix silver and gold nanoparticles to the inner walls of microstructured fibers are demonstrated. Fibers optimized for evanescent field interaction were employed and can result in efficient plasmonic chemical sensing.

articleTitle: Terahertz vibrational modes in non-polar non-hydrogen-bonding crystalline solids
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We observe terahertz vibrational modes in crystals of n-octadecane, a non-hydrogen-bonding, non-polar molecule. These modes are not present in amorphous samples.

articleTitle: Passive mode locking of optical parametric oscillators: An efficient technique for generating sub-picosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We show that gain in an OPO with a large walkoff between the pump and signal saturates just like a laser gain and thus CW pumped OPO can be directly mode-locked with high conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Trap stiffness in negative Optoelectronic Tweezers (OET)
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Optoelectronic tweezers (OET) allow the control of micron-sized particles suspended in a liquid by controlling the dielectrophoretic force with the selective illumination of a photoconductor. High liquid conductivities give a negative force (away from illuminated areas) so that particles are trapped by illuminating a ring around them. This paper explores the force profile of these traps and shows that high stiffness traps can be created (8times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> Nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>), with a linear profile, at low optical powers (8.29 muW).

articleTitle: Femtosecond and nanosecond laser-induced nanoeffects for cell surgery and modification of glass
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Both femtosecond and nanosecond pulses can create low-density plasmas in transparent dielectrics suitable for nano-cell surgery and modification of glasses. The variation of mechanisms with pulse repetition rate and duration is discussed.

articleTitle: 32 W femtosecond Yb-fiber CPA system based on chirped-volume-Bragg-gratings
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Femtosecond (∼670 fs) fiber-CPA at 1.063 μm is demonstrated using broadband chirped-volume-Bragg-gratings for pulse stretching and compression. 32 W recompressed pulses are achieved corresponding to a 75% compression efficiency.

articleTitle: Quantitative blood flow measurements with Multi-Exposure Speckle contrast imaging
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a new multi-exposure speckle imaging instrument and a new speckle model to predict correlation times of flow consistently (within 10% deviation) in the presence of static scatterers such as an intact/thinned skull.

articleTitle: Large-scale high-index-contrast planar lightwave circuits
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Large scale optical integration is enabled by high index contrast materials and building blocks. We highlight recent advances in the miniaturization of optical elements and of dense integration of planar lightwave circuits for Telecommunications and RF Photonic applications.

articleTitle: Effects of gamma irradiation on optical properties of CdSe/ZnS colloidal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Effects of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">137</sup>Cs gamma irradiation on photoluminescent properties of CdSe/ZnS colloidal quantum dots are reported. Optical degradation was evaluated by measuring dependence of photoluminescence intensity on irradiation dose. CdSe/ZnS quantum dots show poor radiation hardness.

articleTitle: Excimer laser micromachining of glass substrates
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Excimer laser machining of microvias and tracks in CMZ glass (100 mum thick) at 248 nm has been investigated and optimised in order to minimise hole taper, microcracking and debris.

articleTitle: 11 MW pico-second pulses with ≫70 W average power from a phase-conjugate Nd:YVO4 bounce laser system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A 78.5 W pico-second master-oscillator power-amplifier system based on a Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> bounce amplifier with a phase conjugator was demonstrated. The peak power of the output pulses was 8-11 MW in a pulse-repetition-frequency region of 0.7-1 MHz.

articleTitle: Polarisation mode converter monolithically integrated within a semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: A monolithically integrated, compact, polarisation mode converter is incorporated within a Fabry-Perot semiconductor laser diode. The predominant polarisation states of the optical output from each facet are observed to be orthogonal.

articleTitle: High-speed switching of a 1.55-μm symmetric SEED
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate high-speed switching of a symmetric self-electrooptic effect device (S-SEED) operating at 1550 nm. Transitions faster than 10 ps are observed, verifying the suitability of this technology for integrated logic operations beyond 40 GHz.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal optofluidics for high throughput biosensing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: Photonic crystal reflectance filters are co-fabricated/integrated with microfluidic channels that enable selective tuning of resonant reflectance spectra on flexible, transparent plastic substrates. Label-free biodetection within the fluid network is demonstrated as an exemplary application.

articleTitle: Fabrication of site-controlled, highly uniform, and dense InGaN quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report fabrication of site-controlled, highly uniform and dense (≫=1e10/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) InGaN multiple stacks of quantum dots using selective area epitaxy in MOCVD. The dot height and lateral dimension are 3 nm and 30 nm, respectively.

articleTitle: The Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA) on NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) mission
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We describe the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter instrument on NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter mission, scheduled to launch in October 2008, which will provide a precise lunar high-resolution global topographic map using laser altimetry.

articleTitle: 10 W average power frequency comb with sub-mHz relative linewidths from an Yb:fiber system
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We present a fully phase-stabilized frequency comb with 10 W average power and 136 MHz repetition rate produced by a Yb:fiber system. Direct comparison with an octave-spanning Ti:sapphire comb yields record-low sub-mHz relative linewidths for frequency combs.

articleTitle: Eight-channel microring resonator array with accurately controlled channel spacing
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We demonstrate accurately spaced 8-channel micro-ring resonators on a silicon-on-insulator platform via thermal tuning. The thermal cross talk between adjacent micro heaters is small.

articleTitle: Radiation pressure force measurement at the thermal noise limit
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We report radiation force measurements to a precision of 100 femto-Newton using a high Q torsion balance oscillator. The opto-mechanically coupled oscillator can be cooled down to a temperature of 300 milli-Kelvin.

articleTitle: Switchable single-longitudinal-mode dual-wavelength fiber ring laser using hybrid gain medium
publicationTitle: 2008 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2008 Conference on Quantum Electronics and Laser Science
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel single-longitudinal-mode dual-wavelength erbium-doped fiber ring laser incorporating a semiconductor optical amplifier. The dual-wavelength output with 40-GHz wavelength spacing is switchable in the range of 1533 nm-1565 nm.
